episodes.title: The Man who is Loved by his Ship! Usopp's Tears!
episodes.description: Usopp believes that the person who repaired the Going Merry in Skypeia was really the Going Merry itself. Franky says that the ship was inhabited by a spirit who enters ships who are dearly cared for. The spirit repaired their ship just enough for them to reach the next island. The doorbell rings from the sea side and CP9 enter.

episodes.title: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train Ran
episodes.description: CP9 discover Franky's hidden room and he fears they'll trample his memories. A long flashback ensues, covering Franky's past in Tom's Workers and how he and Iceburg helped create the Sea Train.

episodes.title: Spandam's Conspiracy! The Day the Sea Train Shook
episodes.description: (Franky's flashback) Spandam, a CP5 representative, was determined to get Tom proven guilty in his trial so he could get the blueprints. As Franky walked into the town, people from the government began to attack with the battleships he had personally constructed. Tom and Iceburg run to their shipyard where they are attacked by two ships which also destroy the others. Iceburg tells Franky that he has to take responsibility or he will never forgive him.

episodes.title: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried
episodes.description: (Franky's flashback) Franky said that if a ship of his were to be used as a weapon, then it's no longer one of his ships. That enraged Tom and he punched Franky for the first time, telling him he had to take pride in the ships he created. He then told the judge that he would accept the punishment for both his previous crime and the recent attack. Franky tried to stop the train to Enies Lobby with his bare hands.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Betrayal! Robin's Sorrowful Decision!
episodes.description: Chopper escapes the burning building with Paulie and Iceburg on his back and collapses outside. Iceburg makes it clear to Nami that Robin wanted to recover the blueprints and to do that, she wanted her companions to leave the island without her. Nami rushes to tell Chopper so they can go looking for the rest of the crew. Elsewhere, the foremen let go of the Going Merry so she would be destroyed at sea.

episodes.title: The Steam Whistle Separates the Group! The Sea Train Begins to Run
episodes.description: Paulie helps clear the name of the Straw Hats but does not tell the mob everything he knows. He gets the mob to follow Chopper so they can search for the rest of the crew. Nami goes her own way so she can rush to the Sea Train. As Nami nears the station, Sanji, ahead of her, approaches the train.

episodes.title: Sanji Breaks In! The Sea Train Battle in the Storm!
episodes.description: Nami and the conductors are rescued by Paulie when the Aqua Laguna floods the main station. A man hands Nami a letter he found from Sanji. It informs her that Usopp, Franky, and he are on board the train that had just departed. On board, he storms the cars. High up in the city, Nami speaks with Kokoro and spots Luffy, stuck in between two buildings, in the back streets where the Aqua Laguna will hit first.

episodes.title: The Shout of Nami's Soul! The Return of the Straw Hat!
episodes.description: Nami finally reaches Luffy and tells him that he needs to hurry before Robin reaches Enies Lobby. Chopper finds Zoro and hands him the Sandai Kitetsu so he can escape the chimney. Luffy pushes apart the buildings he was stuck between and Paulie grabs them all so they can escape the Aqua Laguna's massive wave.

episodes.title: Another Sea Train! Rocket Man Sortie
episodes.description: Sanji fights his way through another train car and finds Usopp and Franky. Seeing how determined Luffy is to save Robin, Kokoro and Iceburg lends the Straw Hat crew the use of another sea train, Rocket Man. The Franky Family shows up, pleading with Luffy to let them join them because they'll do anything for their leader.

episodes.title: Rescue our Friends! The Oath that Links the Enemies
episodes.description: The Rocket Man finally makes it out to sea. As the train connects with the tracks, Luffy has to rescue Chimney before she's thrown off by the wind. In the meantime, Iceburg has a flashback about when he finally met Franky again in Water 7. With Luffy and Chimney safe in the train, Paulie tells his fellow carpenters who the real culprits were. The Straw Hats, Franky Family, and Galley La Company form an alliance.

episodes.title: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro, The Strongest Combo!
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro perform a move that acts similar to a cannon and blasts a hole through the wall of the tidal wave ahead of them, opening up a channel for them to pass through. They miraculously pass through unscathed and the passengers rejoice. Sanji contacts the rest of the crew and fills them in on his current situation. Usopp separates from them but later, when Sanji and Franky are spotted, a man named Sogeking comes to their rescue.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sogeking!
episodes.description: Sogeking makes his grand entrance. Franky and Sanji aren't fooled by his costume but they try to humor him. They devise a plan first, then detach the last two cars and fight their way through the rest. Back in the Rocket Man, Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Chopper get an outfit change; Nami shows off the weapon Usopp upgraded for her while he was still with them.

episodes.title: Cook Confrontation! Sanji vs Ramen Kenpo
episodes.description: Kalifa updates the CP9 on the situation with Franky, Sanji, and Usopp. Sanji tells Franky and Usopp to go on without him so he can fight Wanze and his "Ramen Kenpo". Franky begins to fight Nero, CP9's "Weasel", and Sogeking meets with Robin.

episodes.title: Duel on the Roof! Franky vs Nero!
episodes.description: Franky's fight with Nero continues. Nero discovers that Franky's weak spot is his back, so Franky lies down flat so he cannot get to it. Nero demands that he fight seriously, so Franky gets up to perform his "Centaur" form. Sogeking talks with Robin and tells her that the crew knows about her reasons for leaving. Those on the Rocket Man encounter the discarded cars and Zoro slices them so they can pass.

episodes.title: Crash! Demon-Cutting Zoro vs Ship-Cutting T-Bone!
episodes.description: Zoro clashes with "Ship Cutter" T-Bone. The fight is short and Zoro joins the crew again in the Rocket Man. On the Puffing Tom, Sanji beats Wanze beautiful, though Wanze thinks he's ruined his face. Franky finally gains the upper hand against Nero and defeats him. After beating their respective opponents, Franky and Sanji stand to fight against the other CP9.

episodes.title: Robin Struggles! Sogeking's Clever Scheme!!
episodes.description: After hiding under Robin's cloak for a few episodes, Sogeking finally shows himself. They stumble into the room with the CP9 and meet with Sanji and Franky. Sogeking produces a smokescreen. The four head into another car, detach it, and escape. It's not long before Blueno pulls their car back, though. Franky knocks down the wall so they can escape but ends up on the enemy car. Blueno opens a door then back in the Straw Hat car.

episodes.title: The Judiciary Island! The Full Picture of Enies Lobby!
episodes.description: Robin willingly follows Blueno into his improvised door and Sogeking and Sanji are left alone. For a while, Blueno explains a little of Robin's past involving the Buster Call. Back at the Rocket Man, Yokuzuna the frog jumps onto the front of the train, knocking them from the rails. After Kokoro speaks with him, he joins the group. The CP9, Franky, and Robin finally reach Enies Lobby and disembark.

episodes.title: Operation Disembarkation Commences! The Straw Hat Crew Rushes In!
episodes.description: Luffy and the others finally catch up to Sanji, Usopp, and the rest of the Franky Family as they near Enies Lobby. Paulie sits down with the group and talks about their plan. Luffy does not bother to follow the plan, and slingshots himself beyond the gates before the train stops.

episodes.title: Luffy Charges In! Great Decisive Battle on the Judiciary Island!
episodes.description: Spandam is informed that an intruder has entered the area. Luffy confuses the Marines guarding the entrance gate by manipulating one of their own comrades to fight against them. The rest of Luffy's group come in after he already slingshot himself over the gates. Because they aren't all quite as limber as Luffy, they have to band together to get inside. Giant Gate Keepers Kaashii and Oimo come to fight the Franky Family.

episodes.title: Battle with the Giants! Open the Second Door!
episodes.description: In a David and Goliath turn around, the Franky Family and Galley La bring down Kaashi. Spandam receives an incomplete report about Luffy and believes that he's no longer a threat. The Cipher Pol 9 members meet with Spandam and it looks more like a comedy routine than a briefing.

episodes.title: The Means of Escaping is Opened! Fly through the Sky, Rocketman!
episodes.description: While Robin and Franky are brought before Spandam, Luffy blasts his way through another wave of marines. In order to get past the gate, Zoro orders that they just keep going. Yokozuna the frog bends down the outside gates and they fly over the gate inside. Back on the ground, Paulie is stabbed by someone from "The Law's Watch Dogs", the Houbantai. The Rocket Man flies over the gate and the point of the train smashes into Oimo's back, knocking him out cold.

episodes.title: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hat Pirates' All-Out War
episodes.description: As the title of the episode suggests, the Straw Hats enter an all-out war to catch up with Luffy, albeit a humorous one; Sanji and Zoro bicker over who's more dangerous, Nami injures her own comrades with her improved weapon, and Sogeking fails at being a decoy. The Houbantai show up to stop them and the foremen of Galley La stay behind to fight.

episodes.title: Robin was Betrayed! The Expectations of the World Government!
episodes.description: Robin questions why Spandam was given rights to the Buster Call. The CP9 plan to kill the Straw Hats because they violated the original arrangement; that they entered Enies Lobby after leaving Water 7. Back in the fray, Franky's Giant Bulls talk with Chopper. He translates and they notice that Sogeking is not with them anymore. Elsewhere, Blueno appears before Luffy.

episodes.title: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
episodes.description: For a while, Sogeking talks with Oimo about how he and Kaashi came to support the marines and hears a familiar story. The majority of the episode is a Little Garden flashback. Soddom the Giant Bull takes severe damage and urges those riding him to run before he collapses. Back at the fight between Blueno and Luffy, Luffy throws the first punch to initiate the battle.

episodes.title: Don't Stop! Raise the Signal Fire of a Counterattack!
episodes.description: Kokoro contacts the Straw Hats by way of Nami's baby den den mushi. The Franky family decide to lower the inner bridge so the others can enter the courthouse first. After Gomorrah is blinded, Sogeking arrives with the giants as back up. Shortly after, Gomorrah tells those riding him to hold on, as he plans to take them to the courthouse. Inside, Spandam gives Kaku and Kalifa Devil's Fruits.

episodes.title: Luffy is in Sight! Gather at the Courthouse Plaza
episodes.description: Although Gomorrah was blinded, he continues to rush ahead. Spandam receives word of their progress right as the Straw Hats reach the gate. Zoro slices right through it and while up top, Luffy activates "Gear Second".

episodes.title: All for the Sake of Protecting My Friends! Gear Second in Motion
episodes.description: The Straw Hats enter and Yokozuna the frog and the Franky Family stay behind at the door to watch their backs. The three-headed judge attempts to stop them but the Franky Family holds him off. Elsewhere, Luffy's Gear Second is put into action, ultimately defeating Blueno without having to activate Gear Third.

episodes.title: Answer Us, Robin! The Outcries of the Straw Hat Crew!!
episodes.description: Franky helps Robin escape from their chains and they make it outside to see Luffy. Luffy wants to come over to rescue Robin but she tells him to stay, that she only wants to die. Below, as Yokozuna falls, the giants come to cover. All the Straw hats arrive on the roof, and ask Robin to return.

episodes.title: Robin's Past! The Girl who was Called a Demon!
episodes.description: 20 years ago, on the West Blue island of Ohara, Nico Robin becomes an archaeologist, but Professor Clover forbids her from researching the Void Century. She meets the giant Saul who has washed up on the beach. Meanwhile, Spandine is just off the coast of Ohara.

episodes.title: The Fated Parent and Child! The Mother's Name is Olvia!
episodes.description: Robin continues talking with Saul, and Saul is shocked to learn that Robin is Nico Olvia's daughter and that he is on Ohara. Olvia returns to Ohara to warn the other scholars that the World Government's forces are headed there. She decides not to reveal herself to Robin, not wanting her daughter to be branded a criminal because of her. CP9 arrives on the island, capturing Olvia and rounding up the scholars.

episodes.title: Tragedy of Ohara! Fear of Buster Call!
episodes.description: Clover reveals that the Poneglyphs were most likely carved by an ancient country in order to prevent their enemy, the World Government, from completely erasing their history, but is shot by Spandine, who then activates the Golden Den Den Mushi. Robin recognizes Olvia as her mother, but Olvia denies it, causing Robin to admit that she is an archaeologist and can read the Poneglyphs. The Buster Call commences, and, after a tearful reunion with her daughter, Olvia entrusts Saul with Robin's care.

episodes.title: Say You Want to Live! We are Friends!!
episodes.description: Robin finishes her story and says that while she considers the Straw Hats her friends, she believes that one day, they will be no longer able to protect her from her pursuers, and betray her like the others did. After Spandam points out that taking in Robin means declaring war on the entire world, Luffy tells Sogeking to shoot the World Government flag. Sogeking uses his Sure-kill Firebird Star to burn up the flag, declaring war on the world for Robin's sake. Robin, moved by the depth of Luffy's action, cries out that she wants to live and return to the sea with Luffy, and Luffy and the others prepare to do battle with CP9 and save Robin.

episodes.title: Jump Into the Falls! Luffy's Feelings!!
episodes.description: Luffy's backstory.

episodes.title: A Man's Way of Life! Zoro's Techniques, Usopp's Dream
episodes.description: Zoro and Usopp's backstories.

episodes.title: Tears Which Weaved the Bond of Comrades! Nami's World Map
episodes.description: Nami's backstory.

episodes.title: Separation Refines a Man! Sanji and Chopper
episodes.description: The backstories to Sanji and Chopper.

episodes.title: All for my Comrades' Sake! The Darkness Within Robin!
episodes.description: The reasons for Nico Robin's recent actions, as well as a summary of her back story.

episodes.title: The Blueprints Aren't Passed! Franky's Decision
episodes.description: After Robin decides she wants to live, the Straw Hats wait for the bridge so they can battle CP9. Franky reveals that the Pluton blueprints are with him and burns them in front of Spandam, saying that he's betting it all on the Straw hats. With unexpected help from Kokoro, Franky and the Straw Hats make a dramatic entrance into the Tower of Justice.

episodes.title: Retrieve the 5 Keys! The Straw Hat Crew vs CP9
episodes.description: The Straw Hats and Franky made it to the Tower of Justice. However, Fukurou reveals that one of the CP9 members has the key to Robin's handcuffs, and will not say which, so the Straw Hats must fight every member to find the key. Meanwhile, Chimney follows Spandam and Lucci down a secret corridor.

episodes.title: Power of the Devil Fruit! Kaku and Jyabura Transform
episodes.description: Zoro begins his intense battle with Kaku, and Sogeking fails to retrieve the key from a sleeping Jabra. Kaku reveals his Devil Fruit power and causes the floor to collapse in the process. Meanwhile, Luffy searches high and low in the Tower of Justice, and attempts to cross the whirlpools to the Bridge of Hesitation.

episodes.title: Even if I Die, I Won't Kick You! Sanji's Manly Chivalry
episodes.description: Nami barely escapes from Kumadori, stealing his key in the process. Kaku utilizes his new body to cut the Tower of Justice in half, and Sanji attempts to get the key from Kalifa.

episodes.title: Fukurou's Miscalculation - My Cola is the Water of Life!
episodes.description: Chimney and Gombe show Luffy the secret passage that leads to Robin; Franky puts on a display of raw punching power.

episodes.title: Zoro's New Technique Explodes! The Katana's Name is Sogeking?
episodes.description: Franky's brawl spills into the ocean; Usopp and Sanji attempt to overcome their handcuffs by outsmarting their opponents.

episodes.title: Uncontrollable! Chopper's Forbidden Rumble
episodes.description: After Chopper's first Rumble ball wears off and his second fails he is forced to break a promise to Dr. Kureha. He uses his third Rumble Ball in a row and transform into his most powerful and deadly form: Monster Point.

episodes.title: Boss Luffy Returns! A Dream or Reality Lottery Trouble
episodes.description: A madcap adventure starring the Straw Hats; A camel that eats lottery tickets.

episodes.title: The Great Mochimaki Race to the Castle! Conspiracy of the Red Nose
episodes.description: The madcap throwback continues as Luffy and the gang competes for a priceless treasure hidden inside a tasty snack.

episodes.title: Bubble User Kalifa! Nami Draws Near to the Soap's Trap
episodes.description: Nami battles a bathing beauty and her lethal bubbles; Chopper unleashes his inner beast; Luffy inches even closer to catching up with Robin.

episodes.title: The Resounding Bad News! The Buster Call is Invoked
episodes.description: Spandam accidentally invokes the Buster Call on Enies Lobby with the Golden Den Den Mushi. He also accidentally informs everyone on the island of the coming destruction.

episodes.title: 5 Namis? Counterattack with the Mirage!
episodes.description: Zoro uses Usopp as a decoy in his beast battle; Nami discovers a secret.

episodes.title: Nami's Determination! Shoot the Rampaging Chopper!
episodes.description: Franky and Nami form a plan to stop Choppers rampage; Usopp and Zoro spend time apart.

episodes.title: Hunter Sanji Appears? Elegy to the Lying Wolf
episodes.description: Usopp's life is saved by a familiar foot; Luffy struggles to hit a formidable foe.

episodes.title: Kick! Full Course of Sanji's Footwork
episodes.description: Sanji uses the Devil's leg to even the odds.

episodes.title: The Drawn Sword's Fierce Attack! Zoro vs. Kaku Powerful Slash Showdown
episodes.description: The battle between Zoro and Kaku rages on. Meanwhile Franky finally reaches Luffy.

episodes.title: Zoro the Fierce God! The Incarnation of Asura Revealed by His Soul
episodes.description: Zoro unleashes a demonic nine-sword fighting style on his giraffe opponent. Meanwhile Luffy activates Gear Second in his fight against Rob Lucci, who transforms into his half-leopard form.

episodes.title: Spandam's Shock! A Hero Stands on the Tower of Justice
episodes.description: Robin finds out that Spandam is the son of Spandine, the man who invoked the buster call on Ohara. Sogeking stops Spandam with his Kabuto and saves Robin, while Franky releases her Seastone handcuffs. Now free to use her Devil Fruit powers again, Robin finally releases her anger on Spandam with her Seis Fleur Slap. However, the Buster Call on Enies Lobby has just begun.

episodes.title: Robin's Liberation! Luffy vs. Lucci: Peak of the Decisive Battle
episodes.description: Luffy's battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man's second gear; Spandam's thoughtless Buster Call begins.

episodes.title: The Criminal is Boss Luffy? Chase the Vanished Great Sakura Tree
episodes.description: An ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time.

episodes.title: If I Can't Win, I Can't Protect Anyone! Gear Third Activates
episodes.description: While Sanji and the others are trapped in a tunnel with water pouring in, Luffy activates Gear Third in the battle against Lucci.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Past! Dark Justice and Rob Lucci
episodes.description: The past of Rob Lucci is told by the commander of the Marines.

episodes.title: A Phantom Mermaid is Here? Within Fading Consciousness
episodes.description: Robin rejoins the fight; the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater.

episodes.title: The Island Sinking in Gunfire! Franky's Outcry of Regret
episodes.description: Thanks to a Mermaid the Straw Hats make it safely to the ship. However, Luffy is still fighting Lucci in the first tower of the Bridge of Hesitation.

episodes.title: Wait for Luffy! Fight to the Death on the Bridge of Hesitation!
episodes.description: Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point during his battle with Rob Lucci; the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines.

episodes.title: Feelings Put Into Fists! Luffy's Full-Power Gatling
episodes.description: Usopp's desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final attack on Rob Lucci.

episodes.title: A Friend Approaches from the Sea! The Straw Hat Crew's Strongest Bonds
episodes.description: The Straw Hats must throw themselves into the sea to survive.

episodes.title: The Crew's Great Escape! The Victor's Path is for the Pirates
episodes.description: With the arrival of Going Merry, the Straw Hats make their great escape from Enies Lobby. Thanks to Sanji and his clever strategy of closing the Gates of Justice, the Marines are unable to get a clear shot at Merry.

episodes.title: Thank You Merry! The Sea of Separation in the Snow
episodes.description: The Going Merry cracks and breaks under her own weight, and the crew say their own farewells as they give the ship a Viking funeral, finally putting her to rest. As she goes up in flames, Merry apologizes and then thanks the Staw Hats for treasuring her for so long.

episodes.title: The Disturbance of Peace! The Vice-Admiral with the Fist of Love
episodes.description: The Straw Hats get some much needed rest; Franky makes a big announcement; Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson.

episodes.title: The Strongest Family Line? Luffy's Father Revealed!
episodes.description: Luffy's friends learn that Luffy's grandfather is a marine hero, Luffy learns who his father is.

episodes.title: Its Name is The New World! The Whereabouts of the Great Grand Line!
episodes.description: Luffy has the chance to catch up on things with his old friend Coby; Nami does some serious snooping around.

episodes.title: Shanks Moves! Ceremony to the Rampaging Age
episodes.description: Shanks visits Whitebeard with a serious request; Franky and Iceberg begin construction on a ship.

episodes.title: The Girl Searching for the Yagara! Great Investigation in the Water Metropolis!
episodes.description: Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet.

episodes.title: The Mother is Strong! Zoro's Slapstick Housework Help
episodes.description: Zoro's day is ruined by a group of orphans as he searches for a new sword.

episodes.title: Sanji Crashes! The Mysterious Old Man and Intense Cooking
episodes.description: While out shopping with Chimney, Sanji is persuaded by her to go to a good cook whom which she calls grandpa, the old man teaches Sanji the reason why his food tastes so good, salt which is produced by the Aqua Laguna.

episodes.title: Everyone's Finally Wanted! The Crew of Over Six Hundred Million!
episodes.description: Franky and Iceberg stay up all night, trying to see who can do the most work to finish the new ship for the Straw Hats.

episodes.title: The King of Beasts that will Cross the Ocean! The Dream Ship's Magnificent Completion!
episodes.description: Luffy and the rest of the Staw Hats prepare to set sail on their newly completed ship; Franky discovers that he now is wanted by the government.

episodes.title: Goodbye my Lovable Followers! Franky Departs
episodes.description: The Straw Hats press Franky to leave with them.

episodes.title: Departing the Water Metropolis! Distinction of the Manly Usopp's Duel
episodes.description: While awaiting the return of Usopp, Luffy and the Straw Hats face a barrage of cannon fire by the marines.

episodes.title: The World-Wide Bounties! The Hometowns Dance as the Ship Sails Forward!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats choose a name for their new ship, the crew has a chance to show off the ship during battle with the marines.

episodes.title: The Most Evil Ability! Blackbeard's Darkness Attacks Ace
episodes.description: Blackbeard and Ace match their devil fruit powers against each other.

episodes.title: Mysterious Party of Pirates! The Sunny and a Dangerous Trap
episodes.description: The Straw Hats try to help another ships crew.

episodes.title: Sunny in a Pinch! Roar, Secret Superspeed Mecha
episodes.description: The Straw Hats are lead into a trap when they encounter what appears to be marines.

episodes.title: The Dream Sinking in the New World! The Pirate of Despair, Puzzle
episodes.description: The captain of the Phoenix Pirates loses his will to fight; The Straw Hats try to figure out the Iceberg trap.

episodes.title: The Assassins Attack! The Great Battle Above the Ice Begins
episodes.description: Using the Shark Submerge III, Nami and Franky find out that penguins are moving the icebergs. Afterwards, they are attacked by Hockera. Usopp and Sanji are knocked off the Thousand Sunny by an iceberg, and encounter Salchow and Arbell.

episodes.title: The Hard Fights of the Straw Hat Crew! The Pirate Soul Banking it All on the Flag!
episodes.description: The fights continue with Luffy, distracted due to the lost flag, has initial trouble with Brindo, but the Phoenix Pirates help capture him.

episodes.title: Hot Full Throttle! The Twins' Magnetic Power Draws Near
episodes.description: Luffy battles a set of magnetic twins; Zorro drinks with the man who stole the Straw Hats Flag.

episodes.title: The Great Chaos Mansion! The Angry Don and the Imprisoned Crew
episodes.description: Robin's cola care package helps spring her friends from an icy prison; Luffy's bold words inspire a battered and beaten pirate to keep fighting.

episodes.title: The Phoenix Returns! The Dream of the Pirate Flag Sworn to a Friend
episodes.description: Luffy continues his battle with the magnetic twins; Chopper uses a rumble ball in his battle with a hockey player.

episodes.title: The Red Hot Decisive Battle! Luffy vs. the Scorching Don
episodes.description: Luffy battles an opponent too hot to handle; Robin is attacked by a jungle when a little girl does not get her way; Chopper makes a heroic dash.

episodes.title: Waiting in the New World! Farewell to the Courageous Pirates
episodes.description: Luffy's battle with Papa threatens to destroy the entire icy island.

episodes.title: Chopperman Departs! Protect the TV Station by the Shore
episodes.description: Chopperman must battle a hideously evil villain to regain control of his favorite tv station.

episodes.title: Venture Into the Devil's Sea! The Mysterious Skeleton Floating Through the Fog
episodes.description: The crew is surrounded by a dense fog and they meet skeleton Brook, who tells them his sad story.

episodes.title: The Delight of Having Met People! The Gentleman Skeleton's True Colors
episodes.description: The Straw Hats attempt to unravel the mystery of their new comrade then discover that they have a problem.

episodes.title: One Phenomenon After Another! Disembarking at Thriller Bark
episodes.description: After getting stranded at Thriller Bark, Chopper, Nami, and Usopp are chased by a three headed beast. Back on the boat, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats are terrorized by an unseen enemy!

episodes.title: The Man Called a Genius! Hogback Appears!
episodes.description: Chopper, Nami, and Usopp get scared out of their minds when they encounter a graveyard full of zombies! Meanwhile, the rest of the crew gets trapped in super creepy sea web!

episodes.title: Nami in Big Trouble! The Zombie Mansion and the Invisible Man
episodes.description: Nami, Usopp and Chopper meet Dr Hogback and they spend a crazy night in his castle. The rest of the crew is crossing the forest in order to rescue them.

episodes.title: Mystery of the Zombies! Hogback's Nightmarish Research Laboratory
episodes.description: The Straw Hats discover who the creator of the Zombies is.

episodes.title: His Name is Moria! Trap of the Great Shadow-Stealing Pirate
episodes.description: The Straw Hats find out that they were specifically lured to this strange place.

episodes.title: Feast of the Zombie Song! The Bell of the Night Raid is a Sound of Darkness
episodes.description: Usopp, Chopper, and Nami get trapped in a coffin after being slashed by a zombie samurai. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats make short work of some haunted paintings!

episodes.title: A Bunch of Animals? Perona's Wonder Garden!
episodes.description: Usopp, Chopper and Nami do battle with a garden full of adorably dead zombie animals.

episodes.title: Disappearing Strawhat Crew! The Mysterious Swordsman Appears!
episodes.description: A mysterious swordsman appears during the fights, Luffy has a encounter he may not be able to escape from.

episodes.title: Leftover Chivalry! The Traitorous Zombie who Protects Nami
episodes.description: Robin and Franky end up having to deal with the giant spider zombie while Luffy is turned into a zombie and expected to fight his fellow Straw Hats.

episodes.title: Coming from the Sky! That Man is the Humming Swordsman
episodes.description: Nami gives love advice to a zombie; Luffy finds himself face-to-face with Gecko Moria; Robin gets caught in a spookyspider web.

episodes.title: Luffy in an Emergency! The Living Place of the Strongest Shadow!
episodes.description: Brook strikes the final blow in his battle with the spider monkey, Gecko Moria's plan is revealed. Luffy almost escapes.

episodes.title: The Warrior Known as the Devil!! The Moment of Oars' Revival!
episodes.description: Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying Zombies; Gecko Moria revels the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy's shadow.

episodes.title: Awakening After 500 Years!! Oars Opens His Eyes!!
episodes.description: After Luffy's shadow is forced into a monster, Nami is kidnapped and Usopp and Chopper try to rescue her.

episodes.title: Conviction Strong Enough to Beg for One's Life!! Brook Protects his Afro
episodes.description: Gecko Moria's minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie.

episodes.title: A Man's Oath will Never Die! From Far Memories to the Waiting Friend
episodes.description: Luffy, Zorro and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing; Franky relates to Brooks story about a promise he made to a very special whale.

episodes.title: We will Definately Meet Again! Brook and the Promise of the Cape
episodes.description: Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the story of Laboon the abandoned whale; revelations about Brook's battle with the zombie samurai.

episodes.title: Food, Nami, and Shadows!! Luffy's Enraged Counterattack
episodes.description: Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince the walking skeleton Brooks to become a member of his crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop the Zombie leader from his plan to marry Nami.

episodes.title: Usopp the Strongest? Leave the Negatives to Me
episodes.description: Usopp surprises everyone when he encounters the ghosts.

episodes.title: The General Zombies Are Down In A Flash!! Oars Feels Like An Adventure!!
episodes.description: Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai; Luffy prepares for his battle; Sanji interrupts the undead wedding.

episodes.title: Blazing Knight Sanji!! Kick Down The Fake Wedding
episodes.description: Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria; Sanji's passionate attempt to defeat Nami's beastly abductor.

episodes.title: Invisibility Connection? Sanji's Stolen Dream
episodes.description: Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible; Usopp battles with a zombie bear.

episodes.title: Saving Hero!! The Enemy is the Invincible Princess
episodes.description: Usopp battles the ghost girl and tries to discover the secret of her sudden confidence.

episodes.title: Perona's Terror!! The U in Uso is the U in Usopp
episodes.description: Usopp reaches deep into himself to help even the odds during his battle with the tricky Perona; Luffy finds during his battle that even laying a finger on Gecko Moria may be a major problem.

episodes.title: Slashes Dancing on the Roof!! Finale - Zoro vs. Ryuma
episodes.description: Ryuma and Zoro duel in Hogback's laboratory while Franky guards the injured Brook. Neither opponent is able to gain over the other during the fight. Their attacks on each other quickly destroy the lab.

episodes.title: Chopper is Furious!! Hogback's Evil Medical Practices
episodes.description: Dr Hogback tells Chopper how he met Cindri. Chopper goes mad and bids Cindry to rebel against her zombie nature. Robin fools Hogback so he makes Sanji and Zoro's zombies fall from the tower. Luffy finally faces Oars.

episodes.title: Oars Roars!! Come Out Straw Hat Crew
episodes.description: Moria's mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy's shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji's eyes!

episodes.title: The Enemy is Luffy!! The Strongest Zombie vs. the Straw Hat Crew
episodes.description: One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy's got his sights set on Moria, but he'd better hurry if he wants to save his crew!

episodes.title: You're Going Down, Absalom!! Nami's Lightning Attack of Friendship!!
episodes.description: Absalom is about to kiss Nami when she wakes up and suddenly Lola appears and pretends to fight Nami so she can escape. Absalom falls under Nami's lightning bolt while the rest of the straw hat crew is gathering to stop Oars.

episodes.title: One Down!! Sure Kill Straw Hat Docking?
episodes.description: Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure; Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient; a heroic team battle against Oars in a effort to topple him.

episodes.title: Soundless Invasion!! The Mysterious Visitor: Kuma the Tyrant
episodes.description: Nami chases after Perona, who is fleeing from Thriller Bark; Kuma arrives and wrecks the place.

episodes.title: Oars + Moria - The Greatest Combination of Brains and Brawn
episodes.description: Luffy discovers that he has been chasing Gekko's shadow wile the real Gekko escaped.

episodes.title: A Crazy Strategy to Turn the Tables - The Creation of Nightmare Luffy
episodes.description: Oars manages to turn the tide of the battle by countering the Straw Hats; Nami arrives and joins the fight; Luffy meets some interesting individuals who might be of help.

episodes.title: The Straw Hat Crew annihilated! Full-throttle Kage Kage abilities!
episodes.description: Brook joins the fight; the Straw Hats try to hold off Oars and Moria until Luffy is able to return but they may not be able to.

episodes.title: The Battle for Superiority Starts! Luffy vs. Luffy
episodes.description: While Oars and Moria is ruthlessly pummeling the Straw Hat pirates, Nightmare Luffy arrives to join the battle.

episodes.title: The Conclusion Arrives! Deliver the Finishing Blow
episodes.description: After Luffy's shadow power disappears, he needs help from the rest of the Straw Hats to land the finishing blow in his battle against Oars.

episodes.title: The Bodies Vanish! The Morning Sun Pierces Through the Nightmare Island!
episodes.description: Moria gobbles up every shadow in sight to power up for the final showdown with Luffy.

episodes.title: The Endless Crisis! Orders to Obliterate the Straw Hat Crew
episodes.description: The battle between Luffy and Moria reaches it's end; Kuma causes panic on the island.

episodes.title: It Repels Everything! Kuma's Paw-Paw Power!
episodes.description: The World Government orders Kuma to obliterate every living being on the island.

episodes.title: My Companions' Pain is My Pain - Zoro Prepares to Die
episodes.description: A heated confrontation occurs when Zoro and Sanji have to make a decision so they can save Luffy.

episodes.title: The Promise on that Distant Day - The Song of Pirates and a Small Whale
episodes.description: Hogback and Absalom escape Thriller Bark with the unconscious Moria  and reveal that Blackbeard gained his status as a Shichibukai by defeating Ace.

episodes.title: Brook's Past - Sad Farewell to the Cheerful Crew
episodes.description: Brook recalls his past, when the whale Laboon started following his pirate ship and befriended the crew.

episodes.title: Binks' Sake - The Song that Connects the Past and Present
episodes.description: Brook continues to tell the tale of the Rumbar Pirates' fateful journey into the Grand Line, and the decision he made at the end of his original life.

episodes.title: A New Crewmate! Musician - The Hummer Brook
episodes.description: Brook pledges himself to the Straw Hat Pirates, becoming their ninth member, as the crew settles their affairs at Thriller Bark and continue their journey.

episodes.title: Noro Noro Menace - Return of Foxy the Silver Fox
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates are taking a vacation at Spa Island, but there, they encounter Foxy and his crew, who are pursuing two small girls: Lina and her older sister, Sayo.

episodes.title: The Great Treasure Contest! Collapse! Spa Island
episodes.description: In order to rescue Lina's sister, the crew destroys the Spa Island and look for the hot cross which is the clue to make the gems of Lina's father.

episodes.title: Brook's Hard Struggle - The Difficult Path to Becoming a True Nakama
episodes.description: Brook tries to help his new nakamas because he fears that otherwise he will be dispensed, but Robin tell him her story of Water 7 and he recovers his confidence.

episodes.title: Arriving at Halfway Through the Grand Line! The Red Line
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates are about to reach the Red Line but a terrible storm delays them. Log Pose is pointing downwards and the crew needs more information to get to Gyojin Island.

episodes.title: Hatred of the Straw Hat Crew - Enter Iron Mask Duval
episodes.description: Camie and Pappag introduce themselves to the Straw Hats, who then later find out that their fishman friend has been kidnapped by Iron Mask Duval and the Macro Gang.

episodes.title: The Fated Reunion! Save the Imprisoned Fishman
episodes.description: The mysterious Duval gets excited when the crew that rescued Camie turns out to be the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.title: Tragedy! The Truth of the Unmasked Duval
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates do battle with the Flying Fish Riders and Macro Fishman Pirates. The stakes rise when Duval reveals himself, and exactly who his grudge is against: Sanji.

episodes.title: Explosion! The Sunny's Super Secret Weapon: Gaon Cannon
episodes.description: Duval reveals that he was once a small-time bandit until Sanji's wanted poster came to light. Since then he hid his face with the iron mask until he could get revenge on Sanji.

episodes.title: Landing to Get to Fishman Island - The Sabaody Archipelago
episodes.description: With the Flying Fish Riders taken care of, the Straw Hats rest as Hatchan treats them to the promised takoyaki.

episodes.title: Tyranny! The Rulers of Sabaody, the Celestial Dragons
episodes.description: After landing on the Sabaody Archipelago, the Straw Hats begin searching for a man Hatchan knows who can coat their ship, so they can continue onto Fishman Island.

episodes.title: New Rivals Gather! The 11 Supernovas
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates fight and defeat some bounty hunters who want their bounty.

episodes.title: The Target Is Camie!! The Looming Clutches Of A Professional Kidnapper
episodes.description: Departing from Shakky's Rip-off Bar, Luffy's group attempt to search for Rayleigh but is distracted by the Sabaody Park. Zoro is disrespectful to Saint Charlos, causing him to be shot at.

episodes.title: Rescue Caimie - The Dark History of the Archipelago
episodes.description: Duval and his crew arrive on the Archipelago and start gathering the Straw Hats up to bring them to the Human Auctioning House, where the kidnappers have brought Camie.

episodes.title: Time Limit - The Human Auction Begins
episodes.description: The human auction finally begins, and it is only then that the Straw Hats discovered that their mermaid friend is being sold off at Grove 1.

episodes.title: The Exploding Fist! Destroy the Auction
episodes.description: The auction continues, but Saint Charlos arrives and ruins the Straw Hats' plan to buy Camie back by placing an exorbitant bid on her.

episodes.title: Huge Panic! Struggle in the Auction Hall
episodes.description: After Luffy punches Charlos, the guards begin to attack the Straw Hats, and most of the observers, except for Charlos' family, Kid and Law's crews, evacuate.

episodes.title: Admiral Kizaru Moves! The Sabaody Archipelago in Chaos
episodes.description: Sengoku dispatches Admiral Kizaru to defend the honor of the Celestial Dragons at Sabaody Archipelago.

episodes.title: Break Through the Encirclement! Marines vs. Three Captains
episodes.description: Luffy, Law and Kid's crews join the fight and defeat the rest of the Marines outside the Auction House. The three captains promise to meet and fight in the New World.

episodes.title: Roger and Rayleigh - The Pirate King and His Right Hand
episodes.description: Upon arriving back at Shakky's Bar, Silvers Rayleigh reveals to the Straw Hats that he was the first mate of the legendary Gol D. Roger and also reveals the truth about his crew's dismissal.

episodes.title: No Escape!? Admiral Kizaru's Light Speed Kick!!
episodes.description: Admiral Kizaru appears at the Archipelago and demonstrates his mysterious light abilities, before taking on the Supernova, Basil Hawkins, whilst Urouge and X Drake fight a Pacifista.

episodes.title: Overwhelming! The Marine Combat Weapon Pacifista
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates fight one of the Pacifistas, and while it does not have Kuma's Devil Fruit powers, it is still able to withstand their strongest attacks.

episodes.title: Another Strong Enemy Appears! Broadaxe-Wielding Sentomaru
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates combine their strongest attacks to defeat the Pacifista, but are exhausted after the battle.

episodes.title: Admiral Kizaru's Fierce Attack. The Straw Hat Crew's Desperate Situation!
episodes.description: Usopp and Brook's attempt to attack Kizaru and save Zoro's life failed.

episodes.title: Disappearing Crewmates - The Final Day of the Straw Hat Crew
episodes.description: Sentomaru reveals that Kuma has the ability to make people fly through the sky to far away places.

episodes.title: Special Historical Arc - Boss Luffy Appears Again
episodes.description: In an alternate universe set in Edo period Japan, the Mikoshi (portable shrine) race is about to take place, the winner of which receives Beli1,000,000, and Boss Luffy and his friends recruit Franky to build them a mikoshi.

episodes.title: Special Historical Arc - Destroy! Thriller Company's Trap
episodes.description: Robin reveals Brook's past to Luffy and his friends, and decide to help him. Brook is captured by Thriller LTD, but Luffy and Zoro arrive to help him escape.

episodes.title: Landing! Young Men Forbidden Island Amazon Lily
episodes.description: Having been hit by Kuma, Luffy is teleported to an unknown island.

episodes.title: Hurry! Get back to your friends. Adventure on the Island of Women.
episodes.description: It is revealed that Luffy is on Amazon Lily, an island populated entirely by the Kuja tribe of women warriors.

episodes.title: Everyone is Lovestruck! Pirate Empress Hancock
episodes.description: Luffy decides to leave the island, reunite with his crew and defeat the enemies who had overpowered them earlier, and is determined to borrow a ship.

episodes.title: The Secret Hidden on Their Backs, Luffy Encounters The Princess
episodes.description: Boa Hancock's ship reaches Amazon Lily and she returns to her palace.

episodes.title: The Heartless Judgment! Margaret Turned to Stone!!
episodes.description: Luffy looks at Boa Hancock's back and notes that he has seen what was on it before. Hancock tries, but fails to turn him to stone with her powers when he mistakes her Mero Mero no Mi abilities for Foxy's Noro Noro Beam.

episodes.title: Luffy's Hard Trial! The Power of the Snake Sisters' Willpower!
episodes.description: Luffy is challenged to battle Boa Marigold and Boa Sandersonia in the Amazon Lily arena with the spectators calling for Luffy to be executed.

episodes.title: Battle with Full-Powered Abilities! Gomu Gomu vs. Hebi Hebi
episodes.description: Luffy activates Gear Second and is currently taking the lead.

episodes.title: Hancock's Confession - The Sisters' Disgusting Past
episodes.description: Hancock decides to test Luffy by giving him an ultimatum: either he gets a ship so he can leave the island while the girls remain statues or she changes them back and Luffy finds another way to the archipelago.

episodes.title: Rescue Ace! The New Destination is the Great Prison
episodes.description: Following a party, Luffy learns from Nyon that Hancock is a Shichibukai, and that they have been called together as the Marines is launching an all-out offensive on Whitebeard.

episodes.title: Love is a Hurricane! Hancock Madly in Love
episodes.description: When Nyon visits Hancock, she deduces her illness and when she mentions Luffy wishes to see her, this causes Hancock to get up and speak with him.

episodes.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - Weather Science and Karakuri Island
episodes.description: After being sent away by Kuma, Nami lands on a sky island called Weatheria, while Franky lands on a snowy island called Karakuri Island.

episodes.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - The Island of Giant Birds and the Pink Paradise!
episodes.description: Chopper is awakened by giant birds that want to use him as a toy. Meanwhile, Sanji wakes up in the lap of a beautiful "woman" on an island thats makes everything girly.

episodes.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - The Bridge that Connects Islands and Man-Eating Plants
episodes.description: Robin is found unconscious by Soran in the snow on the Tequila Wolf, a huge bridge that has been under construction for over 700 years. Usopp is chased by a large beetle, but he is saved by a man named Heracles.

episodes.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - The Negative Princess and the Devil King!
episodes.description: Zoro lands on the island where Kuma also sent Perona, who treats his wounds. Brook finds himself on Namakura Island, where he is mistaken for Satan, whom the islanders had summoned for revenge against the Longarm Tribe. Meanwhile, the Marines gather at Marine Headquarters.

episodes.title: A Life-threatening Break-in! The Underwater Prison Impel Down!
episodes.description: Vice Admiral Garp talked proudly to Ace at Impel Down about some of Luffy's actions, and mentions that they both have the blood of a world class criminal.

episodes.title: A Reunion in Hell?! The Man Who Ate the Chop-Chop Fruit!
episodes.description: Hancock turns Domino to stone before she can undergo the body-check, allowing Luffy to escape into the prison.

episodes.title: Break through Crimson Hell! Buggys great Uproar Plan
episodes.description: Buggy and Luffy fight their way through to the entrance of Level 2 by going through Level 1, Crimson Hell, where the lowest ranking criminals are held.

episodes.title: The Prison's strongest Man! Introduction of the Poison-Man Magellan
episodes.description: Hancock and the others finally reach the office of Magellan, a large man who has eaten the Doku Doku no Mi.

episodes.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! A Gold Lion's Ambition on the Move!
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, and Sanji arrive on an island called Little East Blue, a smaller version of the East Blue, which is where they met each other.

episodes.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Little East Blue in Danger!
episodes.description: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Usopp arrive on the island and go to their favorite places in the East Blue.

episodes.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! The Fierce Onslaught of the Amigo Pirates!
episodes.description: Largo uses his devil fruit power to create nets from his body and trap Zoro and Sanji.

episodes.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Luffy vs. Largo - The Battle is On!
episodes.description: After escaping from the net, Luffy knocks Largo far away and goes off to fight him.

episodes.title: The Imprisoned Royal Shichibukai! Jinbei, Knight of the Sea
episodes.description: Luffy and Buggy find Galdino and together they continue to fight through Level 2 of Impel Down, hounded by both Manticores and Puzzle Scorpions.

episodes.title: The Trap of Chief Guard Saldeath - Level 3 Starvation Hell
episodes.description: Luffy, Buggy, and Galdino find themselves on Level 3, a barren floor of extreme heat.

episodes.title: The Liberated Swan! Reunion! Bon Kurei
episodes.description: The prison staff and Hancock finally arrive on the floor where Ace is being held.

episodes.title: Chief Warden Magellan Moves - The Net to Trap Straw Hat Is Complete!
episodes.description: Magellan finally receives word of Luffy's break-in, and decides to gather his forces to Level 4, to cut off Luffy and his allies.

episodes.title: Preparations for War! A Decisive Battle in Level 4 - Inferno Hell
episodes.description: Luffy and his team fall to the hot fire while Magellan works out the plan to capture them.

episodes.title: Magellan's Strength! Bon Kurei Flees Before His Enemy Out!
episodes.description: Luffy begins fighting Magellan despite Bentham's warnings to flee, and finds that he is unable to go on the offensive because of Magellan's poisonous body and long-range poison attacks.

episodes.title: The Fight Finished! Luffy's Final Life-Risking Attack
episodes.description: Magellan has Luffy backed into a corner and is using his devil fruit powers to poison Luffy.

episodes.title: Because He's Our Friend - Bon Kurei's Do-or-Die Rescue
episodes.description: Luffy is thrown into a cell where he is left to die of poisoning.

episodes.title: A Paradise in Hell! Impel Down - Level 5.5!
episodes.description: Mr. 2 apologizes for abandoning Luffy and searches for Ivankov.

episodes.title: Luffy's Treatment Begins! Ivan-san's Miraculous Power!
episodes.description: Emporio Ivankov displays some of his powers, including stopping a vengeful pirate's cannon shot merely by winking.

episodes.title: Believe in Miracles! Bon Clay's Cries From the Heart!
episodes.description: Bentham learns that Ivankov has the ability to control hormones.

episodes.title: Luffy's Back! Ivan-san Begins the Breakout Plan!
episodes.description: As Luffy is finally revived, he is informed by Emporio Ivankov about Iva's background.

episodes.title: Ace's Convoy Begins! Battle on the Lowest Floor - Level 6!
episodes.description: When Luffy made it to Level 6 with Ivankov and Inazuma, they met up with the former cellmate of Ace, Jinbe.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Team Has Formed! Shaking Impel Down!
episodes.description: Luffy is reluctant to free Crocodile, but Ivankov offers to keep him in line by blackmailing him with a weakness he knows about.

episodes.title: Even More Chaos! Blackbeard Teach Invades!
episodes.description: While Luffy and his allies continue fighting on Level 4 of Impel Down, Buggy and Mr. 3 reach Level 2 and release the prisoners there to cause a riot to cover their escape.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Meeting! Blackbeard and Shiryu of the Rain
episodes.description: The Jailer Beasts arrive and overpower many of the prisoners, but Luffy, Jinbe and Crocodile defeat them in a single attack each.

episodes.title: His Spirit Won't Break! Hannyabal Goes All Out
episodes.description: Luffy fights Hannyabal who tries to stop the escapees, but then Blackbeard shows up and breaks up the fight between Luffy and Hannyabal.

episodes.title: The Jet Pistol of Rage - Luffy vs. Blackbeard
episodes.description: Although Luffy wants a proper battle with Blackbeard, Jinbe reminds him there's no time for that as Ace's execution will occur in only a few short hours.

episodes.title: Stop Magellan! Ivan-san Unleashes His Secret Attack
episodes.description: Luffy and the other prisoners are getting closer to the surface, having made it through levels 3 and 2.

episodes.title: Magellan's Scheme! The Jailbreak is Obstructed
episodes.description: Luffy becomes enraged after learning about Magellan defeating Emporio Ivankov and Inazuma, but Mr. 2 and Jinbe persuade him that escaping takes priority.

episodes.title: The Jailbreak Team Driven Into a Corner - Forbidden Move 'Venom Demon'
episodes.description: Jinbe, Crocodile and Daz Bones finally secure a Marine vessel to escape with. Meanwhile, Luffy continues his fight against Magellan, with the assistance of Galdino's Doru Doru no Mi powers.

episodes.title: Create the Final Miracle - Break Through the Gate of Justice
episodes.description: Bentham puts himself on the line to save Luffy and the others, by disguising himself as Warden Magellan.

episodes.title: The Destination is Marine Headquarters - The Ship Sets Out to Rescue Ace!
episodes.description: Shiryu saves Blackbeard and his crew by giving them antidotes to Magellan's poison before taking the opportunity to join with them.

episodes.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! Weatheria Report and Cyborg Animals
episodes.description: As Luffy's ship heads to the Marine Headquarters, the scene shifts to a point some time in the past.

episodes.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Cheeper of Giant Birds and a Pink Showdown!
episodes.description: Sanji is chased by okamas to Caroline - the queen's stand in.

episodes.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Revolutionary Army and the Trap of the Forest of Gluttony!
episodes.description: Robin was captured by the guards of Tequila Wolf and was sent to the Prison Tower.

episodes.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Giant Gravestone and Panties of Gratitude
episodes.description: While heading to the sea to return to the Sabaody Archipelago, Zoro and Perona stumble upon an enormous tombstone. Brook decides he has to wait to find Luffy and the others until he can fulfill his debt to the people of Harahettania.

episodes.title: Flashback Special Before Marineford - The Brothers' Oath!
episodes.description: Luffy recalls his childhood with Ace and meeting Marshall D. Teach in Jaya without knowing who he was.

episodes.title: Flashback Special Before Marineford - The Three Admirals
episodes.description: While Luffy's on his way to rescue Ace, everyone at Marine Headquarters gets ready for the execution.

episodes.title: Ticking Down to the Time of Battle! The Navy's Strongest Lineup in Position!
episodes.description: Only three hours remain until Ace's execution. Luffy reaches Marineford but finds the Gates of Justice closed.

episodes.title: An Enormous Fleet Appears - The Whitebeard Pirates Invade
episodes.description: The world is shocked by the revelation of Ace's father's identity.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the War - Ace and Whitebeard's Past!
episodes.description: Whitebeard reveals his Devil Fruit powers in front of the Marines.

episodes.title: The Force That Could Destroy The World! The Power of the Tremor-Tremor Fruit!
episodes.description: The sea-quakes made by Whitebeard cause a tsunami to come upon Marineford.

episodes.title: An All-Consuming Inferno!! Admiral Akainu's Power!
episodes.description: All the various Whitebeard Commanders show off their skills and abilities, as do some Marines.

episodes.title: Descendant of the Devil! Little Oars Jr. Rushes!
episodes.description: Oars Jr. goes straight for Ace, but the Giant Squad attempts to stop him without much success.

episodes.title: The Winner Will Be Justice - Sengoku's Strategy Is Put Into Action!
episodes.description: Koby and Helmeppo attempted to flee from the war after feeling too overwhelmed by the deaths and chaos, but stumbled upon Akainu and an apparent plan by Sengoku.

episodes.title: The Straw Hat Team Arrives - Tensions Grows on the Battlefield!
episodes.description: Luffy finally shows up together with his formed alliance from the escaped prisoners of Impel Down.

episodes.title: Even If It Means Death! Luffy Vs. The Navy - The Battle Starts!
episodes.description: With Luffy as their inspiration, the other pirates fight back with renewed vigor.

episodes.title: Hard Battles, One After Another! Devil's Fruit Eaters vs. Devil's Fruit Eaters!
episodes.description: One battle after another, it is complete chaos out on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Kuma's Transformation! Ivan's Attack of Anger!
episodes.description: Luffy receives the key to Ace's handcuffs from Hancock, who then fantasizes about a wedding ceremony held on Amazon Lily.

episodes.title: The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Luffy Comes Under the Attack of the Black Sword!
episodes.description: Luffy stumbles upon Mihawk, whom he tries to avoid.

episodes.title: The Extermination Strategy in Action! The Power of the Pacifistas!
episodes.description: The Pacifista enter Marineford as part of Sengoku's plan to win the war against Whitebeard.

episodes.title: Akainu's Plot! Whitebeard Trapped!
episodes.description: As Squard stabs Whitebeard, the pirates and even marines in the war are shocked due to his betrayal.

episodes.title: The Encircling Walls Activated! The Whitebeard Pirates Backed into a Corner!!
episodes.description: In a desperate attempt to stop Whitebeard from advancing to the execution platform, the Marines activate walls to block Whitebeard's path, but gets stopped by the ice.

episodes.title: The Order to Perform the Execution is Given - Break Through the Encircling Wall!
episodes.description: Akainu's Meteor Volcano melts the nearly all the ice and destroys the Whitebeard Pirates' ships, dropping them into boiling water, enabling the cannons on the wall to bombard them while the Pacifistas block the way out.

episodes.title: Moving Into the Final Phase! Whitebeard's Trump Card for Recovery!
episodes.description: Luffy attempts to slip past the admirals, but Kizaru easily catches up to him and knocks him to the ground.

episodes.title: Luffy's Strength is Exhausted! All-Out War in the Oris Plaza!
episodes.description: Ace thinks back to his childhood, when he fought with anyone who spoke ill of Roger, and wondering if he should ever have been born.

episodes.title: Power that Reduces One's Life - Tension Hormones Return
episodes.description: Whitebeard falters for a moment as a result of his age and physical condition.

episodes.title: For a Promise!! Luffy and Coby Clash!
episodes.description: Luffy with his newly restored strength continues on to the execution platform to save Ace and is warned by Ivankov that the hormones only trick his body.

episodes.title: The Scaffold At Last! The Way To Ace Has Opened!
episodes.description: Luffy uses Haki unintentionally just as Ace is about to be executed.

episodes.title: Each On Different Paths! Luffy vs. Garp!
episodes.description: Luffy unwillingly hits Garp, who is blocking his way to Ace. As Garp falls, the bridge crumbles.

episodes.title: Ace is Rescued! Whitebeard's Final Captain's Orders!
episodes.description: Ace is freed at last as he and Luffy fight their way back to escape from Marineford.

episodes.title: The Power that Burns Fire - Akainu's Final Move
episodes.description: Whitebeard aims to take down the whole of Marineford and orders his crew and the other pirates to flee.

episodes.title: Looking for the Answer! Fire Fist Ace Dies on the Battlefield!
episodes.description: An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together.

episodes.title: Marine Headquarters Crumbles! Whitebeard's Silent Rage!
episodes.description: Luffy's has a breakdown due to the emotional trauma of Ace's death, causing Jinbe to take him away.

episodes.title: Settling the Score - Whitebeard vs. The Blackbeard Pirates
episodes.description: Blackbeard and his pirates arrive in Marineford, as they are taken down from the execution platform by Whitebeard.

episodes.title: The Start of the Show - Blackbeard's Plot Revealed
episodes.description: The news of Whitebeard's death is already spreading all over the world. Silvers Rayleigh also hears the news.

episodes.title: The Insatiable Akainu! Lava Fists Pummel Luffy!
episodes.description: Blackbeard expresses his desire to sink Marineford into the ocean after destroying the fortress, but Sengoku attacks him, saying that the island is a symbol of justice in the world.

episodes.title: A Desperate Cry - Seconds of Valor that Change Destiny
episodes.description: The fight in Marineford still rages on, as Trafalgar Law arrives to rescue Luffy.

episodes.title: Enter Shanks! The Ultimate War Ends at Last
episodes.description: Law and his crew take Jinbe and Luffy inside their submarine.

episodes.title: Powerful Independent Rivals! The Beginning of the 'New Era'
episodes.description: As Luffy's fate hangs in the balance, word spreads that the war is over and people all over the world rejoice on the news of the Marines' victory.

episodes.title: Arrival at the Island of Women - Cruel Reality Tortures Luffy
episodes.description: Brownbeard was seen taking over Foodvalten saying it was not a Whitebeard territory anymore, Iva said goodbye to Jinbe and the others.

episodes.title: The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle!
episodes.description: After eating the Hungrila Bird that they captured, Luffy and Toriko team up again to save Nami and Komatsu who have been kidnapped by the Cocoalas.

episodes.title: Luffy and Ace - The Story of the Brothers' Meeting!
episodes.description: Garp drops Luffy to live with the Dadan Family where he meets Ace - who immediately dislikes Luffy.

episodes.title: Enter Sabo! The Boy From the Grey Terminal
episodes.description: Luffy discovers the end of the forest is a slum dumpster named Gray Terminal, a lawless area full of homeless people searching for valuables thrown out by the town's people.

episodes.title: I Won't Run! Ace's Desperate Rescue Operation!
episodes.description: Ace and Sabo rescue Luffy from Porchemy by defeating him.

episodes.title: One Day We'll Go Out to Sea! The Oath Cups of the Three Brats!
episodes.description: Sabo is seen by his father but Sabo pretends to not know him.

episodes.title: Leaving the Dadan Family!? The Secret Base is Complete!
episodes.description: Luffy, Ace and Sabo were going about their usual mischief until Garp turned up, and attacked them for still wanting to be pirates.

episodes.title: Luffy Becoming an Apprentice?! A Man Who Fought Against the King of the Pirates!
episodes.description: Ace, Sabo, and Luffy chase down a Danpa and succeeds to catch it, but a tiger steals it.

episodes.title: The Battle Against the Big Tiger! Who Will Be the Captain?!
episodes.description: Ace, Sabo and Luffy help Naguri make a pirate ship.

episodes.title: Stolen Freedom! The Nobles' Trap Draws Near the Three Brothers
episodes.description: Sabo, Luffy and Ace are caught by the Bluejam Pirates.

episodes.title: The Flames Are Lit - The Gray Terminal's Crisis
episodes.description: Sabo is being chased by his father's men.

episodes.title: Where Is Freedom? The Boy's Sad Departure
episodes.description: While Dadan and Ace stay behind to fight Bluejam, the rest of the Dadan Family and Luffy make a quick escape.

episodes.title: I'm Counting On You! A Letter From a Brother!
episodes.description: Sabo's ship is destroyed by a World Noble.

episodes.title: To Fulfill the Promise - Separate Departures!
episodes.description: After the death of Sabo, Ace and Luffy continue their training while the others discover the Revolutionaries' ship.

episodes.title: I Want to See Them! Luffy's Tearful Scream
episodes.description: Luffy still distraught at the death of Ace, blames it on his weakness.

episodes.title: Straw Hats In Shock! The Bad News Has Reached Them!
episodes.description: On Kuraigana Island, Zoro confronts several Humandrills and is nearly defeated, but then Mihawk appears and scares them away.

episodes.title: Reunited with Dark King Rayleigh! Decision Time For Luffy!
episodes.description: On Maiden Island, Rayleigh kills a Sea King and arrives on the island in front of Law's crew.

episodes.title: Back to Our Captain! A Jail Break at the Sky Island and the Incident on the Winter Island!
episodes.description: At Amazon Lily, Luffy tries to make up his mind regarding Rayleigh's offer, as he made a promise to his crew to meet in three days.

episodes.title: Encounter! The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Zoro's Self-Willed Deadly Struggle!
episodes.description: Zoro tried to go back to the sea using the small boat given to him by Mihawk but he could not get past the humandrills.

episodes.title: Sanji's Suffering - The Queen Returns to His Kingdom
episodes.description: Chopper leaves the Torino Kingdom, while riding one of the birds, hoping to be able to aid Luffy.

episodes.title: An Unbelievable Return! Luffy at the Marine Headquarters!
episodes.description: The Marine Headquarters have started rebuilding, and the Marines had a meeting about Monkey D. Luffy.

episodes.title: Delivered to Friends - The Big News Comes Through!
episodes.description: Some of Luffy's old friends from Impel Down and around the world read the news about Luffy's second appearance at Marineford.

episodes.title: The Pirates Move Out! The Earth Shattering New World
episodes.description: Trafalgar Law and his crew talk about going to the New World.

episodes.title: Live Through Hell - Sanji's Fight with Men at Stake
episodes.description: Nami tricks the old men into letting her stay on Weatheria. Franky stumbles upon Vegapunk's hidden laboratory and finds more blueprints and decides to study them.

episodes.title: I Will Get Much, Much Stronger! Zoro's Pledge to his Captain!
episodes.description: While being put on display in a cage, Brook feels appreciative towards all that Luffy had done for him and decides that he will move on and continue to aid Luffy.

episodes.title: Luffy's Training Begins - Meet Up at the Promised Place in Two Years
episodes.description: Jinbe leaves Luffy with Rayleigh. Rayleigh takes Luffy to an abandoned island to begin his training. Rayleigh introduces Luffy to the concept of Haki and then demonstrates the three different types of Haki.

episodes.title: A New Chapter Opens: The Straw Hat Pirates Regather!
episodes.description: After two years of being separated, the Straw Hats return to Sabaody Archipelago.

episodes.title: An Explosive Situation! Luffy vs Fake Luffy
episodes.description: Fake Luffy and the real Luffy come face-to-face, though the imposter is quickly beaten thanks to Luffy's use of Haki.

episodes.title: The Navy Has Set Out! The Straw Hats In Danger!
episodes.description: Robin visits the Thousand Sunny and meets Franky there. Chopper goes to the Fake Straw Hat Pirates, mistaking them for his own crew.

episodes.title: Big Guns Assembled! The Danger Of The Fake Straw Hats!
episodes.description: Brook finishes his concert, while deciding between the pirate life and rock-n-roll fame when the Marines arrive to capture him, but he escapes. Luffy walks into a very dodgy crowd.

episodes.title: The Battle Is On! Show Them What You Got From Training!
episodes.description: Luffy shows off his new powers in a battle between pirates, navy soldiers, and deadly pacifists.

episodes.title: Everyone Together! Luffy, Setting Out For The New World!
episodes.description: Luffy and his gang reunite, but before they can set sail, they'll need help from all their friends. Luffy along with Zoro and Sanji are heading to Grove #42.

episodes.title: A Suprising Fact! The Man Who Guarded The Sunny!
episodes.description: As world of the Straw Hat resurrection spreads through the navy, Luffy and his crew get acclimated. Caribou is seen punishing the Fake Straw Hats for making him join them instead of the real Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.title: Deadly Combat Under The Sea! The Demon Of The Ocean Strikes!
episodes.description: The Caribou Pirates attack the Straw Hats. While Caribou manages to get on the Thousand Sunny, the rest of his crew gets pulled away by Mohmoo, who gets frightened when he recognizes the Straw Hats from his time in Arlong Park.

episodes.title: Lost In The Deep Sea! The Straw Hats Get Seperated!
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro and Sanji are facing the Kraken.

episodes.title: Undersea Volcanic Eruption! Drifting To The Fishman Island!
episodes.description: The Flying Dutchman shows up and Vander Decken tells Wadatsumi to crush the Thousand Sunny, but then the Kraken beats Wadatsumi.

episodes.title: Landing at The Fishman Island! Beautiful Mermaids!
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates encounter Hammond, some sea-beasts and other fishmen from the New Fishman Pirates.

episodes.title: Excitement Blow-Out! Sanji's Life Under Threat!
episodes.description: Sanji playing in a pool with the mermaids in Mermaid Cove, Luffy, soaking his feet on the side of the pool, comments on how nice it must be to swim, Camie suggests that Luffy could wear a bubble in order to do so.

episodes.title: Fish-Man Island Collapses?! Shyarly's Prediction
episodes.description: As blood donors are finally found, the recovering Sanji stays at the Mermaid Cafe while Luffy, Usopp and Camie meet Pappag and Brook.

episodes.title: The King of The Fishman Island!, Neptune, The God Of The Sea!
episodes.description: Straw Hat Pirates are in a town on Fishman Island and King Neptune and Megalo appear to invite the Straw Hats to Ryugu Palace.

episodes.title: The Ryugu Palace! Taken By The Shark That They Saved!
episodes.description: Luffy, Nami, Usopp, Brook, Camie, and Pappag travel with King Neptune to Ryugu Palace.

episodes.title: A Coward and a Crybaby! The Princess in the Hard Shell Tower
episodes.description: Vander Decken IX reveals that he plans to marry the princess, using his Mark-Mark Fruit curse to throw a giant axe at her.

episodes.title: It's An Emergency! The Ryugu Palace Is Occupied!
episodes.description: The guards around Zoro and the others are preparing to pop their air bubble, however, Nami found some bubbly coral and made the whole room fill with air and Zoro prepares to fight Neptune.

episodes.title: The Ryugu Palace In Shock! The Kidnapping Of Shirahoshi!
episodes.description: Luffy leads Shirahoshi out of her tower inside Megalo while Brook and the Minister of the Right tells them to stop.

episodes.title: Hordy's Onslaught! The Retaliatory Plan Set into Motion!
episodes.description: Luffy is still on his way to the Sea Forest with Shirahoshi, when he notices something going to the Ryugu Palace, which is revealed to be Hody and Vander Decken IX.

episodes.title: The Battle In The Ryugu Palace! Zoro Vs. Hordy!
episodes.description: Neptune begs someone to protect her daughter. Hody just comments on how weak he is and states he only joined his army for military strength and knowledge. He states he will revive the dream and ambition of Arlong.

episodes.title: Keep Shirahoshi Safe! Decken Close Behind!
episodes.description: Chopper tries to persuade Sanji to not turn around, or else he will see Shirahoshi and die. But Sanji turns around and after seeing the princess, turns into stone.

episodes.title: The Crew Falls?! Hody Conquers Ryuuguu Palace
episodes.description: Zoro cuts Hody and asks for Neptune's help to escape from Ryugu Palace. Unfortunately, Hody who was unconscious comes to his senses after taking an Energy Steroid and successfully stops Neptune and the Straw Hats from escaping.

episodes.title: The Haunting Ties! Nami And The Fishmen Pirates!
episodes.description: Robin continues her search while the New Fishman Pirates begin to take over. People are also seen being forced to step on a photo, and if they do not, they are considered as enemies.

episodes.title: A Hero Who Freed The Slaves! An Adventurer Tiger!
episodes.description: Otohime confronts a robber who was stealing money so he could buy food for his ten children. Otohime and Jinbe try to change Fishman island, and Jinbe leaves the Army to join the Sun Pirates.

episodes.title: Kizaru Appears! A Trap To Catch Tiger!
episodes.description: Entering a flashback, Neptune holds a baby Shirahoshi commenting on Tiger's attack on Mary Geoise, stating he would not be able to attend a summit for a long time because of it.

episodes.title: Toriko x One Piece Special: Team Formation! Save Chopper!
episodes.description: Toriko and Komatsu are seen fishing when Komatsu catches a Harusame. After defeating it, Luffy suddenly comes out of the Harusame's mouth and surprises Toriko and Komatsu.

episodes.title: The Death Of The Hero! A Shocking Truth Of Tiger!
episodes.description: The Sun Pirates start making their way to Koala's hometown, while giving her a slight makeover, new clothes and cutting her hair. on their ship, Koala still acts like a slave would, doing chores without being asked and asking for orders.

episodes.title: The Sun Pirates Split! Jimbe Vs. Arlong!
episodes.description: After Fisher Tiger's death, Arlong, enraged, betrays his last wishes and decides to attack and kill villagers of Koala's village for selling him out, upon trying he is easily beaten by Vice-Admiral Borsalino and taken into Marine custody.

episodes.title: Shaking Fishman Island! A Celestial Dragon Drifts In!
episodes.description: With Jinbe having been accepted as a Shichibukai, the Sun Pirates return to Fishman Island.

episodes.title: A Sudden Tragedy! A Gunshot Shuts Down The Future!
episodes.description: Vander Decken IX discovers about the Tamatebako and wishes to use it to age Shirahoshi after she grows up a little.

episodes.title: Back To The Present! Hordy Makes A Move!
episodes.description: After Otohime passed away, Hody Jones had found and killed the suspected human assassin and showed him to the people.

episodes.title: The Kingdom In Shock! An Order to Execute Neptune Issued!
episodes.description: Hody makes his announcement to take over the Ryugu Kingdom with the execution of King Neptune as the start of his new rule. Hody also announces that he will kill Straw Hats so that they will serve as example to all humans in the surface.

episodes.title: A Rift Opens Up! Luffy Vs. Jimbei!
episodes.description: Luffy and Jinbe start their duel to see who gets to fight Hody, but their fight was cut short by Sanji's and Robin's interference.

episodes.title: Something Has Happened To Hordy! The True Power Of The Evil Drug!
episodes.description: The New Fishman Pirates head to the Gyoncorde Plaza to execute King Neptune but before getting at the plaza, they demonstrate a little taste of their power by terrorizing and destroying everything in their path.

episodes.title: The Battle Is On! At Conchcorde Plaza!
episodes.description: Neptune's army put up an attempt to stop Hody Jones and his pirates from reaching Gyoncorde Plaza but seeing the king held hostage prevents them from attacking.

episodes.title: A Surprising Confession! The Truth Behind The Assassination Of Otohime!
episodes.description: Jinbe and Shirahoshi are captured by the New Fishman Pirates when they fall into a trap due to a balloon version of King Neptune which easily tricks Shirahoshi and Megalo.

episodes.title: Shirahoshi's Tears! Luffy Finally Shows Up!
episodes.description: Shirahoshi reveals that Megalo witnessed Hody shooting Queen Otohime and told her in secret.

episodes.title: A Big Clash! The Straw Hats Vs. A Hundered Thousand Enemies!
episodes.description: The citizens celebrate at the arrival of Luffy and his crew. Jinbe comments on how his plan with the Straw Hat Pirates crew worked. Luffy takes down half of Hody's forces with Haki.

episodes.title: Deadly Attacks! Zoro And Sanji Join The Battle!
episodes.description: The Straw Hat Pirates begin their attack with Luffy, Zoro and Sanji taking the lead in the fight but mostly it is the latter two of the three who begin showing their new powers and abilities from their two year separation and training.

episodes.title: Unveiled! The Secret Weapons Of The Sunny!
episodes.description: The battle rages on between the Straw Hats and the New Fishman Pirates. Sanji and Zoro are competing over who can take down the most fishmen.

episodes.title: Iron Pirate! Here Comes General Franky!
episodes.description: The battle between the New Fishman Pirates and the Straw Hats continues, with the Straw Hats gaining the upper hand. Seeing this, Daruma decides to join the fight, targeting the Brachio Tank V and collapsing the ground underneath it.

episodes.title: The Noah Closing In! The Fishman Island Facing Destruction!
episodes.description: Luffy and Hody continue their fight with Luffy getting the upper hand with Haki and Hody's attacks being ineffective against Luffy.

episodes.title: Hurry Up Luffy! Shirahoshi's Life In Jeopardy!
episodes.description: Shirahoshi begins swimming out to sea in an attempt to lure the ark Noah away and save Fishman Island, while Luffy gets Sanji's help to allow him to reach the ship's chains and stop Hody.

episodes.title: The Fierce Fight Begins! Luffy Vs. Hordy!
episodes.description: Hody takes his trident out of Vander Decken's body and, after a short fight, Decken is defeated. Then Hody goes after Shirahoshi, slicing through Ryuboshi and Manboshi, reaches her with his incomparable underwater speed, and grabs her hair.

episodes.title: A Massive Confused Fight! The Straw Hats Vs. The New Fishmen Pirates!
episodes.description: Luffy along with the three princes try to protect Shirahoshi against Hody Jones.

episodes.title: Luffy Loses The Fight! Hordy's Long-Awaited Revenge!
episodes.description: As the Noah falls onto the Fishman Island, Shirahoshi desperately tries to tell Decken to wake up only for Hody to attack her but Manboshi takes the blunt of the attack.

episodes.title: A Shocking Fact! The True Identity Of Hordy!
episodes.description: The story goes back before the Noah started falling back to the island. Jinbe and Sanji continue to fight Wadatsumi and Wadatsumi becomes angry and inflates himself, crushing some of his allies unknowingly.

episodes.title: Back To Zero! Ernest Wishes For Luffy!
episodes.description: As Fukaboshi begins to state who Hody really is, Hody's past is revealed as he recalls his hatred towards humans. The New Fish-Man Pirates officers were taught as kids that the humans are an inferior species and that they should be punished by heaven.

episodes.title: Luffy's All Out Attack! Red Hawk Blasts!
