episodes.description: Brook continues to fight Zeo and reveals his new control over his Yomi Yomi no Mi abilities. Usopp continues to fight Daruma and has set traps for him.

episodes.title: Coming To An End! The Final Decisive Battle Against Hordy!
episodes.description: Hody recovers thanks to the Energy Steroids and manages to overwhelm Luffy and bite him again in the same spot.

episodes.title: Stop Noah! Desperate Elephant Gatling!
episodes.description: All of the New Fishman Pirates lie down defeated while the Straw Hat Pirates are relaxing and waiting for Luffy.

episodes.title: To The Future! The Path To The Sun!
episodes.description: With the Sea Kings having stopped and saved the great ship Noah, Shirahoshi learns a startling secret from the Sea Kings.

episodes.title: The Secret Revealed! The Truth About The Ancient Weapon!
episodes.description: As the whole Fishman Island celebrates the capture and defeat of Hody and the New Fishman Pirates by the Straw Hats, who make their own plans to leave Fishman Island soon.

episodes.title: The Straw Hat's Stunned! The New Fleet Admiral Of The Navy!
episodes.description: King Neptune talks about the Ancient Weapons with Shirahoshi and Nico Robin while Caribou listens and makes his way to Shirahoshi's room.

episodes.title: She Loves Sweets! Big Mom Of The Four Emporers!
episodes.description: The rest of the Straw Hats are waiting for Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji to return the treasure from Caribou. They find Caribou easily with all the treasure.

episodes.title: Many Problems Lie Ahead! A Trap Awaiting In The New World!
episodes.description: The Minister of the Right was thanking the Straw Hats for saving Fishman Island, when suddenly he got a report that the Tamate Box is gone and is in the hands of Baron Tamago and Pekoms.

episodes.title: Finally Time To Go! Goodbye Fishman Island!
episodes.description: The mermaids and Keimi from the Mermaid Cafe ask Madam Shyarly if they can say good bye to the Straw Hats. Madam Shyarly says that her prediction that Luffy will destroy Fishman Island was wrong since they defeated Hody and his Pirates.

episodes.title: To the New World! Heading For The Ultimate Sea!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats are Heading into the New World.

episodes.title: Z's Ambition Arc - The Little Giant Lily!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats find themselves in a middle of an infamous sea in the New World known for its mirages and outrageous weather patterns.

episodes.title: Z's Ambition Arc - Introduction of the Mystery of the Strongest Army Corps!
episodes.description: Nami creates a plan for the Straw Hats to rescue Lily's father, Panz Fry. Chopper, Robin, Brook, and Luffy are the diversion group while Usopp, Sanji, Zoro, and Lily are in the submarine.

episodes.title: Z's Ambition Arc - A Desperate Big Escape Strategy!
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro face off against Shuzo and Momonga. The Straw Hats, Lily, and her father manage to escape with a Coup de Burst and the anchor connected to the Thousand Sunny.

episodes.title: Z's Ambition Arc - Luffy vs. Shuzo!
episodes.description: Shuzo orders his men to be launched at the island like torpedoes and sacrifice themselves for him.

episodes.title: Arriving! A Burning Island - Punk Hazard!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats have arrived at a volcanic island that does not show on the New World Log Pose. Luffy in his enthusiasm votes to go to the island, though most of the crew were reluctant to go because of the sea of fire blocking their way.

episodes.title: A Battle In The Heat! Luffy Vs. The Giant Dragon!
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro start fighting the dragon, which is shown to be able to speak and breathe fire.

episodes.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samaura's Horrifying Severed Head!
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, and Robin are standing near the dead dragon that Zoro killed and Luffy is trying to pull out the man who is stuck in the dragon's body.

episodes.title: Startling! The Secret of the Island is Finally Revealed!
episodes.description: Franky, Sanji, Nami and Chopper are surprised that the samurai is still alive after being cut.

episodes.title: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start To Fight!
episodes.description: Nami's group escaped the prison cell and end up in the Biscuits Room, where they find giant children.

episodes.title: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook Vs. The Mysterious Torso Samurai!
episodes.description: At the lake, Luffy's group have been attacked by Brownbeard and his centaur unit who's job was to intercept and eliminate any obvious intruders.

episodes.title: The Warlord! Trafalgar Law!
episodes.description: Chopper and Nami, leading the children stumble upon a room with people frozen in it. Franky, Sanji and the samurai start to make their way towards Nami and Chopper. Luffy, Zoro, Usopp and Robin get attacked by the centaurs.

episodes.title: In A Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks Into The Ice-Cold Lake!
episodes.description: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp and Robin try to get to the ice side of Punk Hazard but their ship gets capsized by Brownbeard. As Brownbeard's troop prepares attack them again, Zoro gets ready to destroy their bullets but gets dragged down by sharks.

episodes.title: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!
episodes.description: Law was going to to cut up Tashigi into little pieces but Smoker saved her and started fighting against Law. Luffy, Zoro, Robin and Usopp are riding on top of Brownbeard after defeating him and his centaurs.

episodes.title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!
episodes.description: Tashigi tries to see what happened in the fight. Luffy's group sees the flying warship. Luffy sees Law and thanks him for saving him two years ago. Law says that they aren't friends and Luffy agrees since they were both after One Piece.

episodes.title: The Worst In The World! A Scientist Of Terror - Caesar!
episodes.description: The G-5 Marines discussed if Caesar Clown was probably behind the unusual events at the island and that the child abduction cases in that area may have been real.

episodes.title: History's Strongest Collaboration! Vs. Glutton of the Sea!
episodes.description: Featured characters of One Piece, Toriko, and Dragon Ball Z enter the IGO tournament in order to gain the Carat meat, which is said to be the most tasteful in the world. However, it leads in a tie between Goku, Toriko, and Luffy.

episodes.title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!
episodes.description: The children and the Straw Hat Pirates are in a cave with Brownbeard tied up talking about the Master. Zoro, Sanji and Brook go to look for Kin'emon, who had gone to look for his torso.

episodes.title: To Annihlate The Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!
episodes.description: Yeti Cool Brothers make their way to the destroyed lab where the Straw Hats and the children are. Monet tells Caesar Clown about Law having some relation to Luffy, which makes Caesar mistrust Law until Law reassures him.

episodes.title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight On The Snow-Capped Mountains!
episodes.description: Chopper tells the others that Nami in Franky's body was kidnapped by the Yeti Cool Brothers. Franky in Chopper's body takes a Rumble Ball. Luffy and Franky go after the Yeti Cool Brothers to save Nami and defeat them.

episodes.title: Formation! The Pirate Alliance Luffy-Law!
episodes.description: Luffy and Law agree on an alliance; the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates disapprove while Nico Robin approves, even if she warns Luffy about a possible betrayal in a pirate alliance.

episodes.title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliances's Operation Launches!
episodes.description: Zoro, Sanji and Brook are trying to find the samurai and remember what happened to them. They had been knocked out by the Yeti Cool Brothers, who used a gas that makes people drunk.

episodes.title: On The Verge Of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!
episodes.description: Luffy declares that he will capture Caesar. Law will distract Monet while Chopper finds an antidote for drug.

episodes.title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!
episodes.description: Sanji, Kin'emon, Brook and Zoro see Smiley. Brook talks about a story of a creature called Slime which melts the clothes of women, making everyone act perverted except for Zoro, who points out that the slime is killing the fish in the lake.

episodes.title: A Samurai Who Can Cut Fire! Foxfire Kin'Emon!
episodes.description: Law's heart is crushed by the mysterious man named Vergo who was sent along with Monet to watch over Caesar.

episodes.title: Shock! Identity of Vergo, the Mysterious Man
episodes.description: Law gets beaten up by Vergo. Yarisugi tells the parents of the missing children that they are dead. Caesar takes the children from Usopp and Nami.

episodes.title: Save The Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close In!
episodes.description: As Luffy and Law remain captives in Caesar's lab along with the others who were captured, Caesar Clown goes to retrieve the children from the remaining Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.title: Shaking Up The New World! Caesar's Horrendous Experiment!
episodes.description: At the lab, the G-5 Marine soldiers are banging on the door, demanding entry. Meanwhile, the children were returned to the Lab where Caesar ordered his subordinates to make sure they don't escape again. However, Mocha begins to regain her senses, seeing Caesar's subordinates as monsters.

episodes.title: The Deadliest Weapon of Mass Destruction in History! Land Of The Dead!
episodes.description: After Smiley swallows the over-sized candy, the candy coat dissolves revealing a special drug designed to convert the entire content of Smiley's body into a "perfect" weapon of destruction, Shinokuni.

episodes.title: The Counterattack Begins! Luffy and Law's Great Escape
episodes.description: As the Underworld Brokers watched the video feed of the captive Straw Hats and Marines, Eustass Kid and Killer decided to ignore it for more important matters, such as forming an alliance between the Kid Pirates, On Air Pirates and the Hawkins Pirates.

episodes.title: Get To Building R! The Pirate Alliance's Great Advance!
episodes.description: Though the Straw Hats and Brownbeard managed to escape into the lab, they left behind a gaping hole. But they soon realise that Shinokuni can now enter the lab.

episodes.title: Tashigi's Tears! G5's Desperate Breakthrough Plan!
episodes.description: Caesar Clown, incensed with the humiliation that his prisoners escaped and are inside his lab, orders the passage between building A and B to be closed and Shinokuni to be let in to kill the intruders. Vergo, however decided to take care of them himself.

episodes.title: The Treacherous Vice Admiral! Demon Bamboo Vergo!
episodes.description: Luffy races toward Caesar in the hopes of delivering a beating, Sanji saves a damsel in distress, and Chopper tries to prevent the children from eating the drugged candy!

episodes.title: A Fierce Battle Gets Heated! Luffy vs. Caesar!
episodes.description: Sanji and Vergo slug it out in a cloud of toxic gas, Law finds the room that could ruin the New World, and Luffy hopes to bring Caesar`s reign of terror to a brutal end!

episodes.title: The Mastermind in the Shadows! Doflamingo Moves!
episodes.description: Doflamingo orders Vergo to stop Law in his tracks, Luffy battles a deadly snowbird, and the rest of the Straw Hats attempt to survive the fiery breath of an angry dragon!

episodes.title: Luffy Dies from Exposure?! The Spine-chilling Snow Woman Monet!
episodes.description: Luffy goes down fast after Monet puts a chill into him, and Trafalgar Law makes a desperate attempt to reclaim his heart during an electric battle with Vergo!

episodes.title: Fist Fight! Two Vice Admirals Fight
episodes.description: Smoker attacks Vergo for assaulting his men, Luffy meets something strange in the trash heap, and a flashback reveals the true depths of Caesar`s madness!

episodes.title: The Small Dragon! Momonosuke Appears
episodes.description: Luffy befriends a dragon that used to be a human boy, and Captain Smoker continues his brutal battle with the villainous Vergo!

episodes.title: Deadly Combat in Snowstorm The Straw Hats vs. the Snow Woman
episodes.description: Luffy hitches a ride on a dragon, Mocha tries to keep the Master`s candy away from her friends, and Zoro pits his steel against snow in a battle with Monet!

episodes.title: Showing Off His Techniques! Zoro's Formidable One-Sword Style!
episodes.description: To survive his battle with Monet, Zoro must overcome his unwillingness to cut a woman. Elsewhere, Luffy puts a hungry dragon on his back and tries to punch his way out of the basement!

episodes.title: I'll Protect My Friends! Mocha's Desperate Escape
episodes.description: Chopper, Nami, and Robin watch in horror as Mocha makes a heartbreaking sacrifice in a courageous attempt to save the lives of her friends!

episodes.title: Brownbeard's In Grief! Luffy Lands A Furious Blow!
episodes.description: Brownbeard heroically attempts to expose Caesar as a villain, the horrific truth about Punk Hazard is finally revealed, and Luffy puts the hurt on his gaseous enemy!

episodes.title: A Surprising Outcome! White Hunter vs. Vergo!
episodes.description: Luffy makes Caesar pay for his crimes against the children, and Smoker risks his life for a chance to see Vergo fall in battle!

episodes.title: Caesar Defeat! The Powerful Grizzly Magnum!
episodes.description: Law reaches the end of his epic battle with Vergo, and Luffy looks to land a devastating final blow on the murderous gasbag Caesar!

episodes.title: Raid! An Assassin From Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Word of Luffy and Law`s alliance spreads throughout the world, Chopper and Brook race to stay ahead of the deadly gas, and Joker sends a team to rescue Caesar!

episodes.title: Runninng Wild! Invincible General Franky!
episodes.description: Franky battles a lethal beauty, Caesar tries to strike a final blow against Smoker, and Monet detonates an explosive surprise that could spell doom for the Straw Hats!

episodes.title: A Critical Situation! Punk Hazard Explodes!
episodes.description: As the Straw Hats and company flee the crumbling laboratory, Caesar`s desperate act of vengeance thwarts Joker`s plan to forever silence his enemies!

episodes.title: Capture Caesar! General Cannon Blast's!
episodes.description: Franky continues his battle with Buffalo and Baby 5, Nami uses a mighty gust of wind to save the children from a deadly cloud of gas, and Usopp takes a shot at capturing Caesar!

episodes.title: A Touching Reunion! Momonosuke and Kin'emon!
episodes.description: A dragon regains his boyish form, a noble warrior once feared dead makes a shocking resurrection, and bitter enemies set aside their differences to enjoy a well-deserved feast!

episodes.title: It's Time To Say Goodbye! Leaving Punk Hazard!
episodes.description: The weary marines and the rescued children get teary-eyed as they say goodbye to the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Law enters into treacherous negotiations with Joker!

episodes.title: The G-5 Wiped Out! Doflamingo's Sudden Attack!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats set a course for Dressrosa, Law explains his alliance with Luffy, and Smoker`s refusal to reveal a secret earns him a serious beating from Doflamingo!

episodes.title: Intense! Aokiji Vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Smoker`s life is spared by the arrival of an old friend. Law reveals some shocking news about Caesar`s partnership with Doflamingo, and Momonosuke uses his youth to get cozy with Robin and Nami!

episodes.title: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes A Sortie!
episodes.description: Smooth seas stretch out before the Straw Hats as they leave Punk Hazard far behind. While they fear Donflamingo`s return and prepare to face him, another powerful foe lies in wait - one whose power could be their downfall!

episodes.title: Luffy Dies At Sea! The Pirate Alliance Comes Apart!
episodes.description: Breed uses his evil abilities to turn Chopper into a pet - and force Luffy and Law to fight to the death.

episodes.title: A Major Turnaround! Luffy's Angry Iron Fist Strikes!
episodes.description: After Law discovers the secret to Breed`s power, Luffy and his old friend the Kung Fu Dugong give the animal-abusing madman a beasty beat down!

episodes.title: Startling! The Big News Shakes Up The New World!
episodes.description: As the world reacts to Doflamingo`s shocking announcement, Law and the Straw Hats plot the next move in their daring alliance, and a face from the past returns!

episodes.title: Explore! A Kingdom Of Love And Passion - Dresrosa!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats and their friends set out to explore Dressrosa, a land full of beautiful women, delicious food, and live toys that walk amongst the living.

episodes.title: Full Of Enthusiasm! The Corrida Colosseum!
episodes.description: A blind warrior lays a beat down on a gang of masked thugs, Zorro chases the thief who stole his sword, and Luffy finds himself tempted by the promise of a fiery fruit!

episodes.title: A Dangerous Love! The Dancer Girl - Violet!
episodes.description: Zoro continues his hunt for the fairy who stole his sword, Sanji is smitten by a beautiful dancer, and Luffy prepares to fight for the Devil Fruit that belonged to his brother!

episodes.title: A Formidable, Unknown Warrior! Here Comes Lucy!
episodes.description: Sanji falls further under the spell of his new lady friend, and Luffy makes quite an impression as he gets to know the fighters competing for Ace`s Devil Fruit.

episodes.title: A Pirate Noble! Cavendish!
episodes.description: A gorgeous gladiator tells Luffy the story of the world`s greatest warrior, a masked mauler literally destroys the competition, and the Navy makes its presence felt!

episodes.title: The Fatefull Reunion! Bellamy the Hyena!
episodes.description: An old nemesis sees through Luffy`s disguise, Zoro finally catches up to the sword-stealing fairy, and Sanji`s skill at sniffing out snipers impresses his new lady friend!

episodes.title: A Super Rookie! Bartolomeo the Cannibal!
episodes.description: Bartolomeo and Bellamy take center stage in the latest round of the battle royal, but a slugger with a serious punch threatens to steal their thunder. Meanwhile, Luffy is targeted by an angry behemoth!

episodes.title: Big Names Duke It Out! The Heated Block B Battle!
episodes.description: An old enemy of Garp`s reveals Luffy`s true identity, landing the Straw Hat captain in hot water with one of his fellow competitors. Meanwhile, the battle in Block B gets supremely brutal!

episodes.title: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch!
episodes.description: Franky`s new robot friend promises to reveal the tragic secrets of Dressrosa, and a regal brawler prepares to throw a powerful punch that could destroy the entire colosseum!

episodes.title: The Fighting Fish Strike! Across The Deadly Iron Bridge!
episodes.description: While Law, Robin, Usopp, and Caesar attempt to survive a Fighting Fish attack, Sanji learns the heartbreaking truth about the beautiful woman who stole his heart!

episodes.title: Explore! Fairies' Island - Green Bit!
episodes.description: Luffy`s turn to fight in the epic colosseum battle draws near, Zoro has an interesting encounter with a surprisingly strong fairy, and the thoughts in Sanji`s head shock his lady captor!

episodes.title: The Unknown World! The Tontatta Kingdom!
episodes.description: Sanji learns some disturbing news that could mean trouble for his friends, Luffy prepares for a fight, and Robin is captured by a village full of little people!

episodes.title: The Stratagem Of The Century! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
episodes.description: Despite Sanji`s attempt to warn him, Law finds his life in danger after being ambushed by Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Luffy is unable to hide his true identity once the fists start flying!

episodes.title: Shaking Heaven And Earth! Admiral Fujitora's Power!
episodes.description: After his plan falls apart, Law must fight for his life against two powerful opponents. Elsewhere, Sanji bids a touching goodbye to his special lady friend, and Luffy tangles with Brutal Bull!

episodes.title: A Blow of Anger! A Giant vs. Lucy!
episodes.description: Nami, Chopper, and Brook are grotesquely transformed by a hideous woman who fancies herself an artist. Back at the colosseum, Luffy gets serious when his new friend falls victim to a giant attack!

episodes.title: Destruction Cannon Blasts! Lucy In Trouble!
episodes.description: Zoro and his fairy friend argue over directions, Trafalgar Law finds himself outnumbered in his battle with Doflamingo, and Luffy`s latest opponent packs an explosive punch!

episodes.title: The Legendary Pirate! Don Chin Jao!
episodes.description: While Nami, Chopper, and Brook attempt to take back the Sunny, Luffy and the monstrous mauler Don Chinjao take their brutal grudge match to a legendary level!

episodes.title: Light and Shadow! Darkness Behind Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Luffy`s battle with Don Chinjao heats up, Franky learns the tragic truth behind Dressrosa`s mysterious toy population, and Robin and Usopp prepare to join their little friends in battle!

episodes.title: Making A Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland
episodes.description: Luffy continues his battle with Don Chinjao, Franky and Zoro are reunited in the land of the little people, and Law is wounded in a revealing, face-to-face showdown with Doflamingo!

episodes.title: The Fierce Battle Coming To The End! Lucy vs. Chin Jao!
episodes.description: A flashback reveals the story of how Garp changed Chinjao`s world forever. Back in the present, Luffy and his opponent trade ferocious blows that literally rock the colosseum!

episodes.title: Luffy And The Gladiator Of Fate! Rebecca!
episodes.description: During a break between battles, Luffy is attacked by an angry rival, but a beautiful gladiator with mysterious motives offers him food - and a place to rest.

episodes.title: Protect You To the End! Rebecca And The Toy Soldier!
episodes.description: In the moments before battle, the beautiful gladiator Rebecca flashes back to the tragic events of her childhood and the toy soldier who became her constant companion.

episodes.title: The Last - And Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins!
episodes.description: The bloodthirsty crowd hurls insults at Rebecca as the battle of Block D begins. On the other side of the island, Law finds himself on the losing end of his battle with Doflamingo!

episodes.title: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. The Straw Hats!
episodes.description: Brook`s trickery springs the Straw Hats from their artistic prison, but their failure to cuff the culprit means they`ll need help from a cola-powered cannon to emerge victorious!

episodes.title: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish Of The White Horse!
episodes.description: Cavendish wins over the female fans during the Block D battle, Luffy keeps an eye on Rebecca, and Sanji heads toward a heated collision with Doflamingo!

episodes.title: A Big Clash! Sanji vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Sanji`s battle with Doflamingo is interrupted by Law`s sudden arrival, and Rebecca continues her impressive showing in the battle of Block D!

episodes.title: Rebecca's Special Attack! Back - To - The Water Dance!
episodes.description: Law begins a deadly, face-to-face battle with Doflamingo, Zoro enlists the aid of a star struck gladiator, and Rebecca continues to impresses Luffy with her unique fighting style!

episodes.title: The Most Violent Fighter! Logan vs. Rebecca!
episodes.description: Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!

episodes.title: A Big Surprise! A True Identity Of The Toy Soldier!
episodes.description: Rebecca`s battle continues, a madman turns a gladiator into a play thing, and the brave little toy soldier reveals his painful past – and the tragic truth behind King Riku`s fall from power!

episodes.title: A Horrible Past! The Secret Of Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!

episodes.title: A Nightmare! The Tragic Night Of Dressrosa!
episodes.description: Rebecca continues her valiant stand in the arena of battle, Luffy is reunited with Zoro, and the heartbreaking story of how Doflamingo conquered Dressrosa continues!

episodes.title: A Showdown Between the Warlords! Law vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Law`s power begins to fade, making him an easy target for Doflamingo`s vicious attacks. Meanwhile, Franky begs Luffy to let him fight alongside Soldier and the little people!

episodes.title: Two Great Rivals Meet Each Other! Straw Hat and Heavenly Demon!
episodes.description: Luffy sets his sights on a showdown with Doflamingo in a desperate attempt to save Law`s life. Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Brook are attacked by a very deadly foe!

episodes.title: Luffy Astonished! The Man Who Inherit's Ace's Will!
episodes.description: Soldier reveals his daring plan to return all the toys to their human forms, and Luffy has an emotional encounter with someone from his very distant past!

episodes.title: Operation SOP Starts - Usoland Charges Forth
episodes.description: Usopp and Robin join the little people on their mission to turn the toys back into humans, Franky wreaks havoc at the toy house, and Rebecca continues her gladiator battle!

episodes.title: A Burning Passion! Rebecca vs. Suleiman!
episodes.description: Zoro attracts unwanted attention by upsetting a child, Soldier risks his life to lead the attack on Doflamingo, and Rebecca struggles to survive the brutal battle of Block D!

episodes.title: The End Of The Match?! A Surprising Result Of Block D!
episodes.description: Rebecca survives an encounter with an opponent`s deadly alter ego, Franky continues his battle with a man who dresses like a baby, and Violet offers to sneak Luffy into the palace!

episodes.title: The Admiral's Decision! Fujitora vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Franky has his hands full battling a host of enemies at the Toy House, Violet leads Luffy to a secret entrance into the palace, and Fujitora issues Doflamingo a grave warning!

episodes.title: The Final Round Starts - Diamante the Hero Shows Up
episodes.description: Diamante`s unique abilities and the presence of special Fighting Fish add a deadly wrinkle to the tournament`s final round. Elsewhere, Luffy spoils any chance of sneaking up on Doflamingo!

episodes.title: The Castle Moves! Elite Officer Pica Emerges
episodes.description: Luffy tangles with a monster made of stone, Franky bursts into flames after getting shot by a cannon, and the courageous little people hatch a plan to turn the toys back into humans!

episodes.title: Dragon Claw Strikes! Lucy's Intimidating Attack!
episodes.description: Soldier takes a beating from a Doflamingo Family Executive, Lucy shows off a powerful new fighting style, and Zoro pushes his blades to the breaking point in a showdown with a man made of stone!

episodes.title: Defeat Sugar! The Army Of The Little People Charges!
episodes.description: Zoro repeatedly slices his stone opponent into pieces, but he can`t find a way to make the bad guy stay down. Meanwhile, the bravery of the little people could get them turned into toys!

episodes.title: The Last Light Of Hope! The Secret Of Our Commander!
episodes.description: The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol's furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier's stunning true identity! Meanwhile, with the help of another Tontatta group, the Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!

episodes.title: The Rupture Man! Gladius Blows Up Big Time!
episodes.description: Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly-indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!

episodes.title: A Liar! Usoland on the Run!
episodes.description: With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others all busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol? Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make - run and fight another day or face his own doom and challenge Trebol!

episodes.title: A Fateful Encounter! Kyros And King Riku!
episodes.description: The deep and tragic story of Kyros is revealed! The legend of this invincible gladiator is tied up with the royal family of Dressrosa! Meanwhile, Trebol`s defeat at the hands of Usopp is not a sure thing yet!

episodes.title: Operation Failed! Hero Usoland Dies!?
episodes.description: In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo`s chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy, and all hopes rest on Usopp to provide the miracle everyone needs!

episodes.title: The Legend is Back! Kyros' All-Out Attack!
episodes.description: Usopp manages to knock Sugar out and Operation SOP is accomplished! The toys in Dressrosa start turning back to their original forms and the people are slowly realizing who Doflamingo really is! In the meantime, the legendary hero Kyros reverts to his true form - and this mighty champion of the Colosseum has a score to settle!

episodes.title: The Fire Fist Strikes! - The Flare Flare Fruit Power Returns!
episodes.description: Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo's clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring! Will he be able to snag the Flare-Flare Fruit?

episodes.title: Dashing onto the Scene - The Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, Sabo!
episodes.description: Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his new-found followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo`s defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but the Young Master may have a trick left up his sleeve...

episodes.title: The Devil's Trap - Dressrosa Annihilation Plan
episodes.description: The mystery of Doflamingo`s return from the dead is revealed! But there isn`t much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!

episodes.title: The 500 Million Berry Man! Target: Usoland!
episodes.description: As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game - targeting Luffy, King Riku, and Law, but with the highest bounty reserved for Usopp!

episodes.title: Breakthrough the Enemy Lines - Luffy and Zoro's Counterattack!
episodes.description: Doflamingo and Fujitora`s agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace along with Zoro and Law, Fujitora stands in his way!

episodes.title: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!
episodes.description: Robin, Usopp, the Tontatta`s and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo`s deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin`emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town and changes the stakes of the game!

episodes.title: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
episodes.description: With Luffy and the others recovering from Pica`s attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out - to decide who gets to take down Doflamingo once and for all!

episodes.title: Steady Progress! Luffy's Army vs. Pica!
episodes.description: Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica's giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action, summoning all the Navy soldiers on the island!

episodes.title: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!
episodes.description: Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law`s handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him. Finally, Law`s reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed!

episodes.title: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora
episodes.description: Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo`s refuge, making his way through Doflamingo`s guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit! But with Fujitora`s ability to call down a meteor, will Sabo have to power to save himself?

episodes.title: A Desperate Situation - Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
episodes.description: Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas to catch up with Luffy and Law!

episodes.title: Great Escape! Luffy's Miraculous Elephant Gun!
episodes.description: Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum to defend himself and protect Robin and Rebecca!

episodes.title: A United Front – Luffy's Breakthrough to Victory
episodes.description: The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other`s necks towards a unified plan, which might just be enough to get Luffy the chance to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo!

episodes.title: The Second Samurai – Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears
episodes.description: Hidden far underground, Kin`emon finds his old friend Kanjuro, whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along - and that the only way to win is to take the Warlord down!

episodes.title: The Struggle with Pica – Zoro's One Finishing Move
episodes.description: The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.

episodes.title: The Little People's Princess - Captive Mansherry
episodes.description: Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky while Señor Pink, wise to Frankie`s deception, arrives on the scene ready for a manly showdown!

episodes.title: Invulnerable! The Terrifying Headcracker Doll Army
episodes.description: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below - and directly into Luffy and the others` battle with the creepy Headcracker Dolls!

episodes.title: Life-Risking! Luffy is the Trump Card to Victory
episodes.description: Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process? Meanwhile, Sabo tastes Fujitora`s full might!

episodes.title: A Tearful Reunion – Rebecca and Kyros!
episodes.description: Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo -- but Sugar stands in their way!

episodes.title: One Shot One Kill - The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa
episodes.description: Usopp uses Viola`s Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster -- and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp`s ammunition has been specially designed for this specific situation!

episodes.title: Anger Explosion - Luffy and Laws's Ultimate Secret Plan
episodes.description: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy`s own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.

episodes.title: Noble Family - Doflamingo's True Identity!
episodes.description: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…

episodes.title: Ultimate Power - The Secret of the Ope Ope no Mi!
episodes.description: With Fujitora`s stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!

episodes.title: Sad Memories - Law the Boy from the White City!
episodes.description: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law`s traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!

episodes.title: Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
episodes.description: Law`s attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he`s accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon`s mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law`s life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!

episodes.title: A Rocky Road! – Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
episodes.description: Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon`s actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.

episodes.title: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
episodes.description: Corazon`s double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.

episodes.title: The Moment of Resolution: Corazon's Farewell Smile!
episodes.description: The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon`s hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island; the location of Corazon and Law!

episodes.title: Advance, Law! The Kindhearted Man's Final Fight!
episodes.description: Doflamingo and his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law`s whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape - even if that means sacrificing his own life. However, when things turn sour, it`s a chain of lucky coincidences that allows the plan to be set into motion - almost as though someone or something is keeping Law alive!

episodes.title: To Be Free! Law's Injection Shot Blasts!
episodes.description: Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it`s Law`s revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!

episodes.title: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.

episodes.title: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!
episodes.description: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo`s control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!

episodes.title: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!
episodes.description: Lao G and Don Chin Jao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chin Jao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?

episodes.title: The Man's Pride - Bellamy's Last Charge!
episodes.description: Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!

episodes.title: Storm and Stress! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!
episodes.description: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger's horrible true nature!

episodes.title: Barrier-Barrier! Homage God Fist Strikes!
episodes.description: Bartolomeo is in a neck and neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish, but his evil aspect Hakuba keeps complicating the situation more!

episodes.title: The Healing Princess! Save Mansherry
episodes.description: Princess Mansherry`s amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who`ve gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance! It`s up to Leo to save the day!

episodes.title: The Manly Duel! Señor's Elegy of Love!
episodes.description: Señor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both of them are pushed to their limits, we learn Señor`s tragic past! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry`s rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!

episodes.title: Stardust of Death! Diamante's Storm of Vicious Attacks!
episodes.description: Franky and Señor Pink end their harrowing duel in a manly way - but victory knocks the wind out of even the winner`s sails! Meanwhile, Diamante and Kyros struggle desperately on the Sunflower Field, each demonstrating their extreme prowess even in near defeat!

episodes.title: Trueno Bastardo! Kyros' Furious Strike!
episodes.description: Kyros, unbowed by Diamante`s vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain, setting the stage for the Straw Hats` victory.

episodes.title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!
episodes.description: Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!

episodes.title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!
episodes.description: With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King`s Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica`s near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.

episodes.title: So Long! Bellamy's Farewell Blow!
episodes.description: Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy`s hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!

episodes.title: Law Dies - Luffy's Raging Onslaught!
episodes.description: Taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law`s lifeless body! Meanwhile, Doflamingo takes the next step to end the game he started, which will endanger everybody in Dressrosa!

episodes.title: A Blade of Tenacity! The Gamma Knife Counterattack!
episodes.description: The Birdcage draws tighter and tighter around Dressrosa, threatening to destroy all life on the island kingdom! Meanwhile, Doflamingo stands down Luffy for a final confrontation, but a surprising twist shocks everyone on the top of the Royal Palace!

episodes.title: A Collision of Haki! Luffy vs. Doflamingo!
episodes.description: Law`s attack proves powerful - but Doflamingo`s power has depths which he and Luffy haven`t bargained for. When Doflamingo makes his counterattack, Luffy stares him down with an amazing power.

episodes.title: Unassailable! The Stunning Secret of Trebol
episodes.description: Trebol`s wrath is fully inflamed as Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo`s game. But Law gathers enough energy to do more than just speak out.

episodes.title: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!
episodes.description: Cavendish has to make a difficult decision when the severely wounded Law begs him to be left behind. Meanwhile, seeing even his Second Gear or Third Gear attacks aren`t working against Doflamingo, Luffy decides to use his ultimate technique!

episodes.title: Fourth Gear! The Phenomenal Bounce-man!
episodes.description: Luffy and Doflamingo duke it out while the Birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa! Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country, while Luffy`s Fourth Gear proves quite potent against Doflamingo!

episodes.title: A Massive Counterattack! Doflamingo's Awakening!
episodes.description: The Birdcage continues its merciless constriction, sending the residents of Dressrosa fleeing towards the center of the island, while King Riku calls out to his people; survive long enough for Luffy to vanquish the last of the royal family - Doflamingo himself!

episodes.title: Luffy! An All-Out Leo Bazooka!
episodes.description: Fourth Gear gives Luffy the power he needs to head off Doflamingo at every strike! But the energy required to keep Fourth Gear going starts to take a toll on Luffy. Will he have enough left to finish the job?

episodes.title: Flame Dragon King! Protect Luffy's Life!
episodes.description: Bounce-man`s power has drained Luffy, leaving him in need of a rest before he can reuse his Haki, but luckily the gladiators from the Colosseum have come around and are focusing on taking down Doflamingo! Sabo steps in at a crucial moment to defend his brother, Luffy!

episodes.title: Tears of Miracles! Mansherry's Fight!
episodes.description: With Luffy and so many of the Straw Hats` allies incapacitated, victory seems inevitable for Doflamingo - but the compassion of Mansherry may be enough to turn the tide and renew their hope - to stop the Birdcage!

episodes.title: As Long as We Breathe! Stop the Deadly Birdcage
episodes.description: With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts towards slowing down the Birdcage as it squeezes the life out of the country! Meanwhile, Viola seeks Doflamingo out herself, for a shocking confrontation!

episodes.title: Dead or Alive! A Fateful Countdown
episodes.description: Only a bit more time remains before Luffy returns to the scene! But as time slips by, those who had been roused by Princess Mansherry`s powers begin to falter! Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, is about to attack Viola!

episodes.title: Strike the Heavens - Luffy's King Kong Gun of Rage
episodes.description: Luffy regains enough Haki to face off against Doflamingo, but his health is still poor. With the Birdcage closing in, is there a technique left in his repertoire that is strong enough to take down Doflamingo?

episodes.title: To Freedom! Dressrosa Overjoyed!
episodes.description: With Doflamingo thoroughly quashed and the Birdcage collapsing, the people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy remembering the hardships they`ve endured, and the actions taken by Luffy and the others to free them.

episodes.title: Unprecedented - The Shocking Decision of Admiral Fujitora!
episodes.description: Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates tries to agitate Sabo, mocking Ace`s final words in order to unsettle him enough that he can try to steal the Flare-Flare Fruit! Meanwhile, people of Dressrosa beg King Riku to resume the crown when Navy Admiral Fujitora steps in and takes a stunning action!

episodes.title: The World Trembles - The Worst Generation Advances!
episodes.description: Repercussions of Doflamingo`s defeat reverberate around the world! Fujitora`s actions put the Navy in a tight spot, and the "Worst Generation" beings to stir into action!

episodes.title: The Birth of a Legend - The Adventure of Sabo the Revolutionary!
episodes.description: The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army!

episodes.title: The Brother's Bond - The Story of Luffy and Sabo's Reunion
episodes.description: Sabo recounts his surprising reunion with Luffy at the Colosseum as the Straw Hats and the others continue to recoup. Meanwhile, Fujitora gambles on how to make his next move - and the odds are in Luffy`s favor!

episodes.title: The Strongest Creature - Kaido of the Beasts
episodes.description: As Sabo departs, our attention shifts to the other Straw Hats waging a fierce battle on a mysterious island. And a new drama is set into motion as ill portents fall from the sky!

episodes.title: Fujitora on the Move - The Straw Hats Completely Surrounded
episodes.description: As Luffy and the others begin to come to their senses, major players in the Navy arrive to search Dressrosa for the Straw Hats! Also, Rebecca`s history is whitewashed with a fake cover story - but why?

episodes.title: A State of Emergency! Rebecca Is Kidnapped!
episodes.description: Fujitora`s flirting with chance has turned out poorly for the Straw Hats as the full Navy force bears down on Dressrosa searching for the pirates! Luffy and the others make a mad dash for the east port to get off the island, but not without finishing up a piece of business...

episodes.title: The Bond Between Father and Daughter! Kyros and Rebecca!
episodes.description: Rebecca has precious little time to follow Luffy`s lead and make it to Kyros. Can she make it in time? Meanwhile, Fujitora is closing in on Bartolomeo and the other Colosseum warriors while Trafalgar Law faces the shadows of his past!

episodes.title: Manly Spirit - Luffy vs. Fujitora in a Head-to-Head Clash
episodes.description: Law and Sengoku share memories of Corazon, and the secret of Trafalgar Law`s name. Meanwhile, Fujitora uses the destruction caused by the battle in Dressrosa as a weapon, and squares off one-on-one with Luffy!

episodes.title: No Way Out! Admiral Fujitora's Ruthless Pursuit!
episodes.description: The people of Dressrosa show their appreciation to the Straw Hats one last time by foiling Fujitora`s strategy. As Luffy and the others are able to finally make their break from the island, however, an unbelievable new chapter opens in the story of the Straw Hat Pirates!

episodes.title: Sons' Cups - Straw Hat Fleet is Formed!
episodes.description: With newfound allies won in the battle at Dressrosa, and as the Navy watches, Luffy and the Straw Hats depart Dressrosa for open water. But will Luffy accept the oath of allegiance given by his new fleet?

episodes.title: The Numerous Rivals Struggle Amongst Themselves - The Raging Monsters of the New World
episodes.description: While the Straw Hats are underway, Doflamingo has serious predictions for the upset of the world order! Meanwhile, the recent actions in Dressrosa have led to surprising results!

episodes.title: The Silver Fortress – The Great Adventures of Luffy and Bart
episodes.description: While heading to the next island, Zou, Luffy's appetite causes them trouble and he and Bartolomeo find themselves entangled in the scheme of a pirate lord who can manipulate silver.

episodes.title: An Underground Labyrinth – Luffy vs Mine Cart Man
episodes.description: The Tram-Man arrives! And has Luffy, Bartolomeo and Desire on the run! The deeper the three fall into the pit, however, the more clear it becomes that Bill`s group hides a terrible secret!

episodes.title: The Sword Technique Heats Up! Law and Zoro Finally Appear!
episodes.description: Luffy, Bartolomeo, and Desire make their way up the mineshaft, but Bill`s assassin, Peseta, has other plans! Just when the going gets tough, help arrives, and Zoro battles the assassin head on!

episodes.title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Fights a Battle in Extreme Heat!
episodes.description: Luffy, Desire, and Bartolomeo go up against Bill! But the mad, Smelt-Smelt man becomes deranged and lets his true power unfurl! Do Luffy and the others have any hope of exposing Bill`s self-serving aims and turning his gang against him?

episodes.title: The Start of a New Adventure - Arrival at the Mysterious Island, 'Zou'!
episodes.description: Bartolomeo recounts the formation of the Straw Hats, sharing their moving story with the rest of his crew! Meanwhile, the mysterious island of Zou approaches in the distance, obscured by fog. But when the haze clears, no one is expecting what they see!

episodes.title: The New Shichibukai - Son of the Legendary Whitebeard Arrives
episodes.description: Luffy and the others arrive at the mysterious land of Zou, and find the Sunny. But when they board, they find the other Straw Hats have already disembarked. Thus, Luffy, Zoro, Robin and the others take on the challenge of climbing the monstrous elephant!

episodes.title: A Deadly Elephant Climb - A Great Adventure on the Back of the Giant Elephant!
episodes.description: Finally scaling the elephant`s back, the Straw Hats continue their search for the other half of their crew! But the mysterious "island" on the back of the elephant may hold more danger than they bargained for, as they learn they are not alone!

episodes.title: Battle Starts! Luffy vs. the Mink Tribe!
episodes.description: Luffy pushes deeper into the mysterious forest on the elephant's back, but he`s treading in territory where is not welcome! Meanwhile, Usopp and the others make a startling discovery in a ruined city!

episodes.title: Garchu! The Straw Hat Crew Reunites
episodes.description: Luffy and the others survive the Rain-Ruption and learn of its vital role in maintaining life on Zou. They continue on towards the fortress learning more about the mysterious Mink Tribe, and are finally reunited with the others - but is that the whole story?

episodes.title: The Counterattack Begins! The Curly Hat Pirates moves out!
episodes.description: Luffy and the others are unexpectedly welcomed at the fortress and treated well by the Minks, although they have to navigate some cultural differences… And Nami starts sharing what happened to them after they left Dressrosa.

episodes.title: An Incoming Threat - Jack of the Beasts Pirates!
episodes.description: Luffy and the others learn about the dangerous intruders who have come to Zou, and why the island is wrecked! Afterwards, Luffy`s loose lips get them into trouble!

episodes.title: Ruler of Day - Enter Duke Inuarashi!
episodes.description: Duke Dogstorm - the Straw Hats finally meet the ruler of this strange land, and learn more about the battle that took place here; and the mysterious system by which the island is ruled!

episodes.title: Ruler of Night - Nekomamushi Appears
episodes.description: Day turns to night as the Minks keep up their onslaught against the invading Beast Pirates! But Jack`s amazing Devil Fruit power may end the elephant island once and for all!

episodes.title: The Exterminated Capital! The Twirly Hat Crew Arrive!
episodes.description: Night and day, Jack faces the fury of the two sworn defenders of Zou, but while they put up a good fight, the Minks aren`t able to subdue Jack, especially after he brings out his secret weapon...

episodes.title: The Time Limit Closes in! The Bond Between the Mink Tribe and the Crew!
episodes.description: In the aftermath of Jack`s deadly attack on the island of Zou, Chopper and Sanji rush in to save the fallen Mink Tribe - but they will need the help of Caesar to overcome the poisonous effects of the gas!

episodes.title: The Delinquent Comes Home! Emperor Big Mom's Assassins!
episodes.description: More of the dramatic happenings on Zou are revealed as we learn that Jack`s pirate band were not the only visitors to the elephant island! And what about the mysterious fate of Sanji?

episodes.title: The Truth Behind His Disappearance – Sanji's Shocking Invitation
episodes.description: The mystery of Sanji`s disappearance deepens as Luffy learns that Big Mom`s lackeys have caught up with him and the rest - and carry with them an invitation from Big Mom that simply can`t be refused!

episodes.title: To My Buds! Sanji's Farewell Note!
episodes.description: Sanji`s dire situation has become clear, but instead of rallying against Big Mom`s crew, he submits to go along with them to bring an end to this situation. But being separated from one of his crew is more than Luffy is willing to tolerate!

episodes.title: Let's Go See Master Nekomamushi
episodes.description: There`s only one key to finding out what happened to Sanji - and Luffy and the others make their way towards finding out more about their friend`s disappearance, but on their way the indigenous fauna give them trouble!

episodes.title: Luffy's Decision - The Sanji Abdication Crisis!
episodes.description: Luffy hatches a plan to help Sanji, but he`ll have to go alone to avoid an all-out war with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Kin`emon and Kanjuro finally arrive at Zou, unwittingly setting the stage for the Minks` thirst for revenge!

episodes.title: An Explosive Situation – Dog, Cat, and Samurai!
episodes.description: The samurai have landed! And they make their way into the country of Zou unaware of the welcome they will receive by the Minks! The Straw Hats try their best to stop the fight - but as day meets night and Cat Viper and Dogstorm face each other, tensions run high in the elephant country!

episodes.title: The Third One! Raizo of the Mist, the Ninja, Appears!
episodes.description: Revelations abound as the true nature of the Wano clan and their relationship with the Minks is revealed! Momonosuke`s role is greater than any had imagined! But even more shocking - the visage of Raizo the Ninja!

episodes.title: A Red Stone! A Guide to the One Piece!
episodes.description: The mysteries of ninjutsu enthrall the Straw Hats as Raizo, the implausible ninja, makes his true powers known! Meanwhile, a mysterious artifact points the way towards the end of the Grand Line!

episodes.title: The Secret of the Land of Wano! The Kozuki Family and the Ponegliffs!
episodes.description: The mystery of the Ponegliffs is revealed - their true significance, and the story of their creation, leads closer to the Straw Hats than they might have imagined!

episodes.title: A Vow Between Two Men - Luffy and Kozuki Momonosuke
episodes.description: More mysteries of the Kozuki Clan are revealed - and the samurai propose an alliance to help topple Kaido! But Luffy`s response will shock the crew... and force the young daimyo to take responsibility!

episodes.title: The Legendary Journey! The Dog and the Cat and the Pirate King!
episodes.description: Dogstorm and Cat Viper share their story of being on the journey with Oden and Roger but are interrupted by Nami who is concerned about the sea route. Meanwhile, Jack is plotting to bring down the Mokomo Dukedom again!

episodes.title: Returning Nightmare - Assault of the Invulnerable Jack
episodes.description: The plans are set! The Straw Hats divide and conquer, one group heading to save Sanji, the others to the Land of Wano! But in the final moments before their departure, the tremendous elephant island begins to quake!

episodes.title: Defensive Battle of Zou - Luffy and Zunisha!
episodes.description: After being aggressively attacked by Jack`s fleet, the monstrous Zunesha comes to life and beckons to those on its back! But can the Straw Hats understand its cry? And realize in time what the elephant island needs from them?

episodes.title: Save Zunesha! The Straw Hat's Rescue Operation!
episodes.description: With the skirmish with Jack now over, the Straw Hats move on to trying to bandage the great elephant`s wounds! But just as the whole island puts the plan into action, unseen danger lurks on horizon!

episodes.title: Saying Goodbye and Descending from the Elephant! Setting Out to Take Back Sanji!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats and the others split up into four teams, each on different missions! Some from the Mink Tribe insist on leaving with Luffy's team! Meanwhile, Usopp makes a weapon for Nami that seems to work like magic!

episodes.title: To the Reverie - Princess Vivi and Princess Shirahoshi
episodes.description: Luffy`s team sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji! But they didn`t realize there is one more crewmember than they have bargained for! Meanwhile, the leading families and leaders of the world make their way to Mariejois for the pivotal world meeting!

episodes.title: To the Reverie - Rebecca and the Sakura Kingdom
episodes.description: Carrot stows away! And settles in with the Straw Hats as they make their way to rescue Sanji! Meanwhile, in the Sakura Kingdom - formerly the Drum Kingdom, Dalton and Kureha are getting ready for the Reverie so as their former enemy in his newly-built kingdom…

episodes.title: Kaido Returns - The Worst Generation Threatened!
episodes.description: News of the raid on the Revolutionary Army reaches Luffy! But that`s the least of their worries as they face a storm and a sudden lack of provisions! Meanwhile, Emperor Kaido, furious at the loss of Joker, fumes with anger at the reckless generation of upstarts!

episodes.title: A Hungry Front - Luffy and the Marine Rookies!
episodes.description: Sneaking in to the Navy island facility to replenish their food supply, Luffy and the others risk being caught out in the open! Will their infamy make them easy to spot by the hotheaded Navy recruits around them?

episodes.title: The Persistent Trio – The Great Pursuit for the Straw Hats!
episodes.description: The jig is up as Luffy and the others make a daring dash to avoid the furious Navy! Can they escape without having to turn to fight - and after they`ve had a chance to raid the cabinets for food?

episodes.title: Fist of the Devil – Showdown! Luffy vs. Grant
episodes.description: Making a mad dash for the Submerge with the food they stole, Luffy and the others have to get through some of the Navy`s upstart soldiers! Grount, whose arm holds incredible power, summons his training to challenge Luffy!

episodes.title: Sanji's Homecoming! Into Big Mom's Territory!
episodes.description: The Straw Hats continue to suffer from blazing heat and a perilous food crisis! As the seas finally calm, fishing is their only hope! Meanwhile, Sanji arrives in Big Mom`s territory and keeps his cool - until he sees his bride-to-be!

episodes.title: Zero and Four! Encountering Germa 66!
episodes.description: Luffy is in danger as the venomous fish poison courses through his body! With no antidotes on board, the Straw Hats must rely on a mysterious ship for help - a ship that bears a truly surprising crew!

episodes.title: A Deadly Poison Crisis - Luffy and Reiju!
episodes.description: On the edge of life and death, Luffy`s only hope rests with Sanji`s siblings! But even though they refuse to share an antidote, they may be able to save Luffy`s life yet, giving him enough energy to plunge right back into trouble...

episodes.title: Totto Land! Emperor Big Mom Appears
episodes.description: Arriving on Cacao Island, Luffy and Chopper are in heaven as everything before their eyes is edible! But in this most heavenly of places, there are rules to be obeyed - and consequences for breaking them! Luckily someone is on the lookout for the Straw Hats!

episodes.title: The Yonko's Daughter – Sanji's Fiancée "Pudding"
episodes.description: The Straw Hats confront Pudding - the fiancée of Sanji! But when they challenge her for Sanji`s heart, her answer shocks them! Meanwhile an ominous and mysterious message may spell doom for the Straw Hats...

episodes.title: A Massive Attack! Mom's Hunger Pangs
episodes.description: The dangerous waters around the Whole Cake Island harbor terrifying creatures that pose a challenge for the Straw Hats! Meanwhile, Mama slips into a bout of her sickness and ravages her own land in search a specific pastry!

episodes.title: The Capital City Falls?! Big Mom and Jimbei
episodes.description: Big Mom rampages through the Whole Cake Island in search for sweets - but when the kitchen can`t prepare them fast enough her own son steps in to curb the carnage, with deadly results. Only an old face coming across the waters brings Mom what she needs, even though he also brings ill tidings.

episodes.title: The Yonko's Castle – Arrival on Whole Cake Island
episodes.description: As the Straw Hats draw closer to the Whole Cake Island, Pedro shares his sordid past in Big Mom's territory - and hatches a plan to win back Sanji and take an item of great worth from the Emperor!

episodes.title: A Mysterious Forest Full of Candies - Luffy vs. Luffy?!
episodes.description: Brook and Pedro head out in a submersible to infiltrate Big Mom`s stronghold! Meanwhile Luffy, Nami, Chopper and Carrot head into the island chasing the image of Sanji, only to be distracted by the endless supply of sweets and a second Luffy!

episodes.title: Mom's Assassin! Luffy and the Seducing Woods!
episodes.description: Lost in the bewildering woods and chasing after Sanji, Nami and the others find there`s more than meets the eye in this upside down part of the Whole Cake Island! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his brother!

episodes.title: A Seafaring Kingdom! Germa's King Judge!
episodes.description: Luffy continues to move through the mysterious and dangerous woods, unaware of the danger that lurks in the trees! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his father as the wounds of his childhood are laid bare!

episodes.title: A Battle Between Father and Son - Judge vs. Sanji!
episodes.description: Sanji faces off against his father in a duel! His powerful kicks aim at protecting his hands, but the Germa Family has more in store for him yet! Meanwhile Luffy goes deeper into the Seducing Woods and falls for their powerful illusions!

episodes.title: A Giant Ambition - Big Mom and Caesar
episodes.description: Big Mom has Caesar Clown at her whims - and despite his bilking her out of countless amounts of money - she is ready to continue her pursuit of maniacal world control! Meanwhile, Big Mom`s forces are on to the Straw Hats, and Pekoms faces a dire situation!

episodes.title: The Land of Souls! Mom's Fatal Ability!
episodes.description: Finally Nami finds Luffy and recounts her harrowing tale of battling Brulee! Meanwhile the mysterious half-buried man comes clean about his true identity! But this must all be put aside when one of Mom`s most powerful generals comes calling!

episodes.title: A Top Executive! One of the Three Commanders "Cracker" Appears
episodes.description: The identity of the enigmatic Pound, the man half-buried in the woods, is revealed, but his deep connection to Big Mom might not be enough to save him! Nami`s past exploits, however, hold the key to keeping Mom`s minions at bay!

episodes.title: An Enemy With 800 Million Bounty – Luffy vs. Thousand Arms Cracker
episodes.description: Luffy squares off against Cracker, one of the Sweet 3 Generals, as Nami learns the truth about others in the Worst Generation who have come before to challenge Big Mom!

episodes.title: Full Force Showdown – Gear Fourth vs. Bisu Bisu Ability
episodes.description: Luffy continues to fight against Cracker, whose powers to manipulate his surroundings may prove more troublesome than he had thought! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro infiltrate the Whole Cake Island - and must hatch a plan to avoid getting caught!

episodes.title: The First and the Second Join! The Vinsmoke Family
episodes.description: The wind starts to go out of Luffy`s sails as he fights an endless army of Biscuit Warriors! Meanwhile, the oldest two Vinsmoke brothers come home from a war to see their long-missing young brother Sanji.

episodes.title: The Benefactor's Life! Sanji and Owner Zeff!
episodes.description: Luffy starts to run out of steam as the Biscuit Warriors keep multiplying! If he can buy himself 10 minutes to recharge... Meanwhile, Sanji squares off against his family, but realizes they have some vital insurance to make sure he follows their scheme to marry Pudding.

episodes.title: An Angry Sanji! The Secret of Germa 66!
episodes.description: Luffy needs just 10 minutes to recharge! Nami comes to rescue with the help of the Homies! Meanwhile, Sanji learns the terrible truth of Germa`s power - and his father`s dark history!

episodes.title: The Past that He Let Go of! Vinsmoke Sanji!
episodes.description: Nami challenges Cracker on her own! During the all-out fight, she loses her advantage and is close to defeat. Can Luffy bounce back in time? Meanwhile, Sanji`s tragic childhood is made clear.

episodes.title: To the East Blue! Sanji's Resolute Departure!
episodes.description: The terrible history of Sanji`s family continue to unfold. From a rare moment of compassion he is able to escape, only to face his father`s cruelty before setting out on his own.

episodes.title: A Battle of Limits! Luffy and the Infinite Biscuits!
episodes.description: Luffy is in an all-out, all-you-can-eat battle! As Cracker`s endless stream of Biscuit Warriors marches on, Luffy`s endless appetite is put to the test. Meanwhile, Reiju helps Sanji to straighten himself out before he meets his fiancée.

episodes.title: Power of Fullness - New Gear Fourth Tankman!
episodes.description: Luffy needs to think fast in order to turn the battle in his favor - filled with biscuits he debuts a new Gear Four attack that has lasting repercussions! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot find Sanji`s reflection, but can they get a message to him in time?

episodes.title: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! - Part 1
episodes.description: Sanji has memories of his escape from the Germa Kingdom, meeting Zeff, and later joining the Straw Hats as his family heads to the Whole Cake Chateau. Luffy and Nami ride King Baum out of the Seducing Woods, and they contact Chopper and Carrot, who reveal where Sanji is headed as they are pursued by Brûlée. They manage to hide again, but Brûlée brings Randolph, his crane, and the Noble Croc into the world to help her hunt the duo down, and Chopper gets the idea to gain control of Brûlée's power. Back in the real world, Luffy and Nami reach Sanji, and Luffy reunites with his crewmate. However, Sanji kicks Luffy out of the carriage, claiming to have accepted his royal heritage and disowning Luffy.

episodes.title: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! - Part 2
episodes.description: Luffy refuses to back down from the hostile Sanji, causing Sanji to confront him and attack him with Diable Jambe. Despite Sanji's vicious attacks, Luffy refuses to fight back or retreat, and Nami pleads Sanji to stop to no avail. Finally, Sanji knocks Luffy out with a spinning midair kick, and returns to his family. Luffy yells out to Sanji as he leaves, saying that he will stay at this spot and not eat until Sanji returns, as he cannot become the Pirate King without Sanji. This causes Sanji to break down in tears as he is taken to Big Mom.

episodes.title: A Storm of Revenge! An Enraged Army Comes to Attack!
episodes.description: Luffy makes a solemn promise to not move from his spot until Sanji returns to him. But as Mama`s army advances, that promise may prove a costly one. Meanwhile, Sanji and the Vinsmokes come face to face with Big Mom and his bride-to-be Pudding!

episodes.title: The End of the Adventure - Sanji's Resolute Proposal
episodes.description: Luffy stands his ground and waits for his friend to return! But the vengeful army washes over him - only a true friend can step in to turn the tide of battle! Meanwhile, Sanji and Pudding discuss their marriage - and come to a startling conclusion!

episodes.title: I'll Wait Here - Luffy vs. the Enraged Army
episodes.description: Luffy puts his all into battling Big Mom`s vengeful army, however, their skills combined prove too formidable. Meanwhile, Sanji goes to Big Mom herself to bargain for the Straw Hats lives - with shocking results!

episodes.title: Infiltration Inside the Castle - Steal the Road Poneglyph
episodes.description: Chopper and Carrot are captured by Brulee and strung up for dinner! But Chopper sees a chance to free himself! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro launch a plan to reach the Ponegliffs - a daring game of chance!

episodes.title: A Fateful Confrontation - Luffy and Big Mom
episodes.description: Pekoms creates a diversion for Brook to set his plan into action. Meanwhile Luffy continues to goad Big Mom into a fight, and Pudding begins to have stirrings of rebellion herself!

episodes.title: Shout of the Soul - Brook and Pedro's Lightning Operation
episodes.description: Just when Luffy and Nami are in Big Mom`s grasp, Pudding arrives, but with news that they aren`t expecting - meanwhile Brook and Chopper both make headway getting out of their own jams!

episodes.title: Goodbye! Pudding's Tearful Determination!
episodes.description: Sanji hopes his wedding with Pudding will solve the Straw Hat`s predicament - but Pudding secretly plans to to avoid the marriage, sharing a secret with Luffy. Meanwhile Brook comes face to face with Big Mom herself!

episodes.title: Fate of the Left Eye – Pedro vs Baron Tamago
episodes.description: Luffy tries desperately to free himself as the risk of his own well-being! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot continue to search the mirror universe, Brook squares off against Big Mom, and Pedro's past is revealed!

episodes.title: Moist Cigarette! The Night Before Sanji's Wedding!
episodes.description: Luffy struggles to break himself free as Sanji falls deeper in love with the idea of marrying Pudding... But the mask falls off and the deadly charade of Big Mom is revealed as the depths of her treachery come to light!

episodes.title: The Undaunted Soul - Brook vs. Big Mom
episodes.description: Brook continues his all-out struggle against Big Mom, but his secret weapon might not be enough to save him! Meanwhile an unexpected ally from the past comes to the rescue!

episodes.title: Sora's Wish! Germa's Failure - Sanji!
episodes.description: Jimbei arrives on the scene and works to free Luffy and Nami! Meanwhile Sanji confronts his sister with the awful truth of Pudding, and she confides in him the powerful secret of their mother`s undying love!

episodes.title: To Reach Sanji! Luffy's Vengeful Hell-bent Dash!
episodes.description: Brook finds himself totally at the whim of Big Mom, and comes face to face with her brutal love! Meanwhile, Pedro reveals his explosive plan to create a distraction!

episodes.title: The Chateau in Turmoil! Luffy, to the Rendezvous!
episodes.description: Chopper and Carrot use the mirror dimension to get in touch with Nami and Jimbei! Luffy makes it through more obstacles to learn that he just missed Sanji! Meanwhile, Sanji wonders alone about the best course of action.

episodes.title: Deciding to Say Goodbye! Sanji and his Straw-Hat Bento!
episodes.description: Brook hears Big Mom`s plan firsthand as she shares her intentions with Pudding in front of him! Meanwhile Big Mom`s agents believe most of the Straw Hats to be under control, but doubt besets Montd`Or.

episodes.title: Betraying One of the Four Emperors! The Great Brook Rescue Plan!
episodes.description: Nami and the others finally find Brook in the mirror dimension - but he`s in the most inopportune of places! Can they challenge the sleeping Mama and rescue their friend? Meanwhile, Luffy is waylaid on his way back to the rendezvous!

episodes.title: The Rendezvous! Luffy, a One-on-One at His Limit!
episodes.description: Luffy puts up a valiant fight in order to keep his word to Sanji! But will he be able to last until Sanji arrives at the rendezvous? Meanwhile, Jimbei shares the awful truth about the wedding with the other Straw Hats.

episodes.title: A Liar! Luffy and Sanji!!
episodes.description: Sanji and Luffy meet finally - and while he is happy to feed Luffy to replenish his energy, Sanji`s explanation of what actions he must take baffles Luffy! The crucial decision, to turn his back on his friends or his family, tears Sanji apart!

episodes.title: Sanji Comes Back! Crash! The Tea Party from Hell!
episodes.description: The newly reunited Luffy and Sanji hear from the rest of the Straw Hats in the mirror dimension! Then, Jimbei starts telling them about Capone "Gang" Bege and proposes a shocking plan to take down Big Mom!

episodes.title: A Secret Meeting! Luffy vs. The Fire Tank Pirates
episodes.description: The Straw Hats put Jimbei`s plan into action and approach Bege with the possibility of an alliance. But before they are granted an audience, they must make themselves presentable! At the same time, Nami learns about the terror of Big Mom from Lola`s twin sister!

episodes.title: The Deadly Pact! Luffy & Bege's Allied Forces
episodes.description: The proposed alliance between the Straw Hats and Bege unfolds! A gaseous blast from the past, Gastino, a member of Bege`s team, reveals the secret weapon that the team plans to use against the Emperor! But Gastino is not who he seems, and the bait in this trap is none other than Luffy himself!

episodes.title: Luffy Engages in a Secret Maneuver! The Wedding Full of Conspiracies Starts Soon!
episodes.description: Now, the assassination plan of Big Mom is all set and everyone starts preparing for the Tea Party. Montd`Or finds one of his crewmates, Bobbin the Disposer, dead, and suspects Sanji and Luffy of the crime. He goes to check if Sanji is in his room, just as Sanji is running to get back so as not to arouse suspicion.

episodes.title: The Family Gets Together! The Hellish Tea Party Starts!
