While training, Jiraiya accidentally transports himself to Mount Myoboku, opening the path to fulfill his destiny.

episodes.title: Tales of a Gutsy Ninja - Jiraiya Ninja Scroll (Part 2)
episodes.description: Jiraiya's journey to seek out a student is postponed due to the outbreak of the Third Great Ninja War. Jiraiya joins Tsunade and Orochimaru to battle the Village Hidden in the Rain. Following the battle, the three ninja are named the "Legendary Sannin," a title given to them by the enemy Hanzo of the Great Salamander himself.

episodes.title: Infiltrate! The Village Hidden in the Rain
episodes.description: Jiraiya successfully infiltrates the Hidden Rain Village by hiding inside the toad Gamagoro. He sets out to gather information but finds no indications of a civil war occurring within the village.

episodes.title: The Man Who Became God
episodes.description: Foreseeing a possible battle, Jiraiya takes precautionary measures by releasing the scroll toad that commands the key to Naruto's Eight-Signed

episodes.title: Honoured Sage Mode!
episodes.description: Jiraiya battles to defeat his former student Pain, who is now driven by his twisted ideals as an Akatsuki member.

episodes.title: In Attendance, the Six Paths of Pain
episodes.description: Jiraiya completes his Sage Mode transformation to battle the three Pains.

episodes.title: The Tale of Jiraiya the Gallant
episodes.description: Having lost his arm, Jiraiya is outmatched by the six Pains now appearing before him. Of the six, the one called Tendo is revealed to be Jiraiya's former student Yahiko. Jiraiya is still puzzled by the Rinnegan's true powers, but before he can gather his thoughts, he is forced back into battle.

episodes.title: Banquet Invitation
episodes.description: Sasuke arrives at one of the Akatsuki hideouts, having followed in Itachi's footsteps. When Sasuke is about to enter the hideout alone, his older brother Itachi finally appears before him…

episodes.title: The Longest Moment
episodes.description: While Itachi waits for Sasuke in the Uchiha hideout, he recalls the past incident that led to his defection from the Leaf Village. When Sasuke arrives, the fated battle begins between the two brothers.

episodes.title: The Light and Dark of the Mangekyō Sharingan
episodes.description: Following their fierce genjutsu battle with the Sharingan, Itachi explains the secret behind the most powerful ocular jutsu, the Mangekyo Sharingan, and the history of the Uchiha clan…

episodes.title: Amaterasu!
episodes.description: Sasuke loses his left eye to Itachi, but it turns out to be a genjutsu created by the Mangekyo Sharingan. Breaking free of the Tsukuyomi by force, Sasuke makes a furious comeback against the injured Itachi.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.description: At the climax of the battle, both Itachi and Sasuke run out of chakra. However, Sasuke reveals that his actions up until now were only a preparation for his final jutsu.

episodes.title: The Mystery of Tobi
episodes.description: Naruto and his comrades find themselves held up by Tobi, whose strange jutsu is more than just a simple genjutsu.

episodes.title: Fate
episodes.description: In the Akatsuki hideout Sasuke comes face to face with Madara. Announcing himself as Itachi's accomplice from that fateful night, Madara goes on to tell Sasuke the truth about Itachi that he could never have known.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.description: The Uchiha clan was plotting a coup d'etat. The story as told by Madara leaves Sasuke at a loss for words. Because of his gifted talent, Itachi was forced to suffer, torn between his loyalties to the Leaf Village and the Uchiha clan.

episodes.title: Battle of Valley of Clouds and Lightning
episodes.description: Flame from the Amaterasu still remains on the battlefield as Naruto and his teammates continue to search for Sasuke. But despite the search team's best efforts, they cannot find any trace of him.

episodes.title: The Eight-Tails vs. Sasuke
episodes.description: The Taka split up with the Akatsuki to hunt down the remaining Tailed Beast. At the Land of Lightning they go up against Killer Bee, whose attack utilizing Lightning Style and seven blades proves to be more than a match for them.

episodes.title: Wanderer
episodes.description: The Leaf ninja fail to capture Itachi and also lose track of Sasuke. Calling off their pursuit, the team is heading back to the village when an urgent assignment from Lady Tsunade comes in. The mission stems from a treaty between the Third Hokage and the En no Gyoja of the Tsuchigumo Clan...

episodes.title: Successor of the Forbidden Jutsu
episodes.description: Naruto and his teammates are assigned to escort Hotaru, En no Gyoja's granddaughter, to the Tsuchigumo Clan's village located in the mountains. But Hotaru's mind is still attached to Utakata, who left after Naruto's arrival…

episodes.title: The Successor's Wish
episodes.description: Having arrived at the village, Hotaru parts with Naruto and his team. But the Magaki Troops are one step ahead and threaten Hotaru to hand over the forbidden jutsu. Utakata appears, and Shiranami recognizes him as a bounty listed in the Hidden Mist's bingo book...

episodes.title: Rogue Ninja's Past
episodes.description: Yamato and Sai recognize their opponents as trackers from the Hidden Mist Village, but Naruto attacks without questioning. The Hidden Mist demands Utakata be handed over to them in exchange for Hotaru.

episodes.title: Heir to Darkness
episodes.description: Hotaru is brought back to the fort in Mount Katsuragi. Naruto, outraged to learn the forbidden jutsu was embedded inside Hotaru, demands an explanation from Tonbei. But it was none other than Hotaru herself who wished for this.

episodes.title: Separation
episodes.description: Believing Shiranami's story, Hotaru writes a parting letter addressed to Utakata and leaves Mount Katsuragi. Meanwhile Naruto, still searching for Shiranami, falls into the Magaki Troops' trap but manages to escape thanks to help from Utakata.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Jutsu Released
episodes.description: Naruto and Utakata successfully enter the Tsuchigumo village thanks to help from Sakura, Sai, and Yamato. Utakata senses the chakra filling the atmosphere and terrain behaving oddly, and together with Naruto, they enter the cave where the anomaly is originating.

episodes.title: Master and Student
episodes.description: Hotaru, under the control of Shiranami's jutsu, uses the Forbidden Jutsu against Naruto and Utakata. Shiranami trembles with joy, having witnessed the power of the Forbidden Jutsu, while Hotaru is consumed by deep despair.

episodes.title: Sombre News
episodes.description: Returning from the mission, Naruto recollects his strange encounter with Itachi. What did the now deceased Itachi wish to tell him? As Naruto ponders this, Kakashi makes an abrupt visit.

episodes.title: Following the Master's Shadow
episodes.description: Naruto wanders the streets of the Leaf Village, grief stricken over the death of Jiraiya. Unable to overcome his feeling of loss, Naruto traces back through his memories of Jiraiya. What can help the heartbroken Naruto get back on his feet?

episodes.title: Decryption
episodes.description: Naruto and his friends successfully decipher the code Jiraiya left behind with the help of some information Naruto has. The crew immediately calls Fukasaku over, but the message is not enough to solve the mystery of Pain.

episodes.title: The First Challenge
episodes.description: At Mount Myoboku, Naruto begins his Sage Jutsu training under Fukasaku. The first challenge is "Don't move." Fukasaku explains that an extensive amount of time is necessary in order to take in nature energy.

episodes.title: Surpassing the Master
episodes.description: Naruto continues his Sage training at Mount Myoboku, but with very slow progress. Fukasaku runs out of patience and suggests they move on to the next training…

episodes.title: Assault on the Leaf Village!
episodes.description: Shikamaru and the others wait for the information Jiraiya brought back to be analyzed. The Hidden Leaf ninja continue their data analysis, when disaster strikes the village.

episodes.title: Power to Believe
episodes.description: The Leaf Village is under heavy attack from Pain and Konan. Hearing the Akatsuki attack, Tsunade attempts to contact Fukasaku…

episodes.title: Pain vs. Kakashi
episodes.description: In one area of the village, Kakashi enters battle against Tendo Pain, but he can't keep up with Tendo's mysterious attacks. Shurado joins the fight, and Kakashi struggles with the two-on-one disadvantage.

episodes.title: Mystery of Pain
episodes.description: The Leaf Village is under heavy attack from the Akatsuki. Underneath the village Danzo takes action to achieve his ambition. Meanwhile, searching through the Rain ninja's mind, Inoichi Yamanaka is about to stumble upon valuable information.

episodes.title: Surname is Sarutobi. Given Name, Konohamaru!
episodes.description: Konohamaru, Moegi, and Udon are shocked to see the disaster that has struck their home village. But to fulfill their duties as genin, each races out to direct the villagers to a safe location.

episodes.title: Pain to the World
episodes.description: Tsunade comes face to face with Tendo Pain on the rooftop of the Hokage mansion. When Pain demands the Nine Tails be handed over, Tsunade refuses. However, Pain uses the Ningendo's power to learn of Naruto's current location in Mount Myoboku. Tsunade clenches at the sight of the growing number of casualties within the Leaf. But Pain, who condemns the Leaf's arrogance as a major nation, makes the choice to deliver catastrophic damage against the Leaf Village to teach them what true pain is.

episodes.title: Explode! Sage Mode
episodes.description: Sensing danger at hand, Naruto, along with Fukasaku, rushes back to the Leaf Village from Mount Myoboku. But what they see is the remains of the Leaf Village, leveled beyond recognition.

episodes.title: Danger! Sage Mode Limit Reached
episodes.description: Naruto hits Pain with his Sage Jutsu-perfected Wind Style Rasen Shuriken. Although he succeeds in defeating Ningendo, the remaining Pain quickly confronts him.

episodes.title: Nine-Tails, Captured!
episodes.description: Gamabunta and the other toads are defeated while Naruto is captured by Pain. Naruto attempts to fight back with Sage Jutsu, but Gakido sucks out his chakra, forcing him to go out of Sage Mode.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.description: Fukasaku and Shima fall in battle, leaving Naruto open to be captured by Tendo Pain. Just when all is thought to be lost, Hinata, who was following the battle with her Byakugan, steps in to face Pain.

episodes.title: Chibaku Tensei
episodes.description: Naruto loses himself after seeing Hinata taken out right before his eyes. His anger triggers the Nine Tails' chakra to go out of control.

episodes.title: The Fourth Hokage
episodes.description: Naruto meets Minato Namikaze, the Fourth Hokage, inside his inner world. Before his death, Minato planted a fail-safe where he would appear within Naruto's psyche should his son sprout eight tails.

episodes.title: The Two Students
episodes.description: To break the cycle of hate, Naruto heads to where the real Pain is hiding.

episodes.title: Big Adventure! The Quest for the Fourth Hokage's Legacy Part 1
episodes.description: The story goes back to right before the start of the final rounds of the Chunin Exam. As Naruto trains in preparation for his upcoming match, he hears Jiraiya speak of "the Fourth Hokage's legacy."

episodes.title: Big Adventure! The Quest for the Fourth Hokage's Legacy Part 2
episodes.description: Naruto and the others take on the oncoming challenges in order to find the secret technique and break the previous record set by the Fourth Hokage. But Naruto's impulsive action leads the group into various troubles.

episodes.title: Meeting
episodes.description: Naruto comes face to face with Nagato and Konan. Naruto, wanting to confront the problem of their hate-filled ninja world, asks to hear Nagato's side of the story before coming up with an answer.

episodes.title: Origin of Pain
episodes.description: To fulfill their dream, Nagato, Yahiko, and Konan walk through the war zone in search of Jiraiya, hoping to learn ninjutsu from him. After completing their training, the three form an organization with Yahiko as its leader.

episodes.title: Tale of Naruto Uzumaki
episodes.description: Naruto remains silent after learning of Nagato's painful past. Nagato claims true peace cannot exist in this cursed world, dismissing Jiraiya's ideal as nothing more than wishful thinking.

episodes.title: Hero of the Hidden Leaf
episodes.description: Nagato, having decided to believe in Naruto's word, performs his last forbidden jutsu: Gedo Art Rinne Rebirth.

episodes.title: Rookie Instructor Iruka
episodes.description: The Leaf Village is left in ruins in the wake of Pain's assault on the village. While cleaning through the remains of Ninja Academy, Iruka finds an old pillar and recognizes it as a memoir from Naruto's early years at the academy.

episodes.title: Iruka's Ordeal
episodes.description: Naruto spends his days competing with Sasuke, the academy's star student, only to screw up and be the laughingstock of the class. Due to the childhood trauma of losing his parents to the Nine-Tailed Fox, Iruka finds it difficult to interact with Naruto as his student.

episodes.title: Iruka's Decision
episodes.description: Naruto takes up his classmates' dare to venture into the forest and retrieve an item from the dead enemy ninja, unaware that the forest is still dangerous.

episodes.title: Kakashi Hatake, the Jōnin in Charge
episodes.description: An emergency council is held before the Feudal Lord of the Land of Fire. The topic is to discuss plans to rebuild the Leaf Village, and Danzo strongly urges the council to select a new Hokage to replace Tsunade.

episodes.title: Inari's Courage Put to the Test
episodes.description: The Leaf ninja work to rebuild the Hidden Leaf Village. While helping with the restoration, Naruto and Sakura are reunited with two old friends—the carpenter Tazuna and his grandson Inari from the Land of Waves.

episodes.title: Naruto's School of Revenge
episodes.description: Team 7 stops in a town for some rest, where they encounter a man named Tsukado who is out to avenge the death of his relative.

episodes.title: Gaara's Bond
episodes.description: Gaara, recalling a past mission carried out with the Leaf's Team 7, points out that the Leaf Village has Naruto with them.

episodes.title: Naruto: Outbreak
episodes.description: Naruto visits Sakura, who is caring for Tsunade. Sakura recalls an incident that took place three years before, in which she collapsed from symptoms that resembled a disease caused by a mysterious virus.

episodes.title: Deploy! Team Tenten
episodes.description: Tenten and Neji head for the Leaf Ninja Tool Research Lab to procure ninja tools necessary for rebuilding the Leaf Village.

episodes.title: Animal District
episodes.description: Condor, the ostrich previously captured by Team 7, now lives in a forest with baby ostriches. Since his last escape, Condor has trained himself to become a ninja ostrich.

episodes.title: Ah, the Medicine of Youth
episodes.description: After accidentally finishing off Lee's last special youth drink, Naruto asks Guy to make more, only to learn one of its key ingredients, the Jofuku Flower, is out of stock. Naruto is determined to get the Jofuku Flower for Lee's sake.

episodes.title: Gutsy Master and Student: The Training
episodes.description: Jiraiya takes Naruto to a village in the hopes of teaching him how to counter the Sharingan's genjutsu attack.

episodes.title: Record of the Gutsy Ninja Master and Student
episodes.description: Naruto and Jiraiya attempt to save a village from Kandachi, a former right-hand man to Hanzo of the Hidden Rain.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Paw Encyclopedia
episodes.description: Granny Cat requests that Sasuke and Team 7 collect the last cat paw print necessary to complete the "Paw Encyclopedia."

episodes.title: Naruto and the Old Soldier
episodes.description: Naruto is assigned to a team led by jonin Hayama to patrol the north border of the Leaf Village. One of his teammates is Kosuke, an old man who has been a genin for over fifty years, earning him the title "Eternal Genin."

episodes.title: Kakashi's Love Song
episodes.description: A beautiful kunoichi spy named Hanare is captured for attempting to gather intel on the Hidden Leaf.

episodes.title: Neji Chronicles
episodes.description: During the Chunin Exam, Neji rests in the medical room, having lost to Naruto. Just as Tenten comes in to check up on him, they see the Leaf Village attacked by Orochimaru and his men.

episodes.title: The Man Who Died Twice
episodes.description: On his way home Naruto comes across a rock pasted with a peculiar talisman, which he tears off without thinking. That night, Naruto is surprised to find an amnesic ghost standing near his bed.

episodes.title: The Worst Three-Legged Race
episodes.description: Team 7 is after a group of thieves who have stolen the precious Golden Statue from the Feudal Lord's sister.

episodes.title: Team 10's Teamwork
episodes.description: Team 7 and Team 10 are assigned to help a village that is troubled by bandits.

episodes.title: Drive Towards Darkness
episodes.description: Sasuke's jealousy of Naruto's tremendous growth in strength causes friction between the two. Tsunade decides to give them some time apart by assigning them separate missions.

episodes.title: The Sixth Hokage Danzo
episodes.description: Team Samui of the Hidden Cloud arrive at the Leaf Village and are shocked to find it in ruins. Nonetheless, they carry out their orders to deliver the Raikage's official letter to the Hokage, when Danzo appears and announces that he is the new Hokage.

episodes.title: Five Kage Summit's Eve
episodes.description: Karui and Omoi of the Hidden Cloud press Naruto to give information regarding Sasuke. Naruto realizes they're motivated by wanting to save their captured master, but decides he cannot sell out his friend. Instead, Naruto offers himself as a punching bag for Karui and Omoi to abuse to their hearts' content.

episodes.title: Enter the Five Kage!
episodes.description: Kage from each nation set out to attend the Five Kage Summit.

episodes.title: Naruto's Plea
episodes.description: To prevent the cycle of hatred bound to occur should Sasuke be killed, Naruto goes to the Raikage and begs him to forgive Sasuke, but the Raikage quickly dismisses the request.

episodes.title: Painful Decision
episodes.description: Mifune calls for the formation of the Allied Shinobi Forces to counter the Akatsuki and proposes the Hokage to lead them. Meanwhile, Sai reveals Naruto's actions to Sakura.

episodes.title: Racing Lightning
episodes.description: Madara, who has taken an interest in Naruto, makes a sudden appearance before Naruto and reveals the truth behind Itachi's actions. Meanwhile, the samurai learn of Sasuke and his team Taka's entry into the Land of Iron, and battle ensues between the two groups.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Ninja Way
episodes.description: The truth behind Itachi's actions leaves Naruto, Kakashi, and Yamato in shock. Madara then goes on to reveal the eternal hate stemming from as far back as the rivalry between the two sons of the legendary Sage of the Sixth Paths and its relation to the Uchiha clan.

episodes.title: Power of the Five Kage
episodes.description: Having blocked the combined attacks of Gaara, Temari, Kankuro, and Darui with his Susano'o, Sasuke goes after Danzo.

episodes.title: Declaration of War
episodes.description: The four Kage are startled by the sudden appearance of Madara Uchiha. Having sent Sasuke away to safety using the Transportation Technique, Madara unveils to the Kage his "Project Tsuki no Me."

episodes.title: Sakura's Feelings
episodes.description: The Kage respond to Madara's declaration of war by forming the Allied Shinobi Forces, with the Raikage as their leader.

episodes.title: The Tailed Beast vs. The Tailless Tailed Beast
episodes.description: Killer Bee engages in a deadly battle against Kisame, who has come to capture the Eight-Tails.

episodes.title: As One's Friend
episodes.description: Naruto learns from Sai that Sakura intends to kill Sasuke with her own hands. The Sand arrives to brief the Leaf ninja about what happened at the Five Kage Summit.

episodes.title: Danzo's Right Arm
episodes.description: Kakashi decides to go after Sakura to stop her, while Yamato and Naruto are ordered to return to the Leaf Village. Meanwhile, Sasuke confronts Danzo after seeing the many Sharingan embedded in his enemy's right arm.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Visual Jutsu
episodes.description: Danzo's uncanny jutsu prevents Sasuke from landing a clean hit on his enemy. As Karin attempts to analyze Danzo's jutsu, Madara recognizes it as Izanagi.

episodes.title: Danzō Shimura
episodes.description: Danzo believes he's won the battle against Sasuke. Little does he realize, Sasuke placed him under genjutsu before they last exchanged blows.

episodes.title: Sakura's Resolve
episodes.description: Having tracked down Sasuke's whereabouts with Kiba's nose, Sakura attempts to put her allies to sleep and carry out the task of killing Sasuke herself.

episodes.title: Lost Bonds
episodes.description: Memories from his childhood course through Naruto's mind as he rests to recover from his hyperventilation.

episodes.title: The Burden
episodes.description: Sakura tells Sasuke that she wishes to desert the village and join him. A skeptical Sasuke tells Sakura he will believe her if she can finish off Karin.

episodes.title: Two Fates
episodes.description: Naruto reproaches Sasuke for attempting to kill Sakura. Then Sasuke reveals that he killed Danzo with his own hands. He goes on to declare his intent to purify the Uchiha clan's name by annihilating the Hidden Leaf.

episodes.title: High-Level Shinobi
episodes.description: Years ago at the Final Valley, Sasuke told Naruto about high-level shinobi being able to understand one another just by trading blows. Having become a high-level shinobi, Naruto is now able to understand Sasuke's heart.

episodes.title: The Infiltrator
episodes.description: Killer Bee returns to the Hidden Cloud Village to the delight of Omoi and Karui. He has brought Kisame's sword, Samehada, with him. Bee believes the sword has taken a liking to him but is unaware that this is all just part of the Akatsuki's plan.

episodes.title: The Five Great Nations Mobilize
episodes.description: The formation of the Allied Shinobi Forces is ratified by the Feudal Lords of the Five Great Nations. Each Kage returns to their village to prepare for the coming war

episodes.title: Kakashi Hatake, the Hokage
episodes.description: Naruto gathers his friends and tells them that he will defeat Sasuke alone. Meanwhile, the Elders of the Leaf officially nominate Kakashi to become the next Hokage.

episodes.title: Prophecy of the Great Lord Elder
episodes.description: In Mount Myoboku, Gerotora, Fukasaku, and the Great Lord Elder are debating whether to give Naruto the key to the Tetragram Seal left behind by Jiraiya, an act that could unleash the Nine Tails.

episodes.title: Storage
episodes.description: At Mount Myoboku, Naruto prepares to store Gerotora within himself, but hesitates as it also holds the potential risk of unleashing the Nine Tails on the world.

episodes.title: The Five Kage's Decision
episodes.description: The denizens of the Leaf Village ready themselves for the coming of the Fourth Great Ninja War.

episodes.title: The Young Man and the Sea
episodes.description: Tsunade sends out Naruto under the guise of a top-secret mission to keep him hidden away from the Akatsuki. Unfortunately, Naruto, Yamato, Gai, and Aoba are stuck at the pier due to a report of a monster attacking ships.

episodes.title: The Ninja of Benisu
episodes.description: During their voyage, Naruto, Yamato, Gai, and Aoba stop at an island to recover from severe seasickness. There, they unexpectedly meet up with Sakura, Ino, and Choji, who are on an assignment to gather medical herbs for Tsunade.

episodes.title: The Cursed Ghost Ship
episodes.description: Naruto's ship is stranded at sea due to heavy fog, when another ship suddenly appears.

episodes.title: Battleship Island
episodes.description: Pirates living on an island resembling a battleship open fire on Naruto's ship.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Island
episodes.description: Going after Guy, who was whisked away by a giant bird, Naruto, Yamato, and Aoba arrive on an island where they spot a young woman.

episodes.title: Fight! Rock Lee!
episodes.description: Guy recalls the time when he and Lee celebrated Lee learning the Hidden Lotus technique.

episodes.title: Eat or Die! Mushrooms from Hell
episodes.description: Making a stop at a nearby port to stock up on supplies, Naruto buys a rare mushroom from a vegetable merchant. But soon after they set sail for their next destination, Naruto and the other crewmembers find their ship infested with poisonous mushrooms.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Shadow Clones
episodes.description: Naruto's Shadow Clones turn against their master after feeling mistreated and overworked.

episodes.title: The Closed Route
episodes.description: As he prepares for the coming war, Shikamaru begins to feel the pressure of shouldering the lives of his friends. To help ease his mind, Shikaku sends his son on a mission to Mokuzu Island where Shikamaru meets up with Naruto.

episodes.title: The Girls' Get-Together
episodes.description: Hinata's father Hiashi summons the Hyuga clan to discuss the role they will be playing in the upcoming Fourth Great Ninja War.

episodes.title: Naruto's Imposter
episodes.description: Naruto and the others encounter a thief who claims that he is Naruto Uzumaki of the Hidden Leaf. The real Naruto easily takes care of the imposter and hands him over to a ninja who was after the thief.

episodes.title: Naruto's Favourite Pupil
episodes.description: Konohamaru is eager to fight alongside his senior ninja in the coming war, but his young age prevents him from being assigned to the battlefield.

episodes.title: The Kunoichi of Nadeshiko Village
episodes.description: Naruto meets two kunoichi ninja named Shizuka and Tokiwa from the Nadeshiko village who are seeking the student of Jiraiya.

episodes.title: Friends You Can Count On
episodes.description: At the Ninja Academy, Shino recounts the time when he failed to capture a wanted thief.

episodes.title: Ah, My Hero Lady Tsunade!
episodes.description: Tenten is helping out Lee's training to enhance his Eight Inner Gates.

episodes.title: Sai's Day Off
episodes.description: While taking a walk through the Leaf Village, Sai comes across some kids who remind him of Sakura and Naruto.

episodes.title: The Legendary Ino–Shika–Chō
episodes.description: Ino, Choji, and Shikamaru run into Kosuke, an elderly genin who they saved in a previous mission.

episodes.title: Kiba's Determination
episodes.description: Kiba trains hard to catch up to Naruto, who is now hailed as the hero of the Leaf Village, but with little success. Feeling desperate, Kiba asks Kakashi if he could train him.

episodes.title: Kakashi, My Eternal Rival!
episodes.description: As the Leaf ninja's ship heads toward their final stop for supplies before entering the Land of Lightning, Yamato warns the crew to stay alert for enemies who could mimic both the appearance and chakra of their closest allies.

episodes.title: Naruto's Vow
episodes.description: During his final stop for supplies on an island in the Land of Water, Naruto runs into Akatsuchi and Kurotsuchi of the Hidden Stone, who are on an assignment to deliver a letter from the Tsuchikage addressed to the Mizukage.

episodes.title: Land Ahoy! Is this the Island of Paradise?
episodes.description: After a long voyage at sea, Naruto's ship finally arrives at the island of its destination. Before everyone can rejoice, a giant squid attacks the ship. Fortunately, the crew is saved by Killer Bee, the Eight Tails' jinchuriki host.

episodes.title: Killer B and Motoi
episodes.description: Motoi warns Naruto that he is not yet ready to enter training to control the Tailed Beast. Undaunted, Naruto asks Motoi to tell him more about Killer Bee.

episodes.title: The Next Challenge! Naruto vs. The Nine-Tails!!
episodes.description: With Killer Bee as his new master, Naruto begins his training to control the power of a Tailed Beast. In order to do so, one must fight the Tailed Beast head on and absorb its chakra, converting it into one's own power.

episodes.title: The Orange Spark
episodes.description: Inside his mind, Naruto continues his battle against Nine Tails to take control of its immense power.

episodes.title: Target: Nine Tails
episodes.description: Sixteen years ago, Fourth Hokage Minato Namikaze and his wife Kushina are expecting their first child, much to the delight of the young couple.

episodes.title: The Fourth Hokage's Death Match!
episodes.description: Minato is forced to use his Flying Raijin jutsu and leave his wife Kushina behind to save their newborn son, Naruto, from a masked assailant.

episodes.title: Thank You
episodes.description: Minato uses his Transportation Technique to move Nine Tails away from the Hidden Leaf Village.

episodes.title: Battle in Paradise! Odd Beast vs. The Monster!
episodes.description: Guy arrives at the Waterfall of Truth to help Naruto with his training. Instead he encounters Kisame, who has infiltrated the island to locate Naruto and Killer Bee.

episodes.title: The Man Named Kisame
episodes.description: Kisame's escape is prevented thanks to Guy's efforts. Aoba enters Kisame's mind to gather intel on the Akatsuki.

episodes.title: The Angelic Herald of Death
episodes.description: Madara appears in the Hidden Rain Village seeking the corpse of Nagato and his Rinnegan.

episodes.title: The Bridge to Peace
episodes.description: Madara uses the forbidden jutsu Izanagi to escape Konan's Paper Bomb trap.

episodes.title: The Super Secret S-Rank Mission
episodes.description: The Leaf and Cloud ninja prepare to relocate Naruto and Bee, as the Akatsuki may already have knowledge of their location. Aoba assigns Naruto an S-rank mission to distract him from learning about their true mission: keeping the two Jinchuriki hidden from the enemy.

episodes.title: The Artist Returns
episodes.description: Kabuto and a reanimated Deidara attempt to grab hold of the jinchuriki, but are stopped by the Tsuchikage, who has come to protect Naruto.

episodes.title: Assemble! Allied Shinobi Forces!
episodes.description: The Tsuchikage and his team manage to safeguard the Jinchuriki, but at the cost of losing Yamato to the enemy.

episodes.title: Meeting
episodes.description: A look back into the early years when Naruto and Sasuke first met and got to know each other.

episodes.title: Rivals
episodes.description: During the Chunin Exam, Sasuke witnesses Naruto's growth as a shinobi

episodes.title: Rift
episodes.description: Sasuke's defeat to Gaara, and later Itachi, forces him to realize that he is not strong enough to get revenge against his older brother.

episodes.title: Parting
episodes.description: Naruto is determined to save Sasuke, who has deserted the Hidden Leaf.

episodes.title: For My Friend
episodes.description: The Allied Shinobi Forces are on standby, ready to confront Madara's army of reanimated shinobi and 100,000 White Zetsu. But distrust still exists among the Allied Shinobi Forces, who were once sworn enemies until recently.

episodes.title: War Begins!
episodes.description: Kankuro's commando unit enters enemy territory to set up a stronghold for the Allied Shinobi Forces. They are immediately ambushed by the Akatsuki's own commando unit comprised of the reanimated Deidara and Sasori.

episodes.title: Sai and Shin
episodes.description: The Allied Shinobi Forces' commando unit engages with the Akatsuki in the first wave of battle.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Impure World Reincarnatio
episodes.description: Under the guidance of Killer Bee, Naruto enters the final stage of training to master the Tailed Beast Bomb, a Jinchuriki's most powerful technique.

episodes.title: An Old Nemesis Returns
episodes.description: The commando unit is in hot water as they engage the reanimated Kekkei Genkai shinobi, which include Zabuza Momochi and Haku. Luckily, Kakashi and his unit arrive in time to assist them.

episodes.title: The First and Last Opponent
episodes.description: Kakashi and his unit devise a strategy to take on the Kekkei Genkai shinobi, but it's foiled by Kabuto, who uses the Reanimation Jutsu to summon the most powerful members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist.

episodes.title: The Brilliant Military Advisor of the Hidden Leaf
episodes.description: The Akatsuki dispatch an army of powerful reanimated shinobi and White Zetsu across the war zone, causing chaos within the Allied Shinobi Forces' chain of command.

episodes.title: Battleground!
episodes.description: As Darui and his First Company engage an army of White Zetsu, the remaining forces must deal with reanimated shinobi.

episodes.title: No-Good Words
episodes.description: Atsui, Samui, and Darui face off against Kinkaku and Ginkaku, the legendary brothers from the Hidden Cloud, feared even by the Raikage.

episodes.title: Golden Bonds
episodes.description: Darui manages to seal away Ginkaku. Fueled by the rage of losing his brother, Kinkaku transforms into a monster that resembles a jinchuriki's Tailed Beast State.

episodes.title: Road to Sakura
episodes.description: Ino sees Sakura falling from the sky. Although she manages to save her, the shock of the fall has left Sakura with amnesia.

episodes.title: Mifune vs. Hanzō
episodes.description: Kankuro's Commando Unit is cornered by Hanzo's poison attack. Fortunately, Mifune and his Fifth Company arrive in time to provide assistance.

episodes.title: True Kindness
episodes.description: The Ino-Shika-Cho trio is ordered by Shikaku to take down the reanimated Asuma. Remembering Asuma's final words, Shikamaru and Ino are determined to stop their former teacher.

episodes.title: The Complete Ino-Shika-Chō Formation
episodes.description: Choji is unable to attack Asuma and loses his will to fight. Ino and Shikamaru try to snap Choji out of his paralysis.

episodes.title: A Message from the Heart
episodes.description: While training in Chakra Mode, Naruto senses the presence of the Nine Tails' chakra seeping from Kinkaku outside.

episodes.title: Attack of the Gedō Statue
episodes.description: The Allied Shinobi Forces are on the verge of winning the war when Madara Uchiha appears. Madara summons the giant Gedo Statue and unleashes its devastating power.

episodes.title: Unison Sign
episodes.description: Naruto and Killer Bee rush to the battlefield when Nine Tails suddenly speaks to Naruto inside his mind.

episodes.title: Medic Ninja in Danger
episodes.description: Over at the Medical Unit camp, Sakura and the other medic ninja work nonstop to treat the wounded. Neji is there to recover from overusing his Byakugan.

episodes.title: White Zetsu's Trap
episodes.description: Kiba, Shino, and Hinata are sent to investigate an area where the Akatsuki are supposedly getting through. There, the three are ambushed by a White Zetsu and get separated.

episodes.title: Aesthetics of an Artist
episodes.description: Back at the Fifth Company's camp, Kurotsuchi attempts to negotiate with the captive Deidara to find out Kabuto's location, but is quickly rebuffed.

episodes.title: The Allied Mom Force!!
episodes.description: With many of the shinobi away serving in the Fourth Great Ninja War, the Leaf Village is left with just the mothers and children to protect it. Konohamaru is eager to guard the village but is quickly discouraged by the adults who tell him to just go about his day as usual.

episodes.title: The Secret Origin of the Ultimate Tag Team!!
episodes.description: Tsunade and the Raikage arrive to prevent Naruto and Killer Bee from joining the battle. But the two Kage fail to convince the Jinchuriki to turn back, forcing the Raikage to use extreme force.

episodes.title: Two Suns!!
episodes.description: Fourth Raikage Ay attacks Naruto in an attempt to prevent the Jinchuriki from falling into Madara's hands. Ay is unwilling to listen to either Tsunade or Killer Bee's pleas to change his mind.

episodes.title: The Helmet Splitter: Jinin Akebino!
episodes.description: Kakashi assigns Sai to take over for the Sealing Corps, who are recovering from sealing the reanimated shinobi. But Sai is not sure if he can handle the responsibility. Soon afterwards, the Third Company is attacked by Jinin Akebino.

episodes.title: User of the Scorch Release: Pakura of the Sand!
episodes.description: A group of Allied Shinobi, including Omoi and Maki of the Sand, battle against several reanimated enemies. Maki recognizes one of them as Pakura, her former master who was a Sand Village hero.

episodes.title: Things You Can't Get Back
episodes.description: Still coping with the loss of her loved ones, Tsunade indulges in gambling and drinking. Around the same time, the Raikage Ay and his men are on a mission to steal a scroll from a certain village.

episodes.title: One Worth Betting On
episodes.description: The Raikage Ay and his team suffer critical injuries during an enemy attack. Unwilling to sacrifice any more of his men, Ay seeks medical help from Tsunade, who just happens to be in the area.

episodes.title: Danger: Jinpachi and Kushimaru!
episodes.description: Kakashi races to the scene where the Seven Ninja Swordsmen Kushimaru Kuriarare and Jinpachi Munashi were last sighted. Enraged by the carnage they've left behind, Kakashi teams up with Might Guy.

episodes.title: The Lightning Blade: Ameyuri Ringo
episodes.description: Omoi's unit is attacked by Ameyuri Ringo of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen and loses one of Omoi's men. Omoi attempts to avenge his comrade, but Nurui orders everyone to retreat.

episodes.title: Power - Episode 1
episodes.description: Naruto and his team are assigned a mission to identify and hunt down the perpetrator of the Tonika Village massacre. It's been a while since Naruto has had a mission, and he's pumped to take it on.

episodes.title: Power - Episode 2
episodes.description: While investigating the village near Tonika, Kabuto confronts Naruto. An epic battle erupts as Kabuto uses the forbidden Reanimation Jutsu against Naruto. In the meantime, Dokku and the five survivors lie low at the village.

episodes.title: Power - Episode 3
episodes.description: Naruto and Sakura decide to stay at Shiseru's house overnight to help watch over the survivors. Although the children cry and miss their deceased parents, Dokku and Shiseru try hard to bring everyone together as a new family.

episodes.title: Power - Episode 4
episodes.description: A clone possessing the Nine Tails' chakra emerges from Naruto's body. Seeking more power, the clone goes on a rampage, destroying everything in its path.

episodes.title: Power - Episode 5
episodes.description: After their defeat by the Nine Tails' clone, Naruto and Dokku are taken captive by Kabuto.

episodes.title: Power - Episode Final
episodes.description: The legendary Ama no Hoko imbues the Nine Tails' clone with enough power to destroy the world. Naruto is overcome by its immense power and lies unconscious.

episodes.title: Naruto Enters the Battle!
episodes.description: Naruto makes his entrance onto the battlefield and uses his sensory powers to detect and destroy the transformed White Zetsu clones. During the battle, Shikaku updates Naruto with what they currently know on Madara.

episodes.title: A Father's Hope, A Mother's Love
episodes.description: Gaara leads the Fourth Company into battle against the previous Kage, including his father, the late Fourth Kazekage. The Fourth Kazekage attacks Gaara in order to determine if his son is truly worthy to be the current Kazekage.

episodes.title: Contact! Naruto vs. Itachi
episodes.description: Naruto and Killer Bee engage in battle against the reanimated Itachi Uchiha and Nagato. Itachi learns from Naruto that Sasuke has chosen the path of vengeance.

episodes.title: The Acknowledged One
episodes.description: Itachi uses the ultimate genjutsu technique Koto Amatsukami to free himself from the Reanimation Jutsu. Itachi then joins Naruto and Killer Bee to fight Nagato, who is still under Kabuto's control.

episodes.title: The Mizukage, the Giant Clam, and the Mirage
episodes.description: The Fourth Company continue their fight against the reanimated Kage. Gaara and Ohnoki team up to hold off Second Tsuchikage Mu, while the remaining shinobi take on the Second Mizukage, who is willing to be sealed away.

episodes.title: Paradox
episodes.description: Temari leads the attack on the Third Raikage using Wind Style, but even her strongest jutsu is not enough to penetrate the Raikage's invincible armor.

episodes.title: Terror: Steaming Danger Tyranny
episodes.description: Gaara and Ohnoki manage to overcome the Second Mizukage's mirage attack. Having taken an interest in Gaara, the Second Mizukage decides to further test the young Kage's skills.

episodes.title: Ghosts from the Past
episodes.description: Shikamaru, Choji, Neji, and Kiba find themselves up against some familiar faces from the past. The Sound Ninja Four have been brought back by Kabuto's Reanimation Jutsu, and they are ready to seek vengeance.

episodes.title: The Underworld Transfer Jutsu
episodes.description: Shikamaru, Neji, Choji, and Kiba succeed in defeating the Sound Ninja Four. But the enemy uses the Underworld Transfer Jutsu to trap the Leaf shinobi's souls inside a barrier.

episodes.title: The Vengeful
episodes.description: Time is running out for the Leaf shinobi whose souls are trapped inside the Sound Four's barrier. Ino and Shino exhaust their own chakra to keep their friends alive.

episodes.title: The Heart's Eye
episodes.description: Hinata defends Neji from a White Zetsu clone while he's recovering from an earlier fight. She then remembers the time Neji protected her the same way after she temporarily lost her sight.

episodes.title: Fade into the Moonlight
episodes.description: Three years ago, Leaf Anbu Yugao Uzuki lost her lover Hayate Gekko in battle. Unable to cope with his death, Yugao has since left the Anbu and joined the Medical Corps. Meanwhile, Kabuto has reanimated Hayate.

episodes.title: Night of the Crescent Moon
episodes.description: Yugao is ordered by Sukui to track down the reanimated Hayate. Still shaken by her lover's unexpected return as an enemy, Yugao manages to catch up to Hayate and his men.

episodes.title: An A-Rank Mission: The Contest
episodes.description: Naruto arrives to help a team of Allied Shinobi Forces led by Karui, who are struggling against a reanimated samurai. Naruto recognizes the samurai as Tatewaki, a man he met during a past mission.

episodes.title: The Fallen Castle
episodes.description: The Leaf Shinobi succeed in bringing young lord Shu into custody, placing a disguised Naruto as his double. But Tatewaki soon uncovers Naruto's identity and surrounds the intruder with his men.

episodes.title: Prologue of Road to Ninja
episodes.description: Madara is prepping his new jutsu Limited Tsukuyomi, choosing Naruto as his test subject. Meanwhile, Naruto is spending his day off alone in his room. Thinking that Naruto is lonely, Lee suggests they all go to the bathhouse .

episodes.title: The Old Master and the Dragon's Eye
episodes.description: Might Guy arrives on the battlefield to stop a Reanimated Shinobi who he recognizes as Master Chen, the legendary Taijutsu User from the Third Great Ninja War.

episodes.title: Rain Followed by Snow, with Some Lightning
episodes.description: A reanimated boy who can control weather appears before Team Ino-Shika-Cho, Sakura, and Kiba, who are all fighting in different locations. To their surprise, the boy seems to know them.

episodes.title: The Sad Sun Shower
episodes.description: The weather-controlling enemy is revealed to be Yota, a boy who came to the Leaf Village years ago and befriended the local kids, including Naruto.

episodes.title: Lingering Snow
episodes.description: Naruto and the others finally regain their lost memories regarding Yota. Years ago, the Leaf Village kids came to befriend Yota, but the adults believed the young boy was a spy and took him away for questioning.

episodes.title: The Reanimated Allied Forces
episodes.description: Kabuto reanimates an army of unknown shinobi led by Danzo's former bodyguard Torune to retrieve the ones he lost to the Allied Forces. But aside from Torune, the reanimated shinobi are all weak and are quickly sealed away.

episodes.title: Shino vs. Torune!
episodes.description: During their battle against the White Zetsu, Shino's beetles detect the presence of another enemy. Leaving the fight to Kiba and the others, Shino goes to investigate and finds Torune preparing to unleash his forbidden jutsu.

episodes.title: A Hole in the Heart: The Other Jinchūriki
episodes.description: Kabuto reanimates Fukai to attack Killer Bee and Motoi. Fukai warns Killer Bee to escape before being taken over by Kabuto. To everyone's surprise, Fukai releases Eight Tails' chakra and enters Tailed Beast State.

episodes.title: The Soul Living Inside the Puppet
episodes.description: A reanimated Granny Chiyo attacks Kankuro and Mifune's team. Kankuro fights back by using the human puppet of Sasori. The sight of Sasori causes Granny Chiyo to recall the painful memories that led her grandson to create his human puppets.

episodes.title: Run, Omoi!
episodes.description: The Allied Forces receive a report that Omoi has deserted his post, much to the Raikage's shock. It is soon revealed that Omoi has defied orders to go save the Thundercloud Unit.

episodes.title: Reinforcements Arrive
episodes.description: White Zetsu's ability to mimic people's appearances has wrought confusion and distrust within the Allied Shinobi Forces. Naruto arrives to assist, and using his sensory powers, he identifies all the disguised White Zetsu clones, changing the tide of the battle.

episodes.title: Madara Uchiha
episodes.description: The reanimated shinobi appearing before Gaara and Ohnoki is revealed to be none other than Madara Uchiha himself…which raises the question of who the masked man claiming to be Madara really is.

episodes.title: The Five Kage Assembl
episodes.description: The power of the reanimated Madara Uchiha far exceeds what the Allied Forces expected. Despite the difference in power, the Third Tsuchikage, Ohnoki, along with Naruto and Gaara, refuses to give up.

episodes.title: The Unbreakable Mask and the Shattered Bubble
episodes.description: Naruto and Killer Bee face off against the masked man originally thought to be Madara Uchiha, in addition to the reanimated Jinchuriki. Naruto is shocked when he recognizes one of the Jinchuriki.

episodes.title: Jinchuriki vs. Jinchuriki!!
episodes.description: Naruto and Killer Bee take on the six Reanimated Jinchuriki, who've been equipped with the Rinnegan. Using his past experience from fighting the Six Paths of Pain, Naruto devises a plan to stop the Jinchuriki

episodes.title: Four-Tails, the King of Sage Monkeys
episodes.description: Kakashi and Guy arrive in the nick of time to back up Naruto and Killer Bee. The fight intensifies even further when three out of the six Reanimated Jinchuriki enter Tailed Beast State, forcing Naruto and the others to throw in everything they've got.

episodes.title: Nine Tails
episodes.description: Naruto finds himself inside Four Tails' inner world, where he promises to free Four Tails from Madara's control. Listening in on their conversation, Nine Tails recalls all the time he has spent sealed inside Naruto.

episodes.title: Kurama
episodes.description: For years, Naruto was the target of Nine Tails' undying hatred. But their time together has made Nine Tails understand Naruto more than anyone. As Naruto continues to try and free Four Tails from Madara's control, Nine Tails begins to undergo a change.

episodes.title: Two-Man Team
episodes.description: Naruto uses up the last of his chakra trying to free the Tailed Beasts from Madara's control. When all seems lost, the Nine Tails finally acknowledges Naruto as its jinchuriki and offers its help.

episodes.title: The Promise of Victory
episodes.description: The tide of battle is slowly shifting in the Allied Forces' favor, but many are uncertain that they really stand a chance against Madara Uchiha. To help boost their spirits, Shikaku orders Inoichi to send out a message to every member of the forces.

episodes.title: Eyes That See in the Dark
episodes.description: Suigetsu and Jugo's search for Sasuke leads them to one of Orochimaru's old hideouts where they come across his research data, which could tip the outcome of the Fourth Great War. Meanwhile, Sasuke finally sets out to settle his score with Naruto.

episodes.title: A Will of Stone
episodes.description: The Five Kage are outmatched by the real Madara Uchiha's devastating attacks. Just when Third Tsuchikage Ohnoki is about to give up, he remembers the words of the previous Tsuchikage.

episodes.title: The Risks of the Impure World Reincarnation
episodes.description: Tsunade leaves her post as Medic Ninja to join the other Kage in fighting Madara. Meanwhile, Sasuke goes after Itachi and learns that his brother intends on stopping Kabuto's Reanimation Jutsu.

episodes.title: Sibling Tag Team
episodes.description: Sasuke and Itachi team up to stop Kabuto's Reanimation Jutsu. But Kabuto's new ability to use Nature Energy has made him a difficult target for the brothers to land their Susano'o attack.

episodes.title: To Each Their Own Leaf
episodes.description: Kabuto attempts to bring Sasuke over to his side by pointing out that they both are fighting for the same goal: to bring down the Leaf Village. But Sasuke quickly rejects him.

episodes.title: Kabuto Yakushi
episodes.description: Kabuto's past is finally revealed. As child, a woman named Nonou raised Kabuto at an orphanage in the Leaf Village. One day, Danzo and Orochimaru visit the orphanage to provide financial aid under the condition that Nonou work as their spy.

episodes.title: The Izanami Activated
episodes.description: Kabuto's quest to discover his true identity has led him over the years to collect, analyze, and use the abilities of all shinobi within him, including Kimimaro, the Sound Four and Orochimaru.

episodes.title: Izanagi and Izanami
episodes.description: Itachi activates the Visual Jutsu Izanami to trap Kabuto's mind. Itachi then explains to Sasuke how Izanami was originally developed to keep the Uchiha from abusing the power of Izanagi.

episodes.title: I Will Love You Always
episodes.description: The Five Kage watch helplessly as Madara activates his Perfect Susano'o to destroy them. Meanwhile, Itachi succeeds in undoing Kabuto's Reanimation Jutsu. Before fading away, Itachi reveals to Sasuke the truth behind the Uchiha massacre.

episodes.title: Impure World Reincarnation: Release!
episodes.description: Thanks to Itachi, the Reanimation Jutsu is released, and all the Reanimated Shinobi are returned to their resting places. But to everyone's surprise, the real Madara still remains!

episodes.title: Orochimaru's Return
episodes.description: Suigetsu and Jugo finally catch up to Sasuke. In order to learn the truth behind the Leaf's actions, Sasuke decides to resurrect the one man who can help him find the answer—Orochimaru.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Transportation Technique
episodes.description: Having absorbed the chakras of all nine Tailed Beasts, the Gedo Statue begins its transformation into Ten Tails. Naruto, Killer Bee, Kakashi, and Guy try to destroy the Gedo Statue but are stopped by the masked man who is able to phase through all of their attacks.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.description: Kakashi is disturbed to discover a strange connection between the masked man's Transportation Technique and his own Kamui Jutsu. Naruto throws everything he's got against the masked man and succeeds in shattering his mask. The identity of the masked man is finally revealed!

episodes.title: Obito and Madara
episodes.description: The identity of the masked man is revealed to be Kakashi's old friend Obito, previously believed to have died in the battle of Kannabi Bridge. Naruto and the others are further shocked when they learn that Obito has been working with Madara Uchiha for years to orchestrate Project Tsuki no Me.

episodes.title: I'm in Hell
episodes.description: After the Battle of Kannabi Bridge, Obito finds himself inside the hidden lair of Madara Uchiha, who saved the young shinobi's life. There, Obito works to rehabilitate his injured body in the hopes of being reunited with Kakashi and Rin. But when Obito learns that they are in danger, he leaves Madara's hideout to go help his friends and is forced to witness something he does not wish to see…

episodes.title: World of Dreams
episodes.description: Obito watches in disbelief as Kakashi kills Rin. Unable to accept the harsh reality, Obito decides to carry out Madara's dream so that he can create an ideal world where Rin still exists. Taking on the name Madara Uchiha, Obito sets out to find Nagato, who possesses the Rinnegan necessary to accomplish project Tsuki-no-me.

episodes.title: Creeping Shadow
episodes.description: Years ago, Yahiko, Nagato, and Konan form the Akatsuki to realize their dream of bringing peace to the Hidden Rain. ...

episodes.title: The New Akatsuki
episodes.description: Danzo deliberately misleads Hanzo, telling him that the Akatsuki are attempting to sabotage the peace talks between the Hidden Rain and Stone. Believing his story, Hanzo sets up a trap to crush the Akatsuki for the sake of his people.

episodes.title: The Mask That Hides the Heart
episodes.description: After the end of the Third Great Ninja War, the Leaf Village is divided over who should become the next Hokage. Minato Namikaze is soon appointed as the Fourth Hokage, much to the annoyance of Danzo and Orochimaru. Meanwhile, Kakashi is haunted by the deaths of Obito and Rin, causing him to lose focus on his missions.

episodes.title: Minato's Death
episodes.description: Kakashi becomes part of the ANBU Black Ops, an elite team of shinobi who are under the direct command of the Fourth Hokage, Minato Namikaze. Although he is highly regarded by his peers, Kakashi's ruthless way of killing the enemy has earned him the nickname "Cold-blooded Kakashi."

episodes.title: Hashirama's Cells
episodes.description: At the Foundation, Kakashi meets a boy who uses Wood Style, a jutsu that only First Hokage Hashirama was capable of using. Kakashi goes to Third Hokage Hiruzen's library to seek answers and discovers records regarding Hashirama's cells.

episodes.title: The Rogue Ninja Orochimaru
episodes.description: Orochimaru is forced to flee the Hidden Leaf after Third Hokage Hiruzen exposes his illegal experiments. Danzo, fearing that Orochimaru's capture would lead to the exposure of his own involvement in the experiments, sends out one of his men to help the rogue ninja.

episodes.title: Orochimaru's Test Subject
episodes.description: While pursuing Orochimaru, Kakashi wanders into a village inhabited by the Iburi Clan, a group of people with the unique ability to turn into smoke. Kakashi is soon captured and learns that the villagers all serve under Orochimaru.

episodes.title: Their Own Paths
episodes.description: Yukimi leaves the village to see the outside world, taking "Tenzo" with her. Kakashi tries to convince the two to return so that he can set a trap to capture Orochimaru, who is after Yukimi's blood. But Yamato, who has grown attached to Yukimi, abandons his original mission to protect his friend.

episodes.title: The Targeted Sharingan
episodes.description: Danzo orders Tenzo to kill Kakashi and take his Sharingan. Reluctant at first, Tenzo decides to carry out his orders after learning that the Leaf Shinobi has come to be known as "Kakashi the Friend Killer."

episodes.title: A Shinobi of the Leaf
episodes.description: After being saved by the target he was ordered to kill, Tenzo realizes that the man known as "Kakashi the Friend Killer" is someone who values the lives of his comrades more than anyone. No longer wishing to kill Kakashi, Tenzo abandons the mission and returns to the Leaf Village, fully aware that his actions will stir up Danzo's anger.

episodes.title: An Uchiha ANBU
episodes.description: Itachi Uchiha is inducted into Kakashi's unit as the youngest member of the ANBU Black Ops. Itachi's father, Fugaku, is pleased, thinking this will grant the Uchiha access to exclusive, top-secret Leaf intel. But Danzo, who wants intel on the Uchiha, orders Itachi to betray his family and clan by acting as a double agent.

episodes.title: Coup d'État
episodes.description: Following the aftermath of the Nine-Tails incident, many on the Leaf Council voice suspicions that the Uchiha Clan were behind this tragedy. The Uchiha are then placed under 24-hour surveillance by the ANBU, which causes further tensions to arise.

episodes.title: The Night of the Tragedy
episodes.description: Kakashi visits the Uchiha District and notices that the community seems more antisocial than the last time he visited. Meanwhile Itachi finds concrete evidence regarding the Uchiha Clan's coup against the Leaf. The fateful moment is fast approaching…

episodes.title: Jonin Leader
episodes.description: Hiruzen relieves Kakashi of his ANBU duties and assigns him a new position as a Jonin Leader. Reflecting on his past mistakes, Kakashi decides to use the same test that Minato once used to measure one's teamwork.

episodes.title: Team 7
episodes.description: Hiruzen assigns Kakashi to be in charge of Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura, three genin that bear a striking resemblance to the former Team Minato.

episodes.title: Kakashi's Resolve
episodes.description: Kakashi desperately tries to reach out to Obito, but his words fall on deaf ears. Obito instead accuses Kakashi of being trash, which angers Naruto, forcing him to step in and defend his Sensei.

episodes.title: The Allied Shinobi Forces Technique
episodes.description: The barrier is shattered, and Ten Tails appears! With unfathomable power in its attack, it sends shock waves through the air! Kurama takes the lead and tries to go on the offensive, but is helpless against Ten Tails' immense strength. Soon both Kurama and Gyuki exhaust their chakra and fade away.

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.description: The Allied Shinobi Forces begin their onslaught against Obito and Madara. But Ten Tails suddenly transforms and hurls powerful Tailed Beast Bombs toward distant towns. One after the other, the Tailed Beast Bombs find their targets. The shinobi wonder why Ten Tails is aiming so far away as one of the bombs heads toward HQ!

episodes.title: Those Who Dance in the Shadows
episodes.description: Naruto is overcome with grief over Neji's death, but Hinata's words restore his fighting spirit. Shikaku outlines his final strategy before he dies, in which Nine Tails will send its chakra to increase everyone's strength. United in their cause, Naruto and the shinobi set out to take on Ten Tails, determined that Neji and their comrades will not have died in vain!

episodes.title: The All-Knowing
episodes.description: Sasuke returns to the Hidden Leaf Village seeking answers, and standing before him are First Hokage Hashirama, Second Hokage Tobirama, Third Hokage Hiruzen, and Fourth Hokage Minato, all reanimated.

episodes.title: Hashirama and Madara
episodes.description: "Villages did not exist when Hashirama was a child. It was during this strife-filled time that he met Madara Uchiha."

episodes.title: Warring States Period
episodes.description: Madara and Hashirama eventually become the leaders of their respective clans. As the fighting rages on between the Senju and Uchiha, Hashirama approaches Madara about an alliance.

episodes.title: My True Dream
episodes.description: The Senju and Uchiha clans join together to build a shinobi village and fulfill their dreams.

episodes.title: Sasuke's Answer
episodes.description: After listening to what Hashirama and the rest of the former Hokage have to say, Sasuke finally understands how the Leaf Village and its shinobi came to be.

episodes.title: Hole
episodes.description: The fighting rages between Naruto, who stands at the vanguard of the Allied Shinobi Forces, and the team of Madara and Obito.

episodes.title: Something to Fill the Hole
episodes.description: Ten Tails is on the brink of its final transformation and begins to form a massive Tailed Beast Bomb.

episodes.title: Team 7, Assemble!
episodes.description: Team 7 is finally reunited when Naruto, Sakura and Sasuke join forces.

episodes.title: The New Three-Way Deadlock
episodes.description: Bearing a close resemblance to the Legendary Sannin, Naruto, Sakura and Sasuke make a stunning arrival on the battlefield with each of their summonings.

episodes.title: Kakashi vs. Obito
episodes.description: Kakashi holds on to the hope that Obito can return to being the young man that he remembers. But Obito has abandoned the present as well as the memories of his friends and will not try to stop the Infinite Tsukuyomi. Realizing that nothing more can be done, Kakashi comes to a decision to protect the world, while his former friend is determined to end it!

episodes.title: The Directive to Take the Nine-Tails!
episodes.description: Part 1 of a special two-part extra edition! The townspeople are going about their daily business on the streets of the Leaf Village when someone suddenly appears and starts sending them flying!

episodes.title: Naruto vs. Mecha Naruto
episodes.description: Part 2 of a special two-part extra edition! The townspeople are going about their daily business on the streets of the Leaf Village when someone suddenly appears and starts sending them flying!

episodes.title: The Jinchuriki of the Ten Tails
episodes.description: Obito completely absorbs the giant Ten Tails, undergoes a transformation and becomes the Ten Tails' Jinchuriki.

episodes.title: An Opening
episodes.description: Obito has gained complete control over his power as the Ten Tails Jinchuriki. His powerful, cold-blooded attacks force Naruto and his friends into a corner

episodes.title: The Day Naruto Was Born
episodes.description: Minato is filled with regret during his confrontation with Obito. He thinks if only he had recognized Obito as the Masked Man during the assault on the Hidden Leaf Village, he could have stopped the attack, and maybe Kushina would not have died. The next day is the anniversary of Minato's and Kushina's deaths. Obito taunts Minato as a weak shinobi and seals every shinobi inside a barrier in order to destroy them all!

episodes.title: Divine Tree
episodes.description: Naruto and Minato combine their powers to perform a Sage Jutsu attack on Obito.

episodes.title: A Shinobi's Dream
episodes.description: The Ten Tails morphs into its final form, "The Divine Tree," and attacks the shinobi, absorbing their chakra one after another.

episodes.title: Pursuing Hope
episodes.description: Naruto's past, thoughts, and feelings flow into the consciousness of every shinobi, unifying their hearts.

episodes.title: A Heart Filled With Comrades
episodes.description: Naruto and Sasuke size up Obito as the final battle looms. Working in sync, Naruto and Sasuke prepare to attack in the same way Madara once did, bedecking Kurama in the robes of Susano'o.

episodes.title: Obito Uchiha
episodes.description: Naruto objects to Obito's claim that he is the second Sage of Six Paths and declares that he is Obito Uchiha.

episodes.title: I'm Always Watching
episodes.description: Pressed by Naruto, Obito remembers the time he, Kakashi, and Rin teamed up for the Chunin Exam and when he promised Rin that he would become Hokage.

episodes.title: The Promise That Was Kept
episodes.description: Naruto's power of persuasion moves Obito's heart. Due to the influence of the Ten Tails, visions of himself and Rin from the past appear in the inner realm and play havoc with Obito's emotions.

episodes.title: My First Friend
episodes.description: All the Tailed Beasts are freed, and old friends Kakashi and Obito come face to face with each other. What will Obito's response be? Meanwhile, the Tailed Beasts and the Allied Shinobi Forces shift their focus onto their greatest foe, Madara Uchiha. Gaara is reunited with his former Tailed Beast, Shukaku. When Gaara asks Shukaku to lend his power to seal Madara, he refuses. Will their history of animosity prevent them from working together?

episodes.title: The Adored Elder Sister
episodes.description: Hanabi adores her sister Hinata, who struggles to become a worthy successor to the Hyuga Clan.

episodes.title: Hanabi's Decision
episodes.description: When Hinata is labeled unfit as a successor, Hanabi's heart becomes bound to her destiny.

episodes.title: Madara Uchiha Arises
episodes.description: Naruto and the Allied Shinobi Forces successfully extract the Tailed Beasts from Obito. Only Madara remains, and Naruto heads out to tackle this foe.

episodes.title: One's True Heart
episodes.description: With his newly revived strength, Madara doesn't give in against the nine Tailed Beasts.

episodes.title: A True Ending
episodes.description: Despite all efforts, Kurama is extracted from Naruto, and ultimately, all the Tailed Beasts are imprisoned inside the Gedo Statue.

episodes.title: The New Chūnin Exams
episodes.description: The story travels back to the time after Sasuke's defection from the Leaf and before Naruto's return from his two-year training journey with Jiraiya.

episodes.title: The Chūnin Exams Begin
episodes.description: The Hidden Leaf begin preparing for the Chunin Exams. Ino and Choji ask Sakura to join their three-man team as a stand-in for Shikamaru, who is already a chunin.

episodes.title: The Three Questions
episodes.description: The Chunin Exams finally begin and the proctor for Round One is none other than Shikamaru! The first exam is a written test.

episodes.title: One Worthy as a Leader
episodes.description: The genin are unable to figure out the answer and start to panic. Neji announces to everyone in the room that he will tell them how to answer the question.

episodes.title: The Night Before the Second Exam
episodes.description: On the night before the Second Exam, the entrants gather in the cafeteria, and a brawl breaks out. While the Hidden Leaf stand by helpless, the only one who can calm everyone down is Fuu from the Hidden Waterfall Village.

episodes.title: Demon Desert Survival
episodes.description: The Second Exam finally begins! To pass this stage, each team must take possession of both the Heaven and Earth scrolls and make it to the designated site in the center of the Demon Desert within 72 hours.

episodes.title: As a Taijutsu User
episodes.description: Noting the similarities of their circumstances, Lee is outraged at the ones who hurt and belittled Shira and sets out in pursuit!

episodes.title: The Ultimate
episodes.description: Lee challenges Shira to a battle between taijutsu users!

episodes.title: Escape vs. Pursuit
episodes.description: Kiba and his team are in pursuit of Hidden Grass Ninja who have stolen their scroll!

episodes.title: Unwavering Gutsiness
episodes.description: Kiba and his team are in pursuit of Hidden Grass Ninja who have stolen their scroll!

episodes.title: Tenten's Troubles
episodes.description: As the team prepares for dinner, Tenten pulls out a scroll that contains all the ingredients for okonomiyaki.

episodes.title: The Imprisoned Pair
episodes.description: An ancient ruin in Demon Desert comes crumbling down during the battle for the scrolls.

episodes.title: The Place Where I Belong
episodes.description: Ino, Sakura and Choji trudge across a desert under the blazing sun without any provisions. Ino and Sakura are arguing when a giant scorpion attacks and injures Sakura.

episodes.title: The Yamanaka Clan: Secret Ninjutsu
episodes.description: As Ino and her team head toward an oasis, they are attacked by a team of Sand Shinobi comprised of Ameno, Shishio, and Kouji.

episodes.title: The Cursed Puppet
episodes.description: Sakura and her team continue their trek across the desert towards the goal. Their continuous battles have depleted Sakura's chakra, so they stop to rest. Just then, they encounter a puppet manipulated by a rival team from the Sand and end up being discovered.

episodes.title: Their Backs
episodes.description: Ino and Choji fight to protect an immobilized Sakura although they have depleted most of their chakra due to the relentless fighting.

episodes.title: The Hidden Plot Set Into Motion
episodes.description: Sand Jonin Fugi sneaks into the Demon Desert and creates a massive sandstorm in order to assassinate Gaara, the Fifth Kazekage.

episodes.title: The Targeted Tailed Beast
episodes.description: Gaara heads out to rescue Matsuri and the others but is attacked by a mysterious priest who binds him with a Chakra Chain to capture his Tailed Beast.

episodes.title: Neji's Judgment
episodes.description: Neji and the team come across Matsuri collapsed in the desert and find out that Gaara is in danger. Meanwhile, the chains of a mysterious priest bind Gaara and Foo.

episodes.title: Hopes Entrusted to the Future
episodes.description: Gaara meets with Fugi, the mastermind behind the assassination attempt on his life. He confides that perhaps, after all the fear and pain he has wrought upon the Sand, he has no right to be their leader.

episodes.title: On the Brink of Death
episodes.description: After his Tailed Beast is extracted, Naruto is on the verge of dying. Sakura desperately tries to save him, but Naruto's heart gives out.

episodes.title: The Two Mangekyō
episodes.description: Madara has transformed into the Jinchuriki of the Ten Tails and appears before Kakashi. Kakashi and the others combine their powers to attack, but they are no match for Madara..

episodes.title: The Formation of Team Minato
episodes.description: Kakashi has changed for the worse, and Obito doesn't know why. He runs into Kakashi and tries to talk to him, but Kakashi gives him the cold shoulder.

episodes.title: You'll Be My Backup
episodes.description: Obito doesn't understand Kakashi's way of thinking, but he finally learns why Kakashi put his mission first that time at Kannabi Bridge. Presently, Obito and Kakashi return together to confront Madara.

episodes.title: The Blue Beast vs. Six Paths Madara
episodes.description: Guy releases his Eight Inner Gates against Madara, but the Seventh Gate of Shock does not work against him!

episodes.title: Papa's Youth
episodes.description: Dai counsels his forlorn son, telling him what true victory and setting self-rules are about. They become principles that Guy carves deep into his heart. With his father's teachings spurring him on, Guy sets out on his final battle.

episodes.title: The Eight Inner Gates Formation
episodes.description: Guy activates the Eight Inner Gates Formation and relentlessly attacks Six Paths Madara. Even Madara, who has attained power strong enough to create huge fissures in the ground, tries to dodge Guy's direct attacks.

episodes.title: The Sage of Six Paths
episodes.description: Naruto wakes up and encounters the legendary shinobi, the Sage of Six Paths. He reveals to Naruto that he is the reincarnation of his son, Ashura, and that Sasuke is the reincarnation of Indra, Ashura's older brother.

episodes.title: The Ones Who Will Inherit
episodes.description: It's been three years since Naruto set out to train with Jiraiya, and he's just returned to the Hidden Leaf Village. Konohamaru immediately begs Naruto to teach him a new jutsu and he starts to go over the basics...but his explanations are very vague. Soon after, Naruto sets out on a mission, leaving Konohamaru to figure it out alone!

episodes.title: Naruto's Rival
episodes.description: It's been three years since Naruto set out to train with Jiraiya, and he's just returned to the Hidden Leaf Village. Konohamaru immediately begs Naruto to teach him a new jutsu and he starts to go over the basics...but his explanations are very vague. Soon after, Naruto sets out on a mission, leaving Konohamaru to figure it out alone!

episodes.title: To Rise Up
episodes.description: Madara sustains serious damage from the Eight Inner Gates Formation, the move Guy risks his life for.

episodes.title: The Infinite Dream
episodes.description: Madara now possesses the Rinnegan in both eyes, and he is the strongest, most despicable enemy the newly reunited Team 7 has ever faced. Kakashi calls upon Team 7 to recall their first lesson with the bells, and to use teamwork!

episodes.title: The Infinite Tsukuyomi
episodes.description: Madara activates the Infinite Tsukuyomi, and anyone exposed to the light of the full moon--including shinobi and ordinary citizens--loses consciousness. Once ensnared, there is no escape from the Infinite Tsukuyomi. Will mankind be destined to live in a dreamworld forever?

episodes.title: To the Dreamworld
episodes.description: Tenten falls under the Infinite Tsukuyomi and wakes up in the Hidden Leaf Village. When Lee and Guy Sensei appear, Tenten is relieved to see that she is not alone. But her joy is short-lived, as both men act oddly and are dressed stylishly—just where has she been transported to?

episodes.title: Where Tenten Belongs
episodes.description: Tenten falls under the Infinite Tsukuyomi and wakes up in the Hidden Leaf Village. When Lee and Guy Sensei appear, Tenten is relieved to see that she is not alone. But her joy is short-lived, as both men act oddly and are dressed stylishly—just where has she been transported to?

episodes.title: Killer B Rappūden: Part 1
episodes.description: Killer Bee gets caught in the Infinite Tsukuyomi and begins dreaming. In his dream, Jinchuriki are being stripped of their Tailed Beast powers by the Akatsuki. Bee is determined to rescue those who have been captured, and vows to resist the Akatsuki who are coming after him!

episodes.title: Killer B Rappūden: Part 2
episodes.description: The Akatsuki summoned the Ten Tails, but the Princess of Rappu Castle sealed it away safely. Unfortunately, the seal will come undone on the next full moon. Now Killer Bee is determined to gather the power of all nine Jinchuriki before the next full moon and protect the princess. But one by one, adversaries who want to stop Bee appear, beginning with Itachi and Deidara, then Orochimaru, Kabuto and Sasuke!

episodes.title: To See That Smile, Just One More Time
episodes.description: Karin is caught within the Infinite Tsukuyomi and dreams of her past. She was born into the Uzumaki Clan and has the unique ability to heal anyone who bites into her. Driven out of her village, the Hidden Grass takes her in, only to use her for this ability. Karin has no choice but to endure constant suffering in order to survive. She is later chosen to enter the Chunin Exams, where Sasuke saves her life. Karin has never forgotten what he did for her—or his smile

episodes.title: The Loser Ninja
episodes.description: With the exception of Naruto's Team 7, which is protected by the Susano'o, all other shinobi have been swept into a dream world by the Infinite Tsukuyomi. Even the Hokage, Tsunade, has fallen into a dream state. She awakens to find herself in the Leaf Village, where she discovers Jiraiya's final book, entitled "Jiraiya Ninja Scrolls," and begins to read...

episodes.title: The Search Mission
episodes.description: Tsunade continues to read Jiraiya's novel. Chunin- and jonin-level ninja have gone missing, and the Fourth Hokage, Minato, orders a search mission with teams of genin led by Guy and Kurenai. Kakashi's Team 7 is also dispatched, but the hero Naruto Uzumaki, despite being the Hokage's son, has the misfortune of being labeled a loser.

episodes.title: Team Jiraiya
episodes.description: Tsunade continues to read Jiraiya's novel. Chunin- and jonin-level ninja have gone missing, and the Fourth Hokage, Minato, orders a search mission with teams of genin led by Guy and Kurenai. Kakashi's Team 7 is also dispatched, but the hero Naruto Uzumaki, despite being the Hokage's son, has the misfortune of being labeled a loser.

episodes.title: Order of Priority
episodes.description: Team Jiraiya, Shikamaru, and his Leaf teammates are lured into a mysterious village during their battle. A couple children from the village get caught in the crossfire and fall into a cave-in. Yahiko's team rushes to the rescue, but Shikamaru doesn't budge. Meanwhile, Naruto and Neji's teams rendezvous, but a mysterious voice addresses them out of nowhere!

episodes.title: The Masked Man
episodes.description: The Masked Man shows Neji and Naruto images of past incidents that occurred in the Leaf Village. Meanwhile, Shikamaru and friends join up with Team Jiraiya to rescue the children. After fighting side by side with the Leaf, Yahiko and the others seem to have a change of heart.

episodes.title: The Sealed Power
episodes.description: The Masked Man is satisfied that the Hidden Leaf Genin chose the importance of life over their mission, but orders his team to continue their surveillance. Meanwhile, Naruto is frustrated at his inabilities, and recalls why his father Minato sealed the Nine Tails inside of him.

episodes.title: The Rules or a Comrade
episodes.description: Sasuke and Sakura join up with the others, but the Puppet User appears and blocks their path back to the Hidden Leaf Village. Sasuke wants to bring down the puppets and rush back to report to the Fourth Hokage, but Shikamaru and the others insist on staying and rescuing the jonin.

episodes.title: The Child of Prophecy
episodes.description: Jiraiya weakens the seal on the Nine Tails in order to help Naruto learn how to control the Tailed Beast's power. Jiraiya recalls the words spoken to him years ago by the Great Lord Elder. He told Jiraiya that he would have a student, and that his guidance would decide whether the student would save the Ninja World or destroy it.

episodes.title: The Caged Bird
episodes.description: Naruto joins up with the rest of his comrades, and together they overcome the puppet attack. The masked man witnesses this and is convinced there is a future for the young shinobi. He promises to release the kidnapped jonin and begins to explain the truth, and the situation behind his motives.

episodes.title: Returning Home
episodes.description: Naruto's strength is recognized by his fellow genin, except Sasuke. But while Naruto enjoys a close relationship with his father, Sasuke's father, Fugaku, constantly compares Sasuke with his older brother Itachi and barely pays attention to him…

episodes.title: The Mutual Path
episodes.description: Sasuke takes his frustrations out on Naruto and the two begin to fight, this time with their respective new jutsu. Minato steps in just before it turns into a disaster. From this encounter, Sasuke realizes that he is nowhere equal to Naruto in strength and joins the Leaf Police Force, determined to beat him one day.

episodes.title: The Difference in Power
