episodes.description: A new species of moth is eating all the Christmas trees in Swellview, so Captain Man and Kid Danger head over to Neighborville to buy more. On the way back they're attacked by shady tree dealers and have to fight to save Christmas.

episodes.title: Mr. Nice Guy
episodes.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man are tricked into entering an escape room by a factory owner with a "chip" on his shoulder. They are trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out.

episodes.title: Theranos Boot
episodes.description: Henry and the other kids destroy Ray's prized movie prop, The Theranos Boot. To replace it, Henry and Jasper travel to an alternate universe Man Cave using Bill Evil's inter-dimensional transporter and steal their Theranos Boot before Ray finds out.

episodes.title: Rumblr
episodes.description: Captain Man, sick of fighting the same old villains, is convinced to make a profile on a match making app for heroes and villains. Kid Danger agrees to do the same and two of them set up a double-fight to square off with some new villains.

episodes.title: Cave the Date
episodes.description: Henry and the gang set up a secret underground restaurant in the Man Cave for Charlotte's private dinner with music superstar Jack Swagger. When word gets out that Jack Swagger is in town, some unwanted guests crash the party.

episodes.title: Escape Room
episodes.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man are tricked into entering an escape room by a factory owner with a "chip" on his shoulder. They are trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out.

episodes.title: Game of Phones
episodes.description: When a young girl chains herself outside of Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone. While on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan they weren't prepared for.

episodes.title: Remember the Crimes
episodes.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man battle Drex on top of a blimp to stop him from erasing Swellview's memory of Captain Man. But when the blimp aims straight for the Swellview Baby Hospital, one hero must stay behind to save the day.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the End
episodes.description: Kid Danger reveals to Captain Man that he doesn't want to be stuck in Swellview and be his sidekick forever. To make matters worse, Kid Danger is recruited by another town to be their hero.

episodes.title: Captain Drex
episodes.description: Captain Man's old sidekick and nemesis, Drex, returns from the past with an army of cavemen to finish off Captain Man once and for all. Kid Danger may be the only one who can save Captain Man now.

episodes.title: The Fate of Danger: Part 1
episodes.description: Kid Danger and his friends try to figure out how to get Captain Man back from the past, while Drex furthers his scheme to erase Swellview's memory of Captain Man forever.

episodes.title: The Fate of Danger: Part II
episodes.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man battle Drex on top of a blimp to stop him from erasing Swellview's memory of Captain Man. But when the blimp aims straight for the Swellview Baby Hospital, one hero must stay behind to save the day.

episodes.title: Ultimate Robot Battle vs Dude Perfect
episodes.description: It's five against one when Dude Perfect challenges Mark to an epic robot showdown that's full of surprises. The only rule is... there are no rules.

episodes.title: Beating 5 Scam Arcade Games
episodes.description: Mark builds robots to beat the five most common arcade games, shares secret strategies to win tons of tickets and exposes some of the biggest scams.

episodes.title: World's Largest Jello Pool
episodes.description: After spending six months studying Jell-O, Mark sets out to fill an entire pool with it so he can see what it would be like to do a Jell-O belly flop.

episodes.title: Octopus vs Underwater Maze
episodes.description: Mark challenges his pet octopus Sashimi to a nine-part underwater obstacle course that tests her amazing intelligence and incredible dexterity.

episodes.title: World's Tallest Elephant Toothpaste
episodes.description: Science Bob joins Mark for a record-breaking elephant toothpaste experiment involving hydrogen peroxide, an enormous flask — and lots of food coloring.

episodes.title: Egg Drop From Space
episodes.description: "Mark starts out with a plan to drop an egg from the world's tallest building but shifts gears to attempt the world's largest egg drop... from space.

episodes.title: Unbeatable Rock Paper Scissors Robot
episodes.description: Learn the science behind some of the coolest CrunchLabs creations, from a room-temperature ice rink to a rock, paper, scissors robot that can't lose.

episodes.title: Acid vs. Lava Destruction Test
episodes.description: In a scientific face-off, Mark goes head-to-head with NileRed and Kevin the Backyard Scientist to find out which is more destructive: acid or lava.

episodes.title: Backyard Squirrel Obstacle Course
episodes.description: To stop the sneaky squirrels from raiding his bird feeder, Mark builds a challenging eight-part obstacle course in his backyard to try and slow them down.

episodes.title: World's Largest Devil's Toothpaste
episodes.description: Mark throws an epic birthday party for a deserving teen, complete with a record-breaking devil's toothpaste experiment — the first of its kind.

episodes.title: Beating Carnival Scams With Science
episodes.description: Step right up and learn which carnival games are actually winnable and which ones aren't, courtesy of Mark... and a friend from the New York Mets.

episodes.title: My Domino Robot Broke A World Record
episodes.description: Mark's robot Dom is really good at setting up dominos. But can he fill a warehouse with a mural made up of more than 100,000 of them in just 24 hours?

episodes.title: Engineers vs. Extreme Hide & Seek
episodes.description: Mark has 30 minutes to find all nine product designers hidden inside the CrunchLabs warehouse — and they're allowed to fight back with blasters!

episodes.title: My Experience Building The Mars Rover
episodes.description: In honor of the historic Perseverance Mars rover landing, Mark talks to some of his old friends at NASA and suits up to see the actual rover up close.

episodes.title: Lava vs Laser Destruction Test
episodes.description: What's the most destructive substance on Earth? Lava's the reigning champ — but how do lasers stack up? Mark and his friends are about to find out.

episodes.title: Backyard Squirrel 2.0 - Bank Heist
episodes.description: Mark ups his backyard obstacle course game to keep four thieving squirrels away from a bank vault full of birdseed and a lifetime supply of walnuts.

episodes.title: Building a Liquid Sand Hot Tub
episodes.description: With the right amount of forced air, a hot tub filled with sand can look like a bubbling pot of soup. But how? Mark breaks down the science behind it.

episodes.title: This Ball Is Impossible to Hit
episodes.description: Mark uses the magic of engineering to level the playing field in a stacked competition against the world's greatest wiffle ball players.

episodes.title: Vortex Cannon vs Drone
episodes.description: Mark explores the possibilities of anti-drone defense technologies with a crew of backyard YouTube engineers... and the world's largest vortex cannon.

episodes.title: Glitter Bomb 1.0 vs Porch Pirates
episodes.description: Stolen packages? Not so fast. Mark builds the original "Glitter Bomb" trap to combat porch pirates — and really make them regret their life choices.

episodes.title: Engineers vs Food Robots
episodes.description: From cereal and milk to spaghetti and meatballs: Things get messy when the CrunchLabs team cooks up new ways to make Mark's mealtimes more efficient.

episodes.title: Mark Rober vs Ninja Kidz
episodes.description: It's not just the Ninja Kidz — it's the whole Ninja Fam! And Mark's challenging them all to a silly series of "Minute to Win It" style challenges.

episodes.title: Engineers vs Custom Go Kart Racing
episodes.description: CrunchLabs product designers get 24 hours to build and race their own custom go-karts incorporating engineering know-how — and the element of surprise.

episodes.title: Moving Train Jump Test
episodes.description: To answer an assortment of science puzzles, Mark takes his experiments to the next level — on top of a moving train and up high in a hot air balloon!

episodes.title: Lasers vs. Lightning Destruction Test
episodes.description: Now it's lasers vs. lightning in a showdown to find out which one is more destructive. With a series of tests, the CrunchLabs crew declares a champ.

episodes.title: Glitter Bomb 2.0 vs. Porch Pirates
episodes.description: Actor Macaulay Culkin joins Mark as he unleashes upgraded bait packages full of glitter — and stinky fart spray — to lure potential thieves.

episodes.title: How to Escape a Police Sniffing Dog
episodes.description: Mark's running for his life while being hunted down by an expert tracking dog. Can he engineer some distractions to throw the dog off her game?

episodes.title: Backyard Squirrel Olympics 3.0
episodes.description: Let the games begin! From a high jump to a spinning balance beam, Mark's set up a series of backyard battles for squirrels competing for the Walnut Cup.

episodes.title: I Built My Own Space Satellite
episodes.description: One small step in space, one giant leap for taking a selfie. Mark preps a satellite to snap pics of the Earth photobombing the selfies sent by his fans.

episodes.title: I Spent $5M So You Can Go to Space
episodes.description: Get ready for liftoff! After three years of work and spending millions of dollars, can Mark ensure his selfie-taking satellite has a successful launch?

episodes.title: Ours polaire
episodes.description: Nutty Hill is suffering from a stifling heat wave. Searching in vain for a bit of cool air, Grizzy suddenly has a brilliant idea. He'll get into the fridge, where the temperature will be more bearable.

episodes.title: Ours à tartiner
episodes.description: Grizzy is frustrated: just as he was about to coat a nice big fresh salmon with chocolate spread and snuggle up in front of the Tv, he discovers that the pantry is empty!

episodes.title: Ours cellulaire
episodes.description: Grizzy's nap is interrupted by an annoying vibrating. He sees the forest ranger's cell phone. It has various functions, including a game to which he instantly becomes addicted.

episodes.title: Jurassic ours
episodes.description: Freed by the thawing ice, a mysterious giant egg slides up to the front door of the log cabin. The Lemmings watch the hatching of large baby dinosaur that immediately mistakes them for his mummies. How can Grizzy and the lemmings armed with the T rex?

episodes.title: Extrême fitness
episodes.description: In order to seduce the she-bear he's infatuated with, Grizzy decides to take things in hand and slim down with the ranger's bodybuilding equipment. But before starting his exercise routine, he will first have to settle the problem of the Lemmings.

episodes.title: Robots domestiques
episodes.description: By chance, Grizzy discovers that the ranger's new robot vacuum cleaner also gives very pleasant back massages. But the Lemmings see the new gadget more as a competition bumper car.

episodes.title: Contrôle des masses
episodes.description: Grizzy discovers a gadget that controls functions in the cabin. One button creates light an other surveys the house. Will Grizzy be able to rid himself to the lemmings without leaving the couch?

episodes.title: Ours sous contrôle
episodes.description: Grizzy wants to take a nap and under all circumstances prevent the lemmings go to the chocolate cream. For this reason, he turns his refrigerator into a vault. The lemmings try in vain to break the refrigerator until they see the bear sleep and open the refrigerator. Just as he did, he woke up surprisingly.

episodes.title: Popcorn Party
episodes.description: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths.

episodes.title: Danse avec les ours
episodes.description: Grizzy wants to learn to dance the mambo to please his lovely she-bear. He finds a learning kit at the ranger's home which has a dance carpet with footprints.

episodes.title: Échange standard
episodes.description: After receiving a terrible blow over the head, Grizzy is no longer the same: he thinks he's a rodent! He tries to get the gang to adopt him.

episodes.title: Lemming Tonic
episodes.description: A tired Grizzly goes to fetch a pillow but the Lemmings have different plans for the couch.

episodes.title: Ours à gratter
episodes.description: Grizzy discovers that the frenzied "break dance" the Lemmings are doing is actually due to the fleas they are infested with.

episodes.title: Ours à sec
episodes.description: Another heat wave: even the riverbed is dried up. One very thirsty Grizzy discovers that the Lemmings have used the last remaining bottles of water to fill their inflatable pool.

episodes.title: Spider Lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings have caught a little spider. Her sticky threads are perfect for bungee jumping. Grizzy, who has no intention of getting caught in the web, decides to crush the insec

episodes.title: Ours aléatoire
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips to win goodies. But more importantly, there's s grand prize: a giant jar of Yummy.

episodes.title: Ours à l'antenne
episodes.description: Grizzy has prepared himself a TV dinner to eat in front of his favourite series. But his moment of pleasure is abruptly interrupted by unexplained static.

episodes.title: Ours à haute tension
episodes.description: The Lemmings are having a rave party. When Grizzy throws their stereo into the river, he sparks a general power outage and is unable to watch his favourite shows.

episodes.title: Ours au parfum
episodes.description: When he realises that his beloved she-bear adores the smell of flowers, Grizzy decides to offer her the geraniums that decorate the window ledges of the ranger's cabin.

episodes.title: Bear Luck
episodes.description: This is not Grizzy's day: after making a fool of himself in front of the she-bear, he is ousted from the cabin by the Lemmings. But his luck is about to change.

episodes.title: Magnetic Bear
episodes.description: Grizzy sees objects moving all by themselves when the Lemmings play around with a powerful magnet.

episodes.title: Ours charmant
episodes.description: Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through the ranger's books of fairytales, the Lemmings try to recover the frog.

episodes.title: Le meilleur ami de l'ours
episodes.description: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature.

episodes.title: Super Grizzy Bros
episodes.description: When Grizzy discovers the ranger's racing video game, the Lemmings try everything to get their hands on the joystick.

episodes.title: Faux frère
episodes.description: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away.

episodes.title: Tête à l'envers
episodes.description: After being hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy's in love with thinks she's a Lemming.

episodes.title: Problème de taille
episodes.description: A small meteorite falls down by the table it contains jelly beans. But Grizzy uses a red beans and blue beans to chase the lemmings while riding a large birds but the end the bird got very large to chase them.

episodes.title: Ours au trésor
episodes.description: When an underground maze reveals a hidden treasure map, Grizzy and the Lemmings are motivated to find the delicious riches.

episodes.title: Au service de sa corpulence
episodes.description: When he brandishes an Indian scepter that the Lemmings brought home, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants.

episodes.title: Œuvre d'ours
episodes.description: Grizzy tries to impress the she-bear he's in love with by making a sculpture of her from a piece of wood. But the Lemmings gnaw at the work of art to transform it into a slide.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday Lemming
episodes.description: The Lemmings throw a Birthday party when Happy Birthday rings out it wakes Grizzy who is sleeping after a hearty meal. Grizzy must stop the dim but for the lemmings. the party must go on.

episodes.title: Flower Power
episodes.description: A gust of wind sweeps away the flower that Grizzy's adored she-bear wears in her hair. Grizzy sees this as a golden opportunity to dazzle her by bringing it back.

episodes.title: Téléportez, c'est gagné
episodes.description: Grizzy finds communicating vessels. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, regardless of the distance between them. This should satisfy Grizzy's natural lazy streak.

episodes.title: Ours à rebours
episodes.description: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings.

episodes.title: Lemming Airlines
episodes.description: A bag of balloons and a tank of helium gives the Lemmings a chance to fly, but when they attempt to float everything in the living room, Grizzy takes action.

episodes.title: Ours relax
episodes.description: A new reclining chair complete with a control pad is in the cabin, and Grizzy is excited to enjoy a meal while making use of the comfortable chair.

episodes.title: Ça plane pour l'ours
episodes.description: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration.

episodes.title: Sur un air de lemming
episodes.description: A magical flute grants the user the power to control the movements of objects, and the Lemmings want to take advantage of this ability to grab chocolate jars.

episodes.title: Ours dans le vent
episodes.description: A very high powered fan is aimed at the house, creating a wind tunnel, and Grizzy learns that it is the Lemmings who are using this device to float.

episodes.title: Ours de construction (Secret de fabrication)
episodes.description: The Lemmings have fun tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy finds that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the construction.

episodes.title: Kung Fu Lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two.

episodes.title: Songe d'une nuit d'ours
episodes.description: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has delivered his beloved. As he is about to take her in his arms, he is woken by the Lemmings who have chosen this day to blast music.

episodes.title: Secret de fabrication
episodes.description: Grizzy stands in front of the pantry, desperate. The stock of chocolate spread is completely depleted. He realizes that the Lemmings are making some themselves!

episodes.title: Ours Bling Bling
episodes.description: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear.

episodes.title: Ours = mc2
episodes.description: When he accidentally sticks a computer microprocessor to his temple, Grizzy is transformed into an exceptionally intelligent being capable of predicting events to come.

episodes.title: Doudou Vaudou
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings find themselves enchanted by voodoo magic, and they both use the doll versions of each other to gain the upper hand in their struggle.

episodes.title: Fausse impression
episodes.description: Grizzy gleefully discovers that he can print images taken with the ranger's camera which is connected to a state-of-the-art printer. He decides to immortalize and frame himself...

episodes.title: Inspecteur Grizzy
episodes.description: A van pulls up to the ranger's cabin to deliver a crate of jars of chocolate spread. While Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a wrecking bar to open it, someone steals the crate.

episodes.title: Défense d'entrer
episodes.description: As usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter!

episodes.title: Indigestion de lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a stupid bouncing ball.

episodes.title: Sonate en ours majeur
episodes.description: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano at any cost. But when he notices that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of "Für Elise," he decides to learn the piece.

episodes.title: Fractions d'ours
episodes.description: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy. Inside, a case emits a sort of laser beam that divides objects into multiple miniaturized versions of themselves.

episodes.title: L'ours aux œufs d'or
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over an egg-dropping slot machine that houses prizes they've dreamed of, including a rocket and costume jewelry.

episodes.title: Formation minute
episodes.description: Grizzy uses the ranger's new gadget to become a smarter bear. But first, he wants to learn how to get rid of his obnoxious houseguests.

episodes.title: De mémoire d'ours
episodes.description: Grizzy and Lemmings find themselves in their new home for the first time and Grizzy and Lemmings meet with the food of their lives and the contest begins.

episodes.title: Lemmings chimiques
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a new chemistry set to occupy themselves. But when their experimenting interferes with Grizzy's TV time, they must be stopped.

episodes.title: Pilotage à distance
episodes.description: After his TV remote is stolen by a thieving partridge, Grizzy taps the Lemmings to urgently recover his high-tech possession.

episodes.title: L'ours et le papillon
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings chase butterflies for different reasons -- he for a romantic gift for his love, they for a game of “Helicopter.”

episodes.title: Lâche-moi les baskets
episodes.description: A fight over a pair of running shoes intensifies when Grizzy discovers their comfort and the Lemmings become addicted to how well they bounce.

episodes.title: Babysitting
episodes.description: When Grizzy babysits for his crush’s cub, the Lemmings decide to pump the youngster full of soda for burps and giggles.

episodes.title: Ours à double tour
episodes.description: When Grizzy locks his food in a burglar-proof safe, the Lemmings make every ridiculous attempt to unlock the goods.

episodes.title: Le lemming Blues
episodes.description: After witnessing a magician turn a partridge into a bouquet of flowers, Grizzy teaches himself magic in the hopes of making the Lemmings disappear.

episodes.title: Lemmings des neiges
episodes.description: On a sweltering day, Grizzy's ice cream cravings turn cold when he realizes the Lemmings ate all of the chilly dessert.

episodes.title: Augmented Bear
episodes.description: The Lemmings get hooked on a virtual reality game, and Grizzy follows suit in his addiction to a salmon fishing app.

episodes.title: Lemmings sous pression
episodes.description: Nothing comes between Grizzy and his salmon -- except a block of ice. To thaw his meal, he'll have to swipe the blow dryer from the Lemmings.

episodes.title: Lemmings in Space
episodes.description: The Lemmings' dream to reach the stars may come true after they find fireworks that could blast them into space -- but would interrupt Grizzy's nap.

episodes.title: Sniffer Raccoon
episodes.description: As the Lemmings savor the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread undetected, Grizzy trains an adorable raccoon to sniff out the sweet concoction.

episodes.title: Transformational Bear
episodes.description: Leave the couch? No way. Grizzy masters his laziness with the help of the Lemmings' radio-controlled robot, which he's turned into his personal butler.

episodes.title: Shaken Up Bear
episodes.description: Grizzy's snoring makes for good vibrations that the Lemmings can bounce to. But the tiny critters must get creative when the bear suddenly stops.

episodes.title: Pinata Party
episodes.description: The ranger's birthday piñata doubles as target practice for Grizzy and a fun swing for the Lemmings. The race is on to see who gets to control it.

episodes.title: Bear Game
episodes.description: When Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a magical game, they're transported into the board, where each adventure comes to life.

episodes.title: Ranger Lemming
episodes.description: Realizing the Lemmings will obey a big furry puppet, Grizzy uses their gullibility to his advantage.

episodes.title: Halloween Bear
episodes.description: As the Lemmings use leftover marshmallows as a trampoline, an unimpressed Grizzy changes his tune when he eats one of the pillowy confections.

episodes.title: Clean Bear
episodes.description: Grizzy wants to disinfect the gift for his crush, but there's one problem: The Lemmings are hogging the soap for their bobsled.

episodes.title: Wandering Spirits
episodes.description: Thanks to a strange figurine, Grizzy swaps spirits with a caribou. To switch back, he must steal the figurine from the pesky Lemmings, who've stolen it.

episodes.title: Mirror Mirror on the Wall
episodes.description: When Grizzy finds an old hand mirror fit for a princess, he's teleported into the utopia found only in his dreams.

episodes.title: Grizzy the Wizard
episodes.description: When the Lemmings discover a magic stick that brings objects to life, Grizzy plots to steal it to make his life easier.

episodes.title: Moonwalk Bear
episodes.description: One small step for the Lemmings is one giant leap for Grizzy. When fireworks explode at the cabin, all the creatures take a trip to the moon.

episodes.title: Camping in the Wild
episodes.description: With their endless battles over the ranger's cabin, which they do not want to share, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up blowing the cabin up.

episodes.title: Ice & Bears
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight again for Yummy XL with the help of drone.

episodes.title: Carried Away Bear
episodes.description: The Lemmings encounter a white bear that has drifted all the way to them on a chunk of ice that is slowly melting.

episodes.title: Fountain of Bear Youth
episodes.description: Lemmings found a magical a pink liquid thing in a cave in forest, that can make someone child into young and young into child.

episodes.title: Lemmings Kit
episodes.description: Before taking a nap, Grizzy locks the food in a cupboard to prevent the Lemmings from getting into it; to be sure they cannot force the lock and throws all the house tools into the ravine. The Lemmings decided to unlock the cupboard with playing tools.

episodes.title: Timeless Bear
episodes.description: After fell in the underground of cabin due to lemmings, Grizzy found a magical stick which takes both of them in an unknown place, where they met dinosaurs, a big butterfly, a dragon chicken, etc.

episodes.title: Irrestable Bear
episodes.description: Due to crashing of the Lemmings, Grizzy found a pink-coloured liquid thing in the middle of rocks that if someone drinks it, they will fall in love with anyone who is standing in front of them. Grizzy wants to drink this to She-bear, meanwhile the Lemmings wants to drank it to a Moose.

episodes.title: Yummy Fly
episodes.description: After snatching from the Lemmimgs, Grizzy wants to eat the chocolate spread Yummy XL but a fly continuously disturbs him.

episodes.title: Call of the Bear
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings found a lot of the whistles in a box in the cabin that attracts other living organisms to follow the command of whom is whistling. Both of them want to attract the flock of partridges.

episodes.title: Weightless Bear
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally set off a chain reaction which sends the Yummy XL, Salmon, truck flying into space, where it damages a space station and a scientific machine fall in front of cabin with broken parts of station.

episodes.title: Hat Ticks
episodes.description: Grizzy found a magical hat in the house that if something is thrown in the hat, it will came out with the help of the stick. Grizzy throws a flower in the hat to impressing she bear, while the Lemmings also want the hat that they planned they themselves goes into the hat and came out with magic.

episodes.title: No See, No Do
episodes.description: Once again the main characters does not want to share Yummy XL. To washing his hand Grizzy accidentally discovers a chemical solution that make somebody invisible.

episodes.title: Good Bear, Bad Bear
episodes.description: During fighting for the chocolate spread, a magical hammer separates the good nature and bad nature of Grizzy and he becomes into two Grizzys that one is good Grizzy while second is bad Grizzy. Good bear make chocolate spread for the Lemmings while bad bear tries to get for his own.

episodes.title: High-Risk Diving
episodes.description: After studying a magazine advertisement with a couple standing in front of an SUV, Grizzy imagines that if he had a nice car, she-bear would be interested in him. He decided to brought a temporary car from lemmings.

episodes.title: Bear Predictions
episodes.description: While chasing the Lemmings, who stole his jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy crashes into an arcade cabinet near the supermarket which displays a model fortuneteller and her crystal ball.

episodes.title: Lemming Beach
episodes.description: A newly unpacked UV tanning booth holds the place of honor in the middle of the cabin; Grizzy gets it into his head that a classy tan will help him draw the attention of the she-bear.

episodes.title: Of Fur and Swords
episodes.description: The Lemmings have turned the entire cabin topsy-turvy to organize medieval jousts with the ranger's fencing gear; Grizzy, who wishes to recover his couch, tries to straighten up, but is driven out by their fencing foils.

episodes.title: Lemmings Board
episodes.description: From Ranger's mini computer, Grizzy accidentally ordered an hover-board; it's a latest generation skateboard that levitates above the ground without wheels.

episodes.title: Animal Pics
episodes.description: Grizzy found a camera in the Ranger's house and he wants to go to she bear to click her photo but the lemmings also wants the camera to click their group photo.

episodes.title: Bear Diet
episodes.description: The fridge in the cabin has been replaced by a brand new state-of-the-art appliance which analyzes the body fat percentage of whoever wants to serve himself, before selecting the appropriate foodstuffs.

episodes.title: Balloon Bear
episodes.description: Grizzy watches a demonstration of balloon modeling on TV; he decides to make a balloon poodle to offer the she-bear.

episodes.title: Bear Pillow
episodes.description: Grizzy needs a good night's sleep. However, he can't find a pillow comfortable enough until he tries the one that cushions the lemmings' high jump. The pillow is so soft that Grizzy falls asleep instantly, earning the anger of the lemmings who were hoping to play.

episodes.title: Hooks and Loops Bear
episodes.description: Grizzy is awakened from his nap by the unpleasant, ongoing sound of Velcro strips being ripped off; the Lemmings have covered their bodies in Velcro and are throwing themselves against a doormat, which serves as their target.

episodes.title: Fast Workout
episodes.description: The she-bear is enamored with has lost her favorite flower in an inaccessible spot under a giant boulder; Grizzy tries to lift it but can't, so he starts an intensive bodybuilding routine.

episodes.title: Beastly Genie
episodes.description: Grizzy discovers a jar containing a genie who can grant all his wishes! It’s a dream come true… except for one catch: everything disappears once the genie goes back into the jar. Meanwhile, the Lemmings are after the genie too — they want to use him to build a crazy roller coaster!

episodes.title: Never Judge a Bear by It's Cover
Fortune lemming
episodes.description: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

episodes.title: Médecine pas douce
episodes.description: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

episodes.title: Shaolin domestique
episodes.description: After being thrown out of the log cabin by Grizzy, the Lemmings find a dragon statue with a mysterious stone in a temple. Touching the stone makes a fleeting tattoo appear on their bellies, temporarily endowing them with the mastery of Shaolin Kung Fu. The Lemmings return to the cabin and uproot Grizzy with ease! But Grizzy has not said his last word and manages to get hold of the magic stone.

episodes.title: Ennemis pacifiques
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. During their scuffle, they knock over an army crate which falls into the middle of the bamboo forest surrounding the cabin. Alerted by the noise, a peace missionary panda comes out of the forest and tries to calm down the worked-up adversaries. But will the limitless strategies of Grizzy and the Lemmings get the better of the panda's patience?

episodes.title: La Légende des 7 Lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings create a shadow puppet show where seven papercut lemmings confront a bear over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread. The Lemmings in the audience are super enthusiastic, but Grizzy is outraged by the treatment inflicted upon the bear. He decides to intervene and equips the paper bear with an armor and saber! The Lemmings retort with ninja effigies of themselves and mount an attack to recover the coveted jar of Yummy spread.

episodes.title: Ours et dragons
episodes.description: As Grizzy relaxes in the massage chair, a cloud drifts in front of the sun, immediately stopping the electricity supply in the log cabin. The voltage drops continue, even though the sky seems clear now. Grizzy looks out the window and a dragon appears on the horizon! Once over his initial fright, the bear realizes that it's only a kite flown by the Lemmings – using the electricity from the cabin they have rerouted!

episodes.title: Coup de bambou
episodes.description: Grizzy dismantles the toboggan built by the Lemmings in the log cabin and reemploys the bamboo sticks to build a jacuzzi. When the Lemmings discover the bear's piece of work, they imagine a giant waterpark dominated by an immense waterslide. Anticipating the Lemmings' desire, Grizzy tries to barricade himself inside but the rodents manage to eject him from the cabin. The bear comes back, protected by a super bamboo armor…

episodes.title: Ours dans les nuages
episodes.description: The Lemmings organize a drone race throughout the cabin. Grizzy, who was on the verge of falling asleep, interrupts the competition but must contend with the rodents' reprisals. Thrown out of the cabin, the bear falls onto a temple dedicated to the Monkey King. He appropriates the statue's powers, operating a magic cloud by remote control. Grizzy settles in on the cloud and wins the race before the Lemmings. But a cloud that flies that fast can only arouse lust…

episodes.title: Tactique d'ombrelles
episodes.description: To trick Grizzy's vigilance and steal the TV, the Lemmings, disguised as traditional Chinese dancers, perform a number that leaves the bear flabbergasted. The rodents take advantage of their diversion to carry off the TV set on their airborne craft made of Chinese umbrellas. But before they can escape with their bounty, Grizzy recovers the screen. Ever as determined, the Lemmings come back after upgrading their vessel.

episodes.title: Ni yin ni yang
episodes.description: Annoyed by a noisy high-speed chase between the Lemmings and a raccoon, Grizzy abruptly stops the game. The players fall into empty space and land in a clearing. The impact of their crash-landing cracks a black and white tile representing Yin and Yang and a strange light pours over the raccoon. Depending on his mood, the color of his fur changes, and his excitement or calm become contagious to all those around him!

episodes.title: Ours mécatronique
episodes.description: On the way back from a fishing outing, Grizzy unwittingly brings back an electrode that controls a robot. Once activated, the gadget puts itself in the service of the bear, satisfying his each and every need. The envious Lemmings plot to take possession of this new metallic ally. They manage to evict the bear, who does not intend to take this lying down… especially when he discovers a pair of robotic arms hidden in a module that fell out of the robot!

episodes.title: Tai Chi Lemmings
episodes.description: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on… Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

episodes.title: Cabane d'artifice
episodes.description: At nightfall, just as Grizzy starts to doze off, a racket comes from outside the cabin: the Lemmings are sliding along the Great Wall in a crate, propelled by firework rockets. Cleverly avoiding the bear's strategies to stop them, the Lemmings accidentally set off a mechanism in a tower. A secret room filled with cannons and catapults opens, just waiting to be used by the powder monkey apprentices…

episodes.title: Plongée sauvage
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread in the cabin, and it ends up sinking in the lagoon. The bear makes a diving suit from various home facilities, while the Lemmings share a diving tank to put a wrench in their adversary's flippers! But the local wildlife comes to greet them.

episodes.title: Cocochoco
episodes.description: Grizzy wakes up after a nap, starving, but the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread is empty. The cupboards are barren, except for a package of chocolate powder. Grizzy has the idea of mixing it with coconut milk. It's absolutely delicious! But the Lemmings, who are every bit as gluttonous, want their share of the choco-coco drink!

episodes.title: Pêche ascensionnelle
episodes.description: Grizzy gets a nice big bite on the end of his fishing line. While he concentrates hard to strike his catch, the Lemmings divert the fish to tow them on a kite. Grizzy tries to sabotage their improvised kitesurfing game to recover what's rightfully his, until a shark's fin appears on the horizon!

episodes.title: Piratage à tartiner
episodes.description: The cupboards of the log cabin are hopelessly empty and Grizzy's belly is rumbling. Through his binoculars, he observes the overexcited Lemmings slipping all sorts of small metal objects into the slot of… a Yummy vending machine!?! The bear joins them on the pontoon. If only they could find some coins to make the machine work. Maybe the solution is to find the booty indicated on the treasure map they unearthed on the beach?

episodes.title: Virée en mer
episodes.description: After accidentally breaking his favorite sofa, Grizzy spots a cozy fishing cabin on a neighboring island. He requisitions the Lemmings' canoe to get there but discovers that the new cabin is dilapidated and lacking all comfort. The poor bear had been deluded by a poster. However, a fabulous yacht is moored nearby. It catches both his attention and that of the Lemmings, who have just disembarked on the island!

episodes.title: Lemmings des sables
episodes.description: The Lemmings have fun taking potshots at sand statues depicting Grizzy. Outraged, he catapults them far into the distance. Grizzy takes advantage of their absence to erect a monumental sculpture of himself. But just as he takes a selfie in front of the sculpture, Grizzy realizes that the Lemmings have laid hands on… a pirate cannon!

episodes.title: Coaching pas pacifique
episodes.description: After being hit over the head, the Lemmings become hypnotized by a fitness poster and take themselves for sports coaches. They are determined to forcefully train Grizzy, who would much rather lounge around than do push-ups and squats. But the Lemmings' new personality makes them particularly overbearing.

episodes.title: Ours en eaux troubles
episodes.description: Nothing seems to be biting Grizzy's fishing rod and the bear is in despair. Suddenly he spots a fabulous swordfish swimming in the lagoon. The bear is already licking his chops, when he sees the Lemmings straddling the fish in a rodeo game. From inside the cabin he uses as a mooring post, Grizzy manages to snare the swordfish and is about to pull it in, but the Lemmings are riding it toward the high seas. Each party tugs hard. And the cabin starts to slide…

episodes.title: Ours antisismique
episodes.description: The Lemmings discover that several drops of Tabasco sauce poured into a rock fault releases powerful sprays of steam that propel them high into the sky on a pot lid. Except that the entire volcanic island shudders each time the drops are poured. Grizzy, who has decided to take a nap in his hammock, confiscates the bottle before realizing that the Lemmings have an entire stock !

episodes.title: Esprits de compétition
episodes.description: The Lemmings have decided to organize a race with two sand yachts they found on the beach. The only thing missing, is a worthy adversary. They put Grizzy, who was taking a nap, on one of the yachts without waking him up. And the race is off. Grizzy wakes up in shock onboard his sand yacht.

episodes.title: Crabe à tout faire
episodes.description: Grizzy has run out of ideas to open his coconut until he sees the Lemmings' new friend the crab open one with a simple snip of the claw. He confiscates the crustacean and uses it to take the tops off his coconuts. As they fight over the crab, the characters discover a remote-control device in a secret grotto that operates a giant crab. Grizzy takes over the controls, but the Lemmings want to play with the joystick too!

episodes.title: Épreuve de confort
episodes.description: A helicopter takes off from the beach, leaving behind installations for a TV game, namely lots of food supplies – which are locked up. To access the keys and the food, participants must win team tests under the surveillance of a drone. The Lemmings are the yellow team. The red team is composed of Grizzy, an oar, and a flabbergasted crab!

episodes.title: Cabane hors bord
episodes.description: While trying to avoid the Lemmings' outboard speedboat, Grizzy punctures his air mattress and is propelled into a hidden grotto where he finds a conch decorated with Maori symbols that can control whales. Grizzy returns, proudly straddling his cetacean and chases the Lemmings from his peaceful spot. But the Lemmings' imagination is equal to the size of this potential new playmate!

episodes.title: Surcharge parentale
episodes.description: As they fight over a pot of yummy, Grizzy and the Lemmings come face to face with a crying polar bear cub. Seeing them, he starts screaming even more. Annoyed by the crying, the bear and the rodents try to calm the little one, but nothing helps. After feeding and changing, the baby finally falls asleep ... How do you resume the yummy battle without waking the teddy bear?

episodes.title: Attraction de lemmings
episodes.description: A meteorite falls not far from the hut. While the Lemmings are sledding on a metal cover, their sled is suddenly pulled towards the alien rock. In heaven, the rodents start their slide again with the TV dish. But Grizzy intervenes and tries to bring the antenna back at all costs, confronting the magnetism of the meteorite and drawing the wrath of the Lemmings who have decided to play ...

episodes.title: Domino extrême
episodes.description: The Lemmings have set up a long string of dominoes in the hut, which ends in gigantic blocks of ice and a rocket outside. Tired of not being able to find the calm he hoped for, Grizzy sabotaged the course. The rocket strikes a block of ice which causes, while falling, a blast destroying the hut. Grizzy gets his hands on a machine that can carve ice cream. While the bear dreams of an igloo, the Lemmings have other plans ...

episodes.title: Déglaciation sauvage
episodes.description: The Lemmings notice a block of ice in front of the hut, which contains a frozen animal. This is a prehistoric saber-toothed raccoon. Softened, the Lemmings release him and want to domesticate him like a kitten. But the raccoon, when he plays, is a real tornado. Upon awakening, Grizzy discovers the cabin upside down. He's furious. But the wild raccoon intervenes in front of the bear when the latter wants to dislodge the rodents ...

episodes.title: Lemmings thermiques
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally find a container full of gourds of food. Mainly vegetables, they do not find favor with the eyes of the bear who are interested in high-tech material at the bottom of the crate. Behind her back, the Lemmings, on the other hand, found a gourd of yummy. They run off with it. But how do you escape Grizzy equipped with his sophisticated gear?

episodes.title: Œuf de substitution
episodes.description: In a trunk, Grizzy and the Lemmings find a large chocolate egg that contains a surprise. Everyone licks their chops with envy. In their argument and by accident, they send the coveted egg to a group of neighboring penguins. He is adopted by a pair of birds who begin to brood on him, as if they were his own offspring. Unimpressed, Grizzy and the Lemmings seek to seize it, but the entire bird colony intervenes.

episodes.title: La constellation du Lemming
episodes.description: The Lemmings are setting up a nightclub, with loud music and a mirror ball, in an igloo they have built not far from the cabin. The noise keeps Grizzy from sleeping. The bear confiscates the disco ball and throws the Lemmings away. They land in an ice cave where they discover a console that allows you to light up the stars in the sky and control the Northern Lights ... The sky begins to flash. The Lemmings transform the ice floes into an open-air nightclub!

episodes.title: Tournez lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings have improvised a funfair-worthy attraction in the living room. Awake, Grizzy throws their centrifuge out and the Lemmings land in the nearby science station and accidentally wakes up… a mammoth! A bond is born between them and the Lemmings involve the mastodon in their game. This new giant friend makes it possible to transform the entire cabin into a big wheel. Grizzy, who wanted to sleep peacefully, wakes up in panic ...

episodes.title: Super star polaire
episodes.description: Facing an audience of penguins and walruses, the Lemmings put on a show of acrobatic high jumps. Two Lemmings teams compete for the winner's award. By accident, Grizzy participates, but quickly gets caught up in the game, causing the applause to explode! Intoxicated by his victory, the bear has no modest success! But the Lemmings also want their place on the front of the stage!

episodes.title: Mon ami le pingouin
episodes.description: While Grizzy is fishing, a penguin approaches and finds that his bucket is empty. He decides to help him and brings him many fish. The bear, impressed, brings him back to the cabin and quickly a bond develops between the two. This pleasant and friendly new companion arouses the curiosity of Lemmings. They attract the penguin and replace it with a slightly beta one, behind Grizzy's back, who will quickly notice the deception.

episodes.title: Choc thermique !
episodes.description: Grizzy settles down on the couch by the fire, when the Lemmings tumble into the middle of the living room riding a makeshift mount with the vacuum cleaner. Irritated, the bear throws their mechanical steed into the exploding chimney. Freezing cold enters the cabin. Seeking warmth, Grizzy decides to move into the greenhouse at the nearby science station, which is air-conditioned by a drone. But the bear doesn't know he's bringing in his luggage ... the Lemmings!

episodes.title: Activités primitives
episodes.description: The Lemmings have found a new playmate: a walrus! Rodents ride it across the entire hut and then slide it onto the roof, before starting over. Grizzy intervenes and manages to eject the animal to the bottom of a mysterious ice cave. In its center, a dolmen on which is a bone. Anyone who touches it is made docile and its appearance becomes prehistoric. The Lemmings hatch a plan in which Grizzy would bend to their will ...

episodes.title: Cabane sur glace
episodes.description: Grizzy is fishing. The lemmings are making an ice ride inside and outside the cabin. Grizzy catches a fish but it fell onto the ride. He sees it and threw hot chilli pepper into their mouth which caused the ride to melt. But the lemmings have another plan...

episodes.title: Retour de l'être aimé
episodes.description: Grizzy steals a magical figurine from the lemmings that has the power to make objects appear in real life. Just pin the photo of your wishes on it.

episodes.title: Minis ennuis
episodes.description: The Lemmings discover a magical tool that can make things and people smaller. Are you curious to see how they will use it?

episodes.title: Pour des cacahuètes
episodes.description: The Lemmings animate an elephant with peanuts and play with it. Grizzy, who wants to snack on peanuts and realizes this, manages to buy peanuts from Lemmings and peanuts become valuable.

episodes.title: À portée de groin
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a pack of crunch. The crunches fall to the ground and just then a pig enters the cabin and eats the whole package. The pig sniffs and goes to another food source. Grizzy and the Lemmings realize he's a sniffer and decide to follow him.

episodes.title: Safari Express
episodes.description: To win a trophy full of yummy candies, Grizzy and the lemmings enter a photo contest with safari in an animal reserve.

episodes.title: Faux fils
episodes.description: A goose mistook the Lemmings for cubs because of a zorbing ball covered in sand. The Lemmings think about what can be done with the goose and they try.

episodes.title: Le trône de pierre
episodes.description: Grizzy and the lemmings are ejected from the hut and land on a small hill nearby, where they find a golden throne. Whoever sits on it will be the king.

episodes.title: Tam-Tam Lemming
episodes.description: The lemmings find a magic drum. Everyone who hears it can't stop dancing!

episodes.title: Complètement givré !
episodes.description: In the middle of a heatwave, Grizzy and the lemmings are fighting over the refrigerator. Grizzy wants to sleep in the cool, while the lemmings prefer to use it to slide around in the cabin...

episodes.title: Dans tes rêves
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a historical helmet where you can control dreams any way you want. Grizzy realizes this and wants to try.

episodes.title: Cabane supervoltaïque
episodes.description: Grizzy watches a documentary, but the lemmings want to dance in the garage, nightclub style. TV versus music, the energy war has begun!

episodes.title: Jelly Lemmings
episodes.description: Grizzy stumbles on a trunk that can magically combine the qualities of whatever goes inside it, and decides to transform... himself!
The Lemmings discover that gelatin desserts make a beautifully bouncy surface to play on, but Grizzy would rather enjoy them as a snack.

episodes.title: Lancer de Lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings happen upon a bracelet that increases the strength of its wearer.

episodes.title: FrankenGrizzy
episodes.description: Grizzy unwittingly brings to life some medieval armour.

episodes.title: Lemming sur toile
episodes.description: The Lemmings have fun painting themselves alongside the noblemen on paintings.

episodes.title: Désaccord musical
episodes.description: The Lemmings meet a parrot that can identically reproduce any sound.

episodes.title: Un Ours Dans La Bergerie
episodes.description: Grizzy puts a stop to the Lemmings' furious rodeo game on a sheep. Annoyed, they decide to banish the bear to the bottom of the castle dungeons while he's taking a nap. In his prison, Grizzy finds a magic shepherd's crook.

episodes.title: La communauté de la Jelly
episodes.description: The jelly cake battle takes on epic dimensions into a 'heroic fantasy' world!

episodes.title: Mouton de compagnie
episodes.description: The Lemmings disguise themselves outside the castle and take polaroid snapshots of themselves.

episodes.title: Joutes Moutons
episodes.description: Grizzy is pulled from his dreams by the noise made by the Lemmings, perched on sheep, and who oppose each other in jousting. The cunning bear gets rid of rodents by driving their mounts away with food. Angered, the Lemmings hatch a plan to keep the bear away from the castle during his nap and keep him from coming back. Furious at being thus banished, the bear, armed with a catapult, prepares to retaliate...

episodes.title: Esprits gourmands
episodes.description: Grizzy pursues the Lemmings throughout the castle to recover the jelly cake they stole from him.

episodes.title: Foire aux bouquins
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a giant jelly cake and discover a secret passage.

episodes.title: Cabane pas commode
episodes.description: Grizzy chases the Lemmings throughout the castle to swipe the delicious jelly cake they were about to eat. He locks them inside a closet and makes off with the dessert. In the closet, the rodents discover a card to teleport.

episodes.title: L'ours, la grenouille et le moustique
episodes.description: The Lemmings have fun bouncing on the backs of green frogs while Grizzy hunts mosquitoes.

episodes.title: Battle musicale
episodes.description: Grizzy comes home and discovers the Lemmings dancing.

episodes.title: Décalage solaire
episodes.description: The Lemmings make an obstacle course.

episodes.title: Lemmings tiltés
episodes.description: The Lemmings have got their hands on an old pinball machine which they are installing in the cabin. Their frenzied game interrupts Grizzy's nap, which threatens to break the machine. The bear gets locked in the garage by the rodents, but he finds a way to escape and get rid of the game and all of its players. Dropped into the jungle, the Lemmings stumble upon a rubber tree. By discovering its rebounding power, they have the idea of making a giant pinball machine in the middle of the trees...

episodes.title: Conflit de générations
episodes.description: During a fight, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a Mayan temple in the middle of the jungle. Inside, they trigger a magical reaction that causes duplicates of themselves to appear at a different age: a child Grizzy and old Lemmings. Grizzy tries to interest the young bear in the salmon documentary, while the Lemmings want to introduce their ancestors to the dance. But the age difference is heavily felt...

episodes.title: Casse-tête aztèque
episodes.description: The Lemmings take off with the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread. Grizzy catches up with them, but they drop the jar, and it lands in a nearby sacred temple. While trying to get inside, they accidentally activate a mechanism.

episodes.title: Catch canap'
episodes.description: The Lemmings organize wrestling combats on the living room couch. Grizzy, weary of the clamor, stops the match. The displeased Lemmings retaliate, but during their fight the cabin's wood floor caves in.

episodes.title: Ruée vers l'or
episodes.description: After a spat over a jar of Yummy, Grizzy and the Lemmings find gold leaf-wrapped chocolate bits scattered in the jungle. Delicious! On the backs of a bat and a tapir, the rodents and the bear fight over the harvest of candy.

episodes.title: Vol à réaction
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the last spoonful of Yummy. Their brawl is interrupted when they happen upon a full crate of chocolate spread in the garage. The rodents snatch the crate and take off on a drone.

episodes.title: Lucioles à haute tension
episodes.description: At night, the solar panels do power Grizzy's TV.

episodes.title: Crâne de discorde
episodes.description: After stealing Grizzy's jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the Lemmings propel the bear far from the log cabin. Grizzy lands in a temple where he finds a crystal skull which gives you the power to sow discord within a group.

episodes.title: Star of the Day
episodes.description: As he climbs up to the cabin, arms full of succulent berries, Grizzy stumbles, trips, and falls. But against all odds, he pulls off a series of moves worthy of a champion diver and miraculously comes out unscathed. The Lemmings, amazed by the feat, begin to worship him like a true star. Flattered by his newfound fame, Grizzy indulges in the royal treatment. But the Lemmings soon ask him to repeat the jump — this time, from even higher! How can he possibly do it again, when the first time was a complete fluke? He can’t bring himself to tell them the truth, especially after taking advantage of their gullibility.

episodes.title: Diabolical Labyrinth
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings end up lost after misplacing their jar of Yummy in a labyrinth.

episodes.title: Cosy Nest
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings are victims of inexplicable thefts.

episodes.title: Strong Will
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings use a frog with hypnotising powers .

episodes.title: Desired Orientation
episodes.description: Grizzy finds a compass that indicates the direction of one's own desires.

episodes.title: 24-Carat Chocolate
episodes.description: Grizzy finds a sceptre that covers anything it touches in gold.

episodes.title: Jungle Rhythm
episodes.description: The Lemmings organise a dance contest, and the first prize is a jar of Yummy.

episodes.title: The Grizming
episodes.description: A block containing Grizzy and the Lemmings' ancestors cracks during their fight.

episodes.title: For Real
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a strange card game.

episodes.title: Cocoa Tree Spread
episodes.description: The Lemmings discover a tree with chocolate spread sap!

episodes.title: Wild Mutations
episodes.description: The Lemmings get a magical Mayan disc that transforms them into mutants.

episodes.title: Every Which Way
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight for the last jar of Yummy with magic Mayan bracelets.

episodes.title: Cabin in the Moon
episodes.description: While playing in Mayan Temple, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon.

episodes.title: Grizzy Academy
episodes.description: Grizzy decides to teach the Lemmings how to behave in his presence.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.description: The Lemmings and Grizzy collide with Santa's sled while fighting.

episodes.title: Programme On Demand
episodes.description: Grizzy confiscates the remote control device, but the Lemmings find another one.

episodes.title: Frosty Cup
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings get into super-fast snowmobiles and launch into a race.

episodes.title: Choco Granito
episodes.description: The Lemmings consider that Grizzy stole their Granita recipe!

episodes.title: Quick Meal
episodes.description: Grizzy discovers a special lamp that can compact organic elements.

episodes.title: Digital Taming
episodes.description: The extraordinary animals from a tablet game come to life after the device explodes.

episodes.title: Evil Spirit
episodes.description: The Lemmings decide to free a spirit and send it to Grizzy.

episodes.title: Sounds and Visions
episodes.description: The Lemmings find an ultra-modern glowing cabin they can use for their party.

episodes.title: Iced Grizzy
episodes.description: The Lemmings try to destroy the statues of Grizzy, but he will not let them ruin his art.

episodes.title: Yummy Indigestion
episodes.description: A container full of Yummy? What a dream for Grizzy and the Lemmings.

episodes.title: Yeti Cabin
episodes.description: After the Yeti's house destruction by Grizzy, the Lemmings bring him to Grizzy.

episodes.title: Nutty Family
episodes.description: Grizzy decides to adopt a coconut.

episodes.title: Imaginary Invalid
episodes.description: Grizzy pretends to have a twisted ankle so that the Lemmings have to take care of him.

episodes.title: Winning Tokens
episodes.description: The Lemmings set up a mini fair, but Grizzy steals the Lemmings' tickets .

episodes.title: Game of Marbles
episodes.description: The Lemmings play marbles, and it's driving Frizzy crazy.

episodes.title: Five-Star Bowl
episodes.description: Grizzy exchanges his indifferent fish with the Lemmings' affectionate and lively fish.

episodes.title: Lost Object
episodes.description: The Lemmings use cans and tins to build a beach slide, which annoys Grizzy.

episodes.title: Crab Crush
episodes.description: The Lemmings turn into crab rescuers, but soon the house is full of them!

episodes.title: Pirates in Sight
episodes.description: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat.

episodes.title: Crab Basket
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a school of crabs that live in an underwater city.

episodes.title: Grizzy's Odyssey
episodes.description: It seems an epic battle took place in the cabin, and Grizzy is missing.

episodes.title: Flying Sands
episodes.description: Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts, but the Lemmings find a magic conch.

episodes.title: Symphony for Lemmings
episodes.description: Grizzy wants to watch TV, but the Lemmings want to have fun playing music.

episodes.title: Interplanetary Cabin
episodes.description: A rocket carries the cabin into space.

episodes.title: Ready, Set, Bam!
episodes.description: It's time for the racket game, where big scores mean big prizes.

episodes.title: Termitator
episodes.description: The Lemmings adopt a cute insect that eats wood. And what's made of wood? The cabin!

episodes.title: Dad Despite Himself
episodes.description: The Lemmings play with a baby ostrich that Grizzy found outside.

episodes.title: Illuminated Lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings are throwing a big birthday party, but Grizzy is not in the mood.

episodes.title: Hide-and-Seek Lemmings
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings decide to play hide-and-seek in the Svannah.

episodes.title: Nocturnal Din
episodes.description: The Lemmings organized a mega-party, leading to the cabin being invaded by bats.

episodes.title: A Love for Fridges
episodes.description: The Lemmings activate the air conditioner's AI, causing it to fall in love with the fridge.

episodes.title: Bear Family
episodes.description: Grizzy finds a polar bear and realizes they are from the same species.

episodes.title: The Ten Plagues of Grizzy
episodes.description: The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree that casts curses.

episodes.title: Sandbox Games
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a futuristic underground site.

episodes.title: Chocolate Deposit
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a magic stick that functions as a Yummy divining rod.

episodes.title: Firefly Party
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a jewel that gives them total control over fireflies.

episodes.title: Keyring Cabin
episodes.description: The Lemmings' magic keyring has the incredible power to miniaturize any object.

episodes.title: Great Wall Disco
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a hidden mechanism on the Great Wall of China.

episodes.title: Choco-Noodles
episodes.description: Grizzy creates a new Yummy-based recipe: Choco-noodles.

episodes.title: Tough Cookie
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a temple dedicated to an ancestral brioche.

episodes.title: Artificial Intelligence, Natural Idiocy
episodes.description: An AI accidentally connects to Grizzy’s stuffed teddy bear, which comes to life.

episodes.title: All Out for Silk
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a silkworm.

episodes.title: Hello Grizzy? Here Lemmings
episodes.description: The Lemmings use all the electricity for their phones - now Grizzy can’t watch TV.

episodes.title: Grasshopper Bounty
episodes.description: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires.

episodes.title: Sound and Light
episodes.description: The Lemmings use magic Chinese lanterns for sound and light shows.

episodes.title: Hero Despite Himself
episodes.description: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console, and Grizzy is transported into the game.

episodes.title: Mask Time
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a mask that terrifies anyone who looks at it.

episodes.title: Drawer Puzzles
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings crack the codex system of a mysterious box and are sucked into it.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.description: Grizzy finds a giant home cinema screen.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday, Grizzy!
episodes.description: Grizzy wants a peaceful day for his birthday, but the Lemmings have other plans.

episodes.title: The War of the Lambs
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a strange machine capable of duplicating things.

episodes.title: Ultra Wool
episodes.description: The Lemmings have fun jumping on a sheep, until Grizzy gets accidentally shaved.

episodes.title: Lemming Hoods
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a book on Robi Hood and get inspired to steal Grizzy.

episodes.title: Good Fairy, Bad Fairy
episodes.description: Transformed into a fairy, a lemming organises a magic show and gets rid of Grizzy.

episodes.title: Odd Twists
episodes.description: Grizzy finds a glove that can stop the Lemmings' magic stone balls.

episodes.title: The Battle of the Sacred Crown
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings are fighting over a crown.

episodes.title: Were-Lemming
episodes.description: A Lemming touches a magic tooth and transforms into a creature.

episodes.title: Hold-Up, Hens and Yummy
episodes.description: Grizzy uses a hen to protect some Yummy jars from the Lemmings.

episodes.title: Ever Higher
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of jelly that gets stuck in a high-up spot.

episodes.title: Witchcraft Game
episodes.description: Grizzy and the Lemmings play a game: It's the Lemming Knights vs the Bear Magician

episodes.title: Monstrous Costumes
episodes.description: The Lemmings find a magic hat that can transform them to match their costumes.

episodes.title: The Crime was Almost Yummy
episodes.description: Grizzy's sample of yummy is mysteriously crushed - but who is the culprit?

episodes.title: Cabin, My Love
episodes.description: The lemmings find a heart-shaped jewel that brings to life whatever it's attached to. A series of twists and turns catapults it onto a wall of the cabin, which comes to life! Grizzy and the Lemmings realize all the misfortunes it's been through. The now-living cabin can't wait to go back to Canada... without Grizzy and the Lemmings!

episodes.title: The DVD
episodes.description: Gumball is desperate to avoid a late fee on the rented dvd he accidentally destroyed.

episodes.title: The Responsible
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin get to babysit Anais whilst their parents go to a PTA meeting, but being "responsible" has a different meaning when you don't know what it means.

episodes.title: The Third
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin grow bored of one another and seek out a third friend to make their lives more exciting.

episodes.title: The Debt
episodes.description: Believing that his life had been saved, Gumball vows to repay his debt by saving Mr. Robinson's life.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin, thinking that the world will end in 24 hours, decide to make the most out of their remaining time.

episodes.title: The Dress
episodes.description: When his clothes are shrunk in the washing machine by his father, Gumball is forced to wear his mother's wedding dress to school.

episodes.title: The Quest
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin help Anais get her beloved doll back after it is lost on the way to school.

episodes.title: The Spoon
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin become unwitting accomplices in a stick-up at a gas station.

episodes.title: The Pressure
episodes.description: When Masami claims that Darwin is her boyfriend, Gumball vows to help his friend before he gets kissed.

episodes.title: The Painting
episodes.description: After seeing a picture that Anais drew, Principal Brown assumes that Anais finds her family dysfunctional, so he begins to meddle in their family life.

episodes.title: The Laziest
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin challenge their father to a laziness competition, with the loser having to do the winner's chores.

episodes.title: The Ghost
episodes.description: When a ghost named Carrie possesses Gumball's body in order to feel earthly experiences and to eat, he must learn to say "no" to her.

episodes.title: The Mystery
episodes.description: Gumball decides to investigate when his class finds Principal Brown wrapped up in toilet paper, shaved and, covered in green paint, or else face detention.

episodes.title: The Prank
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin's pranks on their father get out of hand.

episodes.title: The Gi
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are ridiculed for their martial-arts outfits by their schoolmates, and their mom tries to convince them to take them off.

episodes.title: The Kiss
episodes.description: A kiss from Grandma JoJo traumatizes Gumball, and Darwin attempts to help him forget.

episodes.title: The Party
episodes.description: Gumball and his friends are invited to a high-school party hosted by Tobias's sister Rachel, but they must find dates in order to attend.

episodes.title: The Refund
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin go to great lengths to get their money back from an incompatible video game, but the rental store's policy prevents them from getting it.

episodes.title: The Robot
episodes.description: Gumball decides to help Bobert act like a real boy. However, it soon becomes a battle for his very identity when the robot plots to take over his life.

episodes.title: The Picnic
episodes.description: During a school field trip, Gumball and Darwin ignore their teacher's warning to go around a dangerous forest and, instead, traverse through it. Hopelessly lost, they must use what very little survival skills they have to escape.

episodes.title: The Goons
episodes.description: Anais tries to "dumb down" in order to have fun with her brothers and father. Gumball, feeling left out, sets up a race in order to win Dad back (and avoid quality time with his mother).

episodes.title: The Secret
episodes.description: Gumball tries desperately to find out Darwin's secret.

episodes.title: The Sock
episodes.description: Mr. Small teaches Gumball and Darwin various ways of becoming more honest.

episodes.title: The Genius
episodes.description: Darwin goes to an institute for geniuses.

episodes.title: The Poltergeist
episodes.description: Richard believes there's a ghost in the attic, but it is actually Mr. Robinson, who Gumball moved up there after he entered a catatonic state due to being kicked out by his wife. Gumball and Darwin work on trying to restore Mr. Robinson whilst Richard, unaware of this, sets traps for the ghost.

episodes.title: The Mustache
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin want to become adults and Richard wants to lose weight. After accidentally having their cereal switched with supplements Richard ordered, Gumball, Darwin and Anais find themselves having very unusual growth spurts.

episodes.title: The Date
episodes.description: Gumball learns how to date so he can go out on a date with Penny. Later on it turns out that he is going to a funeral not a date.

episodes.title: The Club
episodes.description: When Gumball turns down an offer to join the Rejects Club, they seek to enact revenge against him.

episodes.title: The Wand
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin share the power of magic with Richard.

episodes.title: The Ape
episodes.description: Ms. Simian cozies up to Gumball in order to win an award.

episodes.title: The Car
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are eager enough to do numerous chores at Mr. Robinson's house, until they accidentally destroy his car.

episodes.title: The Curse
episodes.description: Gumball's good day turns bad to worse throughout his school day, much to the point where he believes he is "cursed".

episodes.title: The Microwave
episodes.description: Gumball creates a creature, made of every gross thing he could find. The creature proceeds to go on a rampage throughout Elmore.

episodes.title: The Meddler
episodes.description: Seeing Gumball in need of attention, Nicole hangs out with him at school, which becomes increasingly embarrassing for her son.

episodes.title: The Helmet
episodes.description: Gumball wears a lucky helmet, but it tears his family apart.

episodes.title: The Fight
episodes.description: After Gumball's bullying problem, Tina Rex demands to have a fight with him.

episodes.title: The Remote
episodes.description: The Watterson family fights over the remote when they realize everything they want to watch comes on at the same time.

episodes.title: The Colossus
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin upset a giant.

episodes.title: The Knights
episodes.description: Gumball and Tobias compete for Penny's affection by putting on the lamest duel in history.

episodes.title: The Fridge
episodes.description: Mom tries to inspire Gumball to develop ambition.

episodes.title: The Flower
episodes.description: Gumball is jealous when he sees Leslie with Penny.

episodes.title: The Banana
episodes.description: Gumball seeks justice when Banana Joe chews Darwin's pen.

episodes.title: The Phone
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin get their first cell phone, and Darwin develops a texting addiction.

episodes.title: The Job
episodes.description: Richard gets a job as a pizza delivery man, which worries Nicole when strange things begin to occur around the neighborhood.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.description: Carrie takes Gumball, Darwin and Anais to a haunted house party.

episodes.title: The Treasure
episodes.description: Anais uncovers a secret that she thinks will lead her to a treasure.

episodes.title: The Apology
episodes.description: Ms. Simian owes Gumball an apology.

episodes.title: The Words
episodes.description: Gumball tries to teach Darwin to be more direct with mixed results.

episodes.title: The Skull
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin befriend a compulsive liar.

episodes.title: The Bet
episodes.description: Bobert becomes Gumball's servant and obeys every command he receives.

episodes.title: Christmas
episodes.description: Santa Claus is coming to town. Unfortunately he gets run over by the Wattersons, so it's up to them to save Christmas.

episodes.title: The Watch
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to retrieve a family heirloom from an old man.

episodes.title: The Bumpkin
episodes.description: Gumball envies rural life and asks Idaho to teach his family to live like potatoes.

episodes.title: The Flakers
episodes.description: Darwin abandons Gumball when faced with a beating by Tina, so Gumball plots revenge.

episodes.title: The Authority
episodes.description: After Richard is hospitalized from an accident, Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger, which leads Nicole to disagree with her parenting style.

episodes.title: The Virus
episodes.description: An evil virus seeks vengeance on Gumball, Darwin, and Teri after they wipe out his army of bacteria.

episodes.title: The Pony
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin rent a film to watch with Anais, but they keep getting distracted on their way home.

episodes.title: The Hero
episodes.description: Richard gets upset when he realizes Gumball and Darwin think of him as a laughing stock.

episodes.title: The Dream
episodes.description: Darwin kisses Penny in one of Gumball's dreams and he gets mad about it.

episodes.title: The Sidekick
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to get a game back from Tobias, but Darwin begins to feel like he is just a sidekick to Gumball.

episodes.title: The Photo
episodes.description: Gumball tries and fails to look good in the school photos.

episodes.title: The Tag
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin get caught in the middle of a trash can feud between Richard and Mr. Robinson.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.description: A plot to improve Alan and Carmen's relationship backfires, and Gumball has to reunite them.

episodes.title: The Lesson
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin cheat on their math test, they get detention from Principal Brown, and have to escape.

episodes.title: The Game
episodes.description: The Wattersons are carried away by "Dodj or Daar,'' a game invented by the boys.

episodes.title: The Limit
episodes.description: Nicole gets upset with the family at the supermarket.

episodes.title: The Voice
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin receive a scary email, everyone is a suspect... including themselves!

episodes.title: The Promise
episodes.description: Darwin has promised to play video games with Gumball, but there is a Banana Joe-shaped problem...

episodes.title: The Castle
episodes.description: Richard takes charge of the house in Nicole's absence, but his lack of rules soon attracts unwelcome guests.

episodes.title: The Boombox
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to understand Juke's urgent beatbox message.

episodes.title: The Tape
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin fail to make instant home movie classics.

episodes.title: The Sweaters
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin's reputation is challenged and they really couldn't care less...

episodes.title: The Internet
episodes.description: After accidentally creating an embarrassing viral video, Gumball is determined to take down the Internet.

episodes.title: The Plan
episodes.description: The Watterson kids come up with a fool-proof plan to save Nicole, but is it Gumball-proof?

episodes.title: The World
