episodes.description: The life of the "inanimate" objects of Elmore are shown in a series of short skits.

episodes.title: The Finale
episodes.description: The Wattersons are surprised to discover that their past actions have consequences.

episodes.title: The Kids
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin's voices start to break.

episodes.title: The Fan
episodes.description: New Elmore Junior High student Sarah becomes Gumball and Darwin's obsessive number-one fan.

episodes.title: The Coach
episodes.description: The new coach at Elmore Junior High stands up to Jamie.

episodes.title: The Joy
episodes.description: Miss Simian has to save herself from a contagious Joy virus infecting Elmore Junior High.

episodes.title: The Puppy
episodes.description: The Watterson children's long-awaited pet puppy turns out to be a turtle which hates them.

episodes.title: The Recipe
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin discover the secret behind their classmate Anton's immortality.

episodes.title: The Name
episodes.description: Gumball learns his real name.

episodes.title: The Extras
episodes.description: Skits about the random extra characters seen throughout the series.

episodes.title: The Gripes
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin begin to complain about every little thing in their lives, the people of Elmore City mistakenly assumes charity cases and put together a benefit to raise money for them, leaving them having to fix the mix-up.

episodes.title: The Vacation
episodes.description: While driving to a campground, Nicole tells a horror story, which slowly starts to come true as their car breaks down and a stranger comes to help them out.

episodes.title: The Fraud
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin discover Principal Brown's diploma is a fake.

episodes.title: The Void
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin investigate a missing classmate, they discover a far greater mystery....about Elmore.

episodes.title: The Boss
episodes.description: Mr. Robertson has a stress attack and needs a  stuffing transfusion from his son Rocky the janitor. He won't take it unless Rocky gets a better job in life. Rocky gets one with Chanax, where he becomes a work drone. Gumball and Darwin now need to get Rocky's soul back from his boss in order to get him to surgery.

episodes.title: The Move
episodes.description: Clayton may be a liar, but Gumball discovers he wasn't lying about his awesome martial arts move.

episodes.title: The Law
episodes.description: The Doughnut Sheriff shows Gumball and Darwin that the smallest misdemeanor can lead to a breakdown in law.

episodes.title: The Allergy
episodes.description: Gumball needs to find a cure for Darwin's allergy before he sneezes Elmore off the map.

episodes.title: The Mothers
episodes.description: It's Mother's Day and kids put their moms through a series of tests to determine who has the World's Greatest Mom.

episodes.title: The Password
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are shocked to discover that Anais is Dad's favorite child.

episodes.title: The Procrastinators
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin spend the day doing other things instead of taking out the trash like their mother told them to do before she got back home.

episodes.title: The Shell
episodes.description: Gumball inadvertently cracks open Penny's shell, and discovers who she really is inside...

episodes.title: The Burden
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are left in charge of the class pet hamster, but they end up leaving it at school over the weekend.

episodes.title: The Bros
episodes.description: Darwin becomes jealous of Gumball and Penny's new relationship and sets out to find information that will break them up.

episodes.title: The Mirror
episodes.description: Gumball refuses to forward an e-mail purportedly sent by a ghost, against Darwin's advice. When a curse begins to take effect and their family is dragged into another dimension, Gumball and Darwin seek Carrie's help to save them.

episodes.title: The Man
episodes.description: After Granny Jojo brings her new boyfriend to dinner at the Watterson household, Richard forbids her from seeing the boyfriend again.

episodes.title: The Pizza
episodes.description: The Wattersons have had a bad day, but it turns out Larry has too and it's about to get worse . . . for everyone!

episodes.title: The Lie
episodes.description: Noticing that everyone is in the doldrums of January, Gumball and Anais invent a new holiday to spark excitement.

episodes.title: The Butterfly
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin let loose a butterfly from a jar, causing all sorts of chaos throughout the town.

episodes.title: The Question
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to figure out the meaning of life after coming down from a sugar rush.

episodes.title: The Saint
episodes.description: Gumball tries his hardest to get Alan angry to prove Alan is just like everyone else.

episodes.title: The Friend
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin help Anais make up an imaginary friend who turns out to be all too real.

episodes.title: The Oracle
episodes.description: After discovering a prophetic painting depicting Gumball's naked run through the mall, he is determined to avoid that outcome.

episodes.title: The Safety
episodes.description: Darwin becomes obsessed with safety after seeing a video in class.

episodes.title: The Society
episodes.description: When Gumball learns the school has a secret society, he is determined, and irritating, to become a part of it.

episodes.title: The Spoiler
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin have to wait to see a movie, they must go an entire week without someone spoiling the plot.

episodes.title: The Countdown
episodes.description: Miss Simian threatens to expel the boys if they are late for school, so they race a clock in order to arrive on time.

episodes.title: The Nobody
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin investigate the disappearance  of the family's stuff only to find out some stranger is living in the house with them.

episodes.title: The Downer
episodes.description: When Gumball's family tries to cheer him out of an inexplicable lousy mood, he wishes they would all disappear

episodes.title: The Egg
episodes.description: When Nicole arranges a playdate for Anais with a classy family, the Wattersons try desperately to impress them.

episodes.title: The Triangle
episodes.description: Gumball grows jealous of Darwin's new talent.

episodes.title: The Money
episodes.description: The Wattersons become poor when Richard loses all their money.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.description: Richard tries to find the kids before Nicole realizes they're gone.

episodes.title: The Nemesis
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin discover that Rob, who once swore to wreak vengeance on them, has been trying to destroy them for some time… but his traps never work.

episodes.title: The Crew
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin decide it's time they join a crew, they agree that the coolest posse in Elmore is the Senior Citizens. They do everything they can to fit in with them, going to extraordinary lengths to prove themselves worthy of running (well, walking very slowly) with them.

episodes.title: The Others
episodes.description: When Anais reveals that she's in the grade above them at school, Gumball and Darwin's eyes are suddenly opened to a whole new world of other students at Elmore Junior High. Gumball is horrified to learn that there are a bunch of characters who are barely aware of his existence and is determined to force his way into their lives.

episodes.title: The Signature
episodes.description: Dad discovers that Granny Jojo and Louie are planning to get married and move to Florida. To stop this happening he adopts Louie so that he can forbid him from marrying Granny Jojo. But this triggers a series of adoptions within the family which quickly spirals out of control, and causes the unexpected return of someone from Dad's past

episodes.title: The Check
episodes.description: The kids get a check from Grandpa Louie and argue about how to spend the money.

episodes.title: The Pest
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin help Anais deal with a classmate who is bothering her.

episodes.title: The Sale
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are devastated to learn that Mr. Robinson is selling his house and leaving town.

episodes.title: The Gift
episodes.description: After the receive an extravagant invite to Masami's birthday party, Gumball and Darwin are anxious to find just the right gift for her.

episodes.title: The Parking
episodes.description: The Wattersons struggle to find a space in the mall parking lot.

episodes.title: The Routine
episodes.description: Richard goes to the store to buy mayonnaise, but this task turns into an epic adventure.

episodes.title: The Upgrade
episodes.description: Bobert gets updated software, but finds a few problems with it.

episodes.title: The Comic
episodes.description: Gumball is the star of his own comic, but struggles to match up to his heroic alter ego.

episodes.title: The Romantic
episodes.description: Gumball tries to woo Penny with romantic gestures.

episodes.title: The Uploads
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to tear themselves away from the internet, but end up falling down the Elmore Stream-hole.

episodes.title: The Apprentice
episodes.description: Gumball decides that the best way to prove to Mr. Fitzgerald that he's good enough for Penny is to become his apprentice for the day.

episodes.title: The Hug
episodes.description: When Darwin taunts Gumball about how predictable he is, Gumball tries to prove that he can still surprise his buddy.

episodes.title: The Wicked
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to find a single nice quality about their neighbor, Mrs. Robinson.

episodes.title: The Traitor
episodes.description: Gumball calls Alan a traitor when Gumball thinks Alan lied to get out of having dinner together.

episodes.title: The Origins Part One
episodes.description:
When Mom and Dad struggle to keep hyperactive, toddler-aged Gumball from trashing the house and exhausting them, they decide to buy him a pet. It works, but there’s a problem: every goldfish they get him is short-lived, and inevitably ends up being flushed down the toilet. However, when Dad buys a talking goldfish from a mysterious shop, Gumball meets the best friend he’ll ever have. Having been accidentally flushed down the toilet, Darwin has to find his way back to his new family.

Via the sewers, Darwin finds himself flushed out to sea. He is terrified, but determined to make his way back to the Wattersons. However, a fish can’t get very far on land, so Darwin will have to do millions of years of evolution in a matter of hours if he’s going to get home safe and sound.

episodes.description:
When Mom and Dad struggle to keep hyperactive, toddler-aged Gumball from trashing the house and exhausting them, they decide to buy him a pet. It works, but there’s a problem: every goldfish they get him is short-lived, and inevitably ends up being flushed down the toilet. However, when Dad buys a talking goldfish from a mysterious shop, Gumball meets the best friend he’ll ever have. Having been accidentally flushed down the toilet, Darwin has to find his way back to his new family.

Via the sewers, Darwin finds himself flushed out to sea. He is terrified, but determined to make his way back to the Wattersons. However, a fish can’t get very far on land, so Darwin will have to do millions of years of evolution in a matter of hours if he’s going to get home safe and sound.

episodes.title: The Girlfriend
episodes.description: Jamie decides to make Darwin her boyfriend.

episodes.title: The Advice
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin take Mr. Small's advice out of pity and it causes destruction throughout the school.

episodes.title: The Signal
episodes.description: Mysterious interruptions plaguing Elmore cause a strain between Gumball and Darwin, while Richard tearfully has to part with his television set when he can't fix it.

episodes.title: The Parasite
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin fear that Anais is being taken advantage of by a friend...

episodes.title: The Love
episodes.description: After Bobert the robot confesses to Gumball and Darwin that he's fallen in love, a musical number and series of vignettes illustrate what love is and how the people of Elmore express it.

episodes.title: The Awkwardness
episodes.description: A simple run to the store for ketchup leads Gumball to once again encounter The Hot Dog Guy (from "The Hug") and try to get away from him.

episodes.title: The Nest
episodes.description: A neighbor disappears and the Wattersons investigate, but discover the culprit may be their Evil Turtle.

episodes.title: The Points
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin offer to do chores for Tobias to earn bonus points for a video game.

episodes.title: The Bus
episodes.description: Rocky convinces the kids on the bus that they don't have to go to school, little do the kids know that Rocky as well as some other adults are trying to teach them a lesson about skipping school.

episodes.title: The Night
episodes.description: The Moon examines dreams of Elmore residents.

episodes.title: The Misunderstandings
episodes.description: Gumball has a misunderstanding with Penny about a date.

episodes.title: The Roots
episodes.description: Thinking that he is homesick for the sea, the family try to make Darwin connect with his roots.

episodes.title: The Blame
episodes.description: Billy passes out after playing video games and his mother tries to ban them, forcing Gumball and Darwin to defend them.

episodes.title: The Slap
episodes.description: Gumball feels left out when Tobias doesn't greet him with his special high five slap.

episodes.title: The Detective
episodes.description: Anais believes Gumball and Darwin have stolen Daisy, so she sets out to find them.

episodes.title: The Fury
episodes.description: A strange figure arrives and insults Nicole, but the kids are surprised when Nicole doesn't fight back.

episodes.title: The Compilation
episodes.description: Odd internet clips are recalled by the people of Elmore.

episodes.title: The Disaster (Part 1)
episodes.description: When Rob purchases a universal remote from the Awesome Store, he discovers can control the entire universe. He rewinds into the past and remembersGumball had left him in The Void, leaving him scarred and in his current mutated shape. He uses the universal remote to destroy Gumball's life, whilst Gumball has to figure out what's going on before he's ejected once and for all.

episodes.title: The Disaster
episodes.description: Rob finds a remote that controls the universe and travels back in time to enact revenge on Gumball.

episodes.title: The Stories
episodes.description: When everyone in school has had it with Molly's tedious stories, Gumball and Darwin have a plan to get her a new story she'll never forget.

episodes.title: The Rerun
episodes.description: Gumball continues to fight against Rob's attempt to destroy his life.

episodes.title: The Guy
episodes.description: Anais makes friends with an awkward kid named Josh, but Gumball and Darwin think there's something wrong with him.

episodes.title: The Boredom
episodes.description: On a boring Saturday afternoon, Gumball and Darwin decide to find something interesting to do — only to either miss out or pass by all of the weird events happening around them.

episodes.title: The Vision
episodes.description: Gumball accidentally takes Alan the balloon's gym bag and finds a flash drive containing a manifesto outlining Alan's House of Cards-esque rise to power through Elmore Junior High's student council.

episodes.title: The Choices
episodes.description: During a disastrous dinner at home, Nicole flashes back to her childhood, where she first met Richard while trying to make it to a karate tournament, and wonders what life would be like if she never met him.

episodes.title: The Code
episodes.description: After the wifi goes down (and Richard confesses that their connection is from the Robinsons as the Wattersons' credit is so bad, they can't afford to get the Internet for themselves), Gumball and Darwin try to live without Internet by making real-life equivalents of everything associated with the Internet (email, social media, gaming, leaving bad reviews for products and services). When that doesn't work, the Watterson kids decide to hack Mr. Robinson's account.

episodes.title: The Scam
episodes.description: Carrie backs up Gumball's story about a monster, and the students want to hire them as ghost exterminators for Halloween candy.

episodes.title: The Test
episodes.description: When he is labeled a ``loser'' in an online test, Gumball believes he must do the opposite of everything he would normally do.

episodes.title: The Slide
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin give Bobert instructions so he will behave in a safe and responsible manner, but he applies his logic to their rules.

episodes.title: The Loophole
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin are confused when they meet Chi Chi and Ribbit, a pair of goat and frog siblings that copy everything they do and say. Then they find out this copycat family is making money online from imitating the Watterson family.

episodes.title: The Copycats
episodes.description: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato, but he finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined, so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

episodes.title: The Potato
episodes.description: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato. However, he finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

episodes.title: The Fuss
episodes.description: When the family goes to visit Richard's dad, Frankie, who lives in a trailer in the town dump, they assume that he's done time in prison based on his extended absence from Richard's life and try to make him feel more at home.

episodes.title: The Outside
episodes.description: Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and accidentally break her latest hideous vase. But when Gumball, Darwin and Anais try to destroy it, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

episodes.title: The Vase
episodes.description: Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and accidentally break her latest hideous vase; when Gumball, Darwin and Anais try to destroy the vase, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

episodes.title: The Matchmaker
episodes.description: Gumball enlists Carrie to help bring Darwin and Teri together, but when they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.description: When Richard gives Gumball a cursed video game console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world. Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality.

episodes.title: The Console
episodes.description: When Gumball is given a cursed video game console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world; Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality.

episodes.title: The Ollie
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin realize Grandpa Louie has no friends, they create one called Muriel, when Granny Jojo finds out Louie has been spending time online with another "woman", Muriel not existing isn't going to stop her from being destroyed.

episodes.title: The Catfish
episodes.description: Gumball, Darwin and Anais discover that Mr. Wilson has been picking on their Dad for most of his life; ever since he humiliated Richard with a high school prank. The kids try to work Dad through it but when their efforts fail, they realize that getting back at Mr. Wilson is the only way to break the cycle.

episodes.title: The Cycle
episodes.description: When Dad gives Larry’s hairdresser a bad review for saying he’s bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town, forcing Larry to give them stuff with the threat of a bad review. Just because the customer is always right doesn’t mean that what they’re doing isn’t wrong.

episodes.title: The Stars
episodes.description: Miss Simian discovers a failed test from Gumball’s past that brings down his grade point average. This means he has to retake kindergarten all over again, much to her delight. But by demoting him, Miss Simian has inadvertently brought herself down, and they’re left with no choice but to team up if they want things back to normal.

episodes.title: The Grades
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin discover the reason Dad’s diet wasn’t working was that he was actually one of 10 of them and eating a meal for each of them. They eventually manage to help him lose weight, but Richard’s newfound buffness also brings out his more obnoxious side.

episodes.title: The Diet
episodes.description: When Gumball learns that his nemesis, Rob, has found a new nemesis, he tries to sabotage Rob's new "enemy-ship", much to the frustration of Penny.

episodes.title: The Ex
episodes.description: Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that doesn't have special powers. He convinces Mrs. Jötunheim, Hector's mom, to take him on as her apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a big mistake.

episodes.title: The Sorcerer
episodes.description: Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that doesn't have special powers; Gumball convinces Mrs. Jotunheim, Hector's mom, to take him on as her apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a big mistake.

episodes.title: The Menu
episodes.description: When Richard hears the urban legend of a secret Joyful Burger, he will stop at nothing to devour it.

episodes.title: The Uncle
episodes.description: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird. They carefully observe her behavior and decide that the only thing they have to change is absolutely everything.

episodes.title: The Weirdo
episodes.description: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird.

episodes.title: The Heist
episodes.description: Join the citizens of Elmore for a song and dance spectacular that will have people covering their ears with joy.

episodes.title: The Singing
episodes.description: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

episodes.title: The Best
episodes.description: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

episodes.title: The Worst
episodes.description: Richard goes on strike to prove that his work around the house is under appreciated by Nicole.

episodes.title: The Deal
episodes.description: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him.

episodes.title: The Petals
episodes.description: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him

episodes.title: The Puppets
episodes.description: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

episodes.title: The Nuisance
episodes.description: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

episodes.title: The Line
episodes.description: When the kids find out that Mom's life hasn't panned out as she'd hoped, they start taking on her chores, but they accidentally grab her bucket list instead of her to-do list.

episodes.title: The List
episodes.description: From police chases to the inside scoop on Daisy the Donkey, Channel 6 Elmore News has all the top local stories. Experienced newscaster Kip Schlezinger brings the latest news, sports and weather, even when there is absolutely nothing to report.

episodes.title: The News
episodes.description: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

episodes.title: The Rival
episodes.description: Back in time to when Anais is a newborn baby, Gumball and Darwin are terrified of her sinister and evil nature of trying to get the boys in trouble and killed. They decide to ship her away, but her box ends up getting picked up by the garbage disposal, forcing the boys to go and rescue her.

episodes.title: The Lady
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin become suspicious of Richard's connection to a woman named Samantha who is always hanging out with a group of old ladies. When they realize that Richard and Samantha are one and the same, they set out to right a wrong.

episodes.title: The Sucker
episodes.description: Darwin ends up in detention with Julius Oppenheimer Jr. for trying to fix Julius' vandalism, and Julius cons Darwin into being part of his gang... but soon regrets it when everything Darwin does goes wrong.

episodes.title: The Vegging
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin decide to spend the day by simply vegging out on the couch and watch TV. They attempt to ignore all the bizarre events happening around them, but are eventually forced to act when Nicole, Richard and Anais are left hanging in their car over a broken bridge.

episodes.title: The One
episodes.description: Gumball is put off by Tobias' constant burns, despite the fact that he allows Darwin to do so and that he himself is self-deprecating. Realizing that Tobias wants to be his "best" friend, Gumball tries to let him down easily, but this convinces him to instead "wipe out the competition".

episodes.title: The Father
episodes.description: The kids try to help Richard bond with Frankie.

episodes.title: The Cringe
episodes.description: Gumball and Hot Dog Guy discover why they're so awkward with each other.

episodes.title: The Cage
episodes.description: The kids convince Mr. Corneille to become a cage fighter and set up a fight against a fearsome Russian fighter.

episodes.title: The Faith
episodes.description: Alan has lost faith in humanity and turned the world black and white. Gumball must get over his hatred of Alan to bring the color back by singing.

episodes.title: The Candidate
episodes.description: A group of kids get locked in the school after their parents have a charity gala. They appoint Gumball as leader to get them out but it leads to chaos.

episodes.title: The Anybody
episodes.description: When Clayton shapeshifts into people to take their detentions for money, he starts framing them for misdemeanors so Gumball and Darwin must track him down to stop him.

episodes.title: The Pact
episodes.description: When Principal Brown has to take the bus, he and Gumball relate their grievances about their respective girlfriends (Miss Simian's bad morning breath and Penny's irritable laugh). They make a deal to tell each other's girlfriends about their issues, but Principal Brown backs out on his end, causing Gumball to pester him.

episodes.title: The Neighbor
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to find out the name of their neighbor, Antlers Guy, but accidentally blow his witness protection cover.

episodes.title: The Shippening
episodes.description: Sarah finds a notebook from the Awesome Store which magically makes what she draws happens. Unfortunately, she draws bizarre love stories throughout Elmore.

episodes.title: The Brain
episodes.description: The Wattersons have to stop doing stupid things in order to prevent Anais from falling into a coma from facepalming too much.

episodes.title: The Parents
episodes.description: After accidentally bumping into each other in the grocery aisle, Nicole and her parents have it out. The Wattersons discover why Nicole and her parents haven’t been on speaking terms for so long. The kids decide to bring about a reunion, in order to secure the backlog of birthday and holiday presents...

episodes.title: The Founder
episodes.description: Richard creates chaos in the Chanax building when he is mistaken for the long lost CEO. Nicole and a disgruntled employee must save everyone from Richard's dangerous ideas.

episodes.title: The Schooling
episodes.description: Larry warns Gumball and Darwin that if they don't take their education seriously they’ll end up like him. To prove his point, Larry lets Gumball and Darwin work some of his many roles to make them appreciate the value of a good education!

episodes.title: The Intelligence
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin argue with the Internet and make him mad. So mad in fact that he seeks to wipe out humanity and, while doing so, malfunctions! The whole of Elmore is plunged into a time before technology. It's actually pretty nice. Will Gumball and Darwin decide to leave the internet unplugged?

episodes.title: The Potion
episodes.description: Hector is unhappy with his height, so the kids try to use Mrs. Jötunheim's potions to shrink him, but it goes terribly wrong.

episodes.title: The Spinoffs
episodes.description: A sketch show about what "The Amazing World of Gumball" would be like if one replaced Gumball with someone else.

episodes.title: The Transformation
episodes.description: Penny's family argues about being in or out of their shells. Gumball unwillingly tells vague stories to help them settle their dispute.

episodes.title: The Understanding
episodes.description: There's a new kid at school but nobody can understand a thing he is saying. Gumball and Darwin try different ways to figure out what's going on.

episodes.title: The Ad
episodes.description: The Wattersons turn their home into a BnB in an attempt to raise some extra cash.

episodes.title: The Ghouls
episodes.description: It's Halloween in Elmore. As the kids go trick or treating we see what everyone in town is up to. The ghosts and ghouls are finding it increasingly difficult to scare children, and are only scaring part-time. Can Gumball and Darwin help them get their scare back?

episodes.title: The Stink
episodes.description: Gumball decides to put Mr. Small's eco-friendly principles to the test but it doesn't quite go as planned. Mr. Small disappears after deciding to leave the modern world behind. But on the plus side they discover that the Great Stink-Ape of Elmore Woods is definitely not extinct.

episodes.title: The Awareness
episodes.description: Gumball tries to convince Leslie he's an expert on all things plant-related. However, when Leslie realizes Gumball hasn't got a clue what he's talking about, he decides to call his bluff. An escalation of dangerous dares and stunts ensue as they try to out-plant each other.

episodes.title: The Slip
episodes.description: Richard doesn't answer the door in time and the jobsworth delivery guy will not let him have his package. His options are to pick his package up at the depot or pay for a redelivery. Richard doesn't like the sound of either option, so a battle of wills begins that can only end in the destruction of one or both of them.

episodes.title: The Drama
episodes.description: Everyone assumes Darwin and Carrie's relationship is doomed as they're so different. That is, everyone except Darwin and Carrie. When Carrie's cool ghostly ex-boyfriend turns up, Gumball decides to get Darwin to confront what's really going on.

episodes.title: The Buddy
episodes.description: Anais and school psycho Jamie are accused of the same techno-crime. They are forced to team up to discover the real culprit in order to prove their innocence. After solving the case, they realize that they have more in common than they thought.

episodes.title: The Possession
episodes.description: Richard Watterson seems supernaturally attached to his old refrigerator.

episodes.title: The Master
episodes.description: The Wattersons play a fantasy role-playing board game to resolve their differences.

episodes.title: The Silence
episodes.description: Have Gumball and Darwin finally run out of things to say to each other?

episodes.title: The Future
episodes.description: Banana Joe's Mom can predict the future, but she can't predict her own disappearance.

episodes.title: The Wish
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin believe they've turned Miss Simian into a neck-cushion.

episodes.title: The Factory
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin save the day at the Rainbow Factory.

episodes.title: The Agent
episodes.description: On a top secret school assignment Gumball acts like a certain suave British secret agent.

episodes.title: The Web
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin give Nicole a crash course in computers.

episodes.title: The Mess
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin baby-sit, then baby-lose, Penny’s little sister.

episodes.title: The Heart
episodes.description: Mr. Robinson tries and repeatedly fails to win back Gumball and Darwin’s friendship.

episodes.title: The Revolt
episodes.description: Darwin feels bad for the household objects in Elmore and encourages them to rise up.

episodes.title: The Decisions
episodes.description: Darwin has finally had enough of Gumball’s advice and seeks a new mentor.

episodes.title: The BFFS
episodes.description: When Gumball’s old BFF turns up, Darwin gets jealous.

episodes.title: The Inquisition
episodes.description: School Superintendent Evil is coming to Elmore Junior High to stamp out all cartoonish conduct!

episodes.title: The Burger
episodes.description: After Miss Simian scares her class with a lesson on the dangers of eating fast food, Gumball and Darwin find it impossible to eat healthy due to high prices and ubiquitous marketing in their society due to the literal fast food monopolist, Mr. Bilderburger, who owns every food chain in Elmore.

episodes.title: The Assistant
episodes.description: Sick of her lazy family, Nicole makes friends with Elmore Shippit's (the show's equivalent of Amazon.com) A.I. assistant, Ori, who helps her with the errands, listens to her stories, and tries to suck Nicole into her virtual world and kill off her family with a self-driving car.

episodes.title: The Distance
episodes.description: Worried that Gumball and Darwin are getting too attached, Nicole gives Darwin his own room to separate the boys. Gumball tries to win back Darwin's attention when he moves on to new friends.

episodes.title: The Thing
episodes.description: When Granny Jojo is coming over for dinner, Nicole reminds Richard of "the thing". Obviously forgetting, Richard enlists the kids' help to retrace his memories.

episodes.title: The Butts
episodes.description: When Principal Brown feels ashamed of his butt, Gumball helps him regain body confidence in order to read his butt poem at a recital.

episodes.title: The Traffic
episodes.description: To make up for ignoring her due to Nicole tending to her family's antics, the Wattersons take Anais to Daisyland after news hits that the park will be closing, but have to put up with traffic issues.

episodes.title: The Astrological
episodes.description: Mr. Small has been promoted to science teacher due to school budget cuts, and teaches the class on how the stars can predict the future and play matchmaker. Gumball and Penny think it's ridiculous, but when everyone in school falls for their predicted pairs, Gumball worries that he and Penny aren't meant to be together.

episodes.title: The Cheerleader
episodes.description: The Wattersons help Richard get on the school's cheerleading team and finally beat the generational trauma of having his dreams crushed by family members who don't believe in him.

episodes.title: The Boring
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin discover that Molly's stories are so boring and long-winded that they can slow down and stop time, which they use to stall their fight against Tina.

episodes.title: The Teacher
episodes.description: When Gumball's phone is confiscated, he follows Miss Simian and discovers that she is involved in a string of shady deals in order to get school supplies due to lack of educational funding.

episodes.title: The App
episodes.description: When a new video-sharing platform called Clik-Sap (a spoof of TikTok) turns the kids of Elmore into mindless zombies due to their irresistible trends, Gumball and Darwin must fight its power.

episodes.title: The Entrance
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin get invited to Tobias' Tropi-Gal mansion party, despite that they think it's a flimsy excuse for him to hit on their respective girlfriends, so they plan to make a grand entrance. When they find out that no one is going, the boys help out by shipping some contraband cologne that causes vivid hallucinations and destructive behavior.

episodes.title: The Letter
episodes.description: When Darwin sends Carrie a love letter before learning that she hates romantic gestures, he, with Gumball's help, tries to retrieve it before she sees it.

episodes.title: The Gut
episodes.description: When Richard eats Anais' science project, his gut turns into a sentient being who's smarter and more fatherly than Richard ever was. The gut slowly begins to consume Richard's whole body and attacks the kids.

episodes.title: The Wrinkle
episodes.description: When Anais begins growing wrinkles due to stressing over her family's stupidity, she comes up with a way to fix everyone's problems.

episodes.title: The Gourmet
episodes.description: After tasting Masami's gourmet, Gumball decides to become a member of the Yoshida family in order to have his own gourmet.

episodes.title: The Pool
episodes.description: When Gumball, Darwin and Richard discover Mr. Robinson has a luxury above-ground pool, they try to get a dive in. However, after accidentally draining all the water, they must refill the pool before Mr. Robinson finds out.

episodes.title: The Portrait
episodes.description: Nicole wants a new family photo, but her parents, Mary and Daniel, visit with news that Mary is now divorced and dating her yoga instructor, Johnny Toucan, while Richard's con artist father, Frankie, visits and reveals he's dating his parole officer (an anthropomorphic ruler).

episodes.title: The Climb
episodes.description: Gumball gets trauma after an incident with the gym rock-climbing wall where his pants fall off, and tries to get over it.

episodes.title: The Amadain
episodes.description: Gumball is tricked into attending Penny's grandmother's birthday party, and is forced to endure in her family's weird traditions.

episodes.title: The Summoning
episodes.description: Darwin joins a witch coven and lets the power go to his head.

episodes.title: The Unfollow
episodes.description: When Gumball and Darwin realize that Sarah is no longer their number one fan, they try to get her attention back by whatever means possible.v

episodes.title: The Promposal
episodes.description: Penny wants to ask Gumball to the Elmore Jr High Prom, but when Gumball's expectations for an extra romantic and extra complicated gesture become way more than Penny can handle, Penny must find a way to deliver.

episodes.title: The Trumpet
episodes.description: Nicole needs to make sure Gumball makes something of himself so that when he's older, he flies the nest instead of being a slob at home forever.

episodes.title: The Synthesis
episodes.description: During School's Career Day, Nicole and Yuki unite to impress their kids and show the world their full power only to learn where real power comes from.

episodes.title: The Cheapmas
episodes.description: After finding out Christmas is cancelled because Elmore is broke, Gumball and Darwin vow to save Christmas.

episodes.title: The Score
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin try to help Ocho overcome his anger and discover his life is much harder than theirs.

episodes.title: The Diary
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin find a diary. They discover the author is about to miss out on the biggest moment of her life and must find her to figure out why.

episodes.title: The Punishment
episodes.description: Gumball and Nicole vow revenge on the driver of a car that cut them off.

episodes.title: The Roast
episodes.description: After Gumball's smack talking embarrasses him in front of the entire town, he vows to curb his smug ways.

episodes.title: The Survivalists
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin go up against a squirrel in a primal fight for survival (...in their backyard).

episodes.title: The Labels
episodes.description: When an evil guidance counselor arrives at school and gives all the kids awful labels, Gumball and Darwin must defeat her to reclaim their identities.

episodes.title: The Fools
episodes.description: When nobody in Elmore is pranking on April Fool's Day, Gumball takes it upon himself to show them how it's done.

episodes.title: The Homework
episodes.description: Gumball faces the most difficult journey of his life when he attempts to deliver Anais her forgotten homework on the day he is home sick with the flu.

episodes.title: The Sonder
episodes.description: Gumball realizes that each random passerby is living a life as vivid and complex as his own.

episodes.title: The Mister
episodes.description: Now considered a man in his culture, Idaho gets help from Gumball and Darwin as he attempts to handle his new adult responsibilities.

episodes.title: The Tracking
episodes.description: The family tries to save Richard from the consequences of a bet involving a fitness tracker.

episodes.title: The Pants
episodes.description: Disturbed by Banana Joe's decision to start wearing pants, Gumball does everything in his power to put a stop to it.

episodes.title: The Necroprancer
episodes.description: Gumball and Darwin travel to the underworld with Carrie, intent on finding her a permanent body.

episodes.title: The Rewrite
episodes.description: The boys are on the verge of discovering the truth about Elmore, but their old nemesis decides to rewrite the story.

episodes.title: Adventures in Supersitting
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max Thunderman have to babysit their younger siblings, Billy and Nora Thunderman, while their parents, Hank and Barb go out to dinner. Phoebe invites her best friend Cherry over and accidentally exposes the families super power abilities. Meanwhile, Hank and Barb are out for dinner and Hank (Thunderman) has to replace a party entertainer.

episodes.title: Phoebe vs. Max
episodes.description: A prank war between Max and Phoebe gets out of hand when Max pranks his sister on picture day at school and she finally decides to take on the family's troublemaker once and for all.

episodes.title: Dinner Party
episodes.description: Just as Hank reminds the children about their "no non-supes" (non-superheroes) in the house, Max plans to sabotage dinner when Phoebe has to invite her crush, Cole Campbell (guest star Logan Shroyer), and his rich family over. But just as Max's plans are in play, his crush, Tara Campbell (guest star Katherine McNamara) also arrives with the family, forcing Phoebe and Max to work together to keep the night for turning into a complete disaster; while also dealing with their family who is embarrassing them, trying not to be themselves.

episodes.title: Report Card
episodes.description: Max changes the grades on his report card and is moved into an advanced class, at first only to annoy Phoebe and win the class over, but the two butt heads to stay in the class and win the Math Bowl. Meanwhile Hank, Nora and Billy try to catch a newspaper thief, and learn that the culprit might be more closer to home than they think.

episodes.title: Ditch Day
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe create some fun for themselves on Ditch Day, but it becomes a race against time to rush to school and erase footage of Phoebe and Max using their superpowers. But as they try to get to the principal's office to get the footage, they have to participate in a country-Western themed dance to keep the guest for knowing their actual motives for being at the school. Meanwhile Barb is sick and Hank is babysitting the younger siblings, who unknowing to him, are trying to get in on the older ones' plans.

episodes.title: This Looks Like a Job For
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe get signed up to get a job at "Wong's Pizza Palace" to get $200 each to buy a new, cool phone. Barb signs up for a cup stacking contest. Billy and Nora earn so much money at the cup stacking contest that they bought the expensive phone Max and Phoebe want.

episodes.title: The Weekend Guest
episodes.description: Phoebe gets to take care of a Venus Fly Trap from school while their parents go to Meteorberg. Max, Billy, and Nora, try to steal the Venus Fly Trap. Phoebe accidentally spilled water on the Venus Fly Trap and it dies. Max brings it back to life. The things that Max put on to make the Venus Fly Trap made it grow continuously.

episodes.title: You Stole My Thunder, Man
episodes.description: Phoebe gets revenge on Max after winning the school election. Billy and Hank collect rocks and try to hide them while Barb doesn't want the rocks in the house. Max is the new president, and has an assistant named Flunky.

episodes.title: Weird Science Fair
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max want to help Billy and Nora with their science fair at Billy and Nora's school. While the science fair, a huge tomato explodes which Max causes. Barb makes a book club which Hank ruins.

episodes.title: Crime After Crime
episodes.description: Hank creates a neighborhood watch group when crimes start happening. Max takes the blame for the mysterious crimes to hide his own secret, but Phoebe knows he is innocent and it's up to the family to catch the real criminal.

episodes.title: Going Wonkers
episodes.description: Achille's comet is passing Earth, and it's making the Thunderman's powers go crazy. Phoebe can't go to the school dance with Cole because of the comet, unless she and Max stay three feet together. The dance goes terrible as Max ruins the night for them, with Max getting involved in a dance-off, prompting Cole to leave. Phoebe must race to Cole's house for him to forgive her before they leave for a two week-long trip. Meanwhile, the rest of the family try to control their powers.

episodes.title: Restaurant Crashers
episodes.description: It's Barb and Hank's anniversary so they go out for a dinner date. Meanwhile, Phoebe, Max, Billy and Nora accidently destroyed Barb's gift (a new car) so they call their Cousin Blobbin to help them fix the situation.

episodes.title: Thundersense
episodes.description: Phoebe gets the ability to sense danger and uses it to impress her classmates; Max tries to get pity gifts from Barb.

episodes.title: Phoebe's a Clone Now
episodes.description: When Phoebe commits herself to too many activities, Max helps her by creating a clone.

episodes.title: Have an Ice Birthday
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max wants to have a normal teenage birthday party; Mrs. Wong goes missing.

episodes.title: Nothing to Lose Sleepover
episodes.description: Phoebe is caught using telekinesis to save her first sleepover from becoming a disaster; Phoebe must wear an anklet that prevents her from using her powers.

episodes.title: Pretty Little Choirs
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe work together to get even with a mean girl at school.

episodes.title: Paging Dr. Thunderman
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe take Billy to the hospital when he hurts his thumb; Max faints when he sees a needle.

episodes.title: Up, Up, and Vacay!
episodes.description: The Thundermans decide to enroll in a family school competition in order to win a free trip to location of their choosing. But girls want to visit European castles, and boys want a tropical paradise experience, which inadvertently splits them into two opposing teams. There are two different endings to this episode, one where the boys win, and one where the girls win.

episodes.title: Breaking Dad
episodes.description: Hank falls asleep having eating special turkey sandwiches as he teaches at Max and Phoebe's school.

episodes.title: Thunder Van
episodes.description: The kids take a joyride in the Thundervan prompting Hank to teach them a lesson. Billy swears he didn't push anything when things go wonkers. Meanwhile, Barb and Nora have a tea party outside.

episodes.title: Four Supes and a Baby
episodes.description: The children wind up bringing home a real baby instead of Nora's doll when Phoebe drags Billy and Nora to the park to meet her crush and his baby brother.

episodes.title: Max's Minions
episodes.description: Max takes on some freshmen to be his new minions. He becomes the victim of humiliation.

episodes.title: Pheebs Will Rock You
episodes.description: Phoebe tries to turn herself into a bad girl to impress Max's new best friend, a rocker who is in Max's new band.

episodes.title: Haunted Thundermans Pt I
episodes.description: The Thundermans travel to New Orleans to help the Hathaways and the Prestons when a super villain escapes Ghost World on Halloween. This episode guest stars and concludes in Part Two with The Haunted Hathaways.

episodes.title: Shred It Go
episodes.description: Phoebe becomes heartbroken when she thinks her tickets to the MKTO concert were destroyed in the shredder, but she does not know the tickets are with Max, who has secret plans to take his crush to the concert to make her fall for him. Meanwhile, Nora feels her family is replacing her with new paper shredder machine that Hank buys.

episodes.title: Blue Detective
episodes.description: When Max's skin turns blue while out on a date, everybody becomes a suspect as he turns super-sleuth in an effort to find out whodunnit.

episodes.title: Cheer and Present Danger
episodes.description: Phoebe and Cherry's friendship is tested when only one of them makes the cheerleader squad. Meanwhile, Billy and Nora want to keep a stray cat as their own pet.

episodes.title: Change of Art
episodes.description: When Phoebe gets help from Billy on an art project, she learns that he took the piece from a museum.

episodes.title: Winter Thunderland
episodes.description: Max is visited by the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future on Christmas Eve.

episodes.title: Parents Just Don't Thunderstand
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max use one of his devices to make Hank and Barb act like teenagers, but the siblings quickly grow to regret their actions.

episodes.title: Meet the Evilmans
episodes.description: When a retired supervillain -- Thunder Man's old nemesis -- moves to Hiddenville, Phoebe secretly begins dating his son.

episodes.title: The Neverfriending Story
episodes.description: When Phoebe and Max's friends begin spending time with each other, the twins worry that they will be stuck together all the time.

episodes.title: You've Got Fail
episodes.description: Max tries to win an epic-fail video contest by submitting a video of Phoebe as she practices ballet, but Phoebe refuses to cooperate.

episodes.title: Doubles Trouble
episodes.description: Phoebe enlists Max's help in a tennis tournament in order to win a membership at Link's family's country club.

episodes.title: Who's Your Mommy?
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe accidentally sell Barb's old superhero whip to an Electress fan at the family's garage sale.

episodes.title: The Amazing Rat Race
episodes.description: Max turns Billy into the world's fastest rat in order to win the rat races that he has with members of his band.

episodes.title: Mall Time Crooks
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max head out on a trip to the mall to buy Hank's birthday gift and end up having a run-in with security.

episodes.title: It's Not What You Link
episodes.description: Phoebe's plan to get Max and Link to be friends backfires when Link starts spending more time with Max than her.

episodes.title: Cape Fear
episodes.description: When Phoebe sneaks out to a party and saves someone's life, she asks Max to take credit for the save so she can remain on the superhero training path.

episodes.title: Call of Lunch Duty
episodes.description: Phoebe discovers that Max is the person behind the latest rebellious pranks at school, and refuses to reveal his secret to the principal.

episodes.title: One Hit Thunder
episodes.description: Max causes a rift between Phoebe and Link when he uses personal information about them in a song for his band; Hank and Barb try to teach Billy and Nora a valuable lesson.

episodes.title: The Girl with the Dragon Snafu
episodes.description: Phoebe joins the cool group for a class project, but quickly discovers that they do not want to work as hard as she does.

episodes.title: A Hero is Born
episodes.description: Phoebe and Cherry's friendship is tested when the Thunderman family gets some unexpected news; Max goes with Dr. Colosso to accept an award.

episodes.title: Phoebe vs. Max: The Sequel
episodes.description: In the third-season opener, Phoebe gets her first assignment as a superhero: She must safeguard Hiddenville. However, she finds the task a little too simplistic, so she asks Max to make it more challenging for her.

episodes.title: On the Straight and Arrow
episodes.description: Cherry asks Max to use his superpowers to help her get her driver's license; Phoebe's jealousy threatens her relationship with her best friend.

episodes.title: Why You Buggin'?
episodes.description: After discovering that Link's ex-girlfriend is a secret supervillain who wants Link for herself, Phoebe enlists Max's help in exposing her rival's true motives.

episodes.title: Exit Stage Theft
episodes.description: Max tries to reestablish his evil reputation by committing petty crimes; Max must choose between his friends and his reputation.

episodes.title: Are You Afraid of the Park?
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe start a fight between Billy and Nora so they can avoid riding a scary roller coaster, but their scheme backfires when the feud escalates.

episodes.title: Evil Never Sleeps
episodes.description: Phoebe's allegiance is torn when she learns that her boyfriend's father might be plotting a return to evil.

episodes.title: Doppel-Gamers
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe realize they have been neglecting their younger siblings when Billy and Nora bond with an outgoing pair of teens at a gamer's convention.

episodes.title: Floral Support
episodes.description: Max uses Phoebe to help retrieve his chronicle of evil deeds from the school's confiscation closet, but breaks her trust to pull off his plan.

episodes.title: Patch Me If You Can
episodes.description: While Phoebe is baby-sitting her boyfriend's shy little brother, the boy discovers his teddy bear was destroyed by one of Max's inventions and he wants to get revenge on Max. Meanwhile, the rest of the family attend a pirate party .

episodes.title: Give Me a Break Up
episodes.description: Phoebe's relationship with her superhero boyfriend is put to the test when he is offered an assignment overseas.

episodes.title: No Country for Old Mentors
episodes.description: Despite hoping to be matched with her favorite hero in the Superhero Mentor Program, Phoebe feels pressure to choose her father instead.

episodes.title: Date Expectations
episodes.description: Phoebe distracts Max from interfering with her class project by convincing him that a girl at school wants to date him.

episodes.title: He Got Game Night
episodes.description: When Hank raises the stakes of family game night to a new high, each member of the family will do whatever it takes to win the grand prize.

episodes.title: Kiss Me Nate
episodes.description: Max is nervous when his girlfriend auditions for the romantic lead in the school play opposite a cute boy, so he convinces Phoebe to audition for the same role.

episodes.title: Dog Day After-school
episodes.description: Billy and Nora seek Phoebe's help to retrieve their mother's tablet after it is confiscated at school.

episodes.title: Original Prankster
episodes.description: Despite promising his girlfriend that he would stop pulling pranks, Max pulls an epic gag that his friend gets blamed for.

episodes.title: Chutes and Splatters
episodes.description: Phoebe must babysit President Kickbutt's troublemaking teen daughter as her latest superhero mission, but the assignment quickly gets out of control.

episodes.title: I'm Gonna Forget You, Sucka
episodes.description: After Cherry accidentally posts a photo revealing the Thundermans' secret, the Hero League forces Phoebe to end the relationship with her best friend.

episodes.title: Beat the Parents
episodes.description: When Max feels nervous about meeting his girlfriend's parents, he seeks Phoebe's help to try and win them over.

episodes.title: Can't Spy Me Love
episodes.description: Unexpected consequences arise when Phoebe uses the Hero League's villain search software to track down a cute boy.

episodes.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Pheebs
episodes.description: When Chloe announces that Max is her favorite sibling, Phoebe tries to reveal Max's true colors using a bedtime story.

episodes.title: Aunt Misbehavin'
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe surprise their mother by tracking down her long lost sister, only to find the sisters had been feuding for years.

episodes.title: Stealing Home
episodes.description: Hank and Phoebe think their house has been robbed when they return home and discover the furniture is missing.

episodes.title: Back to School
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max return to their elementary school to complete a hero assessment exam and discover that the instructor is a former classmate that Max tormented.

episodes.title: Thundermans: Secret Revealed: Part 1
episodes.description: In "Thundermans: Secret Revealed!", with the Villain League determined to halt Phoebe's superhero ascension and destroy the Thundermans altogether, Max must finally choose between fighting for good with his family, or a life of evil against them.

episodes.title: Happy Heroween
episodes.description: It's a major Halloween storm outside, but inside Dr. Colosso keeps the family spooked by telling scary stories sure to terrify even the bravest of superheroes.

episodes.title: Thundermans: Banished!: Part 1
episodes.description: After the Thundermans' superhero secret is exposed and life at home becomes unmanageable, the family is relocated to a new city; Phoebe and Max risk everything to save Hiddenville.

episodes.title: Smells Like Team Spirit
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max must work together on a series of superhero team-building exercises, but their different approaches to training jeopardizes their future as a crime fighting duo.

episodes.title: Max to the Future
episodes.description: Max is concerned that he is not considered a valuable superhero, so he creates a machine that can predict future crimes.

episodes.title: Better Off Wed
episodes.description: When the children learn that Dr. Colosso ruined their parents' wedding years earlier, they decide to recreate Hank and Barb's dream day as their anniversary gift.

episodes.title: Parks & T-Rex
episodes.description: While preoccupied with the Z-Force training, Phoebe and Max discover that they have forgotten special family events.

episodes.title: Date of Emergency
episodes.description: Phoebe feels left out in relationships since both Max and Cherry are in relationships. So, she creates a lie to fake romance but keeping it proves to be very difficult.

episodes.title: Orange Is the New Max
episodes.description: Phoebe worries that Max will revert to his evil ways after he is asked to give a "Scared Straight" talk to a group of young supervillains in prison, but her efforts to protect Max from himself end up doing more harm than good.

episodes.title: Ditch Perfect
episodes.description: When Phoebe finds out that Max's Band is planning to ditch him, she suspects that the Z-Force training is hurting his friendships. So, she attempts to repair things.

episodes.title: May Z-Force Be with You
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe ask Cherry to secretly fill-in after Phoebe injures herself the night before a meeting with the Z-Force.

episodes.title: 21 Dump Street
episodes.description: After Max is dumped, Phoebe tries to cheer him up by introducing him to another girl, but Max's date turns out to be an intense animal activist who thinks he treats Dr. Colosso cruelly.

episodes.title: Super Dupers
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe use their powers to give their Gideon a confidence boost, but the gesture backfires when he recklessly starts to think he that he has superpowers of his own.

episodes.title: Come What Mayhem
episodes.description: Phoebe makes a life-altering decision when her powers combined with Max's powers are not enough to stop one of Max's old pranks from ruining a superhero gathering.

episodes.title: Thunder in Paradise: Part 1
episodes.description: The Thundermans head to Hawaii for a vacation that they planned. However, when Phoebe accidentally absorbs the evil powers of Dark Mayhem, she becomes determined to complete his plan for world domination and must be stopped.

episodes.title: Save the Past Dance
episodes.description: Tired of hearing tales of Hiddenville's legendary mayor, the kids use a time machine to travel back 60 years to disprove the myths; but when they inadvertently alter the past, the effect spells disaster for their hometown.

episodes.title: Z's All That
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max act as a superhero mentors to one of their siblings but quickly regret selecting Nora after seeing Billy's surprisingly impressive skills.

episodes.title: Can't Hardly Date
episodes.description: As Sarah and Gideon's crushes on Max and Phoebe escalate, the twins attempt to solve the problem by setting them up on a date with each other; Max wants to win back Sarah after he discovers her uncle is a rock star.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Smith
episodes.description: Excited to be honored for their heroism with a school mural, Phoebe and Max learn that the artist holds a personal grudge, and the tribute isn’t what they imagined.

episodes.title: Nowhere to Slide
episodes.description: The Thunder family splits up for the night; the boys decide to survive 24 hours in the wilderness, while the girls try to bond over some of Barb's favorite farm activities from her childhood.

episodes.title: Significant Brother
episodes.description: Sparks fly between Phoebe and Cherry's visiting brother, prompting Cherry to grow concerned that she will be overshadowed by this new romance; after Cherry begs Phoebe not to date her brother, Phoebe must decide between love and friendship.

episodes.title: Rhythm n' Shoes
episodes.description: Determined to meet a famous pop singer visiting Hiddenville High, Phoebe and Max devise elaborate schemes to insert themselves into her performance that quickly lead to disastrous results.

episodes.title: Make It Pop Pop
episodes.description: Nana and Pop Pop Thunderman come to visit, but when Phoebe reveals Colosso is living in their house, Pop Pop's no-tolerance attitude toward supervillains leads him to banish Max and his bunny best friend to the Detention Zone.

episodes.title: Side-Kicking and Screaming
episodes.description: Max & Phoebe secretly employ their parents' former sidekick to ease their busy schedule, but the twins' bickering and inability to share provokes an unexpected response from their new sidekick.

episodes.title: Cookie Mistake
episodes.description: After Phoebe chooses Billy to accompany her to their favorite cookie factory's exclusive tasting event, Max and Nora are determined to sneak in and get to the delicious treats first.

episodes.title: All the President's Thunder-Men
episodes.description: After their requests drive Kickbutt to quit, Max and Phoebe get what they want when Hank is named the new SuperPresident; being the First Family of the Hero League takes its toll on the family.

episodes.title: Mad Max: Beyond Thunderhome
episodes.description: Max finally declares his independence from his parents' house rules and moves to his friend's house, where they only rule is that there are no rules; ultimate freedom quickly becomes more than Max can handle.

episodes.title: The Thundredth
episodes.description: Phoebe and Max are determined to make their 100th save their best and most memorable one yet, but by ignoring a series of small saves they overlook a supervillain plotting revenge on Hank and Barb.

episodes.title: Looperheroes
episodes.description: The Z-Force gives Max and Phoebe a superhero day off, but when they relive the day over and over again, they must find a way to break the loop.

episodes.title: The Thunder Games: Part 1
episodes.description: Max and Phoebe advance to the final tryout for a spot on an elite superhero squad, but a new supervillain with a surprise connection to the Thunderman family may force them to sacrifice their crime fighting dream.

episodes.title: The Astrosmurf
episodes.description: The Smurfs help fulfill Dreamy's wish to travel to the stars by disguising themselves as Swoofs on another planet.

episodes.title: Jokey's Medicine
episodes.description: The Smurfs end up trapped in Gargamel's lair when they decide to get even with Jokey.

episodes.title: Vanity Fair
episodes.description: Gargamel's magic mirror traps Vanity Smurf inside it so Smurfette and Brainy rush to his rescue. Once inside the mirror-world, they cause a giant explosion that shatters the glassy enclosure and hurry back to their smurfy village.

episodes.title: St. Smurf and the Dragon
episodes.description: Un cucciolo di drago ha un appetito insaziabile per le bacche di cui il Grande Puffo ha bisogno per la sua formula dell'invisibilità.

episodes.title: The Magical Meanie
episodes.description: Brainy and Clumsy discover a badly behaving genie who's only nice when somebody says the magic words ""pumpernickel pickle"".

episodes.title: Sorcerer Smurf
episodes.description: Gargamel disguises himself as a long-lost Sorceror Smurf.

episodes.title: Bewitched, Bothered and Be-Smurfed
episodes.description: Hogatha's amulet causes some of Smurfette's wishes to come true when she wears it.

episodes.title: King Smurf
episodes.description: Brainy becomes king of the village and starts a civil war when Papa Smurf's gone.

episodes.title: The Smurfs and the Howlibird
episodes.description: The Smurfs are threatened by a howlibird and have to find a way to defeat it.

episodes.title: Soup A La Smurf
episodes.description: Bigmouth's soup becomes unappetizing when Papa Smurf puts a formula in it that disfigures the hungry ogre.

episodes.title: All That Glitters Isn't Smurf
episodes.description: Every Smurf mistakenly believes that Papa Smurf lost his magic touch.

episodes.title: Dreamy's Nightmare
episodes.description: Dreamy's trip around the world is cut short when Gargamel captures him

episodes.title: Romeo & Smurfette
episodes.description: Hefty and Handy, not to mention everyone else, compete for the amourous attention of Smurfette.

episodes.title: The Magic Egg
episodes.description: A magic egg that grants every Smurf their fondest wishes creates chaos.

episodes.title: Smurphony in 'C'
episodes.description: Harmony discovers a magical horn that puts its listeners into an eternal sleep.

episodes.title: Sideshows Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs enter a human village to rescue Smurfette and Clumsy from a mean showmaster.

episodes.title: Super Smurf
episodes.description: Brainy tries using brute force instead of brains to retrieve his village's stolen food supply from Bigmouth.

episodes.title: Paradise Smurfed
episodes.description: Lazy dreams of discovering a hidden paradise that hides a nightmare.

episodes.title: Sir Hefty
episodes.description: Hefty becomes a knight to slay a dragon that's been setting fire to the village.

episodes.title: The Baby Smurf
episodes.description: Gargamel transforms himself into an blue infant to destroy the village from within.

episodes.title: The Fake Smurf
episodes.description: Hogatha's impersonation of a Smurf backfires when she loses her tail.

episodes.title: Painter and Poet
episodes.description: Two creative Smurfs take their unappreciated talents with them when they flee to a deserted island.

episodes.title: Haunted Smurf
episodes.description: Something is haunting a castle that the Smurfs discover when they leave the village in search for food.

episodes.title: The Purple Smurfs
episodes.description: A purple fly bites Lazy, causing a tail-biting purple epidemic.

episodes.title: The Fountain of Smurf
episodes.description: Papa Smurf becomes a Smurfling, and the Smurfs must find a way to restore him to normal with the help of Gargamel.

episodes.title: The Magnifying Mixture
episodes.description: Brainy accidentally turns Hefty into a giant, who brings an even bigger problem into the village.

episodes.title: Foul Weather Smurf
episodes.description: Handy's weather-controlling machine creates chaos in the climate.

episodes.title: The Hundredth Smurf
episodes.description: Vanity's mirror reflection comes to life and does the opposite of what Vanity does.

episodes.title: The Abominable Snowbeast
episodes.description: The Smurfs encounter a snow creature that turns out to be friendly with Smurfette.

episodes.title: Gargamel, The Generous
episodes.description: An accidental discovery of diamonds by Clumsy attracts Gargamel's attention.

episodes.title: The Smurfette
episodes.description: Gargamel creates Smurfette as a pawn to destroy the Smurfs, and Papa Smurf changes her into a real Smurf to foil Gargamel's plan.

episodes.title: Now You Smurf 'em Now You Don't
episodes.description: Underground trolls use a crystal ball that lets Smurfs see their fondest wishes in order to kidnap whoever touches it.

episodes.title: Spelunking Smurfs
episodes.description: I Puffi scoprono una grotta con cibi congelati e surgelati di un orco di guardia.The Smurfs discover a cave with frozen food and a frozen ogre guarding it.

episodes.title: The Smurf Apprentice
episodes.description: Clumsy turns himself into a dragon, and the Smurfs must help him return to normal.

episodes.title: Smurfed Coloured Glasses
episodes.description: Handy's magical glasses trick Smurfette into seeing Gargamel as handsome.

episodes.title: The Clockwork Smurf
episodes.description: Handy's mechanical Smurf becomes a hero when he rescues Prince Gerard from his evil aunt.

episodes.title: Fuzzle Trouble
episodes.description: A furry little creature becomes a multiplying menace.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Dancing Shoes
episodes.description: The Smurfs split up to retrieve three treasures in order to rescue Smurfette from a forced marriage to a greedy troll.

episodes.title: The Smurfs & The Money Tree
episodes.description: Gargamel's mother tests Greedy's avarice by planting a golden goodie tree outside his house.

episodes.title: The Smurf Who Couldn't Say No
episodes.description: Pushover learns to be steadfast in his refusals when he and Scaredy must relight a mystical fire to calm a rampaging swamp monster.

episodes.title: The Adventures of Robin Smurf
episodes.description: Vanity as Robin Hood must rescue Smurfette as Maid Marian from Brainy as the evil Prince John with the help of his merry   men.

episodes.title: The Cursed Country
episodes.description: The Smurfs find a way to douse the flames of a fire-breathing dragon being used by an evil master to capture slaves for his diamond mine.

episodes.title: S-Shivering S-Smurfs
episodes.description: Nobody pays any attention to Tracker's prediction of an early snowfall until it happens, and now they're angry with him.

episodes.title: Sister Smurf
episodes.description: Smurfette and a human girl flee from their unappreciative families, only to be held prisoner by an old hag.

episodes.title: The Black Hellebore
episodes.description: An evil wizard uses a deadly flower to put everyone in a trance.

episodes.title: Revenge Of The Smurfs
episodes.description: A bunch of disgruntled Smurfs try to get even with a human army that has rampaged the village.

episodes.title: The Three Smurfketeers
episodes.description: It's an ""all for one and one for all"" adventure, brought to you by the boys (and the angel) in blue.

episodes.title: Heavenly Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs try tricking Gargamel into believing he has been sent to his final judgment.

episodes.title: It Came From Outer Smurf
episodes.description: Dreamy's claim of seeing a visitor from another world is ignored until he retrieves a crystal that creates a windstorm.

episodes.title: The Sorcery Of Maltrochu
episodes.description: Johan, Peewit, and the Smurfs must restore a young royal who's gone to the dogs, courtesy of an evil baron who wants to marry the beautiful Genevieve.

episodes.title: Squeaky
episodes.description: Smurfette learns to value the passage of life when her pet mouse dies.

episodes.title: The Kaplowey Scroll
episodes.description: A translated scroll with a magic word that makes things disappear becomes dangerous when Grouchy uses it on Jokey.

episodes.title: The Goblin Of Boulder Wood
episodes.description: Peewit recounts his first encounter with Johan.

episodes.title: Gormandizing Greedy
episodes.description: An overweight Greedy learns that it isn't healthy to overeat.

episodes.title: Waste Not, Smurf Not
episodes.description: Handy's food processor causes the Smurfs to use food unproductively.

episodes.title: Johan's Army
episodes.description: The Smurfs help Johan and Peewit protect the castle when his army's been rendered useless.

episodes.title: The Lost City Of Yore
episodes.description: Nosey's butting-in gets the other Smurfs in the middle of an argument over the evil Scepter of Yore.

episodes.title: The Magic Fountain
episodes.description: Johan, Peewit, and the Smurfs search for the magic fountain to energize an enslaved people.

episodes.title: The Imposter King
episodes.description: Johan, Peewit and the Smurfs must find the real king and stop his imposter.

episodes.title: For The Love Of Gargamel
episodes.description: Tracker learns to respect all life, even Gargamel's, when he helps Papa Smurf create a formula to restore Gargamel and Azrael from being turned to stone.

episodes.title: The A-Maze-Ing Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs meet Malchior the Magnificient inside his labyrinthine manor.

episodes.title: The Haunted Castle
episodes.description: Johan, Peewit, and the Smurfs must help a ghost of a haunted castle find his rightful heir.

episodes.title: Smurfs At Sea
episodes.description: Papa Smurf recounts Dreamy's adventures at sea.

episodes.title: One Good Smurf Deserves Another
episodes.description: Clumsy gets a chance to repay Handy's bravery by rescuing him from a real monster.

episodes.title: The Blue Plague
episodes.description: Brainy gives his fellow Smurfs a meal that makes them feel like chickens.

episodes.title: The Last Laugh
episodes.description: Gargamel's giggle glitter causes uncontrollable fits of laughter in the Smurfs.

episodes.title: The Raven Wizard
episodes.description: An evil wizard kidnaps Sabrina to magically transfer her youth onto himself, and Peewit comes to Sabrina's rescue.

episodes.title: The Ring Of Castellac
episodes.description: Johan, Peewit, and the Smurfs must return a drugged duke to his rightful place.

episodes.title: The Sky Is Smurfing, The Sky Is Smurfing!
episodes.description: Scaredy's warning of danger is taken seriously when a nearby volcano erupts.

episodes.title: Turncoat Smurf
episodes.description: Everybody accuses Brainy of turning against them when he accidentally leads Gargamel into the village.

episodes.title: Return Of Clockwork Smurf
episodes.description: King Gerard seeks bravery of his own when his companion Clockwork is put out of the action and the king's uncle Leopold.

episodes.title: The Littlest Giant
episodes.description: Papa Smurf helps a young runaway giant reunite with his own family.

episodes.title: Bubble, Bubble, Smurfs In Trouble
episodes.description: Scaredy learns that he couldn't find bravery by hiding himself inside a bubble.

episodes.title: Smurf Van Winkle
episodes.description: Lazy is tricked by the other Smurfs into believing he has slept his life away.

episodes.title: The Prince And The Peewit
episodes.description: The court jester and his royal doppelganger switch places.

episodes.title: The Enchanted Baby
episodes.description: Johan, Peewit, and the Smurfs must deliver a baby with magical powers to his parents.

episodes.title: Clumsy Smurfs The Future
episodes.description: A glowing rock Clumsy finds gives him some glimpses into what's going to happen.

episodes.title: Sleepwalking Smurfs
episodes.description: Gargamel uses Madame Trilby's magic flute to lead sleeping Smurfs out of their village.

episodes.title: Smurf Me No Flowers
episodes.description: Lazy is led to believe that he has only a few days left to live, encouraging him to do some physical feats he hasn't thought of doing before.

episodes.title: The Good, The Bad, And The Smurfy
episodes.description: The wizard Mordain, who seeks to overthrow the kingdom by turning his liege into a frog, abducts Papa Smurf and some   others.

episodes.title: A Mere Truffle
episodes.description: Tracker loses his memory when he leads the other Smurfs on a truffle hunt.

episodes.title: The Stuff Dreams Are Smurfed Of
episodes.description: Gargamel does his own version of Freddy Krueger when he invades the dreams of the Smurfs with the help of a magical dream crown.

episodes.title: The Box Of Dirty Tricks
episodes.description: Gargamel gives the Smurfs a destructive little present.

episodes.title: Papa's Wedding Day
episodes.description: A charming woodnymph working for Lord Balthazar tricks Papa Smurf into marrying her.

episodes.title: All's Smurfy That Ends Smurfy
episodes.description: Gargamel steals fairy gold, and the fairies accuse the Smurfs of stealing it, leading into an all-out war that Papa Smurf must   stop.

episodes.title: The Smurfs' Christmas Special
episodes.description: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when an evil mysterious stranger shows up and causes their sleigh to turn over, forcing them to seek help and inadvertently bring Gargamel in on the action.

episodes.title: My Smurfy Valentine
episodes.description: Smurfette's wish for a Prince Smurfing eventually causes two evil wizards, Gargamel and Chlorhydris, to fall madly in love with each other when Gargamel intercepts Smurfette's note to Cupid to make her wish come true.

episodes.title: Once In A Blue Moon
episodes.description: A stork delivers a real Baby Smurf into the village on a rare night.

episodes.title: All Creatures Great And Smurf
episodes.description: Natural nearly endangers the village when he brings home a wounded Azrael.

episodes.title: The Smurf Fire Brigade
