episodes.description: A rash of fires inspire the Smurfs to create an effective invention for fighting them.

episodes.title: The Winged Wizard
episodes.description: Gargamel uses his flying inventions as a way to capture Smurfs.

episodes.title: Every Picture Smurfs A Story
episodes.description: An evil artist tricks Painter into doing a lifelike portrait of Papa Smurf so that he can come to life and find his eternal inspiration.

episodes.title: The First Telesmurf
episodes.description: Overgrown smurfmelon vines make for a new means of communication, and a new way for Gargamel to find the Smurfs.

episodes.title: Handy's Kite
episodes.description: Handy and his high-flying crew are captured by Lord Balthasar.

episodes.title: The Magic Earrings
episodes.description: Hogatha seduces Gargamel into giving her a pair of earrings that let her hear sounds from all over the world -- including Smurfs.

episodes.title: The Last Smurfberry
episodes.description: Gargamel creates a smurfberry famine, causing the Smurfs to seek out across the seas to find more of the berries.

episodes.title: A Little Smurf Confidence
episodes.description: Weakling gains strength from his own willpower when Papa Smurf gives him smurfberry jam to put on his nose and calling it Can Do Cream.

episodes.title: Hogatha's Heart Throb
episodes.description: Gargamel tricks Hogatha into getting her bird call by disguising himself as the wizard of her dreams.

episodes.title: Born Rotten
episodes.description: A furry little creature with a foul smell hatches in the village, attracting Gargamel's nose.

episodes.title: The Tear Of A Smurf
episodes.description: An ugly hag is turned into a beautiful princess when some captured Smurfs shed some tears for her.

episodes.title: The Miracle Smurfer
episodes.description: An impish charlatan tricks the Smurfs into giving him all their possessions to trade for his miracle tonic.

episodes.title: The Smurf Who Would Be King
episodes.description: Dreamy dreams of being stranded in the kingdom of the Pookies, where he is king and must use his secret weapon against the Norf Nags.

episodes.title: How To Smurf A Rainbow
episodes.description: Gargamel's in search for gold when the Smurfs create an incomplete rainbow.

episodes.title: Smurfette For A Day
episodes.description: Hefty becomes a drag queen for a troll king.

episodes.title: Peewit Meets Bigmouth
episodes.description: Peewit accidentally turns a young bratty prince into a chicken. And even worse, Bigmouth feels like having chicken tonight...chicken soup, that is!

episodes.title: Lumbering Smurfs
episodes.description: Clockwork helps the Smurfs protect King Gerard's forest from a rogue band of loggers.

episodes.title: Handy's Sweetheart
episodes.description: Handy falls in love with a mermaid seeking help for her ailing father.

episodes.title: Speak For Yourself, Farmer Smurf
episodes.description: Farmer poses himself as another Smurf to get the amorous attention of Smurfette.

episodes.title: A Hovel Is Not A Home
episodes.description: Gargamel tries to capture Smurfs with the help of his Great Book of Spells in order to buy himself a bigger home.

episodes.title: Forget-Me-Smurfs
episodes.description: An early-blooming flower on an early-breaking spring day causes the Smurfs to forget when the village dam is about to burst.

episodes.title: The Grumpy Gremlin
episodes.description: A gourmet gremlin with a foul-smelling concoction seeks a new home when Peewit accidentally chops down his tree.

episodes.title: Clumsy Luck
episodes.description: Clumsy proves how lucky he really is when he escapes a meteor that crashed into his house.

episodes.title: Willpower Smurfs
episodes.description: Jokey tests his fellow Smurfs' ability to resist temptation, and later Gargamel's when Harmony is captured.

episodes.title: Baby Smurf Is Missing
episodes.description: A couple of poachers kidnap Baby Smurf, thinking that he is a leprechaun.

episodes.title: The Smurfs' Time Capsule
episodes.description: A druid that escapes captivity from a tree seeks out Papa Smurf when his moonrock amulet is stolen.

episodes.title: Wedding Bells For Gargamel
episodes.description: Gargamel accepts the courtship of a beautiful princess to get at her hope chest, which contains a map to the Smurf Village.

episodes.title: To Smurf A Thief
episodes.description: Papa Smurf helps Homnibus clear the name of a young boy accused of stealing.

episodes.title: Greedy And The Porridge Pot
episodes.description: Greedy borrows a magical porridge pot that buries the village in mush when Brainy gets a hold of it.

episodes.title: Harmony Steals The Show
episodes.description: Papa Smurf goes to trial to dispute the origin of Harmony's ""ghostwritten"" symphony.

episodes.title: The Golden Smurf Award
episodes.description: Hogatha transforms herself into a trophy to get some Smurfs for her beauty regimen.

episodes.title: The Moor's Baby
episodes.description: The Smurfs must solve an algebra problem to free the Tooth Fairy and ease the teething pains of both Baby Smurf and a   visiting moor's baby.

episodes.title: Hefty's Heart
episodes.description: Can Hefty find it in his heart to cure himself of the ""yellow hate disease""?

episodes.title: A Hug For Grouchy
episodes.description: Grouchy bravely embraces a pixie under Chlorhydris' spell to break the power of the Wand of Ice.

episodes.title: The Magic Rattle
episodes.description: A magic baby rattle falls into Baby Smurf's hands and an evil fairy wants it.

episodes.title: All Hallows' Eve
episodes.description: Lazy is accidentally turned red by Mother Nature's autumn wand in preparation for Halloween and Jokey's birthday.

episodes.title: The Littlest Witch
episodes.description: The Smurfs befriend a young witch, teaching her to do good, while stopping a bad witch by causing her to lose her powers for a year.

episodes.title: April Smurf's Day
episodes.description: Gargamel plays a trick of his own on the Smurfs by disguising himself as a smurfberry bush.

episodes.title: The Magic Stick
episodes.description: Papa Smurf's magic stick that teleports things or cleans up things gets lost when Bigmouth starts chomping down their   smurfberry bushes.

episodes.title: Baby's First Christmas
episodes.description: A Christmas-time special featuring the Smurfs! Baby Smurf is all set to enjoy the wonder and delight of her very own first Christmas. Then, the evil Chlorhydrus puts a nasty spell on Mr. Nicholas to keep him from spreading his holiday cheer. Fortunately, the resourceful Papa Smurf isn't about to take this sort of thing sitting down. Sending out a call for hrlp, he ralies his little blue buddies to help break the mean-spirited spell. Now, they're embarking on a Smurfish campaign to ensure that the joyful message of Christmas cheer and goodwill once again rings across the land!

episodes.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
episodes.description: Periwinkle, the perfection-minded pixie, finds a kindred spirit in Vanity.

episodes.title: Wolf In Peewit's Clothing
episodes.description: An evil wizard turns Peewit into a werewolf to capture some Smurfs to get Smurf sweat.

episodes.title: A Bell For Azrael
episodes.description: Brainy's brilliant idea to put a bell on Azrael is used against the Smurfs when Gargamel puts his spell on the bell.

episodes.title: The Chief Record Smurf
episodes.description: A lab accident gives Clumsy photographic memory, and Gargamel erases it with his babble bath.

episodes.title: Smurfing In Sign Language
episodes.description: Laconia the mute wood elf teaches a magically soundless Poet the wonders of signing.

episodes.title: A Chip Off The Old Smurf
episodes.description: Everybody contemplates Baby Smurf's future while a locust infestation attacks the forest.

episodes.title: A Gift For Papa's Day
episodes.description: Papa Smurf tries to discreetly dispose a gift hat that he doesn't like wearing.

episodes.title: Good Neighbor Smurf
episodes.description: Brainy proves himself to be a poor roommate when he has to bunk with someone else.

episodes.title: The Smurfstone Quest
episodes.description: Handy, Hefty, and Lazy team up to find a crystal with healing powers.

episodes.title: Hats Off To Smurfs
episodes.description: Vanity finds a new hat that disfigures his face when he splashes water on himself.

episodes.title: The Noble Stag
episodes.description: Oh, ""deer""...Malcolm the Mean has turned King Gerard into a black stag.

episodes.title: Smurfy Acres
episodes.description: Gargamel lures the Smurfs into another Smurf Village with the help of his Great Book of Spells.

episodes.title: No Time for Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs engage in athletic competition to settle a dispute between both ends of the village over misquoted compound words, which turns deadly when the medal Clumsy is awarded actually causes an earthquake.

episodes.title: Smurfily Ever After
episodes.description: Smurfette contemplates over who she would like to marry someday while the Smurfs help prepare for the wedding of Laconia   and Woody, but Gargamel shows up to ruin this joyous occasion with his ghoulish calliope.

episodes.title: No Time for Smurfs
episodes.description: A few Smurfs cause all time to stop when they accidentally break Father Time's hourglass.

episodes.title: Symbols Of Wisdom
episodes.description: Brainy and Gargamel grow magical beards in order to gain respect.

episodes.title: Blue Eyes Returns
episodes.description: Smurfette's orange horse friend returns when Gargamel floods the forest with magic beans.

episodes.title: Secret Of The Village Well
episodes.description: Everyone in the village is wondering what Clumsy's secret wish is.

episodes.title: Stop And Smurf The Roses
episodes.description: Chlorhydris abducts Laconia and tries to kill her by killing off all her flowers.

episodes.title: The Gingerbread Smurfs
episodes.description: Brainy loses big time to Greedy in a bake-off when his magically-created gingerbread cookies come to life and take over the village.

episodes.title: Jokey's Shadow
episodes.description: Jokey's shadow comes to life and causes trouble for him.

episodes.title: Jokey's Funny Bone
episodes.description: Jokey gets more attention than he deserves when he claims he lost his funny bone.

episodes.title: Tick Tock Smurfs
episodes.description: Brainy's new time schedule has the Smurfs rushing through their day, and it's making them feel stressed out.

episodes.title: The Master Smurf
episodes.description: A magic crown turns Greedy into a mind-controlling tyrant, and Papa Smurf must find the other crown to get Greedy to lose   his.

episodes.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
episodes.description: Brainy puts Tailor's clothesmaking skills to the test when his magical needle starts sticking it to the other Smurfs.

episodes.title: The Traveler
episodes.description: A mysterious traveler from the east comes to calm the rage of a magical dragon.

episodes.title: A Pet For Baby Smurf
episodes.description: Baby Smurf's glowing darling becomes a ghoulish danger.

episodes.title: The Incredible Shrinking Wizard
episodes.description: A polluted muck pond causes Gargamel to shrink without limit, and only doing good deeds can restore him to normal.

episodes.title: Breakfast At Greedy's
episodes.description: Lighter-than-air pancakes causes the Smurfs to float uncontrollably.

episodes.title: The Secret Of Shadow Swamp
episodes.description: Grouchy tries to escape from his birthday with an adventurous troll.

episodes.title: The Trojan Smurf
episodes.description: Gargamel hides inside a giant hollow statue of Papa Smurf to lure the Smurfs into taking him into the village.

episodes.title: Smurf The Other Cheek
episodes.description: Dot, dot, who's nose got the spot? An unfriendly game of kick-tag is afoot

episodes.title: A Float Full Of Smurfs
episodes.description: Gargamel and Azrael disguise themselves as rabbits for the Smurfs' autumn festival parade.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Sweet Tooth
episodes.description: Her insatiable appetite for sweets gets out of control when her very touch turns everything into candy.

episodes.title: Smurf On Wood
episodes.description: Take one toad, put Papa Smurf's cap on him, throw in a bunch of superstitious Smurfs who think it's a result of Papa Smurf making a wish at a magic tree, plus one wizard in search of that toad.

episodes.title: The Smurfomatic Smurfolator
episodes.description: Handy builds his dream machine, which he uses against the tall weeds growing in the village.

episodes.title: Petrified Smurfs
episodes.description: Peewit must get Selwyn and Tallulah to work together to reverse a spell that turned half the forest and the Smurf Village into stone before dawn.

episodes.title: Papa's Worrywarts
episodes.description: A young wartless Wartmonger comes of age when a warted Papa Smurf passes his ""worry warts"" onto him.

episodes.title: Lazy's Slumber Party
episodes.description: The Smurfs give Lazy a sleepless night he would rather forget.

episodes.title: The Pussywillow Pixies
episodes.description: A lone Pixie befriends a Smurf lost in Pussywillow Hollow, and with the help of the other Smurfs they rescue her friends from being captured by the Wartmongers

episodes.title: The Bignose Dilemma
episodes.description: Bignose, Gargamel, and Vanity magically switch noses.

episodes.title: The Smurfbox Derby
episodes.description: A race from the top of the mountain falls flat when Gargamel arrives to steamroller the competition.

episodes.title: A Circus For Baby
episodes.description: Hefty loses his fear of heights with the help of an elephant when he rescues Baby Smurf.

episodes.title: Babies In Wartland
episodes.description: Baby Smurf finds himself on the throne with King Bullrush.

episodes.title: The Smurfwalk Cafe
episodes.description: Handy and Greedy are in a dispute over who should get the credit for their accidental co-creation of a new frozen dessert.

episodes.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
episodes.description: Brainy learns to value his friendship with Clumsy when he helps Brainy escape being held prisoner by an ungrateful admirer.

episodes.title: Never Smurf Off 'Til Tomorrow
episodes.description: Handy accuses Lazy of slacking off on the job when a hurricane carries them and several other Smurfs off into an erupting   volcano, but Lazy manages to redeem himself.

episodes.title: Bigmouth Smurf
episodes.description: He's big! He's blue! He thinks he's a Smurf! And what's worse, he's Bigmouth!

episodes.title: Baby's Enchanted Didey
episodes.description: A fragment of Gargamel's magic cloth becomes a new diaper that lets Baby Smurf fly.

episodes.title: The Man In The Moon
episodes.description: The Smurfs convince the Moon Man of his importance when he takes an unexpected vacation.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Golden Tresses
episodes.description: Hogatha wants natural blond hair like Smurfette's, so she captures Smurfette and forces her to cut her hair.

episodes.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
episodes.description: Smurfette's gift of gab really makes a mess of things when Gargamel casts a lying spell on her.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Giant
episodes.description: Gargamel uses smurfberries as a substitute for choke cherries to bring a giant to life.

episodes.title: The Patchwork Bear
episodes.description: The Smurfs help an animated teddy bear find courage when his princess is held prisoner.

episodes.title: Hefty And The Wheelsmurfer
episodes.description: Hefty regains his confidence in the face of disability when he tries out Handy's invention.

episodes.title: Hopping Cough Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs must find the hopping crane to cure themselves of a bouncing disease.

episodes.title: The Little Orange Horse With The Gold Shoes
episodes.description: Smurfette befriends a magical flying horse who lost his shoe sliding down a rainbow.

episodes.title: Monster Smurfs
episodes.description: A magically deformed Smurfette befriends a treestump monster.

episodes.title: The Bad Place
episodes.description: Muddy aliens have landed in the village, and the Smurfs learn to live with them as they seek help to repair their ship.

episodes.title: Smurfing For Ghost's
episodes.description: There's something strange in the neighborhood of Quarrel Castle. Who does Peewit the house-sitter call? Brainy and Clumsy.

episodes.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
episodes.description: Selwyn and Tallulah's pet gargoyle finds friends in the Smurf Village and accidentally sets loose a three-headed hydra.

episodes.title: Smurfiplication
episodes.description: Gargamel uses a multiplying machine on Brainy to get his six Smurfs for making gold.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Misfortune
episodes.description: A pair of charlatan gypsies help the Smurfs rescue Smurfette and Dreamy from Gargamel, who tricks the gypsies with a bag of painted rocks.

episodes.title: Stuck On Smurfs
episodes.description: Togetherness isn't always a good thing when Gargamel makes all the Smurfs get really attached to each other.

episodes.title: Puppy
episodes.description: Hominbus' magical puppy arrives in the village with a magic locket.

episodes.title: Papa's Day Off
episodes.description: Homibus gives Papa Smurf the chance to see how the other Smurfs would handle an emergency situation if he wasn't there.

episodes.title: The Smurflings
episodes.description: Natural, Snappy, and Slouchy get a second childhood with the help of Father Time.

episodes.title: He Who Smurfs Last
episodes.description: Chlorhydris causes all the Smurfs except for Papa Smurf and Baby Smurf to lose their sense of humor.

episodes.title: Baby's First Word
episodes.description: What can possibly ruin a joyous occasion like this? Baby Smurf can say that in one word.

episodes.title: The Masked Pie Smurfer
episodes.description: Jokey lets the custard fly as a masked prankster.

episodes.title: Sassette
episodes.description: The Smurflings create a female counterpart for themselves and a sister for Smurfette.

episodes.title: Papa's Puppy Prescription
episodes.description: Puppy gets a warm nose while Papa Smurf gets a cold nose.

episodes.title: Poet's Writer's Block
episodes.description: Poet finds new inspiration under pressure when he has to write a poem for a princess.

episodes.title: Smurf A Mile In My Shoes
episodes.description: Jokey learns a lesson in humility when he comes to the aid of a tortured sand troll that he teased.

episodes.title: Dreamy's Pen Pals
episodes.description: Dreamy realizes that the Swoofs aren't real at the same time a real alien pays him a visit.

episodes.title: Papa's Flying Bed
episodes.description: An evil spell cast by Gargamel on Papa Smurf's new bed causes him and some other Smurfs to fly off to new adventures.

episodes.title: Mud Wrestling Smurfs
episodes.description: Clumsy steps into the ring against the Wartmongers while Papa Smurf plans an escape.

episodes.title: The Sand Witch
episodes.description: A lonely witch learns to appreciate her friendship with a sea monster when he shows up with Baby Smurf.

episodes.title: Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow
episodes.description: Smurfette escapes from the Wartmongers with the help of Puppy.

episodes.title: Bigmouth's Friend
episodes.description: Bigmouth comes to the aid of Clockwork when Gargamel and Lord Balthasar's mechanical menace attacks King Gerard's castle.

episodes.title: Wild And Wooly
episodes.description: Wooly and the Smurflings help protect a flock of sheep in exchange for wool.

episodes.title: The Dark-Ness Monster
episodes.description: Brainy loses his glasses and finds himself relying on Clumsy.

episodes.title: The Grouchiest Game In Town
episodes.description: Grouchy plays to win against the Games Master in a game where his fellow Smurfs are the pawns.

episodes.title: Queen Smurfette
episodes.description: Smurfette's reign as queen for the day raises a ruckus when Father Time forgets to end the day.

episodes.title: Marco Smurf And The Pepper Pirates
episodes.description: A brave seafaring Smurf gets himself in trouble with pepper pirates.

episodes.title: Educating Bigmouth
episodes.description: The Smurfs help Bigmouth win back the heart of Bignose.

episodes.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All The Animals
episodes.description: Brainy proves himself to be a role model to young Natural.

episodes.title: The Comet Is Coming
episodes.description: A torn message from Papa Smurf makes the Smurfs mistakenly believe that the world is coming to an end when a rare comet passes by

episodes.title: Happy Unhappiness Day To You
episodes.description: Gargamel unsuccessfully searches for Smurfs on a day of emotional cleansing.

episodes.title: The Great Slime Crop Failure
episodes.description: The Wartmongers kidnap Farmer and the Smurflings in order to help restore their slime crops.

episodes.title: Papa's Family Album
episodes.description: Papa Smurf recounts his first adventure with his little Smurfs to the Smurflings.

episodes.title: Love Those Smurfs
episodes.description: Chlorhydris casts a spell on the Smurfs that makes them love only themselves, and a few Smurfs must deliver humble pie to restore their love for each other.

episodes.title: Mutiny On The Smurf
episodes.description: The Smurflings prove themselves to be a capable crew of the S.S. Smurf when Brainy and a few others are accidentally cast away en route to rescue some other Smurfs captured by an evil king musician.

episodes.title: Things That Go Smurf In The Night
episodes.description: Can Snappy make it through the night sleeping without his teddy bear?

episodes.title: Alarming Smurfs
episodes.description: Too many alarms bug the sanity of the Smurfs while the Smurflings run away from the village.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Rose
episodes.description: Smurfette's desire to see a blue rose causes her to smell like a rose.

episodes.title: The Mr. Smurf Contest
episodes.description: Gargamel transforms himself into a Smurf to enter a contest to be Smurfette's escort at a dance.

episodes.title: Have You Smurfed Your Pet Today?
episodes.description: The Smurflings abandon their duty to feed Puppy when they get caught up in Handy's stringaling craze, causing Puppy to be captured by Gargamel.

episodes.title: Unsound Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurflings and Baby Smurf search for a sound to break the magical barrier around the village.

episodes.title: All Work And No Smurf
episodes.description: Brainy overworks the adult Smurfs on their day off, causing unusual transformations.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Time Trip
episodes.description: Gargamel steals Father Time's hourglass and goes back in time to destroy the Smurfs.

episodes.title: They're Smurfing Our Song
episodes.description: Gargamel alters Woody's panpipe to play an evil tune, but Sassette restores its happy tunes by admitting her love for her ""creator"".

episodes.title: Brainy's Smarty Party
episodes.description: The Smurflings host their own Outcast Party, which makes Brainy's party seem like the Communist Party.

episodes.title: Smurfquest (1)
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf returns to the village from a 500-year voyage around the world to restore the power of the Long Life Force Stone. Papa Smurf and a few other Smurfs help Grandpa Smurf find the purest sources of the four primal elements from around the world while the remaining Smurfs stay behind to search for the Long Life Force Stone.

episodes.title: Smurfquest (2)
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf returns to the village from a 500-year voyage around the world to restore the power of the Long Life Force Stone. Papa Smurf and a few other Smurfs help Grandpa Smurf find the purest sources of the four primal elements from around the world while the remaining Smurfs stay behind to search for the Long Life Force Stone.

episodes.title: Smurfquest (3)
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf returns to the village from a 500-year voyage around the world to restore the power of the Long Life Force Stone. Papa Smurf and a few other Smurfs help Grandpa Smurf find the purest sources of the four primal elements from around the world while the remaining Smurfs stay behind to search for the Long Life Force Stone.

episodes.title: Smurfquest (4)
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf returns to the village from a 500-year voyage around the world to restore the power of the Long Life Force Stone. Papa Smurf and a few other Smurfs help Grandpa Smurf find the purest sources of the four primal elements from around the world while the remaining Smurfs stay behind to search for the Long Life Force Stone.

episodes.title: Gargamel's New Job
episodes.description: Gargamel moves in as Prince Theodore's new sorceror while the Smurfs visit the prince.

episodes.title: Grouchy Makes A Splash
episodes.description: Grouchy loses his fear of swimming when he sees Baby Smurf being kidnapped by Gargamel in a duck suit.

episodes.title: No Smurf Is An Island
episodes.description: Handy designs a submarine so that he could visit Marina the Mermaid.

episodes.title: Don Smurfo
episodes.description: Jokey's masquerade as Smurfette's storybook hero Don Smurfo puts him at risk when he has to confront Azrael to prove himself.

episodes.title: The Prince And The Hopper
episodes.description: Smurfette falls in love with a prince who's been turned into a frog by an evil wizard.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Gift
episodes.description: Smurfette's nose for finding out her birthday presents makes her part of an imp's collection.

episodes.title: The Most Popular Smurf
episodes.description: Scruple puts a spell on Jokey that makes all his gag giftboxes contain actual gifts.

episodes.title: A Loss Of Smurf
episodes.description: A suggested beauty regimen turns Vanity into a blue Wartmonger.

episodes.title: The Last Whippoorwill
episodes.description: The Smurfs must rescue the last whippoorwill egg before insects totally invade the forest.

episodes.title: The Color Smurfy
episodes.description: The Smurflings and Grandpa Smurf seek to restore color to a monochrome world by finding the right color in a spectrum pool to restore life to a color sprite.

episodes.title: Lazy's Nightmare
episodes.description: Morphio is using the Smurfs' worst fears to trap them in their dreams, but Lazy finds out how to fight back against those fears.

episodes.title: All The Smurf's A Stage
episodes.description: Timid portrays several different Smurfs to prove his acting ability to Poet.

episodes.title: Smurfs On Wheels
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf, Papa Smurf, and Nat prove getting to Dreamy Steamy Springs on foot is more than half the fun when Handy takes his fellow Smurfs on a wild ride in his camper.

episodes.title: The Littlest Viking
episodes.description: Peewit does prove himself worthy of being a Viking warrior by facing the Stone King.

episodes.title: Baby's New Toy
episodes.description: Baby loses all interest in his current toys, but the Toymaker has lost his interest in making toys. Now the Smurfs need to cheer up both.

episodes.title: Bringing Up Bigfeet
episodes.description: The Smurflings get more practice in babysitting than they ask for when they offer to watch after Bigmouth's nephew.

episodes.title: The Scarlet Croaker
episodes.description: Sassette, who's accidentally captured by a young Wartmonger she befriends, later finds herself and her fellow Smurfs rescued by a mysterious heroic Wartmonger.

episodes.title: Calling Dr. Smurf
episodes.description: Dabbler devotes himself to the study of medicine.

episodes.title: Can't Smurf The Music
episodes.description: Chlorhydris tries to take the music out of the Smurfs by doing away with the notes.

episodes.title: The Royal Drum
episodes.description: Princess Amani from Africa visits King Gerard, and her royal drum attracts the attention of a couple of thieves.

episodes.title: It's A Puppy's Life
episodes.description: Gargamel switches bodies with Puppy and starts making off with the Smurfs.

episodes.title: Sweepy Smurf
episodes.description: A not-so-popular chimney cleaning Smurf gets his due when he rescues Baby Smurf from a burning house.

episodes.title: Journey To The Center Of The Smurf
episodes.description: Miner finds a new way to keep the Smurfs warm all winter when he discovers ""dirty rocks"".

episodes.title: The Tallest Smurf
episodes.description: Gourdy the Genie makes Slouchy the tallest Smurf by shrinking the others to ant-size.

episodes.title: Essence Of Brainy
episodes.description: Brainy has lost his personality, and three of his fellow Smurfs have too much of his.

episodes.title: Dr. Evil And Mr. Nice
episodes.description: Scruple gives Gargamel a magic-induced split personality.

episodes.title: The Root Of Evil
episodes.description: Chlorhydris unleashes a destructive root that turns whoever it touches evil.

episodes.title: Tattle Tail Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurflings learn never to tell lies when their tails start to grow.

episodes.title: Greedy Goes On Strike
episodes.description: An unappreciated Greedy finds new appreciation with a gnome king, who ends up taking advantage of Greedy's talents and ignoring his son.

episodes.title: Future Smurfed
episodes.description: Lord Balthazar creates a rip in the fabric of reality with Father Time's scythe, releasing a baby dinosaur from the past.

episodes.title: Crying Smurfs
episodes.description: Hefty learns that even a tough Smurf like him is never too tough to cry.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Dummy
episodes.description: Jokey's puppet of Gargamel comes to life and carries out the real Gargamel's evil will.

episodes.title: Smurfs On The Run
episodes.description: Gargamel and Sassette upset the balance of truth and deceit, and it's up to the both of them to reset the balance.

episodes.title: A Myna Problem
episodes.description: A myna bird unwittingly protects the Smurfs from Gargamel by repeating a spell that turns them into ducks.

episodes.title: The Horn Of Plenty
episodes.description: The Smurfs travel to the Land Of Plenty to get some of the legendary cornucopia.

episodes.title: I Smurf To The Trees
episodes.description: Gargamel makes all the trees come to life and they decide to leave the forest.

episodes.title: Clumsy's Cloud
episodes.description: Clumsy brings a little cloud of misfortune into the village which really needs a silver lining.

episodes.title: Bookworm Smurf
episodes.description: The world ceases to function when Sassette wishes all the books in the world to disappear.

episodes.title: Farmer's Genie
episodes.description: Farmer encounters Gourdy the Genie in his garden, who makes a mess of things but is allowed to stay in the village anyway.

episodes.title: Master Scruple
episodes.description: Gourdy the Genie finds a temporary new master with Gargamel's apprentice.

episodes.title: Scruple's Sweetheart
episodes.description: Scruple breaks Brenda's heart when he and Gargamel fight over her magic wand at the Broomstick Ball.

episodes.title: The World According To Smurflings
episodes.description: The Smurflings learn about the balance of nature when they misuse Mother Nature's wand.

episodes.title: The Enchanted Quill
episodes.description: Gargamel's after a magic quill that never makes mistakes to draw up a map of the Smurf Village, so Papa Smurf creates a magic quill that goofs up and switches it for the real quill.

episodes.title: The Most Unsmurfy Games
episodes.description: The Wartmongers are using the Smurfs as prey in their hunting game.

episodes.title: Put Upon Puppy
episodes.description: Puppy learns to be obedient when he rescues the Smurfs from Gargamel.

episodes.title: Heart Of Gold
episodes.description: Clockwork rocks the village when Gargamel replaces his heart of gold with a heart of stone.

episodes.title: The Village Vandal
episodes.description: A super-hungry termite causes destruction in the village, and the Smurflings are blamed for it.

episodes.title: The Gallant Smurf
episodes.description: Hogatha turns herself into a Grandma Smurfette in order to capture Grandpa Smurf and present her to the mother of a prince as something she's never seen before.

episodes.title: Sassette's Tooth
episodes.description: Gargamel poses himself as the Tooth Fairy to capture the Smurfs when Sassette loses her tooth.

episodes.title: Snappy's Way
episodes.description: Snappy turns the ""doe-ray-me"" spell back on the troll that cast it on him when he accidentally buries his fellow Smurfs under an avalanche with his selfishness.

episodes.title: Fire Fighting Smurfs
episodes.description: Snappy has a fit of conscience when he finds himself caring for wounded animals from a forest fire he accidentally created.

episodes.title: Handy's Window-Vision
episodes.description: A crystal that transmits images to dozens of smaller crystals turns the Smurfs into ""window-vision"" watching stool potatoes.

episodes.title: Papa Smurf, Papa Smurf
episodes.description: Papa Smurf and Gargamel are accidentally doubled, and must find some way to pull themselves (and the entire village) together.

episodes.title: Jokey's Cloak
episodes.description: Jokey finds an invisibility cloak and uses it to play jokes on the others. But, a side effect of the cloak makes Jokey invisible, and the Smurfs must travel to the Creepy Deepy Swamp to reverse the spell.

episodes.title: Papa's Last Spell
episodes.description: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa Smurf that blocks his ability to use magic.

episodes.title: Lure Of The Orb
episodes.description: Poet, Handy, and Painter fall under the hypnotic lure of a magic orb that gives the illusion of heightened inspiration.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Flowers
episodes.description: A pushy sentient flower learns to respect Smurfette's kindness when it takes advantage of her.

episodes.title: Reckless Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs totally redefine ""extreme sports"" when Gargamel puts a daredevil spell on them.

episodes.title: Head Over Hogatha
episodes.description: Cupid gives Hogatha a case of lovesickness and she falls for Gargamel, but Gargamel just wants to use her to get to the Smurfs.

episodes.title: Smurf On The Wild Side (1)
episodes.description: The Smurfs encounter a loincloth-wearing Smurf in the forest, who turns out to be an infant lost in the forest 150 years ago and raised by squirrels.

episodes.title: Smurf On The Wild Side (2)
episodes.description: The Smurfs encounter a loincloth-wearing Smurf in the forest, who turns out to be an infant lost in the forest 150 years ago and raised by squirrels.

episodes.title: The Smurflings' Unsmurfy Friend
episodes.description: The Smurfs encounter a loincloth-wearing Smurf in the forest, who turns out to be an infant lost in the forest 150 years ago and raised by squirrels.

episodes.title: The Smurfstalker
episodes.description: The Smurfs encounter a loincloth-wearing Smurf in the forest, who turns out to be an infant lost in the forest 150 years ago and raised by squirrels.

episodes.title: Poltersmurf
episodes.description: A wood sprite gets the Smurflings in trouble with all of his practical jokes.

episodes.title: Baby's Marvelous Toy
episodes.description: A bounty hunter is terrorizing the Smurfs.

episodes.title: Sleepless Smurfs
episodes.description: Smurf Village is taken over by little troublesome spirits that were let loose.

episodes.title: Cut-Up Smurfs
episodes.description: Baby's new wishing toy has Gargamel very interested.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Sweetheart
episodes.description: Insomnia takes a hold over the Smurfs thanks to Morphio and Gargamel.

episodes.title: Wild About Smurfette
episodes.description: A magic piece of paper used by Sassette for her paper dolls provides life for them as well.

episodes.title: Sing a Song of Smurflings
episodes.description: Gragamel falls in love with the evil witch Evelyn, but she is only using him to get to the Smurfs.

episodes.title: Smurfing for Gold
episodes.description: Wild Smurf has captured Smurfette's attention, much to the chagrin of the other Smurfs.

episodes.title: Jokey's Joke Book
episodes.description: ""Music hath charms to soothe the savage beast"". The Smurflings prove this with a wild creature.

episodes.title: Poet's Storybook
episodes.description: Jokey's trick with gold-painted rocks causes Gargamel to get in trouble with his debtor.

episodes.title: The Fastest Wizard In The World
episodes.description: If Jokey Smurf isn't surprising people with gift boxes, he's doing it with a joke bag.

episodes.title: Dancing Bear
episodes.description: Natural Smurf wants to learn how to dance and while attending Brainy's school of Dance, they have a encounter with a dancing bear who has escaped from the evil Malakov.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Last Will
episodes.description: Scruple manages to convince Gargamel that he is going to turn into a dog after a encounter with what appears to be a rabid puppy.

episodes.title: Sassette's Bewitching Friendship
episodes.description: A dancing bear escapes from the circus and the Smurflings are made into an act against their wills.

episodes.title: Azrael's Brain
episodes.description: Gargamel thinks he'll turn into a dog by midnight when Puppy bites him, so he steals Lord Balthazar's sensor crown to capture the Smurfs before he does change.

episodes.title: Castaway Smurfs
episodes.description: A bumbling witch named Melina proves her worth when Gargamel is on the rampage.

episodes.title: Legendary Smurfs
episodes.description: Azrael proves that he is smarter than Gargamel thinks he is.

episodes.title: Smurfing The Unicorns
episodes.description: Puppy is poisoned by tainted water and Papa Smurf discovers that he can only be cured by a unicorn.

episodes.title: Vanity's Closest Friend
episodes.description: Vanity gets full of himself while the Smurfs are helping him build a shed and he goes out into the forest where he meets a imp named Winky who becomes his new best friend. The Smurfs then have to find a way to get the Imp off Vanity. While searching for Impweed, they then have a run in with Gargamel who is up to his usual tricks.

episodes.title: Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure
episodes.description: Puppy is poisoned and Grandpa Smurf seeks for a rare unicorn's horn.

episodes.title: Nobody Smurf
episodes.description: Vanity's looks has finally got him an admirer. Now to get rid of the admirer....

episodes.title: Scruple And The Great Book Of Spells
episodes.description: Peewit's party at the castle is ruined by a chamberlain.

episodes.title: Bouncing Smurf
episodes.description: Nobody Smurf tries his best to be somebody.

episodes.title: The Clockwork Smurfette
episodes.description: Scruple becomes a great wizard using Gargamel's book, a little too great when he freezes the entire forest.

episodes.title: I Was A Brainy Weresmurf
episodes.description: Clumsy gets trapped in a rubber tree sap drop.

episodes.title: The Answer Smurf
episodes.description: Hey, if the Smurfs can have a female counterpart, why can't Clockwork have a female companion too? That's exactly what Handy makes.

episodes.title: Vanity's Wild Adventure
episodes.description: Brainy turns into a weresmurf due to a wolfbane scratch.

episodes.title: Soothsayer Smurfette
episodes.description: While everyone is acting like Brainy Smurf, it's up to Slouchy to take care of the village.

episodes.title: Crooner Smurf
episodes.description: Vanity and Wild Smurf find out that they have totally different ways of life when they spend the night together.

episodes.title: Papa For a Day
episodes.description: Smurfette unknowingly gives Baby Smurf a magic fortune teller dress.

episodes.title: Flighty's Plight
episodes.description: Harmony can sing and is a big hit. So big that even Hogatha wants him.

episodes.title: To Coin a Smurf
episodes.description: The Smurfs find out what it is like to be Papa Smurf.

episodes.title: Smurfette Unmade
episodes.description: Flighty learns about strategic decision making.

episodes.title: Sassette's Hive
episodes.description: Gargamel gets Smurfette to go back to the way that he made her to capture the Smurfs.

episodes.title: Little Big Smurf
episodes.description: Gargamel is turned into a bird to capture Smurfs.

episodes.title: Locomotive Smurfs
episodes.description: Sassette is made a Queen Bee.

episodes.title: A Long Tale for Grandpa
episodes.description: Oversized Snappy throws his weight around the village.

episodes.title: Where the Wild Smurfs Are
episodes.description: Handy creates a train for the Smurfs, which Gargamel tries to use against them.

episodes.title: The Magic Sack of Mr. Nicholas
episodes.description: Grandpa's storytelling gets in teh way to saving the Smurf Village from aphids.

episodes.title: Swapping Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs try to save the squirrels from Hogatha.

episodes.title: Predictable Smurfs
episodes.description: Chlorhydris plans to steal toys from Mr. Nicholas in order to bring instant sadness to the world.

episodes.title: Hefty's Rival
episodes.description: The Smurfs fall under the spell of a swapping wizard.

episodes.title: Snappy's Puppet
episodes.description: Clumsy's clumsiness might actually save the Smurfs from the wrath of Gargamel.

episodes.title: Prince Smurf
episodes.description: Wild Smurf and Hefty Smurf get into it over who is the most athletic.

episodes.title: The Return of Don Smurfo
episodes.description: Snappy's new hand puppet seems to have a life of its own.

episodes.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
episodes.description: Hefty is forced to a royal marriage he doesn't really want.

episodes.title: Bad Luck Smurfs
episodes.description: Don Smurfo explores the world outside of his storybook adventure.

episodes.title: Smurfing Out Of Time
episodes.description: Handy and Architect create an apartment which turns out to be a worthless venture.

episodes.title: A Hole In Smurf
episodes.description: Bad luck and misfortune infests on the Smurfs when Gargamel gets a hold of Lady Luck's magic wheel.

episodes.title: Smurf Pet
episodes.description: The Smurfs try to stop time from running out when the River of Time starts drying up.

episodes.title: Timber Smurf
episodes.description: Golf fever hits Smurf Village.

episodes.title: The Smurf Who Could Do No Wrong
episodes.description: The Smurflings find a Nabbit and brings him home, not knowing that he has a BIG appetite.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Lucky Star
episodes.description: A lumberjack proves his worth to the Smurf Village.

episodes.title: The Smurfy Verdict
episodes.description: When Clumsy gets a Do No Harm Charm, everyone gets jealous of him.

episodes.title: Chlorhydris' Lost Love
episodes.description: Smurfette finds a falling star and tries to get it back in the sky.

episodes.title: Stop And Go Smurfs
episodes.description: When Baby Smurf gets lost, Brainy accuses Clumsy of irresponsibility.

episodes.title: Poet The Know-It-All
episodes.description: Chlorhydris tries to ruin all love for the Smurfs when Sassette finds her true weak spot.

episodes.title: All The News That's Fit To Smurf
episodes.description: The Smurfs literally stop in their tracks to help out Painter, but a witch steals the way to make them go again.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Quest
episodes.description: Poet has the power to see into the future.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Second Childhood
episodes.description: Reporter Smurf finds a story on Grandpa Smurf that could really jeopardize him.

episodes.title: 'Tis the Season to Be Smurfy
episodes.description: Gargamel tries to find the Smurf Village with the help of a magic spell.

episodes.title: Gargamel's Second Childhood
episodes.description: Gargamel and Scruple switch ages.

episodes.title: 'Tis the Season to Be Smurfy
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf and Sassette travel to a human village for the Christmas holidays and help out a couple who lives in fear of a thief.

episodes.title: Lost Smurf
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf must save Nanny Smurf, who makes her first appearance here, from a disappearing castle.

episodes.title: Archives of Evil
episodes.description: Nemesis wants Papa Smurf's spellbook, but he ends up getting Greddy's cookbook thanks to Brainy.

episodes.title: Bigmouth's Roommate
episodes.description: Scruple moves in with Bigmouth.

episodes.title: Bungling Babysitters
episodes.description: The Smurfs are all arguing and no notices that Baby Smurf has been kidnapped by Hogatha.

episodes.title: Clockwork's Powerplay
episodes.description: Clockwork Smurf experiences a power overload after being struck by lightning.

episodes.title: Clumsy in Command
episodes.description: Clumsy proves his worth in a mountain hike by saving Brainy.

episodes.title: Don Smurfo's Uninvited Guests
episodes.description: The Smurfs are out of place in Don Smurfo's storybook.

episodes.title: Denisa's Greedy Doll
episodes.description: Gargamel makes Denisa's doll catch Smurfs by his magic.

episodes.title: Denisa's Slumber Party
episodes.description: Sassette goes to Denisa's slumber party.

episodes.title: Grandpa's Nemesis
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf has a face-off with his long time enemy.

episodes.title: Grandpa's Walking Stick
episodes.description: Wild Smurf is afraid of flying but when the Smurfs are about to become trees, he comes to the rescue.

episodes.title: A House For Nanny
episodes.description: The Smurfs help Nanny find a home of her own.

episodes.title: It's A Smurfy Life
episodes.description: Gargamel's at it again, this time using one of Handy's inventions to catch the Smurfs. It's up to Handy to save the day.

episodes.title: Land Of The Lost And Found
episodes.description: Hefty, Handy and Brainy put their own personalities into Scour Smurf so he can find Papa Smurf's telescope.

episodes.title: Long Live Brainy
episodes.description: Just because Brainy is a leader of a group doesn't always mean that he's all that. He has to be a follower as well.

episodes.title: A Maze of Mirrors
episodes.description: Vanity's mirror reflections come to life, much to his horror.

episodes.title: The Memory Melon
episodes.description: Selwynn is given a Memory Melon to try to help him stop quarrelling with Tullulah.

episodes.title: Nanny's Way
episodes.description: Nanny saves the Smurfs from Gargamel and is praised.

episodes.title: Pappy's Puppy
episodes.description: Puppy loses his memory and, even worse, Gargamel uses him to catch the Smurfs.

episodes.title: Shutterbug Smurfs
episodes.description: Thanks to Handy's new camera, Painter might be out of a job as the official painter.

episodes.title: Smoogle Sings The Blues
episodes.description: Smoogle and a raven get into a singing match.

episodes.title: A Smurf For Denisa
episodes.description: Denisa becomes friends with Sassette.

episodes.title: Smurf The Presses
episodes.description: Reporter Smurf thinks that Gargamel has changed his ways when he misunderstands his comments.

episodes.title: Stealing Grandpa's Thunder
episodes.description: Grandpa and Wild Smurf are in danger of being captured in a trap, and Nanny and Smoogle try to trap the man who put up the traps.

episodes.title: The Smurfs That Time Forgot
episodes.description: A baby dinosaur is brought into the present time and the Smurfs try to get him back by a magic key.

episodes.title: Lost in the Ages
episodes.description: While trying to get the dinosaur back, the Smurfs get trapped in time when they lose the key's crystals.

episodes.title: Cave Smurfs
episodes.description: Brainy and Greedy encounter a prehistoric bird.

episodes.title: Hogapatra's Beauty Sleep
episodes.description: In Ancient Egypt, an empress suffers from insomnia and it's up to Lazy to do his thing- sleep so she will get the idea.

episodes.title: Mummy Dearest
episodes.description: Gargamel's Egyptian incarnation puts the Smurfs to work on building a monument for his cat pharoah Azra when they wake up a mummy that saves them.

episodes.title: Shamrock Smurfs
episodes.description: An enchanted stew puts more than a little "Irish spring" into Greedy.

episodes.title: Karate Clumsy
episodes.description: Clumsy does chop-sockey to an evil ninja rat.

episodes.title: Like it or Smurf It
episodes.description: Brainy's version of Double Dare gets dangerous on a volcanic paradise.

episodes.title: Papa's Big Snooze
episodes.description: Papa Smurf goes beddy-bye when a Japanese bug bites him.

episodes.title: A Fish Called Snappy
episodes.description: Snappy does Mr. Limpett when he gets on a water sprite's bad side.

episodes.title: The Smurf Odyssey
episodes.description: The Smurfs help Zeus' feeble son learn the ways of godhood on his quest for the Golden Fleece.

episodes.title: Trojan Smurfs
episodes.description: When in Troy and Smurfette gets captured by an heiress who thinks she's a doll, the Smurfs do what the Greeks did.

episodes.title: Fortune Cookie
episodes.description: Jokey puts some messages of his own inside the fortune cookies.

episodes.title: Imperial Panda-Monium
episodes.description: The Smurfs must rescue a child emperor of China from Gargamel's Oriental self, who wants to usurp the throne.

episodes.title: Smurfette's Green Thumb
episodes.description: Smurfette gets pricked by a magic plant in Babylon and turns whatever she touches into a plant.

episodes.title: Hefty Sees a Serpent
episodes.description: Nobody believes Hefty's story about a serpent until Gargamel's Scottish counterpart captures them.

episodes.title: Phantom Bagpiper
episodes.description: Smurfette becomes a horse jockey to help a Scottish ghost rescue his kidnapped horse.

episodes.title: Jungle Jitterbug
episodes.description: Vanity gets some dance in his pants, which helps bring rain to a South American village.

episodes.title: The Clumsy Genie
episodes.description: Clumsy trades places with a genie in Baghdad, and now he has to cure the Sultan's cold or else!

episodes.title: Scary Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs get turned into monsters after nibbling on a gingerbread house in Germany.

episodes.title: Sky High Surprise
episodes.description: A band of baby bandits in the desert steal the time crystals.

episodes.title: Gnoman Holiday
episodes.description: Julius Geezer of the Gnomans wants Smurfette as his wife, and Lazy has to fight a Gnoman gladiator to save her.

episodes.title: Greedy's Masterpizza
episodes.description: Painter is no longer the only Smurf who can create a "masterpizza!"

episodes.title: The Monumental Grouch
episodes.description: Grouchy has a change of heart in Rome when his likeness is taken for granite.

episodes.title: Curried Smurfs
episodes.description: Gargamel's Far East counterpart finds and sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo.

episodes.title: G'day Smoogle
episodes.description: Does Smoogle find his long-lost cousin Marsupilami down under? Well, actually he finds his own ancestors down under, so who knows?

episodes.title: Grandpa's Fountain of Youth
episodes.description: Grandpa Smurf regains his lost youth in Mexico.

episodes.title: Big Shot Smurfs
episodes.description: Greedy and Brainy are caught up in a civil war between two groups of tiny people off the coast of Spain.

episodes.title: No Reflection On Vanity
episodes.description: Vanity mistakes an icicle for a missing key crystal while the real missing key crystal is about to set adrift into the sea in Antarctica.

episodes.title: Papa Loses His Patience
episodes.description: Is Papa Smurf getting as hot-tempered as those bulls chasing them around in Spain?

episodes.title: Swashbuckling Smurfs
episodes.description: The Smurfs become unwilling shipmates for a parrot pirate.

episodes.title: Painter's Egg-Cellent Adventure
episodes.description: Painter must get a magic chicken in Russia to start laying painted eggs again.

episodes.title: Small-Minded Smurfs
episodes.description: A headhunter in the jungle is doing shrinky-dinks with the Smurfs' heads.

episodes.title: Bananas Over Hefty
episodes.description: An orangutan has got the hots for Hefty.

episodes.title: The Smurfs of the Round Table
episodes.description: It's up to the Smurfs to restore honor to Camelot and wrest control of Excalibur away from Morgan Le Fay.

episodes.title: Wild Goes Cuckoo
episodes.description: A Swiss clockmaker uses Wild Smurf in his next cuckoo clock.

episodes.title: Brainy's Beastly Boo-Boo
episodes.description: An African storytelling stick in Brainy's hands turns his fellow Smurfs into wild animals.

episodes.title: The Golden Rhino
episodes.description: A greedy trader steals both Prince Bakari's golden rhino and a golden Brainy.

episodes.title: Hearts 'N' Smurfs
episodes.description: Gargamel's Dutch doppelganger puts a spell on Brainy that causes all his fellow Smurfs to spread nastiness when they take over Cupid's job.

episodes.title: Off the Baa!
episodes.description: Children's animation set on a remote rural farm. Shaun's flock lives a peaceful life under the watchful eye of their sheepdog Bitzer, but Shaun's insatiable curiosity often leads him into the unlikeliest adventures. A cabbage from a passing truck bounces into the field and Shaun decides to use it as a football, but the pigs are out to spoil the sheep's game.

episodes.title: Bathtime
episodes.description: Children's animation featuring the curious young sheep. The flock does not want to wash in freezing sheep dip, so Shaun hijacks the hot water from the farmer's bathtub.

episodes.title: Shape Up with Shaun
episodes.description: Children's animation set on a remote rural farm. Shirley the sheep has put on weight, so Shaun helps her get in shape with a rigorous exercise regime.

episodes.title: Timmy in a Tizzy
episodes.description: Children's animation. On a remote rural farm, Shaun's flock lives a peaceful life under the watchful eye of their sheepdog Bitzer. But Shaun's insatiable curiosity often leads him into the unlikeliest adventures. When the Farmer takes Timmy's favourite sheep dolly, the little lamb won't stop crying. So Shaun rallies the flock to get it back from Pidsley, the farm cat!

episodes.title: Scrumping
episodes.description: Animation about the adventures of Shaun the Sheep. Shaun's attempts to get his hands on some apples from a tree overhanging the naughty pigs' yard cause trouble.

episodes.title: Still Life
episodes.description: The farmer's turned artist, but will Shaun and pals play along?

episodes.title: Mower Mouth
episodes.description: Goats will eat anything, including the sheep's grass - whilst they look on in horror!

episodes.title: Takeaway
episodes.description: Sheep can't order pizzas, can they? Noone told Shaun and pals, as they strip the scarecrow and head off into town.

episodes.title: Bull
episodes.description: Shaun turns matador when a new addition joins the flock.

episodes.title: Saturday Night Shaun
episodes.description: It's partytime when Shaun finds the farmer's old records, who knew sheep could boogie down?

episodes.title: The Kite
episodes.description: What's more fun than a kite on a windy afternoon? Nothing when Shaun and pals are concerned.

episodes.title: Little Sheep of Horrors
episodes.description: Little lambs shouldn't watch scary movies, as Timmy finds out to his cost.

episodes.title: Buzz off Bees
episodes.description: Something's different around the field, Shaun and the flock decide to investigate.

episodes.title: Fleeced
episodes.description: It's time for a haircut for Shaun and his pals, but is the Farmer really the right man for the job? Not after his first attempt!

episodes.title: Shaun Shoots the Sheep
episodes.description: Shaun finds a camera and sets about taking everyone's photos, whether they want it or not. Are there some prima donnas among the flock?

episodes.title: Big Top Timmy
episodes.description: Little Lamb Timmy joins the circus tonight, but will he make it in show business?

episodes.title: Fetching
episodes.description: With Bitzer head over tails in love with a local lass, can Shaun keep the flock in order?

episodes.title: Mountains Out of Molehills
episodes.description: With the flock in a dancing mood, not even a molehill can spoil their fun... or can it?

episodes.title: Who's the Mummy?
episodes.description: Shaun finds himself out of his depth when newly hatched chicks believe he's their mummy, aw.

episodes.title: Things That go Bump
episodes.description: Strange noises are scaring the flock, Shaun goes to investigate...

episodes.title: Abracadabra
episodes.description: When the Farmer decides to throw out his magic set, Shaun decides to put on a show - but things get out of hand when the flock start disappearing!

episodes.title: Sheep on the Loose
episodes.description: Nearly all the sheep take the bus to the funfair. Shaun and Shirley must convince the Farmer that the flock is out to pasture.

episodes.title: Wash Day
episodes.description: The sheep use the farmer's clotheshorse as a merry-go-round - the garments get dirty and have to be washed before the farmer returns.

episodes.title: The Visitor
episodes.description: When a strange space craft crash-lands on the farm, Shaun and co. help its little green occupant get air-borne again.

episodes.title: Shaun the Farmer
episodes.description: The Farmer is sick in bed, so, with Bitzer playing nurse-maid, it's down to Shaun to handle the daily chores around the farm - with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Tooth Fairy
episodes.description: Bitzer get a terrible tooth pain. Shaun takes the job as dentist but does not succeed. After a successful extraction at the vet Bitzer hope the Tooth Fairy will give him a coin.

episodes.title: Bitzer Puts His Foot in It
episodes.description: The farmer has Bitzer guard some freshly laid concrete - but Shaun and the flock treat it as a Walk of Fame

episodes.title: Hiccups
episodes.description: Shirley drinks Bitzer's lemonade too fast and gets the hiccups. Shaun tries to help with all the usual tricks, and the usual results.

episodes.title: If You Can't Stand the Heat
episodes.description: It is a scorching hot day, and the Flock is desperate to cool down in the Sheep Dip. There's only one thing in their way: the sun-bathing Farmer!

episodes.title: Sheepwalking
episodes.description: It is a peaceful night at the farm, until Shaun starts to walk in his sleep. The Flock cannot resist their natural instinct to follow, and chaos soon ensues.

episodes.title: Tidy Up
episodes.description: The sheep's field is in a mess, and the Farmer tells Bitzer to clean it up - but he makes the mistake of getting Shaun and company to help.

episodes.title: The Farmer's Niece
episodes.description: When the Farmer's Niece comes to stay, Shaun and Bitzer soon discover she isn't as cute and adorable as she seems.

episodes.title: Camping Chaos
episodes.description: An unfriendly camper sets up his tent in the sheep's field. When he goes off exploring, Shaun and the Flock decide to do some exploring of their own.

episodes.title: Helping Hound
episodes.description: The Farmer decides to get a robotic sheep-dog, but when it turns out to be even stricter than Bitzer, Shaun decides it has to go.

episodes.title: Troublesome Tractor
episodes.description: The tractor seems to be ready for the scrap heap and the farmer wishes he could afford to buy a new one. So the sheep overhaul it...

episodes.title: Stick with Me
episodes.description: Bitzer glues the Farmer's broken glasses back together - but when the Flock get their hooves on the tube of glue, things start to get very sticky.

episodes.title: Heavy Metal Shaun
episodes.description: The farmer inspects the lawn with a metal detector. When Shaun and Bitzer try it, they discover a metallic threat behind a hedge.

episodes.title: Snore Worn Shaun
episodes.description: Shirley's snoring is keeping the flock awake, so Shaun decides that the only way to get a peaceful night's sleep is to get her out of the barn.

episodes.title: Shaun Encounters
episodes.description: Two alien kids land at the farm one night and run riot. Can Shaun and Bitzer stop them before they wake the Farmer?

episodes.title: Save the Tree
episodes.description: The Farmer wants to turn the tree in Shaun's field into firewood. So the Flock must take desperate measures to stop their beloved tree getting felled.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.description: When Shaun dresses as the farmer he suddenly has the power to boss Bitzer around, so he decides to throw a party. All goes to plan until Shaun encounters the real farmer...

episodes.title: Draw the Line
episodes.description: The flock hijack a road line-painting machine and cause chaos while creating giant works of art in the field. However, will farmer appreciate their art?

episodes.title: Sheepless Nights
episodes.description: When the sheep's stable's roof is broken, rain leaks in. The sheep try to gain dry land, but the only space they can find is the pig's sty, whom the pigs fart during the big sleep.

episodes.title: Spring Lamb
episodes.description: A reluctant Timmy tries to avoid bath time and in trying to escape he gets a spring attached to his tail. It's up to the flock to catch the bouncing baby sheep and return him to the tub before he destroys the farm.

episodes.title: Strictly No Dancing
episodes.description: The farmer hits the dance floor and attempts to learn how to ballroom dance using Pidsley as his dancing partner. The din they create annoys the sheep so much that Shaun decides to stop them.

episodes.title: Who's the Caddy
episodes.description: The farmer comes across his old golf clubs and decides to knock a few balls around, instantly putting his back out in the process. Shaun takes the opportunity to learn how to play, while Bitzer is forced to tend to his injured master inside the house.

episodes.title: Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow
episodes.description: The farmer gets ready for a date and wants to look his best, so it's time to dust off his prized hairpiece. Shaun can't resist trying the wig on but loses it while showing off to the flock. The race is on as Shaun and Bitzer try to return the wig in time for the farmer's big night.

episodes.title: Bagpipe Buddy
episodes.description: The sheep discover a set of bagpipes on the rubbish dump which they immediately misidentify as a sick emu. They set about trying to nurse it back to health before releasing it back into the wild.

episodes.title: Supersize Timmy
episodes.description: Timmy accidentally eats a tomato grown with Miracle-Grow fertilizer, and expands to become the King Kong of sheep. Shaun must keep the giant toddler out of sight while trying to figure out how to return him to normal size. In the end a Duck eats the growth spurt and grows even bigger than a house.

episodes.title: Lock Out
episodes.description: While preparing for bed, the farmer manages to lock himself out of the house and is stuck outside in his pyjamas. He decides to spend the night in the barn but his incessant snoring drives the flock mad. Shaun concocts a plan to return him to his bed without waking him up.

episodes.title: Cheetah Cheater
episodes.description: A wildlife film inspires Pidsley the cat to play a prank on the flock by disguising himself as a leopard. Shaun is convinced there is a huge beast on the loose and concocts a plan to catch it.

episodes.title: Ewe've Been Framed
episodes.description: Shaun accidentally breaks the farmer's glasses; he and Bitzer have their work cut out trying to prevent their shortsighted master from having mishaps around the farm.

episodes.title: Bitzer's New Hat
episodes.description: The Farmer gives Bitzer a horrible new hat. Bitzer is very upset as he treasured his old hat. The flock rallies round to try to cheer him up with a selection of dashing alternative head gear.

episodes.title: Hide and Squeak
episodes.description: The Farmer is terrorised when a cute mouse appears in the farmhouse and Pidsley the cat is ordered to dispose of the rodent. When the mouse takes refuge in Shaun's fleece, the flock persuade him to protect their new friend from the pitiless cat.

episodes.title: Frantic Romantic
episodes.description: The Farmer trying to impress his new date by cooking a romantic dinner. Unfortunately, the Farmer can't cook and Bitzer is a useless maitre d'. Can Shaun and the flock save the day when they take over the catering behind the scenes?

episodes.title: Everything Must Go
episodes.description: Everything must go when the farmer sets up a stall by the side of the road and leaves Bitzer in charge. The lazy sheepdog soon tires of his role and gives Shaun the job. He proves to be a much better salesman than Bitzer and the flock are only too happy to get stuck in, selling pretty much all the farmer's worldly possessions.

episodes.title: Party Animals
episodes.description: The farmer throws a fancy-dress house party for his birthday. When Bitzer loses all the invitations, however, Shaun saves the day again. Disguised in their own ingenious costumes, the sheep stand in as the guests and have a good old knees-up. But can they fool the farmer into believing he is surrounded by his friends?

episodes.title: Cat Got Your Brain?
episodes.description: Two evil bungling alien scientists transport Pidsley the cat and Shaun aboard their flying saucer. Unfortunately, a foolish error causes the aliens to swap the animals' brains around. Shaun and Pidsley are dumped back to Earth, not realizing they are in the wrong bodies - leading to much confusion around the farm before the aliens return to correct their mistake.At the end, everyone's brains were also swapped.

episodes.title: Two's Company
episodes.description: Shaun is smitten when a bedraggled new sheep lands among the flock. After a wash in the sheep dip, the newcomer turns out to be quite attractive and Shaun immediately falls head over hoof for her. While Bitzer goes on a journey to find her rightful owner, the flock are kept amused by Shaun's romantic antics.

episodes.title: In the Doghouse
episodes.description: Bitzer's kennel is accidentally destroyed by the farmer's tractor crashing into it and the canny canine hopes the farmer will replace it with a new deluxe model. But when he sees his master's clumsy attempt to build a new kennel, Bitzer is so horrified that he packs his bags and leaves home. Shaun, however, hopes to tempt Bitzer to return with the kennel of his dreams. At the first scene, the flock are having a party at the chicken coop.

episodes.title: The Boat
episodes.description: The farmer gets Bitzer to help him renovate an old boat, but as soon as his back is turned the sheep and pigs turn the refurbishment into a swashbuckling game of pirates.

episodes.title: What's Up, Dog?
episodes.description: A wayward balloonist lands in the sheeps field. Shaun and his friends are intrigued by the hot air balloon and inadvertently take to the skies. Down on the ground an ever more desperate Bitzer runs himself ragged attempting to bring the wayward sheep back down to Earth safely.

episodes.title: Cock-a-Doodle Shaun
episodes.description: The cockerel is missing and there's no one to wake up the farm. When Shaun discovers the cockerel has been snatched by the greedy fox, he sets off with Bitzer on a daring rescue mission. Will they get the cockerel back in time to wake up the rest of the farm?

episodes.title: Bitzer's Basic Training
episodes.description: Bitzer thinks The Farmer is planning to replace him, so Shaun helps to knock his friend into shape. Unfortunately Bitzer goes completely over the top with his training regime and starts running the farm with military precision driving everyone crazy.

episodes.title: Chip Off the Old Block
episodes.description: The Farmer has taken up sculpting, but unintentionally drops a huge slab of stone on top of Timmy's teddy. Shaun and the flock must struggle and strain to lift the heavy block and retrieve the precious toy.

episodes.title: Pig Trouble
episodes.description: When Bitzer injures his foot and can't work, the Farmer chooses the pigs to take over his role. The power crazy pigs take the opportunity to turn the farm into a porky paradise - at the sheep's expense. Bitzer tries in vain to warn his master what is going on behind his back, but it's Shaun who steps in and restores the status quo ante.

episodes.title: Bitzer from the Black Lagoon
episodes.description: While trying to retrieve his ball, Bitzer falls into a muddy pond. When Shaun sees a big, blobby, shambling 'thing' squelching across the field, he's convinced they are being attacked by a swamp monster.

episodes.title: Zebra Ducks of the Serengeti
episodes.description: After getting covered in soot, two hapless ducks are mistaken for a pair of rare African Zebra Ducks. Seeing a way to make money, the farmer transforms Shaun's field into an exotic duck enclosure, which he gleefully opens to the public. Shaun doesn't appreciate losing his field and sets about exposing the fraud.

episodes.title: Whistleblower
episodes.description: Bitzer loses his precious whistle and tests out a trumpet as a replacement. Before long, the power of the trumpet goes to his head and his fanfares and jazz styled bugling drives the flock around the bend.

episodes.title: The Big Chase
episodes.description: When Timmy drives off on the farmer's brand new quad bike, Shaun, Bitzer and the flock have to give chase by any means available. Very soon half the animals on the farm have joined in the chase. Can the sheep rescue Timmy and return the quad bike before the farmer finds out?

episodes.title: The Magpie
episodes.description: A magpie has nested in the big tree and is causing chaos by stealing everything around the farm. The magpie's nest soon begins to fill up with loot and Shaun has to come up with a brilliant plan to outwit the burgling bird.

episodes.title: Operation Pidsley
episodes.description: While the farmer is away on a night out, the sheep sneak into the farmhouse for a party.

episodes.title: Pig Swill Fly
episodes.description: The farm is looking spotless and everyone is on their best behaviour when the dreaded farm Inspector pays a visit.

episodes.title: Shirley Whirley
episodes.description: In a bid to help move Shirley around the farm Shaun has the idea of fitting up Shirley with wheels.

episodes.title: Foxy Laddie
episodes.description: A fox arrives at the farm, disguising himself as a handsome ram to infiltrate the flock.

episodes.title: Shaun goes Potty
episodes.description: The sheep have fun with the Farmer's new pool table.

episodes.title: An Ill Wind
episodes.description: The Farmer receives a huge electricity bill and decides to build his own wind turbine to power the farmhouse.

episodes.title: Fireside Favorite
episodes.description: Bitzer has caught a cold and the Farmer decides to tuck him up in the house to recover.

episodes.title: Snowed In
episodes.description: Shaun and his chums awake to find the farm covered in snow!

episodes.title: We Wish Ewe a Merry Christmas
episodes.description: The sheep learn the farmer will be spending Christmas day alone, so the animals decorate the farmhouse to give him a magical time.

episodes.title: The Stand Off
episodes.description: It's breakfast time and The Farmer discovers he has no fresh milk for his morning cup of tea. He sets off in great haste, only to become ensnared in a 'rush hour' traffic jam. Shaun and The Flock are too impatient to wait for breakfast and take matters into their own hands.

episodes.title: The Coconut
episodes.description: The Farmer returns from the fair triumphant - he's won a coconut! He soon discovers getting into the coconut isn't as easy as it seems.

episodes.title: The Shepherd
episodes.description: The farmer enters a shepherd contest to try and earn a trophy. Will Timmy's interfering stop him from winning?

episodes.title: You Missed a Bit
episodes.description: The Farmer expects the windows of his farmhouse to be spotless, so Bitzer calls on the services of The Flock to help him clean them. Will Bitzer be able to clear up the mess before The Farmer returns?

episodes.title: The Crow
episodes.description: Graffitti is appearing around the farm, and The Farmer has given Bitzer the job of removing the painted artwork. But can he eradicate it faster than it appears, and catch the artist in the act?

episodes.title: Shaun the Fugitive
episodes.description: Bitzer rounds up The Flock for bedtime. Alas, a noisy intruder scuppers their plans. The Flock must find an inventive way to get rid of the pest if they are ever going to get a good night's rest.

episodes.title: Hard to Swallow
episodes.description: Shaun is in serious trouble when The Farmer discovers he's the cake thief that's sabotaged his baked goods. When another Farmer arrives and begins negotiations with The Farmer, Shaun fears the worst.

episodes.title: Mission Inboxible
episodes.description: The Flock are delighted when a Bird-watcher drops his duck call in their field and Shaun uses it to entertain them. However, swallowing the duck call isn't what he had in mind - and the ducks aren't too happy either.

episodes.title: Bye Bye Barn
episodes.description: Shaun goes on a secret mission today to retrieve his football from farmer's home.

episodes.title: The Rounders Match
episodes.description: Shaun and The Flock discover that The Farmer has grand plans for their barn - that don't include them! Drastic action is needed if life on the farm is ever going to be the same again!

episodes.title: Film Night
episodes.description: The Flock and The Pigs are playing a high-spirited game of rounders. Shaun steps up to the plate - will he score the winning run? Will the Pigs' foul-play prevent victory? Or will The Farmer discover what they're up to?

episodes.title: Fossils
episodes.description: Bitzer discovers Shaun watching old home movies in the barn.

episodes.title: The Skateboard
episodes.description: Shaun and the Flock help Bitzer discover hidden treasure.

episodes.title: The Piano
episodes.description: Shaun decides he wants to have a go at skateboarding and sets about building a skatepark.

episodes.title: The Snapshot
episodes.description: The Farmer plays the piano and tortures everyone with his musical inability.

episodes.title: Prickly Heat
episodes.description: Shaun is accidentally cut out of the Farmer's family photo.

episodes.title: The Hang Glider
episodes.description: It's a scorching hot day on the farm and the Flock need to cool off. When Bitzer discovers the Sheep Dip is out of action the Flock have to come up with another plan. Meanwhile, the Farmer has his own ideas for cooling off, which don't impress Bitzer at all.

episodes.title: The Shadow Play
episodes.description: The Farmer has a thrilling new hobby - however it's not as easy as it looks! When the Farmer gets stuck in a tree Bitzer comes to his rescue, leaving Shaun and the Flock to get to grips with the airborne contraption.

episodes.title: Bull vs Wool
episodes.description: It's bedtime for Timmy but he's overtired and his Mum can't get him to sleep. Nothing seems to calm him until Shaun accidentally makes a shadow puppet on the wall. Eureka! They put on a puppet show to help Timmy get to sleep. As the drama unfolds the audience see more than they bargained for.

episodes.title: Let's Spray
episodes.description: It's a beautiful day and Shaun, Bitzer and Timmy are enjoying a picnic, when an unexpected guest arrives and spoils the peace. Forced into hiding the trio find ways to entertain themselves, until they have to brave up and face their fear.

episodes.title: Cones
episodes.description: The flock hear the enticing tunes of an ice cream van approaching and quickly hatch a plan to divert it into their field. While the driver seeks help, the flock have great fun with an endless supply of ice cream - but will they be able to cover their tracks before they're discovered?

episodes.title: Caught Short Alien
episodes.description: When Shaun's old friend the Alien drops by for a much-needed loo break, Shaun is only too happy to let him use the facilities in the Farmhouse. While he's going about his business he leaves Shaun in charge of his intriguing new gadget.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday Timmy!
episodes.description: It's Timmy's birthday and the flock have thrown a party for him. At first he's delighted by all the attention. But when the flock become distracted and he's left with no-one to play with, he decides to entertain himself.

episodes.title: The Genie
episodes.description: Shaun dreams of a life in the fast-lane. When Shirley lands upon something that could make his wish come true he can't believe his luck. The only obstacle that stands in his way is the rest of the flock.

episodes.title: 3DTV
episodes.description: The Farmer is very excited by his new purchase. He calls on Bitzer to set up his new TV while he readies himself to watch life in 3D. To his surprise, it's more 3D than he could ever have imagined.

episodes.title: The Smelly Farmer
episodes.description: The Farmer's personal hygiene leaves much to be desired. Shaun, Bitzer and the flock decide action is needed - and set about giving the Farmer a full-service wash.

episodes.title: DIY
episodes.description: When the Farmer pops out for more supplies, Bitzer is left in charge of decorating and calls on the flock for help. He soon realises this may be a terrible mistake as they have their own way of doing things - painting and decorating isn't their strong point!

episodes.title: The Rabbit
episodes.description: The Farmer's niece has come to visit, bringing her precious pet rabbit. The Farmer entrusts Bitzer to look after it while they go inside for lunch. All in a day's work - until the rabbit disappears! Shaun and the flock are called to action to help track down the illusive pet before the niece discovers it's missing. But do they understand what they're looking for?

episodes.title: Prize Possession
episodes.description: The Farmer can't believe his luck - he has a winning ticket! He just needs to keep it safe until morning and there's only one dog for the job! Unfortunately Bitzer is a hopeless guard dog. Can he rescue the winning ticket, or has he lost the Farmer's fortune?

episodes.title: The Spider
episodes.description: Bitzer decides to pamper himself with a relaxing bath while the Farmer is away from the farm. However, his plans are rudely disturbed by a persistent intruder. Will Shaun be able to out-smart the tenacious bug?

episodes.title: The Loony-Tic
episodes.description: Everyone is settling down for a relaxed night on the farm, when Bitzer begins to act very strangely - he just can't sit still. When his peculiar behaviour starts spreading around the flock, Shaun decides he must find out what is causing it.

episodes.title: Men at Work
episodes.description: When the Farmer discovers he's sprung a leak, he calls the water board to come and fix the problem. The bored flock are thrilled by the opportunity to have some watery fun. When the workmen clock off, the party begins.

episodes.title: The Dog Show
episodes.description: It's time for the Annual Dog Show and the Farmer is sure Bitzer has a good chance of winning this year. When things don't quite go as planned, the Farmer comes up with an ingenious idea which might help him win...

episodes.title: Missing Piece
episodes.description: Shaun comes across a discarded jigsaw puzzle and calls on the flock to help him put it together. When Bitzer discovers the final piece is missing they decide they must do whatever it takes to solve the puzzle.

episodes.title: Wildlife Watch
