episodes.description: A film crew arrives to record a rare bird nesting at Mossybottom Farm. The Farmer is delighted by all the attention, but when a cameraman films the flock enjoying a game of cricket, drastic action is needed.

episodes.title: The Pelican
episodes.description: An unusual guest lands on the farm. Shaun and Bitzer try their best to make the visitor feel welcome but can't work out what the unexpected arrival needs. When they realise it is hungry, they set about trying to find it some food - if only they could get their hands on the Farmer's prize catch!

episodes.title: Bad Boy
episodes.description: There's a new kid on the block and he's up to no good. At first Bitzer is charmed by the newcomer, but when he starts to get him into trouble, Shaun decides something must be done to teach him a lesson.

episodes.title: Remote Control
episodes.description: Game on! Everyone is excitedly getting ready to watch a football match on TV, when an out-of-control toy plane hits the TV aerial, ruining the picture. Oh no! Bitzer is sent to fix the problem and asks the flock for help.

episodes.title: Phoney Farmer
episodes.description: The Farmer is off on holiday, confident he's left the Farm in safe hands. However, the animals quickly learn his replacement is only interested in looking after himself! Dismayed and hungry, they decide he has to go.

episodes.title: Ground Dog Day
episodes.description: Bitzer struggles to finish his list of chores before the ice cream van arrives.

episodes.title: The Intruder
episodes.description: When the Farmer tasks Bitzer with ridding the Farm of a pesky Crow, Shaun comes up with an ingenious disguise to fool the intruder. However, the plan backfires when Bitzer is suspected of being the crazed Chicken thief of Mossybottom Farm.

episodes.title: Bitzer for a Day
episodes.description: When the Farmer decides it's time he & Bitzer head out for a bit of Man & Dog time, Shaun seizes his chance to take charge. He soon discovers the job is not quite as easy as he first thought.

episodes.title: Bitzer's Secret
episodes.description: The Farmer decides it's time to get fit - and calls on Bitzer to join him. Bitzer has other ideas and comes up with a secret plan to avoid putting in the hard work. Will his scheme catch up with him in the end?

episodes.title: Ping-Pong Poacher
episodes.description: With the animals of Mossybottom Farm keenly watching 'Shaun Vs Bitzer' in the greatest table tennis match of all time, they fail to notice a hungry Fox who isn't keeping his eye on the ball at all.

episodes.title: Hidden Talents
episodes.description: It's a quiet day and the Flock decide to entertain each other by performing their favourite party tricks. However, when the Farmer tries to join in, things get a little awkward.

episodes.title: Picture Perfect
episodes.description: Bitzer has completed all his chores and is at a bit of a loss. He's delighted when he discovers the Flock's barn needs a good tidy-up - until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

episodes.title: Save the Dump
episodes.description: The Farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local Squire. When the Flock discover they'll lose their beloved dump, they need to come up with an imaginative solution to try and save it.

episodes.title: Duck!
episodes.description: When Shaun and the Flock discover that a pair of nesting Ducks has stolen their bedding to make a comfy new home up on top of Bitzer's kennel, the battle is on to set things straight.

episodes.title: The Stare
episodes.description: Bitzer gets his wish for some peace & quiet when Shaun becomes hypnotised by Mowermouth the goat and finally stops bothering him. But with the whole Flock under the influence of Mowermouth's powerful gaze, Bitzer soon realises just how much he needs his old buddy.

episodes.title: Fruit and Nuts
episodes.description: Tired of eating grass, Shaun sets out to pinch one of the Farmer's prized apples only to have every attempt ruined by his constantly sneezing accomplice - a Sheep, who much to Shaun's frustration, has decided to be his new best friend.

episodes.title: Out of Order
episodes.description: When the farmer gets stuck in the Loo, Bitzer has to get vital supplies to him as a matter of urgency. His initial efforts end in failure and he drafts in Shaun and the gang to help out.

episodes.title: Karma Farmer
episodes.description: The Farmer is stressed out and has had enough of the farm and its inhabitants, so he transforms the farm into a hippy commune where work and chores are abolished.

episodes.title: Spoilsport
episodes.description: Shaun persuades Bitzer to take part in his game of Cricket but Bitzer is more worried about the condition of the pitch than the game.

episodes.title: Baa-d Hair Day
episodes.description: The flock don't recognise Shaun when he loses one his most distinctive features. His old pal Bitzer helps him track down the lost thatch, but not before Shaun becomes very attached to one of the chickens.

episodes.title: The Farmer's Nephew
episodes.description: Bitzer is left with a mountain of work when the farmer is rendered incapable. Enter the farmhand who is more interested in his mobile phone than getting the task done.

episodes.title: Babysitter Bitzer
episodes.description: The flock are off for a girls' night, leaving Bitzer to babysit Timmy. It's not long before the youngster makes clear who's in charge.

episodes.title: Dodgy Lodger
episodes.description: When one of the pigs attempts to make friends with Timmy, his cohort evict him as punishment for un-pig-like behaviour. The sheep take him into the barn and attempt to transform him into the epitome of porcine sophistication.

episodes.title: Dangerous Deliveries
episodes.description: Every time the postman pays the Farmer a visit, Bitzer's canine instincts get the better of him, resulting in shredded mail and and an irate farmer. Shaun decides to help out by taking on the role of Bitzer's therapist.

episodes.title: Timmy and the Dragon
episodes.description: Bitzer, Shaun and Flock are convinced that a monster is at loose on the farm and hide in the barn. But what exactly is it they are afraid of?

episodes.title: Bitzer's New Whistle
episodes.description: Bitzer thinks the future has arrived when he takes delivery of his new high tech farmyard control module but when the gadget malfunctions, Bitzer is left wishing for his old whistle.

episodes.title: Turf Wars
episodes.description: Battle ensues when the pigs muscle in on Shaun's private club and steal all the pizza. Shaun, Bitzer and the flock mount a rescue mission for Timmy who the pigs have taken hostage.

episodes.title: A Prickly Problem
episodes.description: Timmy decides to helps the hedgehogs find a resting place for the night. His efforts, however, lead his weary friends into a series a scrapes rather than giving them a good night's sleep.

episodes.title: Wanted
episodes.description: The farm is paid an unexpected visit from an escapee from the nearby prison, who takes refuge in the barn. After a short while with Shaun and the gang, though, prison doesn't seem such a bad option.

episodes.title: Rude Dude
episodes.description: Never meet your heroes. The Farmer's rock n' roll idol is stranded at the farm when his limousine breaks down. Soon revealed as a spoilt pretender, Shaun decides to show him a lesson from the 'school of rock'.

episodes.title: Keeping the Peace
episodes.description: After spending the night putting together the bed instead of sleeping in it, the farmer has a lie in and Bitzer is in charge of making sure his master's rest is uninterrupted.

episodes.title: Happy Farmers' Day
episodes.description: Bitzer treats the farmer to a restaurant style dining experience, offering a delicious pie as the main course.

episodes.title: Checklist
episodes.description: Animated Series. Bitzer's over-officious management style becomes too much for the sheep, who decide it's time for him to chill out. Bitzer's tasks for the day take on a new purpose, for everyone to have some fun.

episodes.title: Return to Sender
episodes.description: Animated Series. The Farmer receives a mystery gift from his antipodean cousin. Unimpressed with the present, he attempts to throw it away, only for it to keep reappearing. He becomes convinced it has magical powers.

episodes.title: Cone of Shame
episodes.description: Animated Series. Bitzer is an all-too willing volunteer when he has to wear the cone of shame and is happy to let the flock wait on him. That is, until Shaun rumbles his malingering and plots the pooch's comeuppance.

episodes.title: Sheep Farmer
episodes.description: Animated Series. When Timmy sees a particularly grumpy farmer giving one of the flock a hard time, he decides to give him an idea of what it's like to be a sheep. But when the time comes to have the old farmer back, things aren't quite so simple.

episodes.title: Baa-gherita!
episodes.description: A hungry Shaun turns the Farmer’s pottery oven into a pizza factory.

episodes.title: Get Your Goat
episodes.description: The goat gobbles his way deep into the cornfield — at the worst possible time!

episodes.title: Super Sheep
episodes.description: Tired of being pushed around by the pigs, Shaun transforms into a high-flying hero.

episodes.title: Space Bitzer
episodes.description: A drone takes Bitzer on a dizzying ride.

episodes.title: #farmstar
episodes.description: The Farmer sets out to become a viral video star like his popular neighbour.

episodes.title: CSI Mossy
episodes.description: Shaun and Bitzer hunt for a whistle thief on the farm.

episodes.title: Squirrelled Away
episodes.description: A sneaky squirrel spoils Bitzer’s bird-watching plans.

episodes.title: Room with a Ewe
episodes.description: When the Farmer rents out the barn to tourists, Shaun and the flock fight back.

episodes.title: Go Bitzer Go!
episodes.description: The gang helps Bitzer gear up for a race against the snooty dog next door.

episodes.title: Prize Porker
episodes.description: A pig tricks the whole farm into thinking he’s a champion.

episodes.title: Teddy Heist
episodes.description: When the Farmer locks up Timmy’s teddy bear, Shaun hatches a rescue plan.

episodes.title: Costume Drama
episodes.description: A film crew stirs up a little too much excitement on the farm.

episodes.title: Express Delivery
episodes.description: Shaun and the flock race to stop a package from reaching the Farmer.

episodes.title: Pond Life
episodes.description: On a hot day, the gang heads to the pond — only to find it’s full of garbage!

episodes.title: Hot to Trotter
episodes.description: When Bitzer’s dance partner drops out before a big contest, Shaun steps in to help.

episodes.title: Box Fresh
episodes.description: Bitzer goes to extremes to keep the Farmer’s new shoes clean.

episodes.title: Tour de Mossy Bottom
episodes.description: Bitzer gets the out-of-shape Farmer back on his bike and ends up on a wild ride.

episodes.title: Sheep Sheep Goose
episodes.description: A baby goose wants to live with the sheep but doesn’t quite fit in.

episodes.title: Pumpkin Peril
episodes.description: As Bitzer stands guard, the Farmer’s prized pumpkins start disappearing from the garden.

episodes.title: Farm Park
episodes.description: A family fun day at the farm gets out of hand.

episodes.title: Bake it Easy
episodes.description: Despite warnings, the sheep have gobbled up the birthday cake Bitzer has baked for the Farmer. Realising the kitchen cupboards are bare, Shaun and the flock must try and source ingredients for a new one from around the farm before Bitzer realises. The result is certainly a surprise!

episodes.title: Shelf Life
episodes.description: When the Farmer accidentally drills a hole in a waterpipe while putting up a new shelf, Bitzer frantically tries to stop the leak from soaking the living room and prevent the Farmer's precious teapots from sliding off the shelf!

episodes.title: Bed Lamb
episodes.description: Shaun tricks Bitzer into thinking he is unwell so that he can stay in the barn playing video games all day. However, before long, the other sheep are also pulling sickies, and Bitzer is starting to get suspicious. The threat of nasty medicine has everyone out of bed in a flash!

episodes.title: Shooting Stars
episodes.description: When a meteor shower is forecast to pass over Mossy Bottom, Bitzer really wants to see the shooting stars. However, he keeps getting distracted by the flock's curiosity and the Farmer's late-night picnic.

episodes.title: Doorbell
episodes.description: While proudly testing his new doorbell camera, the Farmer realises he has locked himself out. Bitzer must help his boss get back into the farmhouse while simultaneously making sure he doesn't spot Timmy and Shaun with a runaway kite.

episodes.title: Bee Free
episodes.description: The Farmer has taken up beekeeping and is loving all the honey produced by the hive. However, when he discards his protective suit, the swarm move in, bringing it to life! Soon, the ‘Bee-Man' is bossing Bitzer around.

episodes.title: Hoof Fashion
episodes.description: Shaun steps in a can of red paint, and his resulting red hoof makes him a style icon on the farm. Before long, the rest of the flock try their own new looks and soon steal the limelight. As the outfits become more and more outrageous, Shaun wonders if less might sometimes be more.

episodes.title: Bitzer's Bale Out
episodes.description: The Farmer tasks Bitzer with baling up a fresh haystack, but the hungry sheep have hidden inside and are turned into moving bales. A wild game of chase the bale results as Bitzer tries to restore order to the hay field.

episodes.title: Whistle-Stop
episodes.description: Realising that Bitzer has a series of whistles which can control the flock's movements, Shaun steals them and soon has the flock dancing to his tune. When the Farmer finds the whistles stuck together like a harmonica, his dreadful playing gives Shaun a taste of his own medicine.

episodes.title: Ruffing It
episodes.description: Renovations force Bitzer to camp out for the night. When the flock are shut out of the barn, they must also pitch up in the field. The sheep are loving their trendy glampsite at first, but as the weather worsens and batteries run low, the appeal of Bitzer's practical tent grows.

episodes.title: Power Cut
episodes.description: With the Farmer and Bitzer out at the Golden Tractor Awards, the flock take the chance to enjoy all the mod cons of the house – until they overload the power and the house is plunged into total darkness. When the Farmer returns, the flock must escape the house without getting caught.

episodes.title: Stuck in the Muck
episodes.description: After the Farmer manages to drive his tractor into a mud patch, Shaun, Bitzer and the flock try to rescue it from the quagmire. Before long, however, the stranded vehicle sinks far beyond their reach.

episodes.title: Spare Parts
episodes.description: When two different pieces of flat-pack furniture are delivered to the Farmer and Bitzer, confusion ensues as they start to mix up the pieces. Shaun and the Flock are forced to give them a lesson in following instructions.

episodes.title: Sleep on It
episodes.description: An all-night gaming session turns the Farmer and Bitzer into sleep-deprived zombies the next day. Shaun takes the chance to change Bitzer's checklist to suit himself, but he manages to miss the final item: shearing time!

episodes.title: Treasure Hunt
episodes.description: Bitzer is horrified when the farmer scribbles all over his map showing the location of his buried bone and fears he will never rediscover his treasure. The flock are on hand to help him search, even if their methods are unorthodox.

episodes.title: Gone to the Dogs
episodes.description: Bitzer is embarrassed when his dad makes a surprise visit and finds the farmyard in a mess. Feeling sorry for Bitzer, Shaun and the flock make a real show of tidying up. Bitzer and his dad get some bonding time, but as soon as dad leaves, the place descends into anarchy once more.

episodes.title: Shirleyverse, Part 1
episodes.description: Shaun escapes through a ‘portal' inside Shirley's wool to flee an annoying Bitzer, only to emerge into a chaotic version of the farm without him. Desperate to escape, he repeatedly jumps back inside Shirley, emerging somewhere worse each time!

episodes.title: Shirleyverse, Part 2
episodes.description: Shaun escapes through a ‘portal' inside Shirley's wool to flee an annoying Bitzer, only to emerge into a chaotic version of the farm without him. Desperate to escape, he repeatedly jumps back inside Shirley, emerging somewhere worse each time!

episodes.title: Poultrygeist
episodes.description: When a chicken ends up inside Shaun's pillowcase, Shaun tries to get it back, only for the chicken to end up in the farmhouse - and the Farmer to think he is being haunted by a chicken ghost.

episodes.title: Fleece Navidad
episodes.description: When Farmer Ben delivers his perfect Christmas card, Shaun and the gang secretly knit jumpers to try and make sure the Mossy Bottom Farm card is even more spectacular. But getting everyone to pose for the photo proves to be harder than it looks.

episodes.title: Pasta Wars
episodes.description: In the outer reaches of the galaxy, a mother ship in the shape of a pressure cooker is home to some very strange creatures: space lasagna! Their ambition is to invade Planet Earth. Their plan to take over might fall through faster than they thought; after all, the one thing Garfield can never get enough of is lasagna.

episodes.title: A Game of Cat and Mouse
episodes.description: Hunting birds is something Garfield gave up long ago. But when he finds a nest full of what look like abandoned eggs, Garfield puts his feline pride to one side and decides to hatch them. Harry, the stray, doesn't agree with this plan; he would love to put the newborn birds right on his dinner menu.

episodes.title: Perfect Pizza
episodes.description: It's Halloween and Garfield has dressed up as Catzilla, a fierce wild cat monster, to go out trick or treating. But what he doesn't know is that the monster has escaped from the zoo, and the neighbors are terrified of running into him.

episodes.title: Mother Garfield
episodes.description: In the garden, Odie meets a Martian whose space-ship has broken down! To thank him for finding the missing piece of his ship, the Martian makes a Garfield/Odie body switch. Garfield ends up in Odie's body, and Odie in Garfield's!

episodes.title: Pup in the Pound
episodes.description: Odie digs up some bones and finds that they are from the very rare brachiosaurus. Garfield tries to sell them to the local museum, but Mrs. Brubaker, the museum owner, instead wants to demolish Jon's house to search for more brachiosaurus bones. This is Esmeralda Brubaker and Hercules' first appearance.

episodes.title: Odie in Love
episodes.description: Jon begins to notice that Garfield and Odie are more frequently causing messes around the house. Coincidentally, a salesman arrives at the house to sell Jon a highly technological cleaning robot. Jon accepts a trial of the robot before considering the purchase of one, but the robot becomes highly aggressive and violent when it is cleaning up after Garfield and Odie.

episodes.title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
episodes.description: Garfield and Odie watch the news about a villain named Silent Jack, who robs houses while the housekeepers are away. Meanwhile, Jon has gone to the dentist to get his tooth fixed (leaving him unable to talk) and he forgets his key at the dentist.

episodes.title: Turkey Trouble
episodes.description: Nermal meets a cat so called "Agent X" who claims to be a Secret Agent, but in reality, he is just a runaway cat trying to impress the crowd. Garfield becomes jealous as Agent X tells everyone about his adventures of saving people. He soon discovers the true identity of Agent X (Fluffykins), and then turns around the tables in his way to get back his fame.

episodes.title: Catnap
episodes.description: When his friend Squeek invites his big mouse family over to stay at Jon's, they take over the whole house. If he can't get rid of the mice, Garfield will get no lasagna for at least a year.

episodes.title: Agent X
episodes.description: Are any pizzas better than Vito's? Of course not. But Jon thinks they could certainly find cheaper: they could go to Mama Meany, who is a nasty piece of work, more crook than cook, not very Mama at all. He has invented a machine: called the Pizzagrande 7000 which can pump out 10 pizzas per minute, all totally bland and completely inedible.

episodes.title: Orange and Black
episodes.description: Nermal lives with Garfield and Odie for ten days because his owner is out of town. When Nermal fakes a leg injury, Jon feels pity for Nermal, making Garfield and Odie do whatever he requests. Garfield and Odie attempt to get rid of him so they can live normally once again.

episodes.title: Freaky Monday
episodes.description: Jon trips over Odie, and the dish of lasagna he was carrying ends up all over Pooky, Garfield's favorite teddy bear. A quick spin in the washing machine gets him clean again, but now he has to hang outside on the washing line to dry. The next morning, Pooky is gone! Garfield is desperate, and looks for him everywhere.

episodes.title: King Nermal
episodes.description: Liz jumps at the opportunity to weigh Garfield with her new high-tech talking scales. And unsurprisingly, the scales think Garfield is too heavy! Liz gives him a week to lose weight, otherwise she's sending him to the cat fat farm.

episodes.title: Desperately Seeking Pooky
episodes.description: The hypno-snore might be able to cure Jon's insomnia. Jon tries it out, but the program goes haywire when Odie starts barking at a fly! After that, Jon falls asleep any time, any place, whenever Odie barks. Things get worse when Jon starts sleepwalking through town in the middle of the night!

episodes.title: Curse of the Were-Dog
episodes.description: Jon finds his old Accordion but Garfield doesn't like him playing it nor the very sound of it. Garfield tries to get rid of it, but in the end, the Accordion breaks and Jon gets bagpipes instead.

episodes.title: Meet the Parents
episodes.description: Jon has won a turkey in a raffle and decides to cook it for dinner. The only problem is that when the turkey arrives, it's alive and kicking, and nobody wants to deal with it.

episodes.title: Down on the Farm
episodes.description: A new law for dogs has just been introduced: any dog which goes out without a tag on its collar will be thrown into the pound without further ado. Odie gets caught by two guards and dragged off to the dog pound. Garfield therefore heads off to the pound to sneak in and rescue his faithful friend. But then who will get him out?

episodes.title: The Pet Show
episodes.description: Jon comes back from the supermarket with a pet brush he has bought. Garfield isn't keen on the idea since he can take care of his own hygiene, but Odie doesn't mind trying it out. He likes it so much that he falls in love with the brush and swears never to leave it.

episodes.title: Pet Matchers
episodes.description: Tthere's a new TV game show which aims to find out if pets and their masters are really made for each other. Odie is confident that things will calm down once the show has proven Garfield and Jon make a good team. But his cunning plan quickly goes horribly wrong: the Compatriton machine, which never gets anything wrong, says they're incompatible. Garfield gets sent off to live with a boisterous kid called Jeremy, and Jon gets a new pet…. A frog!!

episodes.title: Lucky Charm
episodes.description: Garfield sends Odie to the end of a rainbow, promising that if he makes it before the rainbow disappears, he'll find a pot full of gold. Odie, who makes a good sleuth, finds it and brings it back to Garfield, much to the despair of its owner, a sad little leprechaun. If Garfield agrees to give the pot of gold back, all his dreams will come true.

episodes.title: Bone Diggers
episodes.description: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie. He turns into the monstrous Were-Dog and wreaks havoc in Jon's house.

episodes.title: The Robot
episodes.description: Jon is finally going to meet Liz's parents. Everything has to be perfect, starting with Odie and Garfield, who seem determined to mess things up for him. Liz's parents arrive and bring a little canary, Mimosa.

episodes.title: High Scale
episodes.description: Jon goes to visit his brother Doc Boy who lives on a farm. Garfield is a real city cat, it's no picnic for him! To make things worse, Doc Boy asks him to do some work: pile up some logs, wash down the windows, sweep up the leaves. Things really reach their low point when Garfield realizes there's no TV and no pizza.

episodes.title: Jon's Night Out
episodes.description: A pet show has been organized in town, and the 1st prize is a huge dish of lasagna. Garfield's mouth is already watering at the thought of it, and he decides to compete.

episodes.title: Curse of the Cat People
episodes.description: Liz has just come back from a trip to Egypt and has brought an old mirror as a souvenir. But it's a magic mirror; one lick from Odie, and he and Garfield get sucked through a door into a parallel world! On the other side, the cats are waiting for their new Pharaoh to arrive, accompanied by his jackal.

episodes.title: Glenda and Odessa
episodes.description: The terrible twins Drusilla and Minerva are coming to visit their cousin Jon, and no sooner do they get there than they want to play all kinds of games with Garfield and Odie!

episodes.title: It's a Cat's World
episodes.description: Jon has organized a day of fly-fishing, much to Garfield's dismay since he would rather have stayed home napping. Odie and Garfield visit the underwater world and have all kinds of adventures, some fun, some pretty unpleasant...

episodes.title: Extreme Housebreaking
episodes.description: It's Liz's birthday, and Jon wants to give her a really special present. A family photo of him and his two faithful friends, Garfield and Odie. You would think there's nothing so easy as taking a family photo, but Jon soon realizes that getting the perfect pic is going to be a real challenge!

episodes.title: Time Twist
episodes.description: When an alien stops at a supermarket on earth, Garfield mistakenly enters his space ship and travels through different planets but it becomes hard for him to survive.

episodes.title: Fame Fatale
episodes.description: Garfield has found a very special watch: it can stop time ! At first, he uses it to prolong nap times and meal times and play jokes on his friends, but then it turns against him when it gets stuck and the whole world around him freezes!

episodes.title: Underwater World
episodes.description: Liz has to go away for a few days and asks Jon to look after her goldfish while she is gone. When Garfield finds this out, all he can think about is the great fry-up he's gonna have.

episodes.title: Fish to Fry
episodes.description: At a picnic area, Odie finds a lost baby wolf, so he takes him home, unaware that the mother wolf is following them.

episodes.title: Little Yellow Riding Hood
episodes.description: Liz and Jon come home with a VIP guest : the cat Sir Leo, who is a star looking for a few days of R & R. He has always been famous, but dreams of a normal, peaceful life. Surprisingly he looks like Garfield, who jumps at the chance of replacing him for a while: he doesn't mind a taste of a star's life!

episodes.title: Time Master
episodes.description: A crazy scientist has invented an incredible new machine: the Virtualodeon which makes TV shows real! Unfortunately, the Virtualodeon isn't quite up to speed and Garfield ends up getting trapped inside his own TV.

episodes.title: Family Picture
episodes.description: It's a day like any other at Garfield's house, but then gets sucked through a vortex into a new dimension and ends up in a parallel world where cats have replaced humans, and humans have replaced cats!

episodes.title: Virtualodeon
episodes.description: Garfield's favorite person to pick on is Herman the mailman, who has just had the very bad idea of taking a vacation. The young recruit who replaces him is optimistic and naive when he thinks that Garfield is a cute little cat and everything will turn out fine.

episodes.title: Mailman Blues
episodes.description: Garfield is enrolled in Dr Whipple's obedience class after Jon secretly films his bad behaviour. While there, Garfield discovers Dr Whipple is not who he seems.

episodes.title: Heir Apparent
episodes.description: Doc Boy and Jon want to inherit their cousin's haunted estate, but in order to do so, one must stay there longer than the other.

episodes.title: From the Oven
episodes.description: After hearing children go door to door singing carols on TV, Garfield tries to go around singing carols for food.

episodes.title: Neighbor Nathan
episodes.description: Jon accidentally follows a monster movie instead of a cooking show's recipe while baking a cake. It becomes a villainous Frankenstein monster and attempts to kill him, Garfield and Odie for breakfast.

episodes.title: History of Dogs
episodes.description: Odie runs away from home, sick of Garfield's cruelty towards him, but the new house he runs off to is the residence of a boy with the personality of a mad scientist named Nathan, who plans to use his new invention to transform Odie into a cockroach. Now it is up to Garfield to save Odie.

episodes.title: Up a Tree
episodes.description: Garfield tells us about history of dogs, but puts them in a negative light. When Odie and his dog friends save Garfield's favorite Italian restaurant from a kitchen fire, Garfield is forced to admit that even dogs aren't that stupid.

episodes.title: It's a Cheese World
episodes.description: Garfield shows his ten favorite things and his most favorite thing is watching Odie being tormented by squirrels.

episodes.title: Nice to Nermal
episodes.description: Squeak and his friends want Garfield to take them to Eddie Gourmand's Cheese Land, an amusement park made completely out of cheese where mice are prohibited.

episodes.title: Out on a Limb
episodes.description: Nermal steals Pooky after Garfield is mean to him, and blackmails Garfield into being nice to him. To get Pooky back, Garfield sends an e-mail asking Druscilla and Minerva to come over and play with Nermal.

episodes.title: Super Me
episodes.description: Garfield, Jon, Odie and Nermal all get stuck in a tree, so they try to get help.

episodes.title: Mastermind
episodes.description: Garfield imitates a superhero so that Nermal will reward him with food, but gets caught up with the real superhero and a bank robbery caused by a villainous crime lord.

episodes.title: The Amazing Flying Dog
episodes.description: Garfield gets a device that reads people's minds and saves Vito's pizzeria from rioting alien masterminds.

episodes.title: The Last Word
episodes.description: There's a house on fire and a young pup is crying for help: she thinks it's all over. But no – here comes Odie, the super dog! He wishes his dream was true. Then he could finally speak to the pretty stranger in his dreams. But when Garfield really gets into trouble, Odie puts his grudges aside and flies off to help him.

episodes.title: Iceman
episodes.description: After Nermal makes a comment he doesn't appreciate about his appetite, Garfield bets him that he won't eat a thing for an hour. If he wins, Nermal will be banned from the house for a month. But if he loses, Garfield will be his slave for a whole week.

episodes.title: Caroling Capers
episodes.description: The ice-cream man is back in town, except that this year, it's an ice-cream woman, and Garfield isn't always nice to her, even though he loves ice-cream. In the meantime, a prehistoric man is found in a block of ice and carted off to a history exhibition.

episodes.title: T3000
episodes.description: There's a new employee at the pound: it's a robot with all the latest gadgets and its job is gonna be to make all the pets stick to the straight and narrow. Any pets who have missed a shot or who aren't wearing their nametags get thrown straight into jail by the villain.

episodes.title: Home for the Holidays (1)
episodes.description: Jon wins the lottery, but is unable to find his ticket, but when he finds it, it is revealed that it is not the winning ticket. This is Mr. Barker's first appearance.

episodes.title: Home for the Holidays (2)
episodes.description: An alien named Nimbus from a planet with no gravity lands on earth to recharge his spaceship. While in Jon's house he cancels out gravity, causing household objects to float around the house. This is Nimbus's second appearance, though he's been redesigned and has a higher pitched voice.

episodes.title: The Art of Being Uncute
episodes.description: Eddie Gourmand is the judge for the Cutest Cat Of The Year award and decides for the new cute to be the opposite of cute, and the prize is six months in Greenland, so Garfield decides to make Nermal a mess in order to get some peace and quiet. Garfield wins the contest after getting messy from eating food left out for the audience.

episodes.title: The Haunted House
episodes.description: Aunt Ivy stays at Jon's house after her power line is destroyed by a fallen tree branch. She eventually develops a fear of Jon's bunny slippers after watching a horror movie. The fear continues to mount when the blue moon outside causes the bunny slippers to come to life. This is Aunt Ivy's first appearance.

episodes.title: Night of the Bunny Slippers
episodes.description: The Aliens previously seen in "Pasta Wars" send an asteroid to destroy Earth. Garfield and Odie reluctantly travel in a small rocket to stop the asteroid, but they are surprised to find out that the asteroid is a giant meatball.

episodes.title: Planet of Poultry
episodes.description: Jon sneezes every time he is near Garfield, and a doctor explains that he must get rid of Garfield, however when Garfield does something nice for Jon, he uncovers a shocking secret: he is allergic to goldenrod.

episodes.title: History of Cats
episodes.description: Garfield has to lose ten pounds, but Jon discovers he has been snacking between meals. Liz gives him a robot that will follow Garfield everywhere he goes to endure he sticks to his diet, but Garfield tricks Jon and pretends to board a ship bound for Tokyo, Japan.

episodes.title: The Spy Who Fed Me
episodes.description: Squeak's cat-hating cousin, Max, moves into Garfield's home and rallies the other mice to rebel against him. Meanwhile, Jon calls an exterminator named Mr. Pulver to come rid his house of them.

episodes.title: Gravity of the Situation
episodes.description: Jon spends the day in Mr. Barker's new mansion to come up with a comic book idea. The only trouble is, the house is haunted by a ghost cat.

episodes.title: Ticket to Riches
episodes.description: The twins, Druscilla and Minerva, come to visit. Garfield lures them over to the house of an elderly neighbor, who may or may not be a witch. (Guest appearance: June Foray as Mrs. Cauldron.)

episodes.title: Which Witch
episodes.description: Dr. Bonkers creates a holographic mailman to prevent Herman from constantly being tormented by Garfield, but when Garfield eats a taco, from which sauce drips into the machine, causing the cyber mailman to deliver an early edition of the newspaper. This allowed Jon to buy the winning lottery ticket every day until the taco sauce causes the machine to blow up, destroying the post office lab. The explosion was foretold by Jon because of his early edition of the newspaper.

episodes.title: The Big Sneeze
episodes.description: Jon is in debt, and decides he must sell some of his possessions to pay the bill. When Garfield puts Odie on the stall for two cents, he is bought by the person Jon is being sued by, and it is up to Garfield to get him back by tricked the servant.

episodes.title: Blasteroid
episodes.description: Garfield is looking forward to the holidays and all its joys. Arlene gives Garfield a reason to stop and remember the true meaning of the season, so Garfield decides to help some homeless Cats and Dogs by finding them homes. Part 2 is the first appearance of Jon's parents. This is the first double length (22 minute) episode.

episodes.title: Odie for Sale
episodes.description: Aliens from another planet plan to turn all the earth creatures into chickens.

episodes.title: Guest from Beyond
episodes.description: Nathan (from "Neighbor Nathan") returns and shrinks Garfield with his shrink ray, and Garfield must find a way to return to normal size.

episodes.title: Cyber Mailman
episodes.description: Jon buys a new house monitoring software program, with a person called "Millie", but after the house gets hit by lightning, Millie takes over the whole house..

episodes.title: Farm Fresh Feline
episodes.description: Garfield finds out what life would be like for people who spend their entire existence on hold waiting for their call to be picked up.

episodes.title: With Four You Get Pizza
episodes.description: Jon, Garfield, and Odie visit Doc Boy on the farm and Dr. Whipple puts Garfield under a spell that makes him do chores but he finds a way to get rid of it.

episodes.title: Master Chef
episodes.description: After Eddie Gourmand gives a bad review about Vito's Pizzeria on TV, Jon, Garfield, and Odie go see him to find out why he's so cranky lately and help him.

episodes.title: Honey, I Shrunk the Pets
episodes.description: Jon goes out on a date with Liz to Vito's Pizzeria and Garfield wants to go along, but Vito banned animals from entering the restaurant. So Garfield and Odie disguise themselves as children to get into Vito's, and Nermal and the other cat dress up as children. But Jon and Liz's date turns into disaster.

episodes.title: Garfield Astray
episodes.description: Eddie Gourmand is fired when a vegan food fanatic takes over the station. Jon unwittingly takes him in, which soon turns out to be a mistake, as Gourmand devours every last crumb of food available in rapid fashion.

episodes.title: Black Cat Blues
episodes.description: Garfield tells a small yet untrue history about cats, and the mice are upset because Garfield is making it seem as though cats actually did everything in history.

episodes.title: Dogs Day
episodes.description: After Odie helps their friend, Nimbus, he gives him a forever doggie cookie. Odie licks Jon after eating it, and Jon starts acting like a dog. Then Jon licks Liz and the condition spreads all over the City but it is stopped by Garfield. NOTE This is a parody of The Shining..

episodes.title: The Bluebird of Happiness
episodes.description: After Garfield plays a mean trick on Nermal, a bowling ball falls on his head and he loses his memory. Then, Nermal tricks Garfield into thinking he's an alley cat named Ichabod. Then Garfield meets a couple of stray cats named Tino and Gino.

episodes.title: Inside Eddie Gourmand
episodes.description: When Garfield hears about a chef who can make "The Best Lasagna in the world" from Vito he is determined to find him. Once there in Chef Squisito's Log Cabin in the Woods Garfield disguises himself as a baby in order to find out.

episodes.title: Depths of a Salesman
episodes.description: A miserable, black cat named Jonah passes by Garfield outside, and Garfield is given a curse and has bad luck all the time until he can remove the curse and bring Good Luck to himself. Garfield must figure out how to lift the curse and does with a Banana Peel.

episodes.title: Night of the Apparatuses
episodes.description: One of the baby bluebirds from "Mother Garfield" returns and Garfield saves him from Harry. But Nermal accidentally lets Harry have it and Garfield, Nermal, and Odie must save it before Harry eats it.

episodes.title: Everything's Relative
episodes.description: Jon tells Drusilla and Minerva the story of Penny Henny believing the sky is falling (parody of Chicken Little).

episodes.title: Land of Hold
episodes.description: While Jon's away, Garfield and Odie are pretending to be pirates and they start go on an imaginary pirate ship, and find gold(the fridge), but find other dogs there.

episodes.title: Fido Food Feline
episodes.description: Jon goes out on a big date with Liz and orders Garfield a pizza for dinner from Vito's Pizzeria. Garfield races against Vito's new speedy delivery policy and torments him, but Jon eventually finds out, Vito then has Garfield pay off the hundreds of pizzas he ordered using a tape recorder. A variation of the Garfield and Friends cartoon "The Pizza Patrol".

episodes.title: Cuter Than Cute
episodes.description: Real estate tycoon Brent Mogul threatens to destroy Vito's restaurant, and it is up to Garfield and Odie to stop him.

episodes.title: A Gripping Tale
episodes.description: Garfield retells the time when, after eating dog food, thinking that he was turning into a dog.

episodes.title: Penny Henny
episodes.description: Squeak suddenly has the ability to see future events like Jon hitting his thumb with a hammer.

episodes.title: Wicked Wishes
episodes.description: A giant squid finds its way into the city sewer and sucks Odie in, and Garfield must save him.

episodes.title: Jumbo Shrimpy
episodes.description: Shrimpy the elephant is being mistreated by Dr. Whipple, and Garfield and Odie help Shrimpy from him.

episodes.title: Pirate Gold
episodes.description: Aunt Ivy's house is being rid of mice and she has to stay at Jon's home for a week. Then, Druscilla and Minerva show up, and Jon is so annoyed with them that he tries to get them to stay at Doc Boy's farm. But Doc Boy doesn't want to put up with them either.

episodes.title: Me, Garfield, and I
episodes.description: While Jon's away, a stray cat named Bruno steals the house and Garfield and Odie need to figure it out how to get back in. This is Bruno's first appearance.

episodes.title: Great Pizza Race
episodes.description: Nermal comes over for a visit and the space lasagnas (from "Pasta Wars" and "Blasteroid") return once again and send a spy disguised as a cute kitten over to Garfield's home. Everyone thinks he is way cuter than Nermal, and Nermal gets jealous.

episodes.title: Full of Beans
episodes.description: Prince Orloff gets a lesson about having fun from Garfield and Odie.

episodes.title: Detective Odie
episodes.description: Garfield, Jon, and Odie buy conned items from the "All Buying Channel", but once they find out the items are shoddy, Garfield feels determined to get their money back.

episodes.title: Stealing Home
episodes.description: Odie goes on the case when Jon is mistaken for theft of a neighbor's bracelet.

episodes.title: Love and Lasagna
episodes.description: Odie finds a magical bottle with a genie in it, but it wants Jon to grant the genie three wishes.

episodes.title: True Colors
episodes.description: Odie accidentally swallows a Mexican jumping bean that was given to Jon by his Mexican friend Pablo. Odie now starts jumping all around house, and finally out the pet door into the city.

episodes.title: Rain or Shine
episodes.description: Garfield obtains possession of Dr. Bonkers' cloning ray, and makes clones of himself so he can do what he wants.

episodes.title: Mind Over Mouse
episodes.description: Garfield tries everything he can to try to hibernate like the squirrels but all his attempts prove futile.

episodes.title: The Big Sleep
episodes.description: Garfield's shabby treatment of Nermal draws the ire of a television show host Dr. Goodygood that seeks to teach him a lesson. Dr. Goodygood takes away Garfield's colors, thus making him the same color as Nermal. Garfield has to do a nice thing if he wants them back.

episodes.title: Pampered Pussycat
episodes.description: A mole's tunnel causes Jon's backyard to cave in.

episodes.title: The Mole Express
episodes.description: A Leprechaun named Paddy comes to Jon's home from Ireland, brings its weather to America, and explains how Ireland's weather is always rainy. Jon and Liz go to Ireland for a vacation.

episodes.title: Parrot Blues
episodes.description: Jon watches Mr. Barker's parrot, Paxton, while he is away. However, Paxton flies downtown telling people things that cause all of them to burst into tears.

episodes.title: Unfair Weather (1)
episodes.description: This is a double length (22 minute) episode. Jon, Garfield, Odie, Drusilla and Minerva discover some strange weather when going camping.

episodes.title: Furry Tales, Part 1
episodes.description: When Jon and Liz go for a picnic Garfield reads Odie a medieval story about a handsome cat dressed in boots and a cap with a feather.

episodes.title: Furry Tales, Part 2
episodes.description: In between home-made burritos and Vito's pizzas, Garfield continues telling the story of Prince Jon and fair Elizabeth to a captivated Odie.

episodes.title: Furry Tales, Part 3
episodes.description: After enjoying a tuna salad, Garfield continues his reading of the story of a cat and a puppy on their way to rescue Prince Jon.

episodes.title: Furry Tales, Part 4
episodes.description: Garfield is now standing on a ladder, building a two-foot high sandwich before going on with the story. A waiting Odie is in agony!

episodes.title: Kind to Kittens
episodes.description: The mayor passes a law requiring everyone to be kind to cats.

episodes.title: Little Angel
episodes.description: Jon and Odie pickup a sweet kitten who turns out to be a terror.

episodes.title: Prehistoric Pup
episodes.description: After a meteorite lands, it turns Odie into a prehistoric dog.

episodes.title: Land of Later
episodes.description: A group of inhabitants who live underground turn everbody into procrastinators.

episodes.title: Laugh in a Can
episodes.description: The network adds a laugh track to Garfield's show, much to his chagrin.

episodes.title: The Non-Garfield Show
episodes.description: Jon pitches an idea for a TV show to a successful producer.

episodes.title: The Caped Avenger Rides Again!
episodes.description: Garfield solves a mystery of who stole a rare comic book.

episodes.title: The Superhero Apprentice
episodes.description: Nermal becomes a supervillain to get revenge on Garfield's Caped Avenger routine.

episodes.title: Teddy Dearest
episodes.description: Jon sells Pooky as a new toy to Mr. Allwork.

episodes.title: Bath Day
episodes.description: Garfield, Odie, and Nermal have a fantasy while in the bathtub.

episodes.title: What a Difference a Pet Makes
episodes.description: Garfield answers fan mail sent in asking about pets.

episodes.title: Garfield Gets Canned
episodes.description: Garfield tries to open a can of food while Jon is away for a while.

episodes.title: Partners in Mime
episodes.description: Jon takes part in a competition for mimes.

episodes.title: Boris the Snowman
episodes.description: While vacationing, Garfield encounters a couple of snowmen who come to life.

episodes.title: Long Lost Lyman (1)
episodes.description: Lyman, Jon's best-friend, may well be held hostage by the Zabadu in Franistan!

episodes.title: Long Lost Lyman (2)
episodes.description: Jon has just seen on TV that the Zabadu was wearing the hat he once gave to Lyman, his friend photographer.

episodes.title: Long Lost Lyman (3)
episodes.description: Garfield, Jon and Odie are landing in Franistan.

episodes.title: Long Lost Lyman (4)
episodes.description: Dirk Dinkum has secretly taken pictures of Lyman-Zabadu.

episodes.title: The Golden Lasagna Awards
episodes.description: The first annual Golden Lasagna Awards Show on television! Oh, my! acNermal hasn't won that trophy yet, has he?

episodes.title: Pawparazzi
episodes.description: Garfield Cat wins Brandon Scoop's show Positively Perfect Pussycat Pageant! Er...no....that's a mistake says judge Mary Margaret Freen.

episodes.title: It's About Time
episodes.description: How could Garfield be possibly jealous of adorable Nermal? Nermal doesn't even have his own show!

episodes.title: Online Arbuckle
episodes.description: Missing his mug by inches and pouring boiling hot coffee on his laps, ending up on all fours with a painting on his head, Jon is so clumsy!

episodes.title: Muscle Mouse
episodes.description: Jon is so grateful to Garfield for keeping mice away from the house!

episodes.title: The Write Stuff
episodes.description: Jon in prison! Liz marries Eddie Gourmand! Garfield adopts Nermal! Well, Samuel W. Underburger certainly doesn't do comedy.

episodes.title: Cupid Cat
episodes.description: Jon tries to help his brother Doc Boy find a companion.

episodes.title: The Control Freak
episodes.description: Nathan tests a out device that can control people's minds.

episodes.title: Every Witch Way
episodes.description: Mrs. Cauldron's niece wants to marry Jon.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Cat People
episodes.description: Neferkitty (or Fuzzbutton) turns everybody in town to stone.

episodes.title: The Garfield-Only Show
episodes.description: Garfield decides to fire all the other characters.

episodes.title: Filthy Fugitives
episodes.description: Jon gives out a cash reward to whoever gives Garfield and Odie a bath.

episodes.title: Smartest Dog in the World
episodes.description: Mrs. Cauldron casts a spell on Odie that makes him smarter.

episodes.title: Farmer Garfield
episodes.description: Doc Boy takes his farm animals to Jon's house for him to look after.

episodes.title: More Than Meets the Eye
episodes.description: Nathan tests out a device that can make one invisible.

episodes.title: Fast Friends
episodes.description: Garfield tries to become faster than Mrs. Ferret.

episodes.title: Where's Odie
episodes.description: Garfield is watching his favourite live show: Odie chasing squirrels!

episodes.title: Doggone Jon
episodes.description: Al is a hopeless dogcatcher and Mr. Kennel, his boss, might not even give him his other chance to actually catch a dog.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Machine
episodes.description: Garfield on a diet? Just you wait! Garfield's Mysterious Machine will soon make Jon, Nermal, Herman and Vito surrender.

episodes.title: Fitness Crazed
episodes.description: Biff won't make a sportsman out of Garfield but Garfield can certainly make a greedy idler out of Biff!

episodes.title: Little Trouble in Big China (1)
episodes.description: Garfield absolutely needs to mail Nermal to China this time or the most awesomely adorable kitten will spend the whole summer with him!

episodes.title: Little Trouble in Big China (2)
episodes.description: Garfield, Odie and Dingbang have been kidnapped by Voldo with the help of Bella's horrible Siamese cats.

episodes.title: Little Trouble in Big China (3)
episodes.description: Garfield, Odie, Nermal and Dingbang are now...in a bamboo forest...on the northern edge of the Tibetan plateau!

episodes.title: Little Trouble in Big China (4)
episodes.description: The Great Wall of China! That's where the medallion has led Garfield, Odie, Nermal and Dingbang!

episodes.title: My Friend, Nermal
episodes.description: Cute Nermal's life is at stake! Mean-looking Crusher, Doberman and Rottweiler are chasing him down when Garfield comes and saves him!

episodes.title: Take a Ferret to Lunch
episodes.description: Liz finds it ever so diifficult to get a new owner for Mrs. Ferret. But then again, who would like to have a pet that only eats and sleeps?

episodes.title: Bride and Broom
episodes.description: Garfield-Duck has to wait for Winona's duck spell to wear off! But why did she cast a spell on him?

episodes.title: Problems, Problems, Problems
episodes.description: Garfield the Wise is overbooked! Everyone is literally begging him for help.

episodes.title: Double Double Trouble
episodes.description: Garfield deals with a new pair of twins- Chester and Lester- in addition to Drusilla and Minerva.

episodes.title: The Great Trade-Off
episodes.description: Dr. Puzzle has invented an ingenious device to trade two people's personalities!

episodes.title: Silence Of The Sheep
episodes.description: Garfield had trouble falling asleep so some sheep from sandman's plane came, but failed so he fried them and they decided to put everyone to sleep to prove themselves.

episodes.title: Bulldog Of Doom
episodes.description: Garfield wants a pie on a window, but it's protected by the owners bulldog.

episodes.title: The Dog of My Cat
episodes.description: A episode about complaining starring a dog who complains about everything, so Garfield decides to trick him to become a cat.

episodes.title: World Without Me
episodes.description: Garfield feels depressed all of a sudden and wants to be in a world where he never existed, fortunately the leprechaun (from season 2) shows him the world needs him.

episodes.title: Fraidy Cat
episodes.description: A doctor with a machine the zapped Garfield into being sacred of everything and everyone.

episodes.title: Into the Wild: Call of the Wild (Part 1)
Into the Wild: Into the Woods (Part 2)
Into the Wild: Nermal's First Kiss (Part 3)
Into the Wild: Where Eagles Dare Do (Part 4)
Bewitched - Witches Just Wanna Have Fun (Part 2)
The Mean Machine - Too Smart Smartphones (Part 1)
The Mean Machine - Men of Metal (Part 2)
The Mean Machine - Rocket to Sprocket (Part 4)
The Mean Machine - The Robot Revolution (Part 5)
Glitter Gulch - Go West, Young Cat (Part 1)
Glitter Gulch - Life on the Stage (Part 4)
Against All Tides - Scallywags & Scoundrels Sea (Part 1)
Against All Tides - Adventures on Aruba Island (Part 2)
Against All Tides - Feeding the Fish (Part 4)
Against All Tides - Return of the Queen (Part 5)
The Lasagna Tree: The Rat Pack (Part 1)
The Lasagna Tree: Roaming About Rome (Part 3)
The Lasagna Tree: The Pasta Plant (Part 4)
The Lasagna Tree: The Big Broadcast (Part 5)
Rodent Rebellion (Part 1)
episodes.description: Jon threatens Garfield to get rid of mice while a rat named Ratzo comes over.

episodes.title: Un nouveau nez pour Le Schtroumpf Costaud
episodes.description: After a talk with Jokey and Poet, Hefty is convinced that his nose is too big and he wants a new one because he thinks Smurfette is uninterested in him. When he asks Papa Smurf, he refuses, so Hefty uses a spell that enlarges his nose.

episodes.title: Robot-Nounou
episodes.description: Handy invents a robot to change Baby's diapers. But when the machine malfunctions and kidnaps Baby, the Smurfs must come to his rescue!

episodes.title: Schtroumpf-Fu
episodes.description: The Smurfs ask Smurfette to teach them "Smurf fu," but she's a tough teacher. Her students decide to pull a gag on her and end up in real trouble.

episodes.title: C'est qui le plus costaud ?
episodes.description: Wimpy Smurf challenges Hefty to a fight. In an accident, Wimpy wins and is treated like a strongman. Smurfette, who knows how Wimpy won, helps Hefty to become the strongest again.

episodes.title: Le schtroumpf invisible
episodes.description: While on a scooter, Brainy causes Papa Smurf to drop his latest experiment and as a result, he becomes invisible. In order to make him visible again, he, Brainy and Smurfette have to get a whisker from Azrael.

episodes.title: Attention : chat intelligent !
episodes.description: Upon teaching Scaredy to conquer his fears of bears, Smurfette and Brainy figure they could use Papa Smurf's hypno glasses to hypnotize Gargamel to stop catching Smurfs. This backfires and he falls into the mind control of Azarel. Brainy must get back the hypno glasses and de hypnotize him.

episodes.title: Pas de repos pour le Schtroumpf paresseux
episodes.description: Lazy Smurf no longer wants to miss the important moments in the Village, so Handy builds him a special alarm clock to keep him awake, but it keeps the rest of the Smurfs awake as well. When the others want Lazy to turn it off, Lazy refuses and hides in the forest, but he finds himself facing Gargamel.

episodes.title: Le Monstro Schtroumpf
episodes.description: It's Halloween, the holiday that Scaredy hates. During the annual party, he blends into a monster suit from Papa Smurf and wreaks havoc in the village. However, the Smurfs don't seem to know that it's Scaredy and keep running away from him.

episodes.title: Être ou ne pas être maladroit
episodes.description: Clumsy is kidnapped by Gargamel again and he reveals a magic amulet that makes him the opposite of what he is. He offers to give it to him in exchange for the location of the village. When Clumsy refuses, Gargamel makes sure to let him "escape". Clumsy takes it without knowing that it contains a tracking device that will lead Gargamel straight to the Smurfs' Village.

episodes.title: Le sourire du Schtroumpf Grognon
episodes.description: Smurfette and Smurfblossom notice that Grouchy is never happy. To make up for it, they bring him on a hike with the help of Hefty, Handy, and Papa Smurf. The attempt to do so fails extremely, and they end up trapped on a large mountain. They have to find a way to get back up, while also trying to make Grouchy smile.

episodes.title: Les Schtroumpfs volants
episodes.description: While Handy and Smurfstorm are bickering, they overhear Gargamel's plan to make Azrael fly, so they create they're own flying machines. Meanwhile, Gargamel makes Azrael fly by using the magic amulet (see Clumsy Not Clumsy).

episodes.title: La farce de trop
episodes.description: Vanity is tired of Jokey's exploding box, so he and a couple other Smurfs use magical explosive powder. However, it backfires when the potion creates a bunch of mini-Jokeys, who wreck havoc in the village. They eventually strap Papa Smurf onto a rocket and Vanity and Jokey team up to defeat them.

episodes.title: Dans la peau d'une Schtroumpf
episodes.description: Scaredy and Hefty accidentally break Papa Smurf's telescope while cleaning his lab, so they disguise themselves as girls to avoid punishment. When Smurfette learns about this, she helps them blend in with the others. However, it becomes harder to keep up the act when Papa Smurf tells them about the Iron Smurf Girls Tournament, a competition where Smurfettes compete to hold an egg from breaking.

episodes.title: Invasion extraterrestre
episodes.description: An Alien arrives in the village and takes on the form of a Smurf and forces the Smurfs to be his friends. Smurfette must save the day from the alien with the help of Smurfblossom, Smurfstorm, and Smurflily.

episodes.title: Super Schtroumpf
episodes.description: Scaredy Smurf is tired of being scared. With the help of the Handy, he becomes a self proclaimed "superhero" around the village (in reality, he causes havoc among the village). But when Bigmouth arrives, Scaredy actually has to face his fear.

episodes.title: Qui a schtroumpfé la salsepareille ?
episodes.description: Gargamel steals the sasparillia harvest that the Smurfs use to eat pies. When they find out, they become miserable and they have substitute with blueberries. Meanwhile, Jokey, Brainy, and Chef Smurf begin suspecting that Greedy is the culprit until they understand that it was Gargamel's plan to attract them to the sasparillia field, which is now filled with traps.

episodes.title: Le défilé de la discorde
episodes.description: Vanity convinces Tailor Smurf to make a new outfit for the Smurfs. After Jokey gets a hold of it, he and a few other Smurfs greatly change it up, which causes Vanity to accuse Tailor of being a bad Tailor, which causes them to fight in an all-out war. Other Smurfs begin rooting for one or the other and abandon their clothes until a new outfit is made.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Bêta devient papa
episodes.description: Dimwitty finds an egg in the forest and becomes a "mother" and names it Dimwitty Junior. When the other Smurfs realize he has no parenting skills, they teach him everything they know about parenting, but Dimwitty learns that the baby will be better with his real parents.

episodes.title: Cataschtroumpf en cuisine
episodes.description: After lightning strikes Blossom and Brainy, they get mysteriously transported to an alternate universe — where everything is topsy-turvy.

episodes.title: L'Arbre à Schtroumpfs
episodes.description: Papa Smurf decides to organize an election that will appoint the Smurfs who will be part of the Special Brigade responsible for defending the village. The chosen ones are Dimwitty, Lazy, Scaredy, Clumsy, and Baby. When Gargamel attacks the village and captures all the Smurfs, except the five chosen ones, they have to get along and save their friends.

episodes.title: La Recette du Schtroumpf Cuisinier
episodes.description: When Gargamel attacks the village and snags their friends, Baby, Dimwitty, Clumsy, Lazy and Scaredy join forces to pull off a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Des escargots et des Schtroumpfs
episodes.description: Jokey gives Farmer's racing snails a potion to make them super fast. However, the snails continue their race out of the village - without Chef, Smurfstorm and Hefty on them, so Jokey has to go look for them in the forest.

episodes.title: Un babysitting mouvementé
episodes.description: Chef leaves the village in a huff after Brainy criticizes his food. But when he meets two hungry ogres in the forest, he'll have to cook — or be cooked.

episodes.title: Les Schproumpfs ! - Partie 1
episodes.description: Clumsy and Dimwitty decide to take care of Baby to prove that they're responsible, but their plan backfires when he leads them to Gargamel's doorstep.

episodes.title: Les Schproumpfs ! - Partie 2
episodes.description: Jokey pulls a trick to make the village's annual snail race more exciting. But when the snails go racing into the forest, Jokey is in for a big surprise.

episodes.title: La Guerre des gaufres
episodes.description: Chef Smurf becomes jealous of Smurflily when she starts making waffles that are better than his. He tries to find ways to figure out what her secret is.

episodes.title: L'Assistant du Grand Schtroumpf
episodes.description: Jokey steals a potion that transforms Poet into Gargamel's mother. The two Smurfs have fun toying with the sorcerer — until his actual mother arrives.

episodes.title: La grande crèche
episodes.description: After Baby messes with the Smurfs' revitalizing potion, everyone turns into babies — except Storm. Can she find a cure and Smurf-sit at the same time?

episodes.title: Gargamel voit double
episodes.description: Jokey has fun transforming Poet so that he looks like Gargamel's Mother. When the joke backfires and they find themselves stuck in Gargamel's hovel, they will have to manage to escape without being caught by Azrael and later, Gargamel's mother.

episodes.title: Schtroumpfe-moi ton secret - Partie 1
episodes.description: When Brainy learns that Gargamel is trying to transform into a Smurf, he puts a new security protocol in place: the Smurfs must share one of their secrets to prove their identity. Eventually, Gargamel infiltrates the village disguised as a Smurf, so Brainy has to save his friends.

episodes.title: Schtroumpfe-moi ton secret - Partie 2
episodes.description: Gargamel convinces Dimwitty and Begonia that he's a nice guy who just wants to go to Smurf Village and make peace with everyone. Will they take him home?

episodes.title: Scoop chez les Schtroumpfs/Panique chez les Schtroumpfs
episodes.description: Farmer and Vanity unearth a mysterious gem that curses all who touch it! To stop the bad luck, they'll need to rebury it — but one Smurf has other plans.

episodes.title: La fête de Gargamel
episodes.description: Gargamel convinces Dimwitty and Smurfbegonia that he has become kind, so they invite him to the village to celebrate a big party in his honor.

episodes.title: Bouton d'Or, guerrière de choc !
episodes.description: Gargamel casts a spell over Grouchy that transports everything he complains about to the sorcerer's hovel — even Smurfs!

episodes.title: Les Schtroumpfboards
episodes.description: When Vanity and Jokey start riding skateboards around the village, Brainy believes they're dangerous; he sets up to teach Jokey and Vanity the rules of the roads.

episodes.title: Le trésor des Schtroumpfs
episodes.description: Farmer and Vanity find a chest that contains a magical jewel, but it gives anyone bad luck who touches it. After they figure it out, they decide to bury it, but Vanity, who still wants it, runs away with it.

episodes.title: Le Pouvoir du Schtroumpf Grognon
episodes.description: Gargamel plants a camera in Smurf Village to spy on everything they do. But the tables turn in a dramatic way when the Smurfs uncover his evil scheme.

episodes.title: Gargamel perd la schtroumpf
episodes.description: The Smurfs try to lead Gargamel into a trap by inventing a mysterious "sword of power" for him to discover.

episodes.title: Gargamel à la Une
episodes.description: Vanity and Jokey start riding Smurfboards around the village, so an annoyed Brainy decides to teach them some rules of the road.

episodes.title: La Légende du Schtroumpf Chevalier
episodes.description: A delivery mix-up lands Papa Smurf with a monkey meant for Gargamel. Jokey and Dimwitty get attached to the primate and plot to keep him in the village.

episodes.title: Le baptême de l'air du Schtroumpf Maladroit
episodes.description: Clumsy thinks there's only one place he won't bump into anyone: up in the sky. He begs Handy to teach him how to fly, but Handy has a better idea.

episodes.title: Schtroumpfs TV - Partie 1
episodes.description: When Brainy gets hurt before the big magic convention, Papa Smurf chooses Monkey to fill in for him at the lab. But is the primate up to the task?

episodes.title: Schtroumpfs TV - Partie 2
episodes.description: Jokey grows tired of Brainy bossing all the Smurfs around, so he distracts him with an imaginary competition — but Brainy gets way too invested.

episodes.title: Malin comme un singe
episodes.description: Gargamel captures Papa Smurf, Willow and Vanity. To save themselves, they'll have to help the sorcerer with an impossible task: pleasing his mother!

episodes.title: Le revers de la médaille
episodes.description: Vanity breaks into Papa Smurf's lab to steal a healing lotion for his zit and accidentally turns himself into a fire-breathing lizard!

episodes.title: Miroir, mon beau miroir
episodes.description: Wanting to impress his Mummy, Gargamel creates and leaves a magic cabinet that imprisons anyone who looks into its mirror in the forest. Unfortunately, Brainy, Blossom, Storm, Hefty, and Farmer are taken inside and Vanity must save them.

episodes.title: Le Grand Gargamel
episodes.description: A supporting Smurf who wants to be a boss asks Vanity to make him look like Papa Smurf — but leading Smurf Village is a lot harder than it looks.

episodes.title: La métamorphose du Schtroumpf Coquet
episodes.description: When Vanity notices that he has a pimple on his nose, he breaks into Papa Smurf's lab and steals a lotion to get rid of that pimple, but it turns him into a fire-breathing lizard.

episodes.title: Bonne fête maman !
episodes.description: Clumsy and Dimwitty quit the fire brigade in a big huff, so Smurfette takes over. When she does an incredible job, the former firefighters get jealous.

episodes.title: Dans la peau du Grand Schtroumpf
episodes.description: A generic Smurf wants to feel important and respected, so Vanity gives him a makeover that he now looks like Papa Smurf, but he will have to learn what it is to have responsibilities.

episodes.title: Tout Schtroumpf, tout flamme !
episodes.description: When Gargamel uses magic to switch bodies with Papa Smurf and sneak into Smurf Village, Timid has to figure out how to speak up to save the day.

episodes.title: Le Combat de poésie
episodes.description: Worried that Lily will win the big poetry contest, Poet loses his ability to rhyme. But will he overcome "poet's block" in time to take home a victory?

episodes.title: Où est mon Gyroschtroumpf?
episodes.description: Brainy lends Blossom his special Smurf-way, but she loses it in the forest.  While Smurfette distracts Brainy, Blossom sets out to find the lost scooter.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Cambrioleur
episodes.description: The Smurfs' valuables go missing overnight, sending everyone into a panic.  Brainy sets a trap to lure the thief out of hiding.

episodes.title: Un peu de savoir-schtroumpf !
episodes.description: A worried Papa Smurf prepares the village for a visit from the new nature fairy.  Willow helps the Smurfs learn proper manners before their guest arrives.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Sauvage s'incruste
episodes.description: When Wild sprains his ankle, Brainy takes him to recover at Papa Smurf's house while Papa is out of town.  But once he feels better, Wild insists on staying.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Tout Court
episodes.description: Justa Smurf, surrounded by others who are all Something Smurf, is still searching for his calling.

episodes.title: Pas touche à l'artiste !
episodes.description: When the other Smurfs bale out of posing for Painter's masterpiece, he finds a new subject in Gargamel's mom.

episodes.title: Chef oui chef
episodes.description: When Papa Smurf leaves Brainy in charge of the village while he's away, Brainy decides to use a magic potion to make the Smurfs follow his every command.

episodes.title: Souriez, vous êtes schtroumpfés !
episodes.description: Painter's new camera accidentally freezes the Smurfs in place when he takes their photo.  Gargamel and Azrael try to snatch up the frozen villagers.

episodes.title: Un Admirateur Encombrant (Partie 1)
episodes.description: Big Mouth Falls in love with Smurfette after she removes a splinter from his hand.  Excited, he trails her back to Smurf Village, where he stirs up chaos.

episodes.title: Un Admirateur Encombrant (Partie 2)
episodes.description: Smurfette & Papa Smurf hatch a plan to help her escape Big Mouth's lair.  To save her, the Smurfs will need to involve an unsuspecting Gargamel.

episodes.title: Le Stage d'observaschtroumpf
episodes.description: After a bear disrupts their flower-picking mission, Whild teaches Dimwitty, Poet, and Vanity how to survive in nature.

episodes.title: Gargamel en bave !
episodes.description: Gargamel transforms into a snail to sneak into Smurf Village.  When his plan goes awry, he becomes Dimwitty's special pet.

episodes.title: Les deux bêtas font la paire
episodes.description: After a big fight with Storm and Lily, Blossom decides to leave the comforts of Smurfy Grove to move in with Wild.

episodes.title: Bouton d'Or se met au vert
episodes.description: After a big argument with Storm and Lily, Blossom announces that she is leaving the Girls' Village and is going to live with Wild Smurf.

episodes.title: La Schtroumpfette en fait trop !
episodes.description: Doing too much, Smurfette is very tired. To teach her the art of doing nothing, Papa Smurf entrusts her to the greatest specialist: Lazy.

episodes.title: Okidoki !
episodes.description: Jokey uses a potion that makes Grouchy say "Okey-dokey!" to everything.

episodes.title: Il faut guérir le Schtroumpf Timide !
episodes.description: Convinced that Timid admires him, Hefty decides to take him under his wing, in order to teach him self-confidence.

episodes.title: Soufflé n'est pas jouer !
episodes.description: Chef sprains his ankle and has to rely on Greedy to bring his souffle to the Spring Festival.

episodes.title: Duel magique chez les Schtroumpfs
episodes.description: Papa Smurf and Willow challenge each other in a magic duel.

episodes.title: Schtroumpfez-nous de là !
episodes.description: Because Scaredy is afraid that a ghost is haunting his house, he asks Handy to make it secure. Too well secured, he find himself locked in his house, with Brainy, Blossom, and Chef.

episodes.title: L'envol du Grand Schtroumpf
episodes.description: While Papa Smurf is preparing a potion to cure his voice loss, a sparrow enters his lab and accidentally switches bodies with him.

episodes.title: Le Portrait Volé
episodes.description: Someone has stolen Painter's painting and all the Smurfs are looking for it. While the artist is in despair, Smurfette confuses the culprit for Gargamel.

episodes.title: Chat perdu
episodes.description: Azrael has had enough of Gargamel and leaves the hovel! Only, once in the forest, he gets injured and is picked up by Wild.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Gourou
episodes.description: Smurfette and the students in her Smurf-Fu class mistakenly mistake Baby Smurf for the Smurf-Fu guru who will guide them to the next level.

episodes.title: La citrouille magique
episodes.description: On Halloween, Smurfette gives Wimpy Smurf a magic pumpkin that makes him terrifying, only the pumpkin isn't actually magic at all.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Star
episodes.description: Papa Smurf gives Harmony a potion that charms his audience during a concert. However, Harmony forces the dose and the Smurfs turn into hysterical fans.

episodes.title: Le Fantôme du Grand Grand Schtroumpf
episodes.description: When Brainy's controlling nature gets under the Smurfs' skin, Painter and Chef come up with the ultimate prank.

episodes.title: Escargots en grève !
episodes.description: Tired of their life, Farmer's snails go on strike and join Wild to share his free and unconstrained life. However, they lost an essential thing when they left the farm, something that only Farmer can give them...

episodes.title: Ne réveillez pas un sorcier qui dort !
episodes.description: When Gargamel arrives at the Smurfs' village in the middle of the night asleep, Papa Smurf realizes that the wizard is a sleepwalker. The Smurfs take the opportunity to "have fun" with their sworn enemy.

episodes.title: Le Rallye de la citrouille
episodes.description: During the first mixed pumpkin rally, Hefty, undisputed champion of previous editions, shows off like a macho, much to the annoyance of Storm, who is determined to show him that a girl can beat him. However, the two have uncompetitive teammates: Blossom and Dimwitty.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Tricheur
episodes.description: Greedy cheats on a waffle eating contest and earns the win. Regreting his actions, he uses a potion which brings out his angel and devil side.

episodes.title: La Machine à schtroumpfer dans le temps (Partie 1)
episodes.description: When Handy invents a time machine for Blossom, the duo accidentally goes back to prehistoric times.

episodes.title: La Machine à schtroumpfer dans le temps (Partie 2)
episodes.description: Blossom and Handy are taken prisoner by Prehistoric Smurfs who plan on sacrificing Handy to a ferocious beast.

episodes.title: Rock'n Schtroumpf
episodes.description: The Smurf Orchestra is to give a concert for Willow in honor for her birthday. But when Slammy, the singer and leader of the group, behaves like a diva, he is replaced by another diva: Vanity.

episodes.title: Gagargamel
episodes.description: When he swallows a potion-infested cake, Gargamel falls madly in love with Leaf and no longer wants to leave her.

episodes.title: Schtroumpfe-moi ton doudou !
episodes.description: After losing his favorite pillow, Lazy loses his legendary sleep and borrows Baby's teddy bear to try it.

episodes.title: Le Décoince-schtroumpf
episodes.description: Fascinated by the talkative Blossom, Timid dreams of becoming her friend.

episodes.title: Le Pari
episodes.description: Smurfette accidentally loses the Smurf Village in a bet with Storm and must carefully try to win it back.

episodes.title: Comme un Schtroumpf en pâte !
episodes.description: When Wild steals their cupcakes, Begonia, Lily, and Blossom decide to teach him a lesson.

episodes.title: On ne schtroumpfe pas avec l'Amour !
episodes.description: Persuaded to be an expert in love, Dreamer uses all the great clichés of romance novels to unite two Smurfs whose couple is more than unlikely -- Papa Smurf and Willow.

episodes.title: Farce attaque !
episodes.description: It's Smurf's Fools Day, but Jokey loses his happiness as he is not the only one participating in the event.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf Maladroit fait son cirque
episodes.description: When Clumsy convinces himself that he must become an acrobat at all costs to better manage his clumsiness, the Smurfs create a fake circus company to make his dream come true.

episodes.title: Faut qu'ça pousse !
episodes.description: Chef is growing increasingly worried when he sees that the Yummyus, the main ingredient in his famous Equinox pie, haven't bloomed yet, but Farmer refuses to do anything about it.

episodes.title: Une Salsepareille sans pareille
episodes.description: Papa Smurf, Willow, Leaf, and Gargamel and his mother are looking for the Sarsaparillo plant that grows every 100 years.

episodes.title: Pompiers un jour, pompiers toujours
episodes.description: When the Smurfs try to recruit a new fire brigade, Clumsy and Dimwitty disguise themselves to take part in the tests.

episodes.title: La Salsepapareille
episodes.description: Gargamel bewitches the sarsaparilla fields, causing Chef, Brainy, Dimwitty, and Greedy to float in the air.

episodes.title: Le Schtroumpf à Molette
episodes.description: When Handy turns Diaper Daddy into a perfect assistant, an incident burns the machine's memory.

episodes.title: Il faut schtroumpfer Feuille !
episodes.description: When Leaf gets sick, the Smurfs must cure the fairy to fix the rapidly changing weather.

episodes.title: Un ami de taille
episodes.description: When he's sidelined from the Smurfball tournament, Grouchy goes into the forest, where he befriends Bigmouth, much to the disappointment of Egghead.

episodes.title: Un Noël schtroumpfant
episodes.description: As Christmas approaches, Jokey mixes up the letters that the Smurfs have asked him to send to Santa Claus.

episodes.title: Allô, Docteur Schtroumpf
episodes.description: When Brainy and Farmer find a note from Gargamel to his mother that tells he is very sick, Doctor can't resist going to help him.

episodes.title: Gargamel, reine du bal
episodes.description: When the Smurf Girls invite the Smurfs to their big Equinox ball, Gargamel and Azrael transform into Girl Smurfs and infiltrate the preparations.

episodes.title: Tonton Gargamel
episodes.description: Gargamel confiscates Dwayne and Rowena's toys. Seeking revenge, they free the Smurfs their uncle had captured.

episodes.title: Le Gigaschtroumpf
episodes.description: Jealous of Diaper Daddy, Handy crafts himself a dysfonctional and overpowered exoskeleton. Diaper Daddy is the only one who can save him.

episodes.title: Opération Gargamel
episodes.description: Emboldened by her own talents, Storm enlists Lily and Blossom to help her chase Gargamel out of forest forever...but unknowingly leads them into a trap!

episodes.title: Le bébé costaud
episodes.description: Hefty Smurf unwittingly changes bodies with Baby Smurf when Smurfstorm challenges him.

episodes.title: La Plante de Rowena
episodes.description: Clumsy and Dimwitty want to help Rowena cure her plant, but little do they know it's all a scam to capture Smurfs.

episodes.title: Une si jolie poupée
episodes.description: When one of Jokey's pranks goes wrong, the Smurfs are all turned to pebbles.

episodes.title: Les Grands jeux schtroumpfs (1)
episodes.description: Clumsy and Dimwitty want to help Rowena cure her plant; they don't know that it's all a scam to capture Smurfs.

episodes.title: Les Grands Jeux des Schtroumpfs (2)
episodes.description: Rowena turns Vanity and Storm into dolls.
