episodes.title: Dans le ventre du dragon
episodes.description: Clumsy is desperate to take part in the Great Smurf Games and win the prize, which is a magic sphere that grants a wish to the winner.

episodes.title: Une recette explosive
episodes.description: Clumsy is desperate to take part in the Great Smurf Games and win the prize, which is a magic sphere that grants a wish to the winner.

episodes.title: Un trio d'enfer
episodes.description: Tired of not being able to defend himself, Wimpy decides having a dragon would solve his problems.

episodes.title: L'arbre de la connaissance
episodes.description: Chef uses a cauldron from Papa Smurf's lab and accidentally brings it to life.

episodes.title: Une étoile pour le Grand Schtroumpf
episodes.description: Brainy accidentally gives Gargamel the idea to clone himself to increase his odds of catching Smurfs.

episodes.title: L'équipe de choc
episodes.description: The Smurfs think they have found the famous Tree of Knowledge mentioned in a legend and all rush to ask it for advice. They do not know that it is actually Dimwitty, stuck inside a hollow trunk.

episodes.title: Dragon de compagnie
episodes.description: After breaking Papa Smurf's telescope, Monkey wants to repair his mistake and goes in search of a star.

episodes.title: La Farce ultime
episodes.description: Dwayne finds Handy's jet pack in the forest and takes it to make his own. Handy must then put together a team to go get it from Gargamel, but the only Smurfs available are not the ones Handy was thinking of...

episodes.title: La Nuit du monstre
episodes.description: Smurfette and Grouchy argue over who takes better care of Baby... a competition then begins between the two babysitters.

episodes.title: La grande Excursion
episodes.description: To monitor the captured Papa Smurf and Storm, Gargamel brings to life Lucretia, Rowena's doll, to make her a prison guard who becomes a little too bossy.

episodes.title: La Poupée de Mémé
episodes.description: A monster lurks in the village and turns the Smurfs into crawling zombies. Lily and Farmer must conduct the investigation together despite their differences.

episodes.title: Le Chef d'Oeuvre de Bébé Schtroumpf
episodes.description: Blossom brings Scaredy on a trip to the forest to conquer his fear.

episodes.title: La Guerre des Nounous
episodes.description: Without realizing that it is a trap of Gargamel, Lily finds a sudden passion for pebbles that she finds in the forest and begins a collection which quickly becomes imitated among the Smurfs.

episodes.title: L'ours qui parle aux Schtroumpfs
episodes.description: Blossom dreams of going to Mars. She decides to do it in secret with the help of Handy because Papa Smurf has forbidden them from going there.

episodes.title: En route pour la planète Mars
episodes.description: To respect a Smurfy tradition, Chef and Blossom must find a thirteenth dessert for the Christmas meal, which will take them straight to Gargamel.

episodes.title: Les Schtroumpfs et le Portail Magique
episodes.description: Painter uses Baby to make abstract paintings, but things soon get out of hand.

episodes.title: La dent de Rowena
episodes.description: To prove to Storm that they can also have great adventures, Bubble and Firefly decide to steal one of Rowena's teeth, which is about to fall out.

episodes.title: Les Schtroumpfs escargots
episodes.description: Jokey wants to prove that he is capable of taking care of Baby. While Bubble is there to help him, they accidentally turn Baby into a snail.

episodes.title: La grande Obscurité
episodes.description: Gargamel causes a long dark night to fall on the forest in order to capture the Smurfs and only Firefly can come to their aid.

episodes.title: Le treizième dessert
episodes.description: Meteorite's drum, cursed by Gargamel, bewitches the girls and leads them to Gargamel.

episodes.title: Le plus beau caillou du monde
episodes.description: Gargamel transforms Rowena into a Smurfette in an attempt to capture Smurfs, but Mummy begins adoring her because she reminded her of her doll from her childhood.

episodes.title: Le voleur de Gaufres
episodes.description: Handy creates a machine to translate animal sounds, but Clumsy accidentally breaks it.

episodes.title: Une pâtée pour Azraël
episodes.description: Diaper Daddy feels neglected among the Smurfs and decides to go in search of a place where he will be better loved.

episodes.title: Des pompiers sans camion
episodes.description: Dwayne loves Lily's waffles but she refuses to make him any more. He then decides to take revenge by transforming her into a waffle.

episodes.title: Météorite et le tambour magique
episodes.description: Baby finds Handy's time traveling Cuckoo Clock and accidentally brings the Handy's prehistoric counterpart back to the village.

episodes.title: Le Toutou de Gargamel
episodes.description: Meteorite finds Gargamel's cursed disco mushroom in the forest that she brings back to the village to dance with the Smurfs, not knowing it is a trap.

episodes.title: Le nouveau jouet de Broc
episodes.description: To make Azrael docile, Chef prepares an irresistible pie that Gargamel will serve. Unfortunately, Mummy goes crazy and demands that Gargamel make it again.

episodes.title: La folie du Discoschtroumpf
episodes.description: Following a blunder by Dimwitty and Clumsy, they find themselves wandering in parallel universes, trying to return to their own.

episodes.title: Bébé Schtroumpf devient grand
episodes.description: Attacked by insects, Farmer's crops are in dire straits. When he sees Gulp eating insects, he decides to plant one of his seeds, accidentally creating a Gulp invasion in the village.

episodes.title: Silence chez les Schtroumpfs
episodes.description: Clumsy and Dimwitty are arguing about who should drive the truck. Unable to agree, they park the truck in the forest but lose it.

episodes.title: On a schtroumpfé sur la lune (Partie 1)
episodes.description: While trying to help Farmer grow his plants faster, Papa Smurf accidentally gives the potion to Baby, who starts growing nonstop.

episodes.title: On a schtroumpfé sur la lune (Partie 2)
episodes.description: Gargamel gives Azrael supersonic hearing so that he can help Gargamel to locate the Smurf village.

episodes.title: La Métamorphose du Grand Schtroumpf
episodes.description: When the moon loses its glow, the Smurfs decide to send a team to relight it, unaware that it's just Leaf's mistake.

episodes.title: Un Voleur en Cuisine
episodes.description: While stuck on the moon, Storm, Farmer, and Vanity must enlist a help from their new alien friends to find the safest way home.

episodes.title: Schtroumpfement groumpf
episodes.description: In order to prove to his uncle that he can be a good Smurf hunter, Dwayne makes a potion that gives him the qualities of a hunting dog, but also his faults...

episodes.title: Le nouvel ami du Schtroumpf Paysan
episodes.description: While Storm claims to be afraid of nothing, Jokey challenges her to go to a cave in the middle of the night, to tell her scary stories.

episodes.title: Histoire à schtroumpfer de peur
episodes.description: Following an incident, Hefty's shadow comes to life and rebels because he wants to be free to do what he wants.

episodes.title: L'Ombre du Schtroumpf Costaud
episodes.description: Storm overhears Gargamel talking about a talisman that will give him the power to seize the girls' village and decides to seize it first to save her village!

episodes.title: Le Talisman magique (Partie 1)
episodes.description: Storm must free the girls from Gargamel, who has taken over their village with the talisman's power.

episodes.title: Le Talisman magique (Partie 2)
episodes.description: Papa Smurf turns into a giant arachnid after a spider accidentally intrudes into the potion which was supposed to boost his athletic abilities.

episodes.title: Lucrétia prend le pouvoir
episodes.description: Following yet another bowl of Clumsy, a flower pot falls on Papa Smurf, who loses his mind. While Brainy decides to take charge of the village, the others Smurfs do everything to bring Papa Smurf to his senses.

episodes.title: Le Grand Schtroumpf perd la tête
episodes.description: Someone stole the traditional Blueberry cake from the Fête du Bleu! Chef then wants to innovate with a new recipe, but an investigation to find the thief is necessary!

episodes.title: Le Cadeau du Grand Schtroumpf
episodes.description: Dimwitty and Begonia offer a birthday present to Papa Smurf, but the latter does not like him and then pretends to have lost him. Dimwitty and Begonia find him and then make sure that he never loses him again...

episodes.title: Mon Amie l'Abeille
episodes.description: Lost in the forest, a bee chose Blossom as the new queen and follows her everywhere. But the latter fearing bees, she decides to conduct the investigation with Lily to find the hive.

episodes.title: Shattered
episodes.description: A collision with the Paradox Prism sends Sonic to a parallel world called New Yoke City, where the dull environment looks oddly familiar.

episodes.title: The Yoke's on You
episodes.description: A power outage gives two rebels a chance to break into a lab where the Chaos Council is studying Sonic's strange connection to their energy source.

episodes.title: Escape from New Yoke
episodes.description: To secure the Prism Shard, the rebels battle the Chaos Council. Then Sonic makes a startling discovery about the events that shattered his world.

episodes.title: Unwelcome to the Jungle
episodes.description: In a dimension called the Boscage Maze, Sonic runs into tree-dwelling versions of his friends who warn him of a monster that lives on the jungle floor.

episodes.title: Barking Up the Wrong Tree
episodes.description: To find his way back to the right dimension, Sonic must battle the jungle monster who waged war on his friends and capture the powerful Prism Shard.

episodes.title: Situation: Grim
episodes.description: Back in New Yoke, Sonic desperately tries to convince Nine to join the Resistance, but Nine is focused on building a brand-new home.

episodes.title: It Takes One to No Place
episodes.description: In the tropical No Place, Sonic meets a friendly band of pirates and their mysterious captain, who loves to party.

episodes.title: There's No ARRGH in "Team"
episodes.description: As Sonic's crew races to the Prism Shard, they quickly realize they're not the only ones after it. There's only one way to win — they gotta go fast!

episodes.title: Avoid the Void
episodes.description: Shadow ambushes Sonic in the void of the Shatterverse to confront his rival about the destruction of Green Hill — and take matters into his own hands.

episodes.title: Battle in the Boscage
episodes.description: As the Chaos Council searches for the Boscage Prism Shard, Sonic realizes there's only one way to stop the robots from destroying the forest: a battle.

episodes.title: Second Wind
episodes.description: To save Captain Dread's crew and recapture the Shard, Sonic will have to do what he does best: act fast. Luckily he has help from an unexpected ally.

episodes.title: No Way Out
episodes.description: Friends become foes when Captain Dread's crew questions Sonic's loyalties. Then, a battle on the high seas breaks out over possession of the Shard.

episodes.title: A Madness to Their Methods
episodes.description: The Chaos Council returns to New Yoke City more powerful than ever, forcing the rebels to come out of the shadows and bring a fight to their front door.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.description: Sonic meets his match in Chaos Sonic, a robot version of himself designed to never fail. Meanwhile, the Chaos Council decides to expand their empire.

episodes.title: Cracking Down
episodes.description: The key to reassembling the Paradox Prism lies in one of the Shatterspaces. But can Nine and Sonic find a portal to safely transport the Shards there?

episodes.title: Ghost of a Chance
episodes.description: While Nine reassembles the Paradox Prism, Shadow and Sonic battle the Council to buy more time — but there's one big surprise they weren't counting on.

episodes.title: Grim Tidings
episodes.description: With the Paradox Prism in his hands, Nine begins building the Grim into his own personal paradise — unless Sonic and Shadow can convince him otherwise.

episodes.title: Dome Sweet Dome
episodes.description: To get help in the fight against Nine and his winged lackeys, Sonic heads to New Yoke and forms an allegiance with the very last people he ever expected.

episodes.title: No Escape
episodes.description: Sonic races to No Place to save the pirates before their world collapses, but Nine still needs Sonic's energy to power the Paradox Prism.

episodes.title: Nine's Lives
episodes.description: Sonic must learn to give up some control if he's going to defeat Nine on the battlefield. The first step? Letting the team take over.

episodes.title: Home Sick Home
episodes.description: To beat the biggest bot on the battlefield and get one step closer to Nine, Sonic needs to move fast — and accept a little help from his friends.

episodes.title: The Devil Is in the Tails
episodes.description: Sonic discovers a new ability that may be the key to defeating Nine. But Nine's endless army has only one purpose: to capture Sonic's energy.

episodes.title: From the Top
episodes.description: Reality will cease to exist unless a selfless hero makes the ultimate sacrifice. But will it be enough to reverse the damage Nine caused to the universe?

tt7741824.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business

episodes.title: Scooter Buskie
episodes.description: The constantly crying "worst baby in the world" is making life miserable for all of his neighbors.  Can Boss Baby's field team turn things around?

episodes.title: Cat's in the Cradle
episodes.description: Competition for cuteness heats up when a stray kitten appears on the Templetons' doorstep and the family decides to take him in.

episodes.title: Family Fun Night
episodes.description: Family Fun Night turns into Baby Work Night when trouble follows the Templetons to the grand opening of a seemingly purr-fect restaurant.

episodes.title: Formula for Menace: A Dekker Moonboots Mystery
episodes.description: Tim's alter ego, space detective Dekker Moonboots, steps in to solve a Baby Corp mystery -- and mounting clues suggest it's an inside job.

episodes.title: Monster Machine
episodes.description: The field team enters one of their own in the prestigious Lil' Dumpling Pageant to make sure the winner is someone Baby Corp can trust.

episodes.title: The Constipation Situation
episodes.description: A backed-up Boss Baby is forced to take a sick day when his system stalls -- and he can't go boom-boom. Now it's up to Tim to take over.

episodes.title: The Boss Babysitter
episodes.description: The brothers stay home with a babysitter while their parents go out for the night.  Boss Baby wants to make her look bad -- but she's just too good.

episodes.title: Into the Belly of the Den of the House of the Nest of Cats
episodes.description: While Tim works overtime to do good in the neighborhood, Staci and Boss Baby go undercover to rescue Jimbo from a house that's crawling with cats.

episodes.title: Spirit Day
episodes.description: The team suits up to stop Mega FAT CEO Baby from winning an office spirit day contest that's totally rigged.  Because nobody likes a bully.

episodes.title: Par Avion
episodes.description: A "free" family vacation comes at a cost when Tim's tasked with keeping a plane full of babies calm on an eight-hour flight to Paris.

episodes.title: Cat Cop!
episodes.description: The Templetons cross paths with a "Cat Cop" with connections to cunning villain Bootsy Calico.  Tim masters the art of negotiation.

episodes.title: Hang in There, Baby
episodes.description: An after-hours break-in to save Boss Baby's job transforms a do-gooding Tim into the daring Tim Templeton: Unleashed.

episodes.title: Six Well-Placed Kittens
episodes.description: With Bootsy Calico's plan in full swing, Boss Baby rallies his co-workers to bring Calico and his kittens down and save the town.

episodes.title: As the Diaper Changes
episodes.description: The new Baby Corp CEO gives Boss Baby a big assignment. Meanwhile, Tim's feisty grandmother moves in, turning the brothers into temporary roommates.

episodes.title: Super Cool Big Kids Inc.
episodes.description: After declaring war on old people, Boss Baby focuses the field team's efforts on Frederic Estes. Tim starts his own big-kid business.

episodes.title: P.U.
episodes.description: When Baby Corp's lead scientist accidentally turns the stinkless serum into a stink enhancer, Boss Baby needs Tim's help to freshen things up.

episodes.title: Hush, Little Baby
episodes.description: An innocent trip to the library for toddler story hour sparks a turf war between babydom and Frederic Estes's Consortium of Ancients.

episodes.title: Night of the Frodarg
episodes.description: On a dark and stormy night, Tim and Boss Baby set traps for two wildly different threats: a mythical monster and a Puppy Co. agent named Bug the Pug.

episodes.title: Fugitive's Day Out
episodes.description: After being framed for the Puppy Co. leak, a fugitive Boss Baby goes on the lam and comes face to face with an old corporate rival.

episodes.title: El Apasionado Negocio de la Niñera
episodes.description: When Frederic Estes and his friends monopolize Marisol's talents for elder care, Boss Baby and Tim team up to get their babysitter back.

episodes.title: Plushythingy
episodes.description: The Consortium of Ancients floods the market with an irresistibly fluffy new toy that has babies going gaga -- a little too gaga.

episodes.title: Number One Problem
episodes.description: Gigi's potty training strategy has a diaperless Boss Baby hanging out in the buff. But a horrified Tim can't handle all the nakey time.

episodes.title: Picture Perfect
episodes.description: With the Templeton men away on a "Dudes Weekend," Staci and Jimbo join forces to return a blankie to its rightful owner.

episodes.title: Play It Again, Tim
episodes.description: Tim's parents enroll him in piano lessons for the rest of the summer. But Boss Baby suspects Tim's "lessons" are part of a larger Frederic Estes plot.

episodes.title: Research & Development
episodes.description: With Baby Corp's stinkless serum in enemy hands, Turtleneck Superstar CEO Baby issues a challenge to deliver a new formula by 5 p.m.

episodes.title: Wrinkles & Stinkles
episodes.description: In the wake of Tim's discovery, a newly crowned Boss Baby seizes the chance to show his team what a real leader looks like.

episodes.title: Bossa Nova
episodes.description: Ousted from the office and desperate for direction, an unemployed Boss Baby joins a mommy/daddy and me playgroup. But he isn't the only new member.

episodes.title: The Museum Job
episodes.description: A long line at the museum's family bathroom sends baby love into the toilet. Can the field team evict the potty squatter and get things moving?

episodes.title: Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist)
episodes.description: While the Boss Baby helps Tim sell magazines for a school fundraiser, a suspicious baby whisperer is breaking up the playgroup ... but why?

episodes.title: The Coo Chi Coup
episodes.description: The stage is set for corporate sabotage when Staci sends the Boss Baby undercover to take down Baby Corp's latest leader at a company retreat.

episodes.title: Lights, Camera, Org Chart!
episodes.description: Unruly baby Scooter Buskie sends shockwaves through the playgroup org chart — and all of babydom — when he lands the cover of the Bubbeezee catalog.

episodes.title: The Big Break
episodes.description: A broken bone sends the Boss Baby to a wisecracking doctor who fancies himself a comedian. In other news, Tim's lucky pencil is cursed.

episodes.title: Escape from Krinkle's
episodes.description: Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp - but first, he'll need to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom. Can the field team help him escape?

episodes.title: Puppy Party
episodes.description: A party in the park drags the Boss Baby into a dogfight with his old nemesis, Puppy Co.'s Bug the Pug — and the loser must don the "Collar of Shame."

episodes.title: Mega Fat
episodes.description: A flashback episode reveals everything that happened to Mega Fat between getting fired from Baby Corp and getting adopted by a famous journalist.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.description: Halloween is the perfect cover for the Boss Baby and his costumed field team to sneak into the belly of the beast. But Staci's got plans to stop them.

episodes.title: Who's a Good Baby?
episodes.description: Baby love has never been higher. But a crash is coming, and the Boss Baby and his crew are determined to bring Bubbeezee down for good.

episodes.title: Yellow 100
episodes.description: As the newly named CEO, the Boss Baby sets a goal for baby love to hit 100%. But now everyone's working overtime to please him.

episodes.title: Pyg & Tam
episodes.description: The Boss Baby declares war on a new threat: a popular TV show starring a pygmy goat, a tamandua and their human handler.

episodes.title: Conference Room B
episodes.description: Company morale is so low that the Boss Baby throws a last-minute cupcake party, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.

episodes.title: Game Plan
episodes.description: Boss Baby's next scheme to increase baby love? A petition to change the local soccer team's name from the Hive to the Babies.

episodes.title: Night Owls
episodes.description: After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's mature enough for the adult world. Meanwhile, Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.

episodes.title: OCB
episodes.description: It's the Boss Baby's worst nightmare when a consultant comes to Baby Corp with zany ideas, then sets his sights on the CEO's job.

episodes.title: Chicago
episodes.description: On a trip to the Windy City to see Gigi and Grandpa, the Boss Baby comes face to face with an ambitious infant who's masquerading as an adult.

episodes.title: Baby Boss
episodes.description: The Boss Baby's away at a checkup, so it's up to interim manager Staci to fend off three wars: one from Pyg & Tam, one from OCB and one from Bug the Pug.

episodes.title: Boom Baby
episodes.description: Boss Baby discovers an old Mega Fat initiative called Project Boom — and it's threatening to ruin baby rights everywhere.

episodes.title: The Fumbling of Football Mike
episodes.description: After the Boss Baby accidentally sells Tim's favorite toy at a yard sale, he uses company resources to try and get it back.

episodes.title: Teambuilding
episodes.description: Baby Corp is dismantled and comms are down, but that won't stop the Boss Baby from rallying to reunite his employees. Tim spends one last day with Danny.

episodes.title: Theo 100
episodes.description: With diapers piling up in the Templetons' basement, the Boss Baby crafts a plan to break into Baby Corp, kick out his enemies and take his business back.

episodes.title: Left in the Dark
episodes.description: When Lincoln wants to watch the finale of his favorite show, he has to beat each sister to get to the couch first!

episodes.title: Get the Message
episodes.description: After Lincoln leaves a scathing voicemail on Lori's phone, he realizes he has to erase it before she hears it.

episodes.title: Heavy Meddle
episodes.description: Lincoln is tired of his sisters meddling in his business until he's being picked on at school.

episodes.title: Making the Case
episodes.description: Lincoln secretly videos his sister's most embarrassing moments in order to win a video contest at school.

episodes.title: Along Came a Sister
episodes.description: Lincoln is given the responsibility of taking home his classes' tarantula, but it gets loose and wreaks havoc!

episodes.title: Chore and Peace
episodes.description: Thinking he has the worst chores, Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores with him.

episodes.title: Project Loud House
episodes.description: In order to get his project to school on time, Lincoln works to get each of his sisters out the door during their morning routine.

episodes.title: In Tents Debate
episodes.description: The Loud family is planning a vacation and needs a place to go. To avoid the camp grounds, the children pitch ideas for Dairyland Amusement Park or the beach. Their parents let them make the choice where Lincoln is left with the deciding vote.

episodes.title: The Sweet Spot
episodes.description: Lincoln devises a plan to get the best seat in the car for a long, family, road trip.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Tables
episodes.description: Lincoln tries to prove he's mature enough to have dinner at the adult table, leaving the kiddie table behind him.

episodes.title: Driving Miss Hazy
episodes.description: Tired of doing favors to get a ride from Lori, Lincoln decides it's time to help Leni pass her driver's test.

episodes.title: No Guts, No Glori
episodes.description: Lincoln conspires with the rest of his sisters to overthrow Lori's tyranny as their "baby"sitter.

episodes.title: Picture Perfect
episodes.description: Lincoln plots to take the "perfect" family photo for his parents' anniversary gift.

episodes.title: Undie Pressure
episodes.description: Lincoln and his sisters bet on who can go the longest without doing their most annoying habits.

episodes.title: Linc or Swim
episodes.description: Lincoln purchases a kiddie pool, and things get out of hand when all 10 of his sisters want to use it.

episodes.title: Hand-Me-Downer
episodes.description: After Lincoln gets a pink hand-me-down bike from Lori, he borrows Lynn's cool BMX bike without telling her.

episodes.title: Sleuth or Consequences
episodes.description: Someone clogged the Loud House toilet and Lincoln sets out to find out whodunit.

episodes.title: Changing the Baby
episodes.description: After noticing that none of his sisters share his interests, Lincoln attempts to mold Lily into his mini-me.

episodes.title: Sound of Silence
episodes.description: Lincoln buys a pair of noise-cancelling earbuds to drown out the noise his sisters' make.

episodes.title: Space Invader
episodes.description: After an argument with Lucy, Lynn is allowed by Lincoln to bunk in his room for the night, but overstays her welcome.

episodes.title: For Bros About to Rock
episodes.description: When Lincoln and Clyde head off to their first concert, Luna tags along, hoping to make the experience a great one.

episodes.title: Ties that Bind
episodes.description: After eavesdropping on his parents, Lincoln thinks they have decided to get rid of their kids!

episodes.title: The Green House
episodes.description: In an effort to be more energy-efficient, Lincoln rallies his family to stop using so much electricity.

episodes.title: The Butterfly Effect
episodes.description: After spilling an experiment of Lisa's, Lincoln sets off a chain reaction that unravels the household.

episodes.title: It's a Loud, Loud, Loud, Loud, House
episodes.description: When Lincoln finds a note in the attic that suggests there's a lot of money hidden somewhere in the house, he and his sisters try to find it.

episodes.title: House Music
episodes.description: Lincoln signs his family up for a talent show and they form a band.

episodes.title: Two Boys and a Baby
episodes.description: Thinking it'll be easy, Lincoln and Clyde take on the task of babysitting the youngest Loud, Lily.

episodes.title: Overnight Success
episodes.description: Lincoln invites Clyde to a sleepover, but gets jealous when Clyde wants to hang out with his sisters.

episodes.title: Toads and Tiaras
episodes.description: After Lola gets injured and can't compete in her pageant, Lincoln coaches Lana to take her place.

episodes.title: A Novel Idea
episodes.description: It's Dad's annual Take Your Daughter to Work Day so Mom offers to take Lincoln to her work: a dental office.

episodes.title: Cover Girls
episodes.description: When all 10 of Lincoln's sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day, Lincoln has his hands full.

episodes.title: Out On A Limo
episodes.description: Lincoln wins a ride in a limo and starts to change after soaking up the good life.

episodes.title: Attention Deficit
episodes.description: Lincoln starts spending time at Clyde's house after Clyde's dads give Lincoln more attention than he gets at home.

episodes.title: Save the Date
episodes.description: After a hurtful misunderstanding, Lori and Lincoln go on a double date with Bobby and his sister, Ronnie Anne.

episodes.title: Come Sale Away
episodes.description: It's time for the Loud family annual garage sale, and every kid is determined to out-sell the others.

episodes.title: Lincoln Loud: Girl Guru
episodes.description: For a class assignment, Lincoln and Clyde must start a business, so they decide to sell Lincoln's girl expertise.

episodes.title: Roughin' It
episodes.description: Lincoln is worried that he's lost his manliness from growing up with all sisters, so he and Clyde go camping.

episodes.title: The Waiting Game
episodes.description: Lincoln gets Lori a job at a pizza arcade, but when he starts to ask favors of her, Lori gets in hot water.

episodes.title: The Loudest Yard
episodes.description: When Lincoln's mother signs him up for peewee football, Lincoln schemes to have Lynn take his spot.

episodes.title: Dance Dance Resolution
episodes.description: It's the Sadie Hawkins dance at school and Lincoln's sisters have accidentally landed him four dates!

episodes.title: A Fair to Remember
episodes.description: When Lincoln and Bobby become friends, Lori sets out to make Bobby jealous by hanging out with Clyde.

episodes.title: A Tattler's Tale
episodes.description: Lola wants to be a part of the siblings' secrets club, but they won't let her in because she's a "tattle tale."

episodes.title: Homespun
episodes.description: The children complain about their house, but they start to feel differently after a tornado threatens to destroy it.

episodes.title: April Fools Rules
episodes.description: Luan pranks the entire household every year on April Fools' Day, but this year Lincoln has a plan to avoid her pranks.

episodes.title: The Price of Admission
episodes.description: After seeing a scary movie (that his parents told him not to), Lincoln can't go to sleep and pulls an all-nighter.

episodes.title: One Flu Over the Loud House
episodes.description: When a common cold ravages through the loud house, Lincoln believes his sisters have turned into Zombies!

episodes.title: One of the Boys
episodes.description: Lincoln wishes he had ten brothers instead of ten sisters, and Lisa gives him a glimpse into that reality.

episodes.title: Cereal Offender
episodes.description: The Loud children make a trip to the supermarket to do the grocery shopping for their mother, but Lincoln has other plans.

episodes.title: Raw Deal
episodes.description: Lincoln becomes a hypochondriac when Lucy reads his fortune and predicts that his day will end in disaster.

episodes.title: Study Muffin
episodes.description: All of Lincoln's sisters develop a crush on his new tutor, making it impossible for Lincoln to study.

episodes.title: Funny Business
episodes.description: Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant.

episodes.title: Snow Bored
episodes.description: The Loud children have fun on a snow day.

episodes.title: Intern for the Worse
episodes.description: When Lincoln and Clyde both get an internship at Flip's, they compete to win the title of manager.

episodes.title: The Old and the Restless
episodes.description: After seeing how tame Pop Pop has gotten in his advanced age, Lincoln takes him out for a day to remember.

episodes.title: 11 Louds a Leapin'
episodes.description: The Louds are getting ready for Christmas when the unthinkable happens to Lincoln - his sled goes in the neighbor's yard! Lincoln and Clyde attempt to pull off a sled-rescue-mission and end up finding secrets about Mr. Grouse.

episodes.title: Suite and Sour
episodes.description: When the Loud parents win a trip to a resort, they decide to take the children with them because the children have promised to behave.

episodes.title: Baby Steps
episodes.description: When Clyde thinks his parents are having another baby he goes to Lincoln for help on how to be a great big brother.

episodes.title: Brawl in the Family
episodes.description: When Lori and Leni both buy the same dress, a fight breaks out leading to Defcon five in the Loud house.

episodes.title: Back in Black
episodes.description: When Lucy gets a crush on a "regular and normal" boy, her sisters decide to give her a makeover.

episodes.title: The Whole Picture
episodes.description: When Lincoln accidentally erases his childhood photos, he & Clyde try to recreate them before Lincoln forgets.

episodes.title: Lock 'N Loud
episodes.description: After Dad gets upset with the kids for never locking the front door, the kids take home security to the next level.

episodes.title: Vantastic Voyage
episodes.description: The children grow tired of their family van falling apart, so they decide to try to trick Dad into buying a cool, new van.

episodes.title: Making the Grade
episodes.description: When Lincoln's four-year-old sister, Lisa, gets put into his 5th grade class, his social standing is at stake!

episodes.title: No Such Luck
episodes.description: Lincoln finds himself with unexpected free time after his sisters worry that he is bad luck, and ban him from attending their activities.

episodes.title: Frog Wild
episodes.description: When Lincoln finds out his class is dissecting frogs, he and Lana embark on a mission to rescue them.

episodes.title: Patching Things Up
episodes.description: Lana and Lola try out for Bluebell Scouts, but discover one of them might be more suited for it.

episodes.title: Cheater by the Dozen
episodes.description: When Lincoln and Clyde think Bobby is cheating on Lori, they follow him around town gathering evidence.

episodes.title: Kick the Bucket List
episodes.description: Lincoln and Clyde's spring break plans are put in jeopardy when they only have one day to complete their list.

episodes.title: Party Down
episodes.description: Lori throws a sophisticated party, but it backfires when her guests don't like what she's planned.

episodes.title: Fed Up
episodes.description: Tired of monotonous meals, the kids make a plan to sabotage dinner so they can have pizza.

episodes.title: Shell Shock
episodes.description: Lincoln and Ronnie Anne have to take care of an egg baby, but Lincoln doesn't trust her with the fragile egg.

episodes.title: Pulp Friction
episodes.description: Lincoln and Clyde submit an Ace Savvy comic to a meet-the-creator contest, but are foiled by a surprising nemesis.

episodes.title: Pets Peeved
episodes.description: When Lana brings home a new pet, who the children adore, the four original Loud pets scheme to get rid of him.

episodes.title: Out of the Picture
episodes.description: Afraid they'll be forgotten, Lincoln and Clyde want to make a splash in the yearbook and crash group photos.

episodes.title: Room with a Feud
episodes.description: Seeing his sisters fight with their roommates, Lincoln suggests a room shuffle based on a compatibility test.

episodes.title: Spell it Out
episodes.description: Tired of her siblings walking all over her, Lucy turns to a spell book once to teach her siblings a lesson.

episodes.title: The Loudest Mission: Relative Chaos
episodes.description: Ronnie Anne and Bobby visit their crazy, chaotic extended family. Bobby fits in great but Ronnie Anne struggles with the smothering nature of their relatives. Little do they know, their mother has a secret motive.

episodes.title: Back Out There
episodes.description: Clyde, worried that Lincoln is hung up on Ronnie Anne, tries to cure his post-breakup blues.

episodes.title: Fool's Paradise
episodes.description: The Loud family believe that they are safe from pranks on April Fool's Day because prankster Luan is away at camp.

episodes.title: Potty Mouth
episodes.description: When the kids hear Lily curse, they're worried they have been a bad influence on her.

episodes.title: L is for Love
episodes.description: A love letter addressed to "L" Loud shows up at the house and the family has to figure out who it was meant for.

episodes.title: ARGGH! You For Real?
episodes.description: Lincoln and Clyde find out that ARGGH! is coming to town and decide to go to the taping.

episodes.title: Garage Banned
episodes.description: Tired of her siblings, Lori moves to the garage, but quickly finds it's more than she bargained for.

episodes.title: Job Insecurity
episodes.description: When the children discover that their father is not at his old job anymore, they begin to worry it might be their fault.

episodes.title: Change of Heart
episodes.description: Clyde, desperate to learn how to act normal around Lori, enlists Leni's help.

episodes.title: Health Kicked
episodes.description: Worried that Mom and Dad are hurting their health from not being active, the kids encourage them to exercise.

episodes.title: Lynner Takes All
episodes.description: Tired of Lynn's poor sportsmanship during board games, the siblings decide to team up to take her down.

episodes.title: Future Tense
episodes.description: Lynn Loud Sr. and Rita Loud meet the Yates Family, consisting of Jancey and Bumper Yates Sr. and their children Beatrix Yates, Belle Yates, Bumper Yates Jr., and Beau Yates. As they see that they have an impressive life, Lynn Sr. and Rita think that their children aren't doing enough to ensure their successful futures and have them do various things to make them more well-rounded like the Yates Family.

episodes.title: Yes Man
episodes.description: The Loud sisters need help from the "master of persuasion", AKA Lincoln. He will teach them how they can ask Mom and Dad for money.

episodes.title: Friend or Faux?
episodes.description: Lisa gets her kindergarten report card back to discover she's gotten an F in social skills. To bring up her grade, she must make a friend.

episodes.title: No Laughing Matter
episodes.description: When Luan realizes how her siblings complain about her jokes, she gives up her passion. But the others feel bad about it, so they have to show Luan that she is funny.

episodes.title: Tricked!
episodes.description: On Halloween, Lincoln and Clyde plan to go to the fancy gated community of Huntington Manor at Huntington Oaks in order to get the full-sized candy bars. Meanwhile, Lucy assembles a haunted corn maze and operates it with the help of Lori, Leni, Luna, Luan, Lynn, and Rita. Also, Lola, Lana, Lisa, and Lily compete to see who will get maximum candy as a reluctant Lynn Sr. escorts them.

episodes.title: No Spoilers
episodes.description: Leni has been known to ruin the surprise party of her siblings. To keep Leni from ruining the surprise birthday party for Rita, Lincoln must work to keep Leni from spoiling the birthday surprise. As Lincoln does his part of the assignment, the rest of Lincoln's sisters work to get the party ready including the part where they involved inviting people they know to the party.

episodes.title: Read Aloud
episodes.description: The family embarks on a reading challenge at the library, but Lola refuses to participate.

episodes.title: Not a Loud
episodes.description: When Lincoln discovers the first page of his baby book is blank, he worries his parents are hiding something.

episodes.title: Legends
episodes.description: Dad and Lincoln get on "Legends of the Hidden Temple" and can't wait to for a day of bonding. Guest Stars: Jace Norman, Cooper Barnes

episodes.title: Mall of Duty
episodes.description: Lincoln wants to go to the mall, but has to watch his younger sisters, so he decides to take them to the mall.

episodes.title: The Crying Dame
episodes.description: To get Lily to stop crying the kids give her an old singing toy from the attic but it quickly drives them crazy.

episodes.title: Anti Social
episodes.description: Dad declares war on the kids' devices so they decide to show Dad how great electronics and the internet are.

episodes.title: Snow Way Out
episodes.description: Lana convinces the kids go to the Burpin' Burger to meet her racecar driving hero despite the heavy snowfall.

episodes.title: Snow Way Down
episodes.description: When Lincoln goes on vacation with Clyde he realizes just how overprotective Clyde's Dads are.

episodes.title: Roadie To Nowhere
episodes.description: Luna learns Chunk was like her in high school, and worries her ambition to be a rocker is unrealistic.

episodes.title: A Fridge Too Far
episodes.description: Lincoln wages war after his food is filched from the refrigerator.

episodes.title: Selfie Improvement
episodes.description: When Carol Pingrey's photo gets more likes on social media than Lori's she tries to one-up her.

episodes.title: No Place Like Homeschool
episodes.description: Lola is being temporarily homeschooled. Thinking it looks like fun, the other kids try to get in on it.

episodes.title: White Hare
episodes.description: Lincoln has a plan for introducing himself to a new girl, but when the sisters catch him he has to avoid them.

episodes.title: Insta-Gran
episodes.description: Pop Pop introduces his new girlfriend to the family. She seems great until she starts showing up unannounced. Guest Star: Jennifer Coolidge

episodes.title: City Slickers
episodes.description: Lori and Lincoln visit the city. Lori struggles to be a city girl and Lincoln finds Ronnie Anne has changed.

episodes.title: Fool Me Twice
episodes.description: The family has a new plan to dodge Luan's April Fool's Day pranking: stunt doubles.

episodes.title: Net Gains
episodes.description: Lynn desperately wants to win a basketball championship but gets drafted onto a terrible team.

episodes.title: Pipe Dreams
episodes.description: Mom and Dad are sick of waiting in the long bathroom line so they decide to build a secret bathroom.

episodes.title: Fandom Pains
episodes.description: Lucy is upset that Lori and Leni started watching her vampire series, as a new character is introduced.

episodes.title: Rita Her Rights
episodes.description: After racking up tickets, Mom finds it more relaxing to perform community service than being at home.

episodes.title: Teachers' Union
episodes.description: To try and make gym class better, Lincoln and Clyde set Coach Pacowski and Mrs. Johnson up.

episodes.title: Head Poet's Anxiety
episodes.description: Luan mentors Lucy, teaching her how to manage the ups and downs of pursuing a life in the arts.

episodes.title: The Mad Scientist
episodes.description: Lisa gets invited to work at a prestigious science institute, seeing it as an opportunity to get away from her crazy and crowded family life.

episodes.title: Deal Me Out
episodes.description: Lincoln and Clyde worry that they may be too old to still be playing Ace Savvy.

episodes.title: Friendzy
episodes.description: Lincoln discovers that having a friend over means getting special privileges, and he takes advantage of that.

episodes.title: Tripped!
episodes.description: Everyone in the family has worked hard to save for family vacations. But as they drive to their destination, almost everything goes wrong that can go wrong for the family.

episodes.title: Pasture Bedtime
episodes.description: The boys struggle with whether to attend Liam's barn sleepover or Girl Jordan's awesome pool party.

episodes.title: Shop Girl
episodes.description: The kids worry that Leni is too weak and they try to teach her how to be more aggressive.

episodes.title: What Wood Lincoln Do?
episodes.description: Lincoln has to complete a woodworking assignment, but has a history of failure on the topic.

episodes.title: Ruthless People
episodes.description: When the house is infested with termites, half the family stays with Pop Pop and the others with Aunt Ruth.

episodes.title: Scales of Justice
episodes.description: When Lana learns her favorite fish are in jeopardy of losing their home to construction she springs into action.

episodes.title: Crimes of Fashion
episodes.description: When Leni gets fired from her job due to missing scarves, Lincoln and Clyde (as Ace and Jack) take on the case.

episodes.title: Breaking Dad
episodes.description: Dad has Mr. Grouse watch Lily while he goes to a concert but things quickly start to go wrong.

episodes.title: Absent Minded
episodes.description: Clyde discovers he didn't earn junior administrator job. But can he give up the perks that come along with it?

episodes.title: Gown and Out
episodes.description: When Lola advances to a regional pageant she worries she could lose for the first time.

episodes.title: Be Stella My Heart
episodes.description: When the new girl starts hanging around Lincoln and his friends, they begin to suspect she likes one of them.

episodes.title: House Of Lies
episodes.description: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs.

episodes.title: Game Boys
episodes.description: Lincoln asks to borrow Clyde's new gaming system, but Clyde struggles to trust that it's safe with him.

episodes.title: Sitting Bull
episodes.description: The older sisters reluctantly let Lynn into their babysitting club but she quickly proves to be too aggressive.

episodes.title: The Spies Who Loved Me
episodes.description: Ronnie Anne wants to go downtown. But her grandparents think it's too dangerous, so they decide to spy on her.

episodes.title: Missed Connection
episodes.description: When Lori and Bobby attempt to have their daily conversation, a few misunderstandings lead to them having a rather awkward conversation. Because of this, the two fear that dating long distance isn't working out for them. With encouragement from their respective parents, Lori and Bobby attempt to show each other that they care for each other though various means, like signs of affection, a home video, and virtual dating, but when that ends up not working, the two decide to spend their day together, which is just as troublesome as when they were separate.

episodes.title: Everybody Loves Leni
episodes.description: Torn between her work friends and her school friends, Leni tries to bring everyone together.

episodes.title: Middle Men
episodes.description: When Lincoln and Clyde go to tour the middle school, Lynn gives them some questionable advice.

episodes.title: Jeers for Fears
episodes.description: After agreeing to go to The Royal Woods House of Terror, Linc and Clyde have to toughen up and face their fears.

episodes.title: Tea Tale Heart
episodes.description: Lola discovers Lucy has an old, fragile doll and decides she must borrow it – no matter what Lucy says.

episodes.title: The Loudest Thanksgiving
episodes.description: Lori and Bobby are faced with the frightening reality of spending Thanksgiving apart, and try to bring their families together for the first time.

episodes.title: Really Loud Music
episodes.description: Hoping to win a song-writing contest, Luna contemplates whether she should go with a song that's true to her sound or try to make something that the whole world will love.

episodes.title: Predict Ability
episodes.description: Lincoln worries that he is predictable after he discovers that he has rituals. Later, Lori develops the yips.

episodes.title: Driving Ambition
episodes.description: When Lori finds out that the golf coach from her dream college is coming to see her play, she develops the yips.

episodes.title: Home of the Fave
episodes.description: After a pun-filled trip to the grocery store with Luan and Lola, Dad worries Lola thinks he plays favorites.

episodes.title: Hero Today, Gone Tomorrow
episodes.description: When Lynn's friend Margo is celebrated for a one-in-a-million soccer goal, Lynn has to try and be supportive.

episodes.title: Cooked!
episodes.description: The kids promise to help Dad with the grand opening of his new restaurant by coming up with promotions. But their lack of teamwork and crazy promos lead to an ultimate nightmare in the kitchen for Dad.

episodes.title: The Write Stuff

episodes.description: Piper wants the prison's outdoor running track reopened, but in order to get it, she'll have to give her corrections officer something he wants.

episodes.title: Moscow Mule
episodes.description: Red gets pressured to smuggle drugs through her kitchen; Larry publishes an article about Piper in the "New York Times;" two babies come into the world.

episodes.title: Fucksgiving
episodes.description: Thanksgiving arrives with the promise of a visit by Larry, but Piper's raunchy dance moves land her in solitary with a holiday feast of moldy bologna.

episodes.title: Bora Bora Bora
episodes.description: Pennsatucky discovers a new skill; the inmates try to scare delinquent teenagers straight; Pornstache's side business suffers a tragic setback.

episodes.title: Tall Men with Feelings
episodes.description: The prisoners mourn one of their own and even a drunken Pornstache reveals surprising emotions; Larry gives a revealing radio interview.

episodes.title: Fool Me Once
episodes.description: Painful truths reorient several relationships and careers; Pennsatucky feels disrespected by Piper, which is not good; Larry delivers an ultimatum.

episodes.title: Can't Fix Crazy
episodes.description: Red's scheme to reclaim her kitchen backfires; the inmates stage a Christmas pageant; Piper's plans unravel even as she realizes her life is in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Thirsty Bird
episodes.description: Piper's world is turned upside down when she is forced to confront the consequences of her actions and face new challenges.

episodes.title: Looks Blue, Tastes Red
episodes.description: A mock Job Fair provides Taystee with a chance to show off her business smarts; Red feels isolated from her prison family.

episodes.title: Hugs Can Be Deceiving
episodes.description: Piper is challenged by her Soso experience; Morello gets her heart broken; a figure from Taystee's past arrives to disturb the status quo.

episodes.title: A Whole Other Hole
episodes.description: Sophia gives the women a lesson in female anatomy. Meanwhile, Larry makes changes to his life. Lorna takes a risk away from the prison when she finds out her Christopher is getting married.

episodes.title: Low Self Esteem City
episodes.description: A bathroom turf war sees deeper lines drawn in the sand as Gloria and Vee go head to head. Piper receives devastating news.

episodes.title: You Also Have a Pizza
episodes.description: Love is in the air as the inmates prepare for a Valentine's Day party; Red makes an intriguing new discovery. Larry asks Piper to be his prison mole.

episodes.title: Comic Sans
episodes.description: Piper starts a prison newsletter with the help of Healy and a few other inmates; Vee launches an entrepreneurial enterprise.

episodes.title: Appropriately Sized Pots
episodes.description: Piper faces a new backlash over special privileges; Caputo feels pressure to toughen up, resulting in administrative changes.

episodes.title: 40 Oz. of Furlough
episodes.description: Piper's relationship with Larry is tested. Meanwhile, Red attempts to redeem herself.While Red receives recognition for her strives towards redemption, Piper's and Larry's relationship is tested. Meanwhile, Litchfield welcomes back a familiar face.

episodes.title: Little Mustachioed Shit
episodes.description: The guards crack down on prison contraband. Later, a secret is revealed. The prison guards finally crack down on the inmates to stop the smuggling issue. After Bennett framed Pornstache, problems arise. And a big secret between Piper and Polly is revealed.

episodes.title: Take a Break from Your Values
episodes.description: Piper is shocked at an unexpected change in her status; Soso's hunger strike attracts new support that takes on a religious fervour.

episodes.title: It Was the Change
episodes.description: Tensions run high as a prison power outage forces several issues to come to light; Piper finds herself compromised and is forced to think on her feet.

episodes.title: We Have Manners. We're Polite.
episodes.description: In the Season 2 finale, Several futures hang in the balance as the inmates face and confront their worst nightmares; Life will never be the same again.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.description: Caputo's kinder, gentler new regime includes organizing a Mother's Day fair for the inmates that brings up a LOT of mixed feelings about family.

episodes.title: Bed Bugs and Beyond
episodes.description: Tempers flare when bed bugs invade, as Alex cracks, Red lashes out at Piper, Aleida interferes with Daya and Bennett, and Caputo gets bad news.

episodes.title: Empathy is a Boner Killer
episodes.description: Nicky's stash situation gets complicated. Alex and Crazy Eyes try a new drama class. Red assists Healy with a personal matter.

episodes.title: Finger in the Dyke
episodes.description: Big Boo comes up with a scheme to make money. Daya, Taystee and Crazy Eyes confront reality. Caputo tries to make a good impression on some visitors.

episodes.title: Fake It Till You Fake It Some More
episodes.description: Rumors fly among the inmates about a new, higher-paying job assignment, especially when they have to take a test for it.

episodes.title: Ching Chong Chang
episodes.description: Regime change isn't going over well with the staff, but Red makes it work for her. Lorna finds a way to meet men. Chang shows her private side.

episodes.title: Tongue-Tied
episodes.description: Norma's healing powers draw more believers. Piper creates a new business venture. Caputo breaks in the new hires.

episodes.title: Fear, and Other Smells
episodes.description: Piper gets creative in order to grow her business. Crazy Eyes's sci-fi sex story for drama class is a hit. Alex doesn't trust new inmate Lolly.

episodes.title: Where My Dreidel At
episodes.description: Too many inmates seem to be getting religion, so a rabbi comes to visit and Leanne tries to organize Norma's followers.

episodes.title: A Tittin' and a Hairin'
episodes.description: Pennsatucky, Piper, Crazy Eyes and Lorna get closer with their new admirers. Tensions between Sophia and Gloria, and Alex and Lolly escalate.

episodes.title: We Can Be Heroes
episodes.description: Caputo and Piper confront labor issues. A miracle occurs in Norma's group. Crazy Eyes's erotica winds up in the hands of the staff.

episodes.title: Don't Make Me Come Back There
episodes.description: Daya goes into labor. Sophia suffers a hate crime. Stella helps Piper with a business snag. Taystee takes on a new role.

episodes.title: Trust No Bitch
episodes.description: Miracles and conversions occur, but Piper and Caputo know that some situations can't be dealt with through spiritual means.

episodes.title: Work That Body for Me
episodes.description: With a major security breach and a lot of new inmates, Caputo has to call in the big guns. Things get a little too real for Crazy Eyes and Lolly.

episodes.title: Power Suit
episodes.description: the newcomers stir up ethnic and domestic problems, but Maria sees an opportunity. Judy's special treatment raises eyebrowes.

episodes.title: (Don't) Say Anything
episodes.description: A new job puts Taystee close to Caputo. Lorna has to get creative in her marriage. Soso and Poussey deal with some awkward truths.

episodes.title: Doctor Psycho
episodes.description: Nothing stays hidden for long when emotions run high, but Red, Healy and Caputo try to keep the peace. Piper has a business competitor.

episodes.title: We'll Always Have Baltimore
episodes.description: Company policies lead to a shortage of critical supplies and an eventful trip to a prison convention. Piscatella starts a new anti-gang initiative.

episodes.title: Piece of Shit
episodes.description: Piper's plan to edge out the competition could backfire badly. Cindy finds a way to make Taystee's job pay off. Luschek gets some interesting mail.

episodes.title: It Sounded Nicer in My Head
episodes.description: Paranoia strikes deep for Lolly and Judy, aggravating an already tense situation. Red sticks to a Russian tradition for an important occasion.

episodes.title: Friends in Low Places
episodes.description: A new work detail doesn't go over well with the inmates. Judy seeks help from Poussey. Maria finds a place she can conduct business.

episodes.title: Turn Table Turn
episodes.description: Ramos and Flores figure out ways to rebel against authority. A news item has an unexpected effect. Red and Lorna face personal disappointment.

episodes.title: Bunny, Skull, Bunny, Skull
episodes.description: The movie night selection becomes controversial. Aleida makes an adjustment. Piper worries the prison punishments are getting too medieval.

episodes.title: People Persons
episodes.description: Caputo's leadership is challenged and the inmates are in for a long night of lockdown after workers make an unsettling discovery.

episodes.title: The Animals
episodes.description: Alliances shift among the prison "families" as Piscatella and his guards crack down. Poussey, Judy and Alex prefer to look ahead to the future.

episodes.title: Toast Can't Never Be Bread Again
episodes.description: Corporate bureaucracy and simmering anger work against Caputo's efforts to keep a sensitive situation under control.

episodes.title: Riot FOMO
episodes.description: As the standoff at the prison spirals into a full-blown riot, enterprising inmates take advantage of the confusion. Taystee confronts Caputo.

episodes.title: Fuck, Marry, Frieda
episodes.description: Maria convenes a special assembly in the chapel as the inmates plot their next move. Frieda makes use of the survival skills she learned as a kid.

episodes.title: Pissters!
episodes.description: Linda begins to see the prison in a new light, while Judy grows desperate to escape. With darkness falling, the inmates compile a list of demands.

episodes.title: Litchfield's Got Talent
episodes.description: Red and Blanca dig for dirt on Piscatella. Suzanne conducts a séance. The guards show off their talents for "Litchfield Idol" judges Leanne and Angie.

episodes.title: Sing It, White Effie
episodes.description: When the inmates' antics make the morning news, Flaca and Maritza soak up the spotlight. Brandy and her crew auction off Judy to the highest bidder.

episodes.title: Flaming Hot Cheetos, Literally
episodes.description: Boo defends Doggett, Janae consoles Soso, and Lorna comes on to Nicky. While Alex lays low in the yard, Piper decides to take a stand.

episodes.title: Full Bush, Half Snickers
episodes.description: Black Cindy concocts a scheme to distract Suzanne when she spirals out of control. Taystee and Piper search for ways to honor Poussey's memory.

episodes.title: Tied to the Tracks
episodes.description: While Taystee sits down with a negotiator, Red and Blanca put their own plan into action. Gloria counsels Daya and asks Caputo for a favor.

episodes.title: The Tightening
episodes.description: Red senses trouble, but the others are convinced she's just paranoid. Taystee and Black Cindy enlist an unlikely ally, and two old friends clash.

episodes.title: The Reverse Midas Touch
episodes.description: Taystee tries to keep the negotiations on track. Angie comes up with an idea for fixing Leanne's finger. Piscatella's past is revealed.

episodes.title: Breaking the Fiberboard Ceiling
episodes.description: Red and the others weigh their options. Gloria wrestles with her conscience as she moves forward with a plan. Lorna takes over the pharmacy.

episodes.title: Tattoo You
episodes.description: Boo dabbles in blackmail; Nicky promises to help Lorna, Doggett makes a discovery, and Piper comes to a realization about Alex.

episodes.title: Storm-y Weather
episodes.description: As chaos descends on Litchfield three days into the riot, the inmates wonder what the future holds and seek solace in loved ones.

episodes.title: Who Knows Better Than I
episodes.description: The COs at Litchfield's maximum security unit size up the new arrivals. Off her medication, Suzanne hallucinates.

episodes.title: Shitstorm Coming
episodes.description: Ordered to hand out harsh sentences, the feds search for scapegoats. Languishing on paid suspension, Caputo tries to break out of a rut.

episodes.title: Look Out for Number One
episodes.description: Linda makes a power play, Piper digs for information about Alex, and the women get their first taste of a decades-old feud between cellblocks.

episodes.title: I'm the Talking Ass
episodes.description: Aleida struggles to find work on the outside. Backed into a corner, Nicky pleads her case to Red. Taystee reaches out to Caputo for help.

episodes.title: Mischief Mischief
episodes.description: Pranksters wreak havoc on Halloween. Luschek earns points with the other guards. As Linda faces a crisis, Donuts and Pennsatucky have a change of plans.

episodes.title: State of the Uterus
episodes.description: While Daddy deals with backlash, Badison plots revenge. Flaca finds a co-host for her radio show. Lorna discovers that pregnancy has its perks.

episodes.title: Changing Winds
episodes.description: Badison hustles to get back in Carol's good graces. Blanca longs to get pregnant -- and Nicky has a plan. Caputo and Figueroa's relationship evolves.

episodes.title: Gordons
episodes.description: Taystee gets fan mail -- and an assist from an old friend. Piper lobbies Luschek to bring back kickball. Aleida tries out a new sales tactic.

episodes.title: Break the String
episodes.description: While Daddy buys time with Barb, Daya looks for new ways to bring in oxy. Black Cindy's guilt takes a toll on her body. Red acquires a powerful ally.

episodes.title: Chocolate Chip Nookie
episodes.description: Aleida seizes a business opportunity. An anonymous tip sends Caputo on a stakeout. Luschek tries to help Gloria, who worries she's in danger.

episodes.title: Well This Took a Dark Turn
episodes.description: While Red and Carol scheme against Frieda, Suzanne watches Frieda's back. Lorna swears her allegiance to Barb as Nicky works to thwart another plot.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.description: Carol and Barb prepare for war. Linda auditions inmates for a prison PR video. Alex makes a deal with Badison to keep Piper out of trouble.

episodes.title: Be Free
episodes.description: Piper gets surprising news and a boost from her friends. The jury returns with a verdict, and the big kickball game is on.

episodes.title: Beginning of the End
episodes.description: Piper struggles to adapt to life after Litchfield. Alex promises to keep her nose clean. Daddy's infidelity angers Daya.

episodes.title: Just Desserts
episodes.description: Piper earns her keep by babysitting. Aleida pressures Hopper to go for a promotion. Random drug searches put the heat on Alex. Daya gets an offer.

episodes.title: And Brown is the New Orange
episodes.description: A new warden ushers in big changes. Blanca reunites with an old friend. Suzanne tries to mend Taystee and Black Cindy's relationship.

episodes.title: How to Do Life
episodes.description: Piper goes to work for her dad. Vinnie visits Lorna with news. A desperate Taystee asks Daya for a favor. Caputo leads a restorative justice class.

episodes.title: Minority Deport
episodes.description: Aleida tries to keep her teen daughter out of trouble. Piper and Cal shed their responsibilities for a day. Blanca navigates the legal system.

episodes.title: Trapped in an Elevator
episodes.description: Taystee takes advantage of her new position. Linda teaches Tamika how to pivot. Black Cindy and Maria make amends to people they've hurt.

episodes.title: Me as Well
episodes.description: Piper plays the field. Caputo tries to get ahead of a scandal. Daya sends Taystee on a mission. Nicky finds romance.

episodes.title: Baker's Dozen
episodes.description: Neri takes Piper on a wilderness retreat. Taystee tutors Pennsatucky. Suzanne tends to the chicken coop. Nicky has a difficult conversation with Red.

episodes.title: The Hidey Hole
episodes.description: Competition forces Daya to find a new mule. Piper decides to come out as a felon. Karla asks to leave for a custody hearing. Shani confides in Nicky.

episodes.title: The Thirteenth
episodes.description: While Piper reconnects with faces from her past, Alex revisits her own romantic history. Linda puts Tamika on notice. Caputo owns up to his misdeeds.

episodes.title: God Bless America
episodes.description: Maria tries to make peace with Gloria. Karla and Blanca plead their cases. Figueroa stands up to Litvack. Piper attends a posh fundraiser with Zelda.

episodes.title: The Big House
episodes.description: Taystee meets with a lawyer. As the GED exam looms, Suzanne gives Pennsatucky a pep talk. Gloria faces a dilemma. Alex confronts Piper.

episodes.title: Here's Where We Get Off
episodes.description: Tearful farewells, emotional tributes, new beginnings. Say goodbye to the women of Litchfield in the series finale.

episodes.title: It's Been a Hard Day's Noise
Do not Lean out of the Window
Journey to the Center of the Earth
Now You See Me, Now You Don't
Gladiator Oggy
episodes.description: Oggy and Olivia go to the Coliseum to watch a gladiator combat. The roaches filch Oggy's popcorn but when he goes after them he ends up being enlisted as a gladiator!

episodes.title: Shift that Chariot, Oggy!
episodes.description: When Oggy sees Olivia set off to Rome on Bob's chariot, he's miserable. How can he compete? He doesn't know how to drive those things! Jack gives him chariot driving lessons, which become a nightmare when the roaches get involved.

episodes.title: Oggy's Special Spa
episodes.description: Oggy finds a great job working in the Roman Baths. Today, a celebrity is expected: Julius Caesar! Unfortunately, the cockroaches want to use the luxury spa too. Oggy freaks out: if Caesar sees those roaches, he can say goodbye to his new job!

episodes.title: RodeOggy
episodes.description: Jack wants to participate in a rodeo contest organized by Buffalo Bill. Joey also wants the first prize. He is also registering. Jack then leaves the contest and asks Oggy to replace him. Who will win? Joey or Oggy?

episodes.title: In the Glare of the Sun
The Race to the North Pole
Oggy and the Legend of Excalibur
Oggy and the Search for the Grail
Oggy and the Not So Smart Bracelet
Oggy Learns to Swim or Not
And The Winner Is... Dee Dee!
Whose Turn To Do the Dishes?
Tic et Toc
episodes.description: While playing with cockroaches, Piya disturbs Oggy's house. When Piya understands that this weighs on Oggy, she becomes even more manic than him... Oggy and Piya will have to compose together to find the right balance and live in harmony.

episodes.title: The Stray's First Day
episodes.description: Meet the freshman class at Pup Academy, a secret school where pups become dogs. There's goofball golden Corazon, shy sheepdog Whiz, stray boxer Spark and 10-year old Morgan, who is about to discover his secret destiny: his family have been the caretakers of this secret school for generations, and it's time for Morgan to start his new job.

episodes.title: Tell Us About Your Human Day
episodes.description: Spark gets into a sticky situation when she makes up an imaginary human best friend to avoid telling her pup friends she's a stray pup, as Morgan endures Charlie's off-the-wall caretaker training.

episodes.title: Cooking Up Trouble
episodes.description: Morgan struggles to balance his overbooked schedule between work at Pup Academy and his studies at his middle school, much to the frustration of his project partner Izzy, who really wants an A+.

episodes.title: My Uncle Is Dude
episodes.description: Corazon lies about having a famous uncle - Dude from "The Descendants" - not knowing the real Dude is coming to Pup Academy to judge the annual talent show, as Morgan and Charlie engage in the ultimate prank war.

episodes.title: Oopsie!
episodes.description: Corazon gets himself into big trouble when his mischievous neighbor, teacup pup Oopsie, named after the only word she knows, follows him through the secret fire hydrant portal to Pup Academy where 'no outside dogs are allowed.' Meanwhile, Morgan tries to tech-up the school with not-so productive results.

episodes.title: Spark Strays
episodes.description: After a bad day at Pup Academy, which makes Spark question where she belongs, Spark is ready to quit the Academy for good. But when she skips school to hang with King and the Lost Dogs, Spark learns the grass isn't always greener on the other side.

episodes.title: Izzy Gets Busy
episodes.description: Charlie and D.O.G take a day off, leaving Morgan in charge of the Academy on his own for the first time. Morgan thinks he's got it covered but doesn't realize his plan is about to be unraveled by Izzy, who is set on getting to the bottom of what her pup does all day.

episodes.title: Kitten Academy
episodes.description: It's time for the annual student exchange, and Pup Academy is getting ready to welcome a - kitten. Spark tries to hide her secret friendship with this kitten from her judgmental classmates, as Corazon discovers cats aren't as bad as he thought when he's sent to Kitten Academy to learn about acceptance.

episodes.title: Into the Wildwood
episodes.description: D.O.G. and Charlie's plan to pair up Morgan and Spark for a class assignment to bring them closer together backfires when the duo ends up lost in the dangerous Wildwood forest.

episodes.title: Secrets Unleashed
episodes.description: When Morgan accidentally shares photos of Pup Academy with Wolfehead Middle School's biggest gossip, the Academy is in danger of being revealed to the world unless Morgan can get the photos back and cover up his mistake.

episodes.title: The Substitute
episodes.description: A sick day for Morgan means an adventurous day for his friendly fill-in! Meanwhile, the pups get playful with a collection of creative pranks.

episodes.title: The Thing with King
episodes.description: Spark is finally feeling like she's found a place she belongs ...until King calls in the favor she owes him. Now Spark must decide whether to honor her commitment to her paw-pact with King - or betray Pup Academy and all of her new friends.

episodes.title: The Constellation Fades
episodes.description: The greatest friendship on earth is at risk when the constellation that powers Pup Academy fades out and humans no longer want dogs as best buds.

episodes.title: Spark Wants Back
episodes.description: Spark explains her side of the story after leaving the Academy, but Corazon and Whiz soon find out it was all part of Professor Fitz's sinister plans.

episodes.title: The Day of the Stray
episodes.description: Everyone thinks Spark is the Chosen One according to school prophecy. But since Spark spent her life as a stray, she's not used to special treatment.

episodes.title: Skunked!
episodes.description: Some uninvited guests look to stink up this year's Howlathon during the harvest moon. But Corazon has a smelly secret weapon to stop them.

episodes.title: The King Sting
episodes.description: The pups need all the extra paws they can get to help break King out of Animal Control when he's snatched up after his hideout is suddenly raided.

episodes.title: Most Valuable Pup
episodes.description: It's the Howlers vs. the Growlers on the fetchball field. Will Spark be the first stray to win the MVP trophy, or will Bite take the title once again?

episodes.title: The Stray's Last Day
episodes.description: The guard dogs haven't seen a sign of Wolf in weeks, but D.O.G. can't shake the feeling that something wicked will try to ruin the pups' Graduation Day.

episodes.title: Come Home Year
episodes.description: Calvin Penney welcomes his family home for a long-awaited reunion as an unexpected arrival makes waves throughout the coastal town of Snooks Arm.

episodes.title: Crown and Anchor
episodes.description: Calvin teams up with marine researcher Dr. Fonda Howander to investigate strange events, while his son Wade tries to make sense of unsettling dreams.

episodes.title: Sir John Franklin
episodes.description: Wade and Calvin encounter mysterious newcomers. Fonda warns the town's residents about a nautical threat as unease spreads through the community.

episodes.title: The Ocean Will Have Us All
episodes.description: As outsiders draw Calvin into a dangerous hunt for the creature, an unseen danger begins closing in on his family and everyone else in town.

episodes.title: Little Pot Rock
episodes.description: Calvin uncovers shocking truths about his past. Fonda makes a startling discovery as unexpected company arrives.

episodes.title: The Unfathering Deep
episodes.description: As the true motives behind the crisis become clear and an evacuation begins, Calvin, his family and Fonda devise a risky plan to save their town.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar retreats to Los Angeles for a more exciting life. When the murder of a friend connects him with LAPD detective Chloe Decker, Lucifer becomes intrigued with the idea of punishing criminals, sending the devil himself into a struggle between good and evil.

episodes.title: Lucifer, Stay. Good Devil.
episodes.description: When a movie star's son is killed after being chased by the paparazzi, Chloe takes a deep look into the case with a little help from Lucifer. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel continue to encourage Lucifer to go back to hell.

episodes.title: The Would-Be Prince of Darkness
episodes.description: When a 22-year-old future superstar quarterback wakes up to find a dead girl floating in his swimming pool, he turns to his friend, Lucifer, for help. Lucifer enlists Chloe to investigate the case, which leads to the world of big money sports and people who will literally kill to be number one.

episodes.title: Manly Whatnots
episodes.description: In an effort to get over his infatuation with Chloe, Lucifer decides that he must seduce her. Meanwhile the two team up on a missing girl case and Amenadiel confronts Maze about his concerns about Lucifer.

episodes.title: Sweet Kicks
episodes.description: After a shooting occurs at a fashion show and a young woman is killed, Lucifer becomes intrigued by the danger of the situation and begs Chloe to get in on the case. Meanwhile, when Maze admits to Amenadiel that she wants to go back to hell, he sets his sights on Dr. Linda.

episodes.title: Favorite Son
episodes.description: Lucifer bails on Chloe when he becomes bored with her investigation into a ruthless biker gang murder. However, when he discovers something was stolen during the crime that was very personal to him, he demands that Chloe let him rejoin the case.

episodes.title: Wingman
episodes.description: In attempt to find the contents of his stolen container, Lucifer enlists the help of an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Chloe digs deeper into the Palmetto case, uncovering a lead that might finally expose the truth.

episodes.title: Et Tu, Doctor?
episodes.description: When a therapist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe enlist the help of Dr. Linda to look into possible suspects. Meanwhile, Malcolm confronts Chloe about the night he was shot, and Lucifer experiences his first bout of jealousy.

episodes.title: A Priest Walks Into a Bar
episodes.description: A priest seeks out Lucifer's help when he suspects an underground drug operation has set up shop at a neighborhood youth center. Meanwhile, Malcolm manipulates a way to keep an eye on Dan.

episodes.title: Pops
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe are tasked with solving the murder of a prominent restaurateur. When they meet his son, they suspect he played a part in the death. Meanwhile, Chloe's mom returns home, sending Chloe's life into upheaval, as Lucifer learns his own dysfunctional family isn't nearly as unique as he thought.

episodes.title: St. Lucifer
episodes.description: When philanthropist Tim Dunlear is found dead, Lucifer explores his good side by becoming a benefactor for Tim's glitzy Los Angeles charity.

episodes.title: #TeamLucifer
episodes.description: When a woman is found dead on the Hollywood Walk of Fame – with her body twisted into the shape of a pentagram – the investigation leads Lucifer and team into the world of Satanists, where they soon realize, evil doesn't always live where we expect it to.

episodes.title: Take Me Back to Hell
episodes.description: When Lucifer is framed for murder, he and Chloe must work together to clear his name and prove the identity of the true killer.

episodes.title: Everything's Coming Up Lucifer
episodes.description: Lucifer is distracted by his mother’s escape from hell, as he and Chloe investigate the murder of a stand-in actress. Meanwhile, Chloe’s faith in Lucifer is tested by the new medical examiner, Ella. Also, Amenadiel hopes to rein in Lucifer’s wild side, as they both deal with the absence of Maze.

episodes.title: Liar, Liar, Slutty Dress on Fire
episodes.description: When Lucifer’s mother, Charlotte, turns up at the scene of a grisly murder pleading innocence, Lucifer is hesitant to believe her tale. Not wanting to leave her on her own, he instructs Maze to babysit her – and not to torture her, allowing him to investigate the case with Chloe.

episodes.title: Sin-Eater
episodes.description: Lucifer and Chloe investigate a gruesome murder after a video of the crime surfaces on social media. When a second video appears, they realize they have a serial killer on their hands. Meanwhile, Lucifer’s mom returns as Charlotte Richards. Also, Amenadiel, struggling with his loss of power, has an appointment with Linda.

episodes.title: Lady Parts
episodes.description: After the bodies of two young L.A. transplants are found poisoned, Chloe and Lucifer hunt for the killer. Upon Maze convincing Chloe to go out for drinks, which the detective perceives as an act of friendship, but is actually part of a bet between Maze and Lucifer, the two make a shocking decision.

episodes.title: Weaponizer
episodes.description: Lucifer is excited to investigate the murder of his favorite action movie hero, Wesley Cabot. Longtime rival Rolf Van Zandt initially is a suspect, but the investigation soon shifts. Meanwhile, Uriel shows up and Amenadiel is forced to come clean about his lost powers. Also, Lucifer and Uriel fight about Chloe and their mother.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.description: Guilty and self-destructive, Lucifer clashes with Chloe during an investigation, leading her to team up with Dan instead. Meanwhile, Amenadiel bonds with Charlotte, and Maze takes Trixie trick-or-treating.

episodes.title: My Little Monkey
episodes.description: When the prisoner convicted of killing Chloe's father is murdered, new evidence suggests he was actually framed. Meanwhile, Maze tries to find a job and Lucifer shadows Dan in order to learn how to be "normal".

episodes.title: Trip to Stabby Town
episodes.description: After discovering that Azrael’s blade has been stolen by a human, Lucifer quickly connects it with a string of violent stabbings revolving around a local yoga studio. While Chloe investigates the murders, Lucifer enlists Ella’s help in locating the sword to stop the carnage.

episodes.title: Homewrecker
