episodes.description: "Family Guy" retells three Oscar-winning stories: "Silence of the Lambs," "American Beauty" and "Forrest Gump,".

episodes.title: Bend or Blockbuster
episodes.description: Resolved to enjoy a family movie night, the Griffins take a road trip to Bend, Oregon, to rent a VHS from the last Blockbuster in existence.

episodes.title: A Wife-Changing Experience
episodes.description: Joe accidentally sees Lois naked, leading to a reinvigoration of his sex life with Bonnie. Meanwhile, Stewie is gifted an electric SUV and quickly embodies the "Range Rover" lifestyle.

episodes.title: The Munchurian Candidate
episodes.description: Lois hypnotizes Peter into satisfying her sexual proclivities. Meanwhile, Stewie renovates his treehouse in an attempt to win over Brian and Chris.

episodes.title: Unzipped Code
episodes.description: Cleveland is fired as a mailman after an ignominious mishap, but flourishes in his new job at the brewery.

episodes.title: Happy Holo-ween
episodes.description: Peter makes a hologram of himself in order to get out of menial household duties.

episodes.title: The Stewaway
episodes.description: During a game of "hide and seek," Stewie takes refuge in Quagmire's suitcase, only to wind up in Paris. Meanwhile, Peter and Lois take a getaway to Vermont, where Lois is intent on breaking Bonnie's Instagram "like" record.

episodes.title: Get Stewie
episodes.description: Stewie finds himself in public disgrace after a popstar unleashes her fan base on him for a benign comment. Meanwhile, Peter gets lap band surgery and enjoys the merriment of excess skin.

episodes.title: Carny Knowledge
episodes.description: Peter and Chris finish last in a "Generation Gap" game at a carnival, forcing them to try to reconnect. Meanwhile, Brian starts to date a carny, whom he can't break up with even after witnessing some of her crude habits.

episodes.title: The Candidate
episodes.description: Stewie and Doug compete for the honor of class "snack captain".

episodes.title: Love Story Guy
episodes.description: The guys recount their first true love stories, leading to parodies of "Castaway," "Dirty Dancing" and various Meg Ryan rom-coms.

episodes.title: Old West
episodes.description: The guys try to help Mayor Wild West reconnect with his estranged father, Old West.

episodes.title: Single White Dad
episodes.description: Peter is mistaken for being a single parent, and relishes in the perks that come with it.

episodes.title: White Meg Can't Jump
episodes.description: Meg joins the Adam West High School basketball team, and her play is fueled by Peter's lambasting from the crowd. Meanwhile, Stewie goes down a rabbit hole of conspiracies, which ultimately ends with him developing multiple personalities.

episodes.title: Adoptation
episodes.description: To restore his public image, Carter adopts a young girl from an orphanage, drawing jealousy from Lois.

episodes.title: The Bird Reich
episodes.description: To take advantage of a work policy granting leave in the event of a pet's death, Peter adopts the oldest bird he can find... and realizes it used to belong to Hitler. Meanwhile, after giving Stewie a signed copy of his book, Brian finds it in a free library, causing Brian to give up writing.

episodes.title: A Bottle Episode
episodes.description: Lois is blocked from a vacation rental app and accused of stealing after the family's trip to Nantucket. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian buy saltwater taffy in bulk, and try their hands at door-to-door sales in the community.

episodes.title: Vat Man and Rob 'Em
episodes.description: When Peter gets a job as the new night watchman, he and the guys turn Pawtucket Brewery into an after-hours bar. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian's plan to collect "lost dog" return money backfires when Brian is used for a dangerous TikTok stunt.

episodes.title: From Russia with Love
episodes.description: After Brian's Instagram is hacked, Meg takes Stewie and Brian to Russia, only to realize she'd rather stay there. Meanwhile, Lois reverts to her tormented teenage self when Quagmire starts dating her high school bully.

episodes.title: Adult Education
episodes.description: Meg gets married in Russia but returns home after discovering she was used for a green card marriage. Meanwhile, Chris, in need of an extracurricular activity, joins Principal Shepherd in shooting pornos at the high school.

episodes.title: Fertilized Megg
episodes.description: Meg agrees to be Bruce and Jeffery's surrogate causing a pregnant Meg to annoy her family. But, when the couple fails to pick up the baby, the Griffin's must take care of their new family member.

episodes.title: Supermarket Pete
episodes.description: With the brewery under construction, Lois implores Peter to take a new job, but grows irate when he begins work at the grocery store. Meanwhile, armed with his police stories, Joe and Brian team up to write their own true crime novel.

episodes.title: A Stache From the Past
episodes.description: When Peter loses the Griffins' home in a reverse mortgage, he and Mayor West travel to confront the man advertising the scheme, Tom Selleck. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian open a booth at the flea market, leading to a rivalry with Bruce.

episodes.title: Old World Harm
episodes.description: Peter and Lois vacation in Florida, only to discover they've rented a condo in a retirement community. Back at home, Brian helps Stewie take his first shower.

episodes.title: Baby, It's Cold Inside
episodes.description: Peter is emasculated when, on their anniversary, he abandons Lois amidst a shark attack. Meanwhile, Stewie finds a mini fridge and lives the dorm lifestyle.

episodes.title: Boston Stewie
episodes.description: Stewie tries to civilize his half-brother, Boston Stewie, so that he may be adopted. Meanwhile, Meg and Chris start a venture in which people online pay Chris to sit on and smash cupcakes.

episodes.title: Snap(ple) Decision
episodes.description: Winner of a Snapple contest, Lois uses her winnings to take Meg on a tropical vacation. Flaunting their wealth, the two are kidnapped. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian undergo "friendship therapy".

episodes.title: Baking Sad
episodes.description: Meg discovers her tears produce delicious cookies, and her, along with her siblings, enjoy a profit until the success makes her too happy to cry. Meanwhile, Peter and the guys launch a "male talk show".

episodes.title: The Return of the King (of Queens)
episodes.description: Lois decides to sell the family's television to help pay for Christmas presents, but when Kevin James gets upset over losing Peter as a viewer, he apparates into the Griffin house.

episodes.title: Cabin Pressure
episodes.description: When the Griffins win a trip to Maine at Peter's company picnic, they decide to invite their friends on the vacation; tensions run high and things soon spiral out of control when the cabin burns down.

episodes.title: Teacher's Heavy Pet
episodes.description: Lois joins Chris's school as a substitute teacher, launching him into the cool kids club... but only time will tell how long he remains a member.

episodes.title: Take This Job and Love It
episodes.description: Peter and his friends wonder about what their dream jobs would be; Peter enters a sequence featuring himself as a James Bond-type; Quagmire reflects on his job as an aerobics instructor; Cleveland and Joe take part in a "Lethal Weapon" sequence.

episodes.title: Lifeguard Meg
episodes.description: Stewie and Brian become overwhelmed after winning a coffee shop; Peter and his friends annoy Meg at her new lifeguard job when they don't follow the pool rules.

episodes.title: Fat Actor
episodes.description: Peter tries to protest Hollywood after learning that Brad Pitt was cast in a biopic about a politician. After Pitt injures himself on set, Peter must act out the role himself.

episodes.title: Faith No More
episodes.description: Brian becomes romantically interested in someone and it inspires him to use Stewie's time machine. Strange consequences result from their journey.

episodes.title: Fat Gun
episodes.description: Peter and his friends star in their own adaptation of “Top Gun”.

episodes.title: Live, Laugh, Love
episodes.description: When Peter realizes Joe has never found him funny, he is determined to make Joe laugh. Lois chaperones Chris and Meg's school trip, where she strives to reunite Principal Shepherd with his long-lost love.

episodes.title: Drunk With Power
episodes.description: Peter runs into Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh at a brewery tour, and the two drink the night into oblivion. When Peter wakes up, he realizes their lives have swapped, and he joins the Supreme Court as Brett Kavanaugh, and Brett returns to Quahog as Peter.

episodes.title: Lois C.K.
episodes.description: Lois becomes a stand-up comedian using real-life stories about Peter as content. Once Peter catches wind about this, he tries his best to straighten his life out to avoid being ridiculed by Lois's comedy act.

episodes.title: The Chicken or the Meg
episodes.description: Meg starts dating a chicken she meets on a reality dating show "Sex Farm" and moves out when Peter disapproves of their relationship.

episodes.title: Dog Is My Co-Pilot
episodes.description: After successfully landing a plane, Brian and Quagmire go on a press tour. Chris and Stewie open a boutique pizza place.

episodes.title: Pitch Imperfect
episodes.description: Peter must gain his family's respect back after he makes a humiliating throw. Brian and Stewie become chiropractors.

episodes.title: Hard Times at Adam West High
episodes.description: Chris uses Stewie's time machine to stop himself from having an erection during a book report. Peter becomes jealous when he sits out of a lottery pool and the guys win $123.

episodes.title: The Elle Word
episodes.description: When Quagmire starts dating a mystery woman, Peter, Joe, and Cleveland go on a stakeout and discover her to be The Librarian.

episodes.title: A Real Who's Hulu
episodes.description: Peter and the family act out three Hulu parodies including ‘Only Murders in the Building,’ ‘The Dropout’ and ‘The Bear.’

episodes.title: China Doll
episodes.description: Stewie finds out his stuffed bear Rupert was made in China and makes it his mission to take him back there to meet his family.

episodes.title: One Foot in Front of the Mother
episodes.description: Due to a police complaint about his excessive barking, Brian has to wear a shock collar; looking to join an after-school team, Chris discovers a talent for speed walking.

episodes.title: The Fat Lotus
episodes.description: In this Griffin-family twist on the popular HBO series, Peter suspects Lois of betraying his trust with Quagmire at a swanky vacation, while Stewie worries that his wealthy new friends plan to sacrifice him in a volcano.

episodes.title: Cool Hand Lois
episodes.description: When Lois tries masturbation for the first time, she abandons her responsibilities as a mother and starts dating Bonnie instead. Peter and Joe crash their couples’ trip to win back their wives before it’s too late.

episodes.title: Martian Meg
episodes.description: Meg enlists in a training program for a mission to Mars when she gets fed up with feeling like she doesn't belong.

episodes.title: Row v. Wade
episodes.description: Brian wins a boat on "The Price is Right" and decides to sail to Texas to help women seeking legal abortions. Joe makes a confession to the guys that shocks them to their core.

episodes.title: Karenheit 451
episodes.description: Lois becomes the leader of a group of mothers who want to ban books from schools.

episodes.title: Twain's World
episodes.description: In an effort to improve his writing, Brian convinces Stewie to go back in time and bring Mark Twain to the present-day, but the plan goes awry when Twain overindulges in pornography.

episodes.title: The Edible Arrangement
episodes.description: For the first time in the show's history, Lois and Stewie finally understand each other -- thanks to Brian's edibles -- and explore and try to explain their complicated relationship.

episodes.title: Pumpkin Spice Girls
episodes.description: Meg discovers the seasonal delight that is the pumpkin spice latte, but when the limited time offering lapses, she and Lois concoct an elaborate heist to steal the formula.

episodes.title: Man-Fest Destiny
episodes.description: Peter and the guys become shipwrecked at Fire Island; Chris and Brian perform a lobotomy on a social-media-crazed Stewie.

episodes.title: Bringing Up Brady
episodes.description: Meg pursues an unlikely friendship with an NFL great; Stewie and Brian host a dinner party at a home furnishing store.

episodes.title: Dear Francis
episodes.description: Peter calls out the name "Francis" while making love with Lois, but she believes he meant his deceased father, leading to a round of therapy. Things worsen when Lois discovers "Frances" is the name of the Clam's new, pretty waitress.

episodes.title: Viewer DMs
episodes.description: In this follow up to the "Viewer Mail" episodes, the Griffin family retells The Lord of the Rings,? explains how the Griffins' ancestors arrived in Quahog, and looks back at Quagmire's 1960s variety show.

episodes.title: Scent of a Woman
episodes.description: Brian discovers his nose can detect diseases and smells that Meg has cancer, prompting her to live her life while she's still got it; a game of "Truth or Dare" puts Lois in a tough spot with Peter.

episodes.title: Play Time
episodes.description: In this three-act parody, the Griffins spoof the stage by putting up To Kill a Mockingbird, The Odd Couple and Hamlet.

episodes.title: Phony Montana
episodes.description: After going on a date with a Cuban-American woman named Carmen, Brian inexplicably develops a Cuban accent - which he worries will hurt his chances with her.

episodes.title: A Few More Ways to Die in the West
episodes.description: In this Griffin family spoof of the Old West, Peter, known as Quiet Burp, and his gang of outlaws agree to escort a wealthy businessman on a train journey.

episodes.title: Tall Stewie
episodes.description: When Stewie puts on a pair of boots that make him slightly taller, his newfound confidence changes the power dynamic in the Griffin family.

episodes.title: Lower G.I. Joe
episodes.description: A colonoscopy reveals Peter has a rare collectible toy action figure lodged in his intestine, but the reward for selling it causes a rift between him and the guys.

episodes.title: Friend's Best Man
episodes.description: Stewie becomes engaged to Rupert, but Brian is upset when he is not chosen as the best man.

episodes.title: Let the Goodtimes Walk
episodes.description: A powerful sleeping aid medication gives Joe the ability to walk while he is asleep, but Joe grows concerned when it becomes clear that the guys prefer his sleepwalking self.

episodes.title: High School History
episodes.description: In this three-act parody of prominent historical eras, the Griffins take a humorous look at The French Revolution, the American Civil War, and World War II.

episodes.title: Muddy Puddles
episodes.description: It's raining and Peppa is sad because she can't play outside. When the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games - jumping in muddy puddles! When Mummy and Daddy Pig join in, things get very muddy indeed.

episodes.title: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
episodes.description: Mr Dinosaur is George's favourite toy. When Mr Dinosaur goes missing, George is distraught. Daddy Pig helps Peppa to become a detective and together they track down Mr Dinosaur, making George a very happy little piggy again.

episodes.title: Best Friend
episodes.description: Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play. George wants to play too, but Peppa won't let him join in their games, which makes him sad. Later, when Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses they discover they need a patient.  George is allowed to join them and is happy to play the patient.

episodes.title: Polly Parrot
episodes.description: Peppa and George visit Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's house, and meet their new pet parrot, Polly, who repeats everything you say.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.description: Peppa and George are playing hide and seek. Peppa is very good at hiding but George is too easy to find so she doesn't want to play with him any more. So Daddy Pig helps hide.

episodes.title: The Playgroup
episodes.description: George is going to Peppa's playgroup but Peppa doesn't want him to. It's her playgroup after all. When George arrives he's a hit with all her friends. They think he's 'brilliant!'

episodes.title: Mummy Pig at Work
episodes.description: Mummy is busy working on her computer and Peppa wants to help. Mummy Pig takes a break and lets Peppa and George play on the computer, but they are not allowed to play games. Peppa and George try to play their computer game "Happy Mrs. Chicken" and the computer crashes. Luckily, Daddy can fix it.

episodes.title: Piggy in the Middle
episodes.description: George can't catch the ball so Mummy suggests they play 'Piggy in the Middle' to help him learn. When Daddy Pig lifts George up, Peppa feels like the littlest piggy, but Mummy soon gives her a helping hand.

episodes.title: Daddy Loses His Glasses
episodes.description: Daddy loses his glasses and is completely helpless without them. Peppa and George help him to look for them. They search everywhere but can't find them.

episodes.title: Gardening
episodes.description: Peppa and George help Grandpa in the garden. Peppa and George are fascinated when Grandpa Pig tells them that everything grew from a tiny seed. Peppa and the others plant a strawberry tree, but it takes a long time for the seed to grow. George wants to grow something more unusual!

episodes.title: Hiccups
episodes.description: George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups. Peppa thinks it's very funny at first, but when George's hiccups start to spoil their game, Peppa decides that she should cure him in her own special way.

episodes.title: Bicycles
episodes.description: Peppa Pig and George decide it is a great day to go and ride bicycles while Daddy Pig is admiring a prize-winning pumpkin he has. Peppa's friends are all riding bicycles. When Peppa teases George about having a tricycle, the others point out that Peppa still needs stabilisers. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without them, however, Peppa accidentally smashes into the pumpkin!

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.description: Mummy Pig makes Peppa box to put secret things in. George is sad because Peppa won't tell him what's in the box. When George gets his own box, and Peppa can't guess what's inside, she decides she doesn't like secrets much.

episodes.title: Flying a Kite
episodes.description: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy are flying a kite in the park. It gets tangled in a tree beside a big muddy puddle. Mummy Pig doesn't want George and Peppa to get muddy but when Daddy falls in, everyone gets splashed.

episodes.title: Picnic
episodes.description: The Family go on a picnic. Peppa and George find a little pond and feed bread to the ducks. Mummy Pig's delicious strawberry cake attracts a wasp that chases Daddy Pig all around the picnic site.

episodes.title: Musical Instruments
episodes.description: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig find an old box full of musical instruments. Mummy plays the violin, Daddy plays the accordion and Peppa bangs the drum. But no one can play the Swiss horn.

episodes.title: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
episodes.description: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden. Peppa pretends to be a butterfly. Grandpa Pig shows George how to play at being a wriggly worm. Then they all have fun jumping in muddy puddles, pretending to be frogs.

episodes.title: Dressing Up
episodes.description: Peppa and George love dressing up. One day they creep into Mummy and Daddy's room and dress up in their clothes. Peppa pretends to work at Mummy's computer and George does some digging in Daddy's vegetable garden.

episodes.title: New Shoes
episodes.description:
Peppa loses her shoes, but she gets new red ones, making her happy again.

Peppa loses her shoes, so Mummy buys Peppa some new shiny, red shoes. Peppa loves her new shoes so much she never wants to take them off! After it rains, the family search for puddles to jump in. Peppa would love to join in but she is still wearing her new, shiny shoes.

episodes.title: The School Fete
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go to the school fete. Peppa, George and their friends have their faces painted as tigers. All the children get a balloon and clever Daddy Pig impresses everyone when he makes a dinosaur shaped balloon.

episodes.title: Mummy Pig's Birthday
episodes.description: It is Mummy Pig's birthday and Mummy Pig celebrates it with her family. Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are just as excited. They have lots of fun preparing secret, birthday surprises for her. Peppa, George and Daddy Pig prepare a wonderful birthday surprise for Mummy Pig. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present she is absolutely delighted.

episodes.title: The Tooth Fairy
episodes.description: When Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy explains that the Tooth Fairy will come to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake and see the Tooth Fairy. But staying up is harder than she imagined.

episodes.title: The New Car
episodes.description: The family's car breaks down and it has to go to the garage. While it's being fixed, they borrow a new one with lots of exciting buttons. One makes the roof go down, one makes the windows go up and one squirts Daddy in the face!

episodes.title: Treasure Hunt
episodes.description: Granny and Grandpa organise a treasure hunt. Grandpa buries the treasure in a secret place in the garden and Peppa and George have to find it, using a map and following the clues. They have lots of fun looking for the treasure!

episodes.title: Not Very Well
episodes.description: Peppa isn't feeling well and has red spots all over her face. Doctor Brown Bear pays a visit and says that Peppa will be fine, but she must stay in bed for a little while. The rash isn't catching, so her friends can come to visit!

episodes.title: Snow
episodes.description: It is snowing today. Peppa and George must wear their hats and scarves and gloves. They have lots of fun playing in the snow, making footprints and throwing snowballs. Then they build a snowman, complete with hat and scarf and gloves.

episodes.title: Windy Castle
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go on a day trip to Windy Castle. There's a wonderful view from the top. Peppa and George look through a telescope and can even see Granny and Grandpa Pig's house in the distance!

episodes.title: My Cousin Chloé
episodes.description: Peppa's older cousin Chloé comes to visit. Peppa and George have been playing games and Peppa has been teasing George by making up the rules as she goes along. But now Chloé is here, Peppa has to play by someone else's rules for a change.

episodes.title: Pancakes
episodes.description: Mummy Pig is making everyone pancakes. George and Peppa gobble theirs up noisily. Daddy Pig thinks that he's a bit of an expert at pancake flipping but he flips his pancake so high that it sticks to the kitchen ceiling! Can the family get it down?

episodes.title: Babysitting
episodes.description: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out so Granny and Grandpa Pig are baby-sitting. Peppa and George are put to bed but are too excited to sleep. Everyone has such fun that they exhaust themselves.

episodes.title: Ballet Lesson
episodes.description: Peppa is excited about her very first ballet lesson and decides to teach Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and George how to dance. She is surprised to learn that Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig know a few ballet moves of their own.

episodes.title: Thunderstorm
episodes.description: Peppa and George are in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder! Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa decides that she loves thunderstorms. They make big, muddy puddles!

episodes.title: Cleaning the Car
episodes.description: Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy. Mummy Pig insists that they clean the car first. Peppa and George help but it turns out to be a very messy job indeed.

episodes.title: Lunch
episodes.description: The family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner.  Grandpa Pig picks some vegetables and Granny Pig makes them into a delicious salad. George doesn't want to eat the salad, but when clever Grandpa Pig makes them into a dinosaur shape George eats up everything on his plate.

episodes.title: Camping
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go camping. Daddy Pig loves the great outdoors. At bedtime they realise that the tent is too small for them all, but it's not a problem, Daddy Pig likes sleeping under the stars - until it starts to rain.

episodes.title: The Sleepy Princess
episodes.description: It's bedtime but Peppa isn't at all sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur! The Sleepy Princess falls asleep after a hard day's work and soon, just like the Princess, Peppa and George are sleeping too.

episodes.title: The Tree House
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig has a big surprise for Peppa and George. He has built them a beautiful tree house in his garden, with cute little curtains on the window. Peppa loves being in the tree house and invites everyone else to come in.

episodes.title: Fancy Dress Party
episodes.description: Peppa and George are having a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa is dressed as a fairy princess and George is a scary dinosaur. Peppa has to judge the best costume and finds it quite difficult not to pick herself.

episodes.title: The Museum
episodes.description: Peppa and her family visit the museum. Peppa enjoys the Kings and Queens's room and imagines being a Queen. George's favourite room is the dinosaur room. Daddy's favourite room is the one with the cakes - the museum café!

episodes.title: Very Hot Day
episodes.description: Today is a very hot day. Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles but the puddles have all dried up. Mummy Pig suggests they put on their swimming costumes and splash about in the paddling pool instead.

episodes.title: Chloé's Puppet Show
episodes.description: Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloé. Chloé has a new puppet theatre and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a puppet show about a pig who snores a lot but Daddy Pig and Uncle Pig miss the show - they're far too busy snoring!

episodes.title: Daddy Gets Fit
episodes.description: Daddy Pig loves to watch television but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise as his tummy is looking a bit big. Peppa gives him LOTS of exercises to do. Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.

episodes.title: Tidying Up
episodes.description: Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. Once the room is tidy Mummy says they can go back to their game. The room doesn't stay tidy for long. Peppa's doll and George's dinosaur are at the bottom of the toy box.

episodes.title: The Playground
episodes.description: Peppa and George are at the playground. Peppa loves to play on the swings but George doesn't like to be pushed too high. Peppa gets stuck in the tyre on the climbing frame and Daddy Pig gets stuck on the slide.

episodes.title: Daddy Puts up a Picture
episodes.description: Mummy Pig has a new picture of Peppa and George. Daddy Pig offers to put it up while Mummy is out. The DIY job is not as simple as he thought so Daddy Pig, Peppa and George have to mend the wall before Mummy Pig returns.

episodes.title: At the Beach
episodes.description: Peppa and George love going to the beach. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand. When it's time to go home, they almost forget Daddy Pig!

episodes.title: Mister Skinnylegs
episodes.description: George finds a spider in the bathroom sink. When Peppa sees it, is very frightened and screams and runs downstairs to tell Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig.  Peppa later realises that it doesn't want to hurt her.

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's Boat
episodes.description: Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Danny Dog is sailing too, with Granddad Dog. Grandpa Pig and Granddad Dog are best friends and race to see who has the fastest boat.

episodes.title: Shopping
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go to the shops for some tomatoes, spaghetti, onions and fruit. George sits in the trolley in the supermarket while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list. Soon, they have everything they need, but Daddy Pig has something that wasn't on the list - a delicious chocolate cake.

episodes.title: My Birthday Party
episodes.description: It's Peppa Pig's birthday and she wakes up very early - she doesn't waste any of her special day. Peppa gets a present then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear.

episodes.title: Daddy's Movie Camera
episodes.description: Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera. First, Peppa shows him how to work it, and then he records Peppa saying hello. Everyone laughs when they see Peppa on TV. Peppa, George and Mummy make a movie just for Daddy.

episodes.title: School Play
episodes.description: Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play. Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig help her to practice her lines. On the night of the play, Peppa and her friends act out the story beautifully.

episodes.title: Bubbles
episodes.description: George is making bubbles and Peppa is popping them. When the bubble mixture runs out, Daddy Pig shows them how to make really big bubbles then makes a big, muddy, bubbly puddle for everyone to play in.

episodes.title: Emily Elephant
episodes.description: There's a new pupil today, Emily Elephant. Everyone wants to be her friend because she's good at building blocks and makes a very loud noise with her trunk. Peppa and Emily have something in common: they both muddy puddles.

episodes.title: Polly's Holiday
episodes.description: Granny and Grandpa's pet, Polly Parrot comes to stay. Peppa and George love her as she's very funny and repeats everything anyone says. When Polly flies away, no one can get her back, until George comes up with a plan. Can George get her back?

episodes.title: Teddy's Day Out
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are having a picnic and Mr Zebra, the postman and his daughter Zoë Zebra are also having a picnic, so they join up for one big picnic. When it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind. So the Zebras make a special delivery.

episodes.title: Mysteries
episodes.description: After watching their favourite television programme, 'Detective Potato', Peppa and George are inspired to become famous detectives too. Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve. Teddy is hidden and Peppa and George try to find him.

episodes.title: George's Friend
episodes.description: Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur but George and Richard are not very good at sharing their toys. Mummy Pig shows George and Richard that they can have much more fun if they play together.

episodes.title: Mr Scarecrow
episodes.description: Grandpa is planting seeds for a garden, but the birds keep eating them. Peppa and George help Grandpa to make a scarecrow to stop the birds eating the seeds. Peppa worries that the birds will be hungry.

episodes.title: Windy Autumn Day
episodes.description: It is a cold and windy day, so Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig wear their hats, scarves and coats to the park. At the park, it is so windy that Peppa's ball blows into the pond and George's hat blows into a tree.

episodes.title: The Time Capsule
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule. The children discover that their parents made a time capsule with Madame Gazelle many, many years ago. And now it is time to open it up.

episodes.title: Rock Pools
episodes.description: Peppa and George are at the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Peppa and George like sandy beaches, but this is a different kind of beach, with lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore. Peppa rescues a little fish and puts it back in the sea.

episodes.title: Recycling
episodes.description: Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig tells Peppa and George that bottles don't go in the bin, they go into a special green box to be recycled. Old newspapers go in a red box and tins go in a blue box. Peppa and George have fun filling the boxes.

episodes.title: The Boat Pond
episodes.description: Peppa, her family and friends are playing at the pond with their toy boats. Everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit. Daddy Pig makes Rebecca a very special paper boat out of newspaper.

episodes.title: Traffic Jam
episodes.description: There is a traffic jam.

episodes.title: Bedtime
episodes.description: It's nearly time for bed. Peppa and George are playing outside when they are called in for their bath. Peppa and George have a bath and brush their teeth so Daddy Pig can read them a story. Soon they are fast asleep. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig finally sit down but they are sleepy too.

episodes.title: Sports Day
episodes.description: It is Sports Day at Peppa's playgroup and lots of special events, including running, jumping and "tug of war", are due to take place. Daddy Pig tells Peppa that it's not the winning that matters but taking part, but she would really like to win a prize.

episodes.title: The Eye Test
episodes.description: Peppa's friend, Pedro Pony, wears glasses. Peppa thinks she might need glasses too, so Mummy Pig takes her to visit the optometrist for an eye test. Peppa is disappointed to find she has perfect vision - but that doesn't stop her from wearing some fabulous sunglasses.

episodes.title: Granddad Dog's Garage
episodes.description: Daddy Pig's car runs out of petrol but thankfully Grandad Dog's garage is not far away. With one phone call, Grandad Dog is on his way and tows Daddy Pig's car back to his garage.

episodes.title: Foggy Day
episodes.description: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are taking Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it gets a bit foggy, and soon it is so foggy they can't see anything. They decide to go home. But which way is home?

episodes.title: Jumble Sale
episodes.description: Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa, and each of her friends, bring in an old toy but they soon realise that favourite toys can be hard to let go of.

episodes.title: Swimming
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit. Everyone is surprised to discover that Daddy is very good at swimming and diving.

episodes.title: Tiny Creatures
episodes.description: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden. Peppa finds a little snail and Grandpa shows them his beehive. Peppa, George and their friends have fun pretending to be cheeky snails and busy bees.

episodes.title: Daddy Pig's Office
episodes.description: Peppa and George are visiting Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Daddy works with Mr Rabbit and Mrs Cat. Mr. Rabbit's job is all about numbers, Mrs Cat's job is all about drawing shapes on the computer, and Daddy Pig's job is.. complicated.

episodes.title: Pirate Island
episodes.description: Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure and they all build a big sandcastle. The children love Pirate Island.

episodes.title: George Catches a Cold
episodes.description: Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining - but when George takes off his rain hat, he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

episodes.title: The Balloon Ride
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go to the school fête. The top prize in the raffle is a trip in a Hot Air Balloon. Peppa wins! Everyone enjoys the flight until the balloon gets caught in a tree. Luckily, it lands in a very familiar garden.

episodes.title: George's Birthday
episodes.description: Today is George's birthday and Mummy and Daddy Pig have a special day planned. George gets a new Brontosaurus toy and the family go to the museum to see lots of different dinosaurs, including a robot dinosaur that actually moves and roars! The special day ends with a big cake and all of Peppa and George's friends having fun together.

episodes.title: The Long Grass
episodes.description: The grass is very long. It is so long that when Peppa and George play outside they can't see each other George's ball gets lost in it. The grass is too much for Daddy Pig's rusty old lawnmower so he calls Grandpa Pig for help. Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.

episodes.title: Zoë Zebra the Postman's Daughter
episodes.description: Mr. Zebra the Postman is delivering the post and today his daughter Zoë is helping him. Zoë Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa & George; - an invitation to her birthday party.

episodes.title: Painting
episodes.description: Today Peppa and George are painting. Daddy shows Peppa and George how to mix paints and the three of them paint a beautiful picture of a cherry tree in the garden. Everything is going very well, until the ducks turn up, and runs through the paint - and all over their masterpiece!

episodes.title: Cuckoo Clock
episodes.description: Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden cuckoo bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo!', but George wasn't looking and missed the whole thing. George does not want to miss the cuckoo again.

episodes.title: The Baby Piggy
episodes.description: Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloé. Today is a special day because Peppa and George are meeting Chloé's new baby brother, Alexander for the first time.

episodes.title: Grandpa's Little Train
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude. When he takes Peppa and George for a ride on Gertrude, they meet their friends along the way. There is plenty of room on the train for everyone, so they all hop aboard. Peppa and George think that Gertrude is the very best train in the whole world!

episodes.title: The Cycle Ride
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go for a day's cycle ride. Peppa rides her little bicycle, while Mummy and Daddy Pig ride their tandem with George on the back. Peppa loves cycling downhill but is not so keen on peddling uphill, so when they meet Peppa's friends and decide to have a race, Peppa insists it should be a downhill race.

episodes.title: Ice Skating
episodes.description: Peppa and George are going ice-skating today. They have never been ice skating before and Peppa keeps falling over. Daddy Pig tells her not to worry; everyone falls over when they skate for the first time.

episodes.title: The Dentist
episodes.description: Peppa and George are going to the dentist for a check-up. Peppa and Georges's teeth are lovely and clean and Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white but notices that George's plastic toy "Mr Dinosaur's" teeth are a bit yellow and in need of a tooth-clean.

episodes.title: Dens
episodes.description: Peppa and George are playing in their tree-house. Peppa's friends come to play but Peppa decides that only girls can come into the tree-house, so Grandpa Pig builds the boys their very own den shaped like a castle. When it starts to rain, the boys and girls rush out to play together in the muddy puddles.

episodes.title: Pretend Friend
episodes.description: Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa cannot see Leo but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and he likes playing dressing up. Peppa decides that now she can see Leo. Even Mummy and Daddy Pig play along with the game. But Peppa's little brother George cannot see Leo and feels a bit left out.

episodes.title: School Bus Trip
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains there is a fantastic view and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.

episodes.title: Rebecca Rabbit
episodes.description: Peppa and George are going to Rebecca Rabbit's house today. Rebecca's house is a bit different; it is inside a hill and has tunnels instead of stairs and corridors. Peppa and George love Rebecca's house.

episodes.title: Nature Trail
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go for a walk in the woods and follow a nature trail in the countryside. Peppa and George discover footprints left by little birds and ants. When they get lost they follow their own footprints back to the picnic.

episodes.title: Pen Pal
episodes.description: Peppa has a new pen pal in France, a little donkey named Delphine. Peppa  receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.

episodes.title: Granny and Grandpa's Attic
episodes.description: Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic. Although the attic is very full, they have trouble deciding what to throw out, because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything. Amongst the clutter, Peppa finds an old record player and some funny old records. The record player still works and soon everyone is dancing.

episodes.title: The Quarrel
episodes.description: Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends. But one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends anymore. As time goes by they really miss each other but still they refuse to make up. When they finally do, they realise that they will always be best friends.

episodes.title: The Toy Cupboard
episodes.description: Peppa and George's toy basket is full and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra, the postman, loves assembling flat pack furniture.

episodes.title: School Camp
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire. At bedtime Peppa and her friends get a little scared so they all end up sleeping in Madame Gazelle's tent.

episodes.title: Captain Daddy Pig
episodes.description: Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds - Daddy Pig to the rescue!

episodes.title: The Powercut
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are at home when suddenly go out and Peppa's house is in darkness. There has been a power cut. While the family waits for the electricity to come on again, Peppa and George have fun thinking of games to play in the dark. Peppa makes a pretend television, and enjoys playing with it so much she carries on after the power is restored.

episodes.title: Bouncy Ball
episodes.description: Peppa and George are playing in the garden with their bouncy ball when Suzy Sheep turns up with two tennis rackets. Suzy uses the bouncy ball to play a game of tennis with Peppa, leaving George feeling a bit left out until he is given the job of "ball boy".

episodes.title: Stars
episodes.description: It is night time and the sky is fall of shining stars. Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star. The stars are far away and look very tiny. But when Peppa and George look through a telescope the stars look much bigger.

episodes.title: Daddy Pig's Birthday
episodes.description: Today is Daddy Pig's birthday, but he still has to go to work. While Daddy is away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George make a chocolate birthday cake and prepare a "special birthday surprise". What can Daddy's "special surprise" be?

episodes.title: Sleepover
episodes.description: Peppa is going for a sleepover at Zoë Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant. The girls are too excited to go to sleep and stay up playing games and having fun until at last they feel sleepy.

episodes.title: Cold Winter Day
episodes.description: It is a very cold winter day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play. Peppa and George are wearing their hats, scarves, mittens and coats. They want to jump in muddy puddles, but the problem is that the puddles are all frozen over and are slippery, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.

episodes.title: Work and Play
episodes.description: When Peppa and Suzy learn that grown-ups must work all day, they decide to play at working in a shop. But they quickly find it is very tiring!

episodes.title: The Rainbow
episodes.description: Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.

episodes.title: Pedro's Cough
episodes.description: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?

episodes.title: The Library
episodes.description: Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.

episodes.title: The Camper Van
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go on holiday in a special van, and Peppa is surprised to find that at a push of a button the van turns into a little House for them to sleep in.

episodes.title: Camping Holiday
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are on holiday in their special camper van. They decide to go to Duck Land, a special park where they can see the ducks in the river, and are surprised when their van turns into a boat.

episodes.title: Compost
episodes.description: Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside help make the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.

episodes.title: Richard Rabbit Comes to Play
episodes.description: Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep comes to play with Peppa. The little boys don't want to play the same games as Peppa and Suzy, so they all play jumping up and down in muddle puddles.

episodes.title: Fun Run
episodes.description: Daddy Pig finds it hard work when he runs a race to raise money for the school roof. It is far easier to run when a wasp is chasing him.

episodes.title: Washing
episodes.description: Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which makes Daddy's shirt pink.

episodes.title: Polly's Boat Trip
episodes.description: Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog, who rescues them in his boat.

episodes.title: Delphine Donkey
episodes.description: Peppa's French friend Delphine Donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.

episodes.title: The Fire Engine
episodes.description: Peppa and George go with Mummy Pig to Miss Rabbit's Mummies Fire Engine Service.

episodes.title: Princess Peppa
episodes.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig, but Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed, until they are told a story.

episodes.title: Teddy Playgroup
episodes.description: Peppa brings home a Teddy from Playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he won't have a very exciting time.

episodes.title: Danny's Pirate Party
episodes.description: It's Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig, the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.

episodes.title: Mr Potato Comes to Town
episodes.description: All of the people in Peppa's town are excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre in town.

episodes.title: The Train Ride
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride, where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.

episodes.title: Granny Pig's Chickens
episodes.description: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.

episodes.title: Talent Day
episodes.description: It is Talent Day at Peppa's playgroup and Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

episodes.title: A Trip To the Moon
episodes.description: Peppa's family go to the museum's Moon Exhibition with George's friend Edmond Elephant.

episodes.title: Grandpa at the Playground
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.

episodes.title: Goldie the Fish
episodes.description: Goldie the Fish does not look happy and isn't eating her food, so Peppa, George and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the Vet.

episodes.title: Funfair
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go to the Funfair, where Mummy Pig tries her hand at winning a giant teddy for Peppa, but Mummy Pig is told she will not be able to win prizes in any of the competitions.

episodes.title: Numbers
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends learn how to count through playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.

episodes.title: Digging up the Road
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull and his roadworks team are in the way digging up the road.

episodes.title: Freddy Fox
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

episodes.title: Whistling
episodes.description: Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.

episodes.title: Doctor Hamster's Tortoise
episodes.description: Doctor Hamster the vet comes to Peppa's playgroup to show the children her pets.

episodes.title: Sun, Sea and Snow
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow!

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's Computer
episodes.description: Mummy Pig gives Granny and Grandpa Pig her old computer to work, and play, on. Will the elderly hogs be able to use it?

episodes.title: Hospital
episodes.description: Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is feeling poorly and in the hospital.

episodes.title: Spring
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig organises a chocolate egg hunt for Peppa and her friends. Will the piglets track down the treats?

episodes.title: Miss Rabbit's Helicopter
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and her family for a ride in her Rescue Helicopter!

episodes.title: Baby Alexander
episodes.description: Peppa's cousins come to visit, but baby Alexander is too young to talk, until Peppa teaches him his first word.

episodes.title: Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.

episodes.title: Miss Rabbit's Day Off
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister, Mummy Rabbit, and the other adults, offer to fill in for Miss Rabbit at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works!

episodes.title: The Secret Club
episodes.description: Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club - going on secret missions, and doing secret things. In secret. But soon everyone wants to join!

episodes.title: Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.

episodes.title: Shake, Rattle and Bang
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle brings lots of musical instruments into playgroup for the children - instruments that go 'shake', 'rattle' and 'bang'!

episodes.title: Champion Daddy Pig
episodes.description: Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper, until everyone helps him train to win it back.

episodes.title: Chatterbox
episodes.description: Peppa tries to prove to Suzy Sheep that she is not a chatterbox, but staying quiet is harder than it sounds.

episodes.title: Mr Fox's Van
episodes.description: Mr Fox takes Freddy to Peppa's house for a bike ride with the other children. When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. The children then all try to guess what kind of things Mr Fox has in the back of his van! Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken!

episodes.title: Chloé's Big Friends
episodes.description: Peppa and George go to play with their cousin, Chloé, and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any childish games.

episodes.title: Gym Class
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers!

episodes.title: The Blackberry Bush
episodes.description: Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden so that they can make a pie.

episodes.title: Pottery
episodes.description: Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoë, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.

episodes.title: Paper Aeroplanes
episodes.description: Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing... because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes!

episodes.title: Edmond Elephant's Birthday
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they expected.

episodes.title: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World
episodes.description: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island!

episodes.title: Santa's Grotto
episodes.description: It is Christmas and Peppa, George and the children all visit Santa's Grotto to tell him what they would like for Christmas. Peppa asks for a very special doll as a present, but will Santa be able to deliver it to her?

episodes.title: Santa's Visit
episodes.description: Peppa and George wake up very early on Christmas morning - has Santa delivered the presents they want? Peppa is worried when Santa brings everyone but her a present, but he soon returns to deliver her missing present in person.

episodes.title: Potato City
episodes.description: Peppa and her family visit a new theme park: Potato City. There they discover that the magic of vegetables never ends.

episodes.title: The New House
episodes.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to visit a house that Mr Bull is building. Who will their new neighbours be?

episodes.title: Basketball
episodes.description: The children are taught how to play basketball by Daddy coach. They are soon good enough to take on a bigger team.

episodes.title: Horsey Twinkle Toes
episodes.description: There is much excitement when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie for Peppa and George. What could it be?

episodes.title: Naughty Tortoise
episodes.description: Tiddles the Tortoise, Doctor Hamster's pet, has got stuck up a tree, again! Who can save him?

episodes.title: Mr Fox's Shop
episodes.description: It is Granny and Grandpa's anniversary. Peppa and George go to Mr Fox's Shop to find them a present. Mr Fox's Shop sells everything.

episodes.title: Shadows
episodes.description: Peppa and George notice they have shadows, and no matter how fast they walk, run, or jump - they can't lose them.

episodes.title: International Day
episodes.description: It is International Day at playgroup and Peppa and her friends have dressed up as countries of the world.

episodes.title: The Rainy Day Game
episodes.description: It is raining outside so Peppa and George have to stay indoors. While they wait for the rain to stop, Daddy Pig teaches them a fun game.

episodes.title: Mummy Rabbit's Bump
episodes.description: Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise!

episodes.title: Pedro the Cowboy
episodes.description: Pedro Pony spends the day just like a real cowboy would have in the Wild West: setting up camp in the garden and sharing stories with his friends.

episodes.title: Peppa and George's Garden
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig brings some seeds for Peppa and George to grow a garden. Daddy Pig makes himself useful by being the scarecrow.

episodes.title: The Flying Vet
episodes.description: Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

episodes.title: Kylie Kangaroo
episodes.description: Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, but who can jump the highest?

episodes.title: Captain Daddy Dog
episodes.description: Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited! Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts! What can they be?

episodes.title: Grampy Rabbit's Dinosaur Park
episodes.description: To celebrate Freddy Fox's birthday, the children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find Freddy's birthday treat.

episodes.title: Bedtime Story
episodes.description: Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

episodes.title: Lost Keys
episodes.description: Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger...

episodes.title: George's New Dinosaur
episodes.description: George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur breaks. With all the additional features surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit's train has broken down with a carriage full of passengers who need to get to work. Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train Gertrude.

episodes.title: The Pet Competition
episodes.description: Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but finds it hard to choose the best pet...

episodes.title: Spider Web
episodes.description: Mummy Pig finds a spider in the house and orders Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes, wherever he likes.

episodes.title: The Noisy Night
episodes.description: Peppa's family are staying at cousin Chloé's house. After a long day everyone is tired and wants to go to sleep. But baby Alexander's crying is keeping everyone awake!

episodes.title: The Wishing Well
episodes.description: Granny Pig places a large order of plastic gnomes and a wishing well for the garden, Peppa and George love them but Grandpa Pig is not happy. He wishes they would all disappear!

episodes.title: Mr Potato's Christmas Show
episodes.description: Hoor-oink! It's Christmas, and Playgroup is going to the theatre to see a special performance. Some people have never been to a theatre before.

episodes.title: Madame Gazelle's Leaving Party
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle announces she is leaving the playgroup. The children are very sad to loose their favourite teacher. And decide to throw her a leaving party.

episodes.title: The Queen
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's award for Industry, for all the hard work she does. Peppa and her friends accompany Miss Rabbit to the Palace to meet the Queen!

episodes.title: Desert Island
episodes.description: When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. He soon realises he misses the sea after all.

episodes.title: Perfume
episodes.description: After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.

episodes.title: The Children's Fete
episodes.description: The school roof has a leak, again! The children organise a fete to raise money for a new roof.

episodes.title: The Aquarium
episodes.description: Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish surely Peppa can find a new friend for Goldie?

episodes.title: George's Racing Car
episodes.description: Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching motor racing on the television, Granny Pig tells them all to go out and enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.

episodes.title: The Little Boat
episodes.description: Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?

episodes.title: The Sandpit
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends are building a desert island, in the sandpit. They add a forest, a lake, houses, and shops. It's all going very well until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up...

episodes.title: Night Animals
episodes.description: It is night time at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?

episodes.title: Flying on Holiday
episodes.description: The Pig family are preparing to go on holiday, Peppa and George pack their favourite toys and Granny and Grandpa are left to look after Goldie the Fish.

episodes.title: The Holiday House
episodes.description: Peppa and her family have landed in Italy, where they discover another spoken language. Daddy Pig finds driving around a little hard. Peppa rings Granny and Grandpa Pig to check are looking after Goldie the Fish.

episodes.title: Holiday in the Sun
episodes.description: It is the first day in their holiday villa, Peppa and her family go exploring to the local village where there is pizza to eat, presents to buy and a post card to be sent to Goldie the Fish.

episodes.title: The End of the Holiday
episodes.description: Peppa has enjoyed her holiday abroad, but it is now time to go home. Suzy has missed Peppa very much and can't wait to see her. Peppa can't wait to see Goldie the Fish...

episodes.title: Mirrors
episodes.description: George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.

episodes.title: Pedro is Late
episodes.description: The playgroup is going on an outing to the museum. Everyone is on the bus ready to go, except Pedro Pony. Where is he?

episodes.title: Garden Games
episodes.description: Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with. But not all the games are easy for little George.

episodes.title: Going Boating
episodes.description: Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals. When all the families have a race, Daddy Pig soon wishes he had picked a boat that was easier to sail and did not have to be pedalled.

episodes.title: Mr Bull in a China Shop
episodes.description: While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.

episodes.title: Fruit
episodes.description: It is fruit day at the supermarket, and Miss Rabbit is making fruit smoothies. Everyone is picking their favourite fruits to blend. George gets a special 'dinosaur' juice, to make him big and strong. Roar!

episodes.title: George's Balloon
episodes.description: Peppa and Suzy have nothing to do, and are bored. Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with. But not all the games are easy for little George.

episodes.title: Peppa's Circus
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig has put up a tent in his garden. Peppa and her friends decide it's a perfect place to put on a circus. With Peppa as the ringmaster, the show can begin!

episodes.title: The Fish Pond
episodes.description: Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fish pond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then...

episodes.title: Snowy Mountain
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good at skiing and was once a world champion! But in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone...

episodes.title: Grampy Rabbit in Space
episodes.description: Grampy Rabbit visits Peppa's playgroup to talk about space rockets. The talk is going very well until suddenly Grampy Rabbit loses his voice. Can Doctor Brown Bear get him talking again?

episodes.title: The Olden Days
episodes.description: Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young but are pleased to see that they've always been best friends.

episodes.title: Pirate Treasure
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends are playing pirates. But when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something!

episodes.title: Playing Pretend
episodes.description: When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles!

episodes.title: The Castle
episodes.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen and even meet a dragon. It's George's favourite day ever!

episodes.title: Miss Rabbit's Taxi
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family in her taxi to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her!

episodes.title: Scooters
episodes.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters when it's time to pick up the children.

episodes.title: Pumpkin Competition
episodes.description: It's Halloween! Peppa has been helping Grandpa Pig carve his massive pumpkin. Now, with the help of Miss Rabbit, they have to work out how to get it to the pumpkin competition!

episodes.title: Gerald Giraffe
episodes.description: A new student, Gerald giraffe, joins the playgroup.

episodes.title: Parachute Jump
episodes.description: When the school roof is broken, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money for the repairs. Peppa and George think that it is exciting, but Daddy Pig goes up in the aeroplane with her and has to overcome his fear of heights!

episodes.title: Easter Bunny
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends are at Rebecca Rabbit's house for an Easter Egg hunt. But can they find the Easter Bunny hiding all of the chocolate eggs?

episodes.title: Simple Science
episodes.description: Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment - how many children does it take to pick up Madame Gazelle?

episodes.title: School Project
episodes.description: It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup! Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter...

episodes.title: Mummy Pig's Book
episodes.description: Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's Greenhouse
episodes.description: Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it's time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

episodes.title: Molly Mole
episodes.description: There is a new girl at school, and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

episodes.title: Move to Music
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.

episodes.title: London
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle takes the whole class to London for the day where they are given a tour by the Queen herself!

episodes.title: The Police
episodes.description: When the Police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.

episodes.title: The Zoo
episodes.description: The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown arond by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.

episodes.title: Canal Boat
episodes.description: For Captain Daddy Dog's birthday, Mummy Dog surprises him with her present of a boat trip on a 'Canal Boat', which isn't quite what he was expecting.

episodes.title: Australia Part 1 - The Outback
episodes.description: Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig embark on their first ever Australian holiday.

episodes.title: Australia Part 2 - Surfing
episodes.description: The Kangaroos take Peppa and her family to the beach on their second day in Australia, where they try surfing for the first time.

episodes.title: Australia Part 3 - The Great Barrier Reef
episodes.description: Mrs Kangaroo takes everyone on an amazing adventure under the sea in her submarine to see the Great Barrier Reef!

episodes.title: Australia Part 4 - The Boomerang
episodes.description: Sadly, Peppa and her family's holiday in Australia is coming to an end, but they still have time to play with a boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby.

episodes.title: Nursery Rhymes
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery thymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.

episodes.title: Masks
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task - making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks... The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter!

episodes.title: Digger World
episodes.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to Digger World. They have lots of fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.

episodes.title: The Doll Hospital
episodes.description: Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital. But she soon realises that she likes Teddy just the way she is.

episodes.title: Wendy Wolf's Birthday
episodes.description: It's Wendy Wolf's birthday and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party! There are bubbles and balloons to play with - and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf!

episodes.title: George's Woolly Hat
episodes.description: Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean - even if it means that they get messy instead!

episodes.title: Sailing Boat
episodes.description: Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.

episodes.title: Soft Play
episodes.description: It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing - soft play! George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups!

episodes.title: The Market
episodes.description: Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall - he is selling some extra special items!

episodes.title: Father Christmas
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends put on a Christmas show for their parents.

episodes.title: Peppa Goes To Paris
episodes.description: Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's Pond
episodes.description: Peppa and George are helping Grandpa pig to dig a brand new pond for his garden!

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time
episodes.description: Peppa and her family go on a walk through the forests where they meet all their favourite fairytale characters.

episodes.title: Police Station
episodes.description: Oh, no! George has lost Mr Dinosaur! Maybe the police can help George find him.

episodes.title: When I Grow Up
episodes.description: It's time for playgroup! Today Peppa and her friends are deciding what they might like to be when they grow up.

episodes.title: The Ambulance
episodes.description: Dr. Brown Bear comes to visit the playgroup and teach all of the children what to do when there's been an accident.

episodes.title: Doctors
episodes.description: Tiddles the Tortoise gets stuck in a tree and falls onto Pedro Pony's nose when he tries to rescue him! This sets off a chain of events, with visits by Doctor Brown Bear, Doctor Hamster and Doctor Pony to save the day!

episodes.title: Super Potato
episodes.description: Mr. Potato has come to visit the playgroup and he's brought along his superhero friend, Super Potato!

episodes.title: Grampy Rabbit's Hovercraft
episodes.description: Grampy Rabbit takes Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig for a ride in his hovercraft.

episodes.title: Playgroup Star
episodes.description: Peppa wonders why Daddy Pig never got a playgroup star when he was younger.

episodes.title: The Carnival
episodes.description: The carnival comes to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things.

episodes.title: Mr. Bull's New Road
episodes.description: When Peppa takes Goldie the Fish for a visit to the vets, she is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building.

episodes.title: Caves
episodes.description: Peppa and her family enjoy a day out at the caves, with Grampy Rabbit as their tour guide.

episodes.title: Grandpa’s Toy Plane
episodes.description: Grandpa and Granny Pig share their toys and hobbies with Peppa and George. Granny has a special doll from childhood, but Grandpa builds toy planes.

episodes.title: George's New Clothes
episodes.description: George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand new clothes; after trying on lots of new exciting outfits, George finds an outfit that suits him just right.

episodes.title: Madame Gazelle's House
episodes.description: The Peppa family soon realizes that Madame Gazelle's house is being pushed over by a tall tree.

episodes.title: Long Train Journey
episodes.description: When Daddy Pig receives a letter saying that he must go away on business to test some very important concrete, Peppa, Mummy and George decide to go along too. They all enjoy the very long train journey, snoozing and singing to pass the time.

episodes.title: Suzy Goes Away
episodes.description: Mummy Sheep learns that she has got a new job, which means moving far away! Peppa and Suzy wonder how they can stay best friends? Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

episodes.title: Tiny Land
episodes.description: Peppa has a day out with her family and Suzy Sheep, visiting Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs!

episodes.title: Stamps
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig shows Peppa and George his extensive stamp collection, which inspires them to send a postcard of their own! But when Grandpa gets a very special stamp in the post, he misplaces it. Where can it be?

episodes.title: The Panda Twins
episodes.description: PC Panda brings his twin daughters, Peggi and Pandora, to playgroup. They love puzzles and solving mysteries, just like their dad.

episodes.title: Chinese New Year
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle teaches the children about Chinese New Year. They learn about sweeping out the old year, and how lucky the colour red is. Together they make a dragon costume, and parade up the hill to watch the fireworks.

episodes.title: Mandy Mouse
episodes.description: Peppa's Playgroup have a new friend to meet - Mandy Mouse. Mandy uses a wheelchair. The children have a lot of fun playing with Mandy as she is super sporty and loves to play games.

episodes.title: Recorders
episodes.description: The children have a music lesson with Madame Gazelle and all learn how to play the recorder. After lots of practising at home, the children put on a wonderful performance for all the parents to enjoy.

episodes.title: Miss Rabbit's Relaxation Class
episodes.description: Mummy Pig is persuaded by Miss Rabbit to come along to her relaxation class to help Mummy Pig relax but actual relaxing proves to be more challenging than expected.

episodes.title: Parking Ticket
episodes.description: When Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket whilst parked in the wrong place, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules too just like children and also get told off too.

episodes.title: Lots of Muddy Puddles
episodes.description: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

episodes.title: Father's Day
episodes.description: The pre-school adventures of a cheeky and slightly bossy little pig called Peppa, who lives with her mummy and daddy and little brother George. Sometimes these adventures involve a few tears but they always end happily.

episodes.title: Funny Music
episodes.description: Daddy Pig has a new synthesiser. Peppa, George and Mummy Pig have fun finding and sampling sounds from around the house.

episodes.title: Buttercups, Daisies and Dandelions
