episodes.description: Cousin Chloe, Peppa and George pick flowers making daisy-chains and transforming George into a fearsome dandy-lion.

episodes.title: The Marble Run
episodes.description: Peppa, George, Rebecca and Richard Rabbit have so much fun playing with the marble run. Though when Daddy Pig joins in, the marble run gets much bigger.

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector
episodes.description: When George loses his wind-up robot's metal key, Grandpa Pig uses his metal detector to find it and finds a lot of other things on the way

episodes.title: World Book Day
episodes.description: It is World Book Day at playgroup but Peppa has so many favourite books she just cannot decide which to go as.

episodes.title: Children's Festival
episodes.description: The family head to the Children's Festival.

episodes.title: Muddy Festival
episodes.description: In her second day at the Children's Festival, which has been muddy thanks to the rain, Peppa learns about activities involving mud.

episodes.title: Strawberries
episodes.description: Peppa and George go strawberry picking with Granny and Grandpa.

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's birthday
episodes.description: It's Grandpa Pig's birthday and the family go out for a celebratory meal. Peppa has never been to a restaurant before.

episodes.title: The Petting Farm
episodes.description: Peppa and friends visit a Petting Farm where they enjoy feeding chickens and meeting cute and squeaky guinea pigs and they all learn it's important to wash your hands after handling the little anima

episodes.title: Pizza! Pizza!
episodes.description: It's almost lunchtime at Peppa Pig's house. Mummy suggest they all make pizza together, they have a lot of fun preparing and mixing up all the food to make their own pizzas - it's all so lovely and messy.

episodes.title: TV Land
episodes.description: Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made. Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato.

episodes.title: Roman Day
episodes.description: Granny Pig, Peppa and George have fun dressing up as Romans, making a pebble mosaic of a Dinosaur and learn a little Latin too!

episodes.title: Bird Spotting
episodes.description: Peppa and George are birdwatching with Grandpa Pig looking for birds and ticking them off in Grandpa pigs book.

episodes.title: Super Potato Movie
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the Super Potato movie.

episodes.title: Bat and Ball
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play bat and ball, she teaches them so well that they beat her at the game and win!

episodes.title: Buried Treasure
episodes.description: Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox dig a huge tunnel and find a box of pirate treasure and the police seem to be missing their pirate treasure. Something mysterious is going on.

episodes.title: Christmas at the Hospital
episodes.description: Peppa hurts her arm on Christmas Day, so her family take her to the hospital and visit Santa.

episodes.title: Valentine's Day
episodes.description: Peppa and her playgroup friends are making cards for Daddy Pig.

episodes.title: The Perfect Day
episodes.description: While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.

episodes.title: Breakfast Club
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends go to school early to have breakfast together.

episodes.title: The Botanical Gardens
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit shows Peppa's family around the Botanical Gardens.

episodes.title: Mr Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz
episodes.description: Mr Potato visits the school to talk about fruit and vegetables. But which team will win his quiz?

episodes.title: Viking Day
episodes.description: Peppa and George join Granny Pig and her friends to play at being Vikings.

episodes.title: Made Up Musical Instruments
episodes.description: The playgroup children make homemade musical instruments.

episodes.title: In the Future
episodes.description: When Charlotte Sheep looks after Suzy during a sleepover with Peppa the girls imagine what their world looks like in the future.

episodes.title: Doctor Hamster's Big Present
episodes.description: Dr. Hamster is hard at work so Grampy Rabbit, Peppa and George give her a wheel to help her.

episodes.title: Butterflies
episodes.description: Dr. Hamster shows the children her caterpillars which they make butterfly wings and go through the life cycle.

episodes.title: Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
episodes.description: When the family visit Grampy Rabbit he shows off his jet pack but he helps out Miss Rabbit.

episodes.title: Detective Potato
episodes.description: Peppa and George go with Daddy Pig to buy some gravel, but on the way back they are unable to find their car in the very large car park

episodes.title: Electric Car
episodes.description: Daddy Piggy arrives in a new electric car. The family goes for a ride and are surprised when the car talks and sings

episodes.title: Stone Age Granny
episodes.description: Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

episodes.title: Space Adventure!
episodes.description: Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's historical re-enactment society. Grampy Rabbit has lent them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.

episodes.title: Fire Station Practice
episodes.description: Today is the fire station practise day. Mummy Pig joins with the other mummies to practise fighting fires. The fire brigade demonstrate their practice using their motto: Ready, Steady, Go!

episodes.title: Mr Bull the Teacher
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle must go to the dentist so leaves the class with Mr Bull. The children already know the subjects Mr Bull suggests teaching, so he decides to show them how to fix a squeaky floorboard.

episodes.title: Looking for Things
episodes.description: Mummy Pig is baking an apple pie, so Daddy Pig suggests Peppa and George play a game of looking for things. Peppa and George have fun running around the house solving the clues.

episodes.title: Poems
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle introduces the children to poetry, explaining how sounds can be poems too. Together they make a poem about rain and perform it to the parents.

episodes.title: Please And Thank You
episodes.description: Granny and Grandpa talk to Peppa and George about manners. Madame Gazelle teaches all the children about how wonderful it is to say please and thank you.

episodes.title: Ice Cream
episodes.description: Mr Labrador has an ice cream van but runs out of ice cream. Granny Pig suggests Peppa and George make their own ice cream with the help of Mr Labrador.

episodes.title: Science Museum
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends go on a school trip to visit a science museum. There are lots of fun activities including bubbly water, static balloons and Grampy Rabbit's rocket ship.

episodes.title: Jukebox
episodes.description: Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.

episodes.title: Windmills
episodes.description: Peppa and friends are at playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle tells the children all about wind power, whilst Mr Bull and the workmen have a lovely cup of tea made from wind power.

episodes.title: Mandy Mouse's Birthday
episodes.description: Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed Mandy loves cheese!

episodes.title: The Sandcastle
episodes.description: Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

episodes.title: America
episodes.description: Peppa and her family win a trip to America to star in Super Potato's movie, Vegetables in Space.

episodes.title: The Diner
episodes.description: Peppa and family are driving in their large camper van across America to get to Hollywood.

episodes.title: Canyon Country
episodes.description: Peppa and family visit the Grand Canyon, white water raft and discover an ancient cave.

episodes.title: Hollywood
episodes.description: Peppa and family make it to Hollywood and find where Super Potato and Hash Brown are filming.

episodes.title: Motorbiking!
episodes.description: Peppa and George embark on a camping trip to the seaside.

episodes.title: Sea Treasure
episodes.description: Summary. Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig camp at the seaside and find rope bits, seashells, and bottles ashore.

episodes.title: Monkey has a Cough
episodes.description: Zoe visits Peppa with her toy monkey.

episodes.title: Police Car
episodes.description: The Police return to Playgroup and offer Peppa and Freddy the chance to spend the day with them.

episodes.title: Hop, skip and jump!
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden and together they learn to hop, skip and jump

episodes.title: Rescuing Miss Rabbit!
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself

episodes.title: Peppa's Diary
episodes.description: Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try

episodes.title: Playing Golf
episodes.description: George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door

episodes.title: Creepy Crawly Safari
episodes.description: The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect

episodes.title: Hoops
episodes.description: Peppa And George Try Hula Hooping

episodes.title: The Park
episodes.description: Peppa and her family visit the park. Peppa's friends see which kinds of equipment they’re the best at.

episodes.title: The Life Boat
episodes.description: Captain Daddy Dog takes Danny Dog and Peppa to visit Grampy Rabbit and his lifeboat. Grampy Rabbit explains all about why the lifeboat is important in saving lives at sea and how important it is to always check the weather.

episodes.title: Lucky Hamper
episodes.description: Peppa's Playgroup help create a hamper of goods for a charity raffle.

episodes.title: Jelly
episodes.description: Peppa and George discover a jelly mould.

episodes.title: Potty Training
episodes.description: Peppa, Suzy Sheep, Mummy and Daddy Pig teach George how to use his potty.

episodes.title: Trampolines
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit teaches them how to bounce.

episodes.title: Health Check
episodes.description: Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check up.

episodes.title: Skateboarding
episodes.description: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised

episodes.title: Mountain Climbing
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Though Mummy Pig is worried about George when hegets scared of heights, she is the one who ends up in real trouble

episodes.title: Police Boat
episodes.description: eppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat

episodes.title: The Tractor
episodes.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast

episodes.title: Christmas with Kylie Kangaroo
episodes.description: Peppa and her family visit Kylie Kangaroo for Christmas, and realize that Christmas is so much different in Australia!

episodes.title: Winter Games
episodes.description: Everybody is once again skiing on the mountains, but an unpredictable Mummy Pig once again showcases her skiing skills.

episodes.title: Undersea Party
episodes.description: Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding a undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment!

episodes.title: The Clubhouse
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends are very excited! Mr. Bull is bringing a clubhouse to the playground and the kids have fun playing in it

episodes.title: Detective Club
episodes.description: Daddy Pig is in a bad mood when his car keys go missing. So Peppa and her friends become detectives and help the police

episodes.title: Clubhouse Shop
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends put on a clubhouse shop for their parents. Then Mr. Labrador gives everyone ice creams!

episodes.title: Clubhouse Adventure
episodes.description: Mr. Lion and Mrs. Crocodile arrive at the clubhouse and Peppa and her friends have fun with the penguins

episodes.title: Talking
episodes.description: Lotte Llama joins playgroup, and teaches the others on how to speak German.

episodes.title: Woodland Club
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends visit Mr. Wolf's Woodland Club.

episodes.title: Danny's Pirate Bedroom
episodes.description: Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagine a pirate adventure along the way.

episodes.title: Weather Station
episodes.description: Peppa's playgroup learn about the weather.

episodes.title: Roller Disco
episodes.description: Peppa and friends visit the Roller Disco rink.

episodes.title: Guinea Pigs
episodes.description: Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.

episodes.title: Grandpa's Rock Garden
episodes.description: Peppa and George help out Grandpa Pig create a rock garden.

episodes.title: Charity Shop
episodes.description: Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need!

episodes.title: Families
episodes.description: While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

episodes.title: The Owl
episodes.description: Peppa, George, Grandpa and Granny go owl-spotting.

episodes.title: The Apple Tree
episodes.description: The family visit the apple tree, and notice how it changes every season as they keep visiting it.

episodes.title: Hippies
episodes.description: Everyone becomes hippies for the day and Grampy Rabbit is the leader.

episodes.title: Bug Hotel
episodes.description: Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel.

episodes.title: Parachute Games
episodes.description: The Playgroup play many games using a Parachute.

episodes.title: The Big Hill
episodes.description: When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.

episodes.title: Kiddie Workout
episodes.description: Mr. Potato visits the playgroup to showcase an exercise class.

episodes.title: Little Cars
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Center.

episodes.title: Monkey Trees
episodes.description: Peppa and her family team up with Danny Dog to swing across the monkey trees.

episodes.title: Flying Disks
episodes.description: The family visit Danny Dog at the park, who has a new flying disks.

episodes.title: Grandpa Pig's Christmas Present
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig receives a drone (or to him, a Quad-Copter) for Christmas, but he soon loses it.

episodes.title: Canoe Trip
episodes.description: The family go canoeing.

episodes.title: The Holiday
episodes.description: The family go on holiday to a small house, that's actually quite small!

episodes.title: Water Park
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are going to the Water Park.

episodes.title: Dinosaur Party!
episodes.description: Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house, where Granny dresses as a dinosaur!

episodes.title: Superhero Party
episodes.description: Pedro has a superhero-themed party and Super Potato is one of the guests.

episodes.title: A Day with Doctor Hamster
episodes.description: Peppa and Suzy Sheep spend a day helping Dr Hamster the Vet.

episodes.title: Playgroup Garden
episodes.description: The Playgroup children have fun in the garden growing plants and playing hide and seek.

episodes.title: Bowling
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog take Peppa, George and Danny bowling.

episodes.title: Swimming Lesson
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit takes the children for swimming lessons in the little children's pool.

episodes.title: Cruise Ship Holiday
episodes.description: Peppa and George go on a cruise with Granny and Grandpa Pig.

episodes.title: Holiday on the Sea
episodes.description: There are lots of activities to do on the cruise, like breakfast at the pirate cafe!

episodes.title: Tropical Day Holiday
episodes.description: The cruise visits an island where the family buy lots of souvenirs.

episodes.title: Sailing Home
episodes.description: On the final cruise day, the kids help a sad Pirate Pete find Mrs Mermaid.

episodes.title: Grandpa’s Robot
episodes.description: Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house; Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he is building a robot.

episodes.title: Paper Games
episodes.description: The Playgroup learns how to use paper in fun ways.

episodes.title: Clouds
episodes.description: Dark clouds keep blocking out the sun on Peppa and George's trip to the beach.

episodes.title: Mr Bull Digs Up The River
episodes.description: Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig see Mr. Bull using his digger in the river, and discover what should be and what shouldn't be in a river.

episodes.title: Granny Sheep Moves In
episodes.description: Granny Sheep moves in with Suzy and Mummy Sheep for the first time ever.

episodes.title: Cardboard Boxes
episodes.description: Granny Sheep takes Peppa and Suzy in an imaginative world by using cardboard boxes to create pretend locations.

episodes.title: Clubhouse Takeaway
episodes.description: In the clubhouse, Peppa and friends create a pretend fast-food takeaway.

episodes.title: Walkie-Talkies
episodes.description: Peppa and George learn about how to use code-names when talking with walkie talkies. When PC Panda overhears a "Pirate Hog" and "Jolly Face" through his own walkie talkie, he wonders what those could be...

episodes.title: Peppa’s Office
episodes.description: Inspired by Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig's office work, Peppa decides to have an office of her own. It may be small, but it's perfect for her.

episodes.title: Little Swift
episodes.description: Peppa and family learn about a bird called a "Swift".

episodes.title: What Babies Do
episodes.description: Peppa thinks she can look after Baby Alexander well.

episodes.title: Lenses
episodes.description: Peppa accidentally gives Penny Polar Bear and Pedro Pony each other's glasses, and now they have trouble seeing properly.

episodes.title: Igloo
episodes.description: Penny Polar Bear is impressed with the igloo that Peppa and George have built in the snow.

episodes.title: Mr. Bull Is Getting Married!
episodes.description: Peppa finds out from Mr. Bull that he is marrying Mrs. Cow.

episodes.title: Getting Ready For A Wedding
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends help prepare for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding.

episodes.title: Wedding Day
episodes.description: The big day has arrived at last. Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are finally about to be newlyweds!

episodes.title: Party Bus
episodes.description: Peppa goes to Candy Cat's birthday party, which is happening on a special party bus!

episodes.title: Movie Night
episodes.description: Peppa and his friends goes to Penny Polar Bear's House to watch Super Potato Movie 2.

episodes.title: Art House Day
episodes.description: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect art piece at Suzy's house.

episodes.title: Wildflower Wood
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers.

episodes.title: Racquet Games
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson; the children play badminton instead; Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream after the lesson.

episodes.title: Sunny Day Games
episodes.description: Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.

episodes.title: Magic Trick
episodes.description: Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

episodes.title: Jumping Stick
episodes.description: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it; Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.

episodes.title: Adventure Caravan
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is the Biggest Potato in the World. However, when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

episodes.title: Caravan Friends
episodes.description: After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car; the bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.

episodes.title: Chloe's Birthday Party
episodes.description: At Chloe's birthday party, kids and grown ups alike strive to complete the Jumping Knights challenge to win the prize. George is the last to try making it through the course and discovers the birthday cake.

episodes.title: Broken Party Bus
episodes.description: Miss Rabbit's Arrives With The Broken Party Bus It's A Job For Grampy Rabbit Once It's Fixed Mummy Rabbit And Rebecca Rabbit Arrive With A Cake As It's His Birthday

episodes.title: Spooky Clubhouse
episodes.description: The Kids decorate the Clubhouse to make it scary for Halloween but not too scary. The kids show the house to the adults who pretend to be scared but the kids assume that it's not too scary.

episodes.title: Living Above the Shops
episodes.description: Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his house in the apartment above the shops where families live in the same building, Peggi Pandora and Candy Cat also live there and help Peppa to get to know the place.

episodes.title: Roof Garden
episodes.description: Peppa And Her Family Have Come To Help All The Flat Dwallers Make A Roof Garden Mr Bull Comes To Help With A Big Truck With A Carne There's Even Something For Ms Duck

episodes.title: Moving Day
episodes.description: Peppa Is Playing With Candy Cat While Emily Elephant's Granny Moves Out Of The Flat When The New Neighbors Arrive Peppa Recognises Her Hoilday Friend Rohan Rhino

episodes.title: Everybody Sleepover
episodes.description: Today Peppa Is Playing With All Her Friends In Each Of The Four Apartments On The Main Street With So Many Connected Rooms It's The Perfect Place To Hide

episodes.title: Walking Bus
episodes.description:
Today The Children Are Going To School On A Walking Bus The Children Make Engine Noises As They Walk Through The Forest Up The Hill

And Finally Arrive At School However After All That Walking It's Almost Time To Go Home

episodes.title: Happily Ever After
episodes.description: In The Classroom Madame Gazelle Reads A Story But There's A Page Missing So She Makes Up A Ending During Recess The Kids Make Their Alternative Endings Which Everyone Likes Better

episodes.title: Singing Lesson
episodes.description: Today The Classroom Has A Singing Class When The Parents Arrive The Children Perform Their Song And Madame Gazelle Tells Them That There Will Be A Singing Competition Tommorow

episodes.title: Singing Competition
episodes.description: Today Is The Adults Singing Contest And The Kids Are The Judges The Contest Ends With The Kids Singing Grampy Rabbit's New Song

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.description: Mummy Pig's sister, Aunt Dotty travels from far away for Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.title: Christmas Cards
episodes.description: In The Classroom The Children Madame Gazelle And With The Help Of Granny Sheep Create A Giant Christmas Card Full Of Messages Drawings And Gifts To Thank Father Christmas

episodes.title: Larenzo Lion
episodes.description: Today Mummy Pig and Peppa went to the zoo where they met Larenzo the lion, who lives inside the park and helps his father, Mr. Lion, the zookeeper, take care of the animals. Larenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but the wooden animals are distributed in his two bedrooms!

episodes.title: Dinosaurs Alive!
episodes.description: Today, Madame Gazelle's students are visiting the zoo. Mr. Leo shows them a giant lizard, revealing that it will be released into the wild! The children think it is a dinosaur and the news spreads. Mr. Leo explains that it is a lizard, but if he actually had a dinosaur, he would keep the news a secret!

episodes.title: The Big Announcement
episodes.description: Today is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have some big news to tell Peppa and George. But the two have a hard time waiting patiently and decide to distract themselves by playing. The parents get their attention by telling them that they will soon have a little brother, sparking Peppa and George's excitement. Peppa wants to know the size of the little one in Mummy's belly and, with the help of their mobile phone, they discover the various stages of growth, which are compared to the size of various fruits and vegetables. The little ones thus have an idea of ​​how their little brother will grow and can't wait to meet him!

episodes.title: Being Babies
episodes.description: Peppa is in Rebecca Rabbit's den and they are baking cupcakes, but when the twins start crying, Mummy Rabbit goes off to feed them. Peppa suggests that they pretend to be babies to get as much attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along, bringing them milk and then inviting them to go to sleep! They confess that they are not really babies and Mummy Rabbit pretends to be surprised that they have grown up so quickly!

episodes.title: Mr. Cat's Café
episodes.description: Daddy Pig takes Peppa to the cafe where Candy shows Peppa how to draw pictures.

episodes.title: Cushion Den
episodes.description: George is bored so Mummy Pig makes a cushion den for him.

episodes.title: Staying Up Late
episodes.description: Peppa is excited that Aunt and Uncle Pig and Chloe are coming for dinner tonight. Mummy Pig explains that it's a grown-up night, but after doing some chores, Peppa is allowed to stay up! Peppa finds the conversation boring, so she suggests they play a game. Peppa is proud that she stayed up, even longer than daddies!

episodes.title: The New TV
episodes.description: Peppa and her family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grandpa Rabbit fixes it, the family rents a new TV, which can do everything, but it is no match for the old TV. So, when the old TV is fixed, the new TV is returned to the shop!

episodes.title: Indoor Adventure
episodes.description: A storm ruins Peppa and her family's planned outdoor adventure, so they decide to take it indoors anyway. Using their imaginations, they go sledding in the snow, climb a mountain and set up camp in the attic around a campfire and under the stars...

episodes.title: Hot Dry Day
episodes.description: It's a sunny and hot day, Peppa and George are playing in their inflatable pool. During the day they help the garden animals to cool down, except Tidles, who loves the high temperatures. Suddenly a storm comes and the family runs to shelter, while the animals like the rain. Peppa and George also like the rain, because it makes muddy puddles!

episodes.title: Folk Music Band
episodes.description: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden and Granny's friends are playing folk music! Peppa learns that it's old-fashioned music, played on all sorts of instruments, such as a washboard, a whistle and a hurdy-gurdy. The group plays for Grandpa Pig and makes up a song about apples. As they sing, Grandpa Pig builds an apple juice press and hands out a glass to everyone!

episodes.title: Calling Kylie
episodes.description: It's bedtime and Peppa wonders what Kylie is doing at the moment. So Daddy Pig suggests they call her to find out. Peppa is surprised to learn that it's morning where Kylie is! Daddy Pig tries to explain why using a ball representing the Earth. The next morning Kylie calls Peppa, telling her about her busy summer day, but where Peppa lives it's winter! When Peppa tells her friends about the phone calls she's had with Kylie, they want to call her too, but Peppa knows she's still asleep!

episodes.title: House Rules
episodes.description: While driving Peppa to Suzy's house, Mummy Pig reminds her to be polite and say please and thank you, but Peppa already knows this rule. At Suzy's house, Peppa is surprised to see that there are other rules: no shoes inside and no jumping on the beds. Suzy and Peppa are invited to Emily's house for a picnic. There, there are other rules: no peanuts, as Emily is allergic, and brushing your teeth after every meal. On the way home, Peppa explains the different rules for each house.

episodes.title: Bigger House
episodes.description: With the arrival of the new baby, Mummy Pig decides that they need a bigger house.

episodes.title: The Big Build
episodes.description: Daddy Pig helps remodel the house.

episodes.title: Decorating
episodes.description: Peppa and George decide on how their new rooms should look.

episodes.title: Bigger Car
episodes.description: Daddy Pig gets a larger car to replace their older one, as it lacks any more room for the new arrival.

episodes.title: Jigsaw Festival
episodes.description: Jigsaw Festival Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival! Peppa is amazed by all of the completed jigsaws around the festival.

episodes.title: Hobbies
episodes.description: Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.

episodes.title: Patchwork Quilt
episodes.description: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!

episodes.title: Granny Sheep’s Art Van
episodes.description: Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.

episodes.title: Being Inspired
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boat yard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.

episodes.title: Sibling School
episodes.description: Peppa and George visit a special school run by Miss Rabbit on how to look after newborns.

episodes.title: New Baby
episodes.description: Mummy Pig is about to give birth to a loving baby girl, and Peppa and George; who are staying with Granny and Grandpa Pig, are excited for the arrival.

episodes.title: Baby Names
episodes.description: Peppa sees the new baby for the first time, and tries to think of a good name for her.

episodes.title: Holding The Baby
episodes.description: Peppa feels unsure about holding Evie Pig for the first time.

episodes.title: Hearing Test
episodes.description: Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss in one ear and suggests George tries a hearing aid.

episodes.title: Favourite Sound
episodes.description: Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his new hearing aid. She shows him all her favourite sounds including the splashing and sploshing of jumping in a muddy puddle!

episodes.title: Hospital Sleepover
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, the nurses tells Grandpa Pig he'll need to stay overnight.

episodes.title: Caring For Grandpa Pig
episodes.description: Grandpa Pig found his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant be discharged! Peppa and Suzy volunteers to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as in hospital.

episodes.title: Penny Polar Bear’s Party
episodes.description: It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party! The children find out they will be playing ice hockey! The children are all kitted out in their safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning how to play.

episodes.title: Biggest Picture In The World
episodes.description: Today, Granny Sheep is taking the children to the shopping center to paint a big mural. When they arrive, they meet Mr. Meerkat, the health and safety officer, who is put to the test by Granny Sheep.

episodes.title: Duck Race
episodes.description: Peppa has come to the river for the duck race! Everyone brings their own plastic duck, and they each encounter obstacles on the river.

episodes.title: Martial Arts
episodes.description: At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. They learn how to fall safely, balance and how to throw punches.

episodes.title: Dr Hamster’s Ant Farm
episodes.description: Dr. Hamster is visiting the playgroup today, and she has brought a giant ant farm. With all the talk about ants, they don't notice they've escaped!

episodes.title: Grownup Playground
episodes.description: Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.

episodes.title: Run Daddy Run
episodes.description: After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!

episodes.title: Coach Peppa
episodes.description: After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.

episodes.title: Marathon
episodes.description: It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!

episodes.title: Holiday with Suzy
episodes.description: Peppa and Suzy go on holiday with their families to the Great Tree Nature Park. However, they have to spend all day traveling by bus, something that doesn't excite Peppa or Suzy... until they discover that there might be fairies!

episodes.title: Riding in the forest
episodes.description: On the first day of the holiday, the families meet Bobby Beaver. He recommends they bike up to the panoramic viewpoint.

episodes.title: Beaver dam
episodes.description: Today, Mr. Beaver is teaching everyone how to build a dam! During this, Peppa and Suzy accidentally overwhelm Bobby.

episodes.title: Fairyland
episodes.description: It's the last day of the holiday, but the adventure isn't over yet! The families adventure through the forest to find the fairies!

episodes.title: Muddy Bob
episodes.description: Peppa stays at Suzy's house and accidentally gets mud on the carpet. She blames an invisible character named Muddy Bob before telling the truth after talking with Granny Sheep

episodes.title: Piano lesson
episodes.description: Peppa has a piano lesson today, and Mummy Pig has brought Baby Evie to watch. However, when Peppa tries, Evie cries!

episodes.title: Super picnic
episodes.description: Super Potato is organizing a picnic, but when he starts telling his stories, the children make all sorts of requests, including flying them back home!

episodes.title: Magnets
episodes.description: Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa shows off his collection of magnets, but his newest magnet is enormous. When Granddad Dog appears with another magnet, they stick together and become even more powerful.

episodes.title: Floating market
episodes.description: The Playgroup organize a floating market to raise funds. Everything goes well until Madame Gazelle drops the money into the lake. Luckily, Grampy Rabbit retrieves it with his submarine.

episodes.title: Mummy Pig's Work Trip
episodes.description: Today, Mummy Pig is going on a work trip to promote her new book. Peppa spends the day pretending to be Mummy Pig. Even so, she misses her terribly. Luckily, during an interview, Mummy Pig announces that she will be returning home in the morning.

episodes.title: Art class
episodes.description: Peppa and her friends are with their grandparents in Granny Sheep's art class. Although the grandparents are finding it a little difficult to keep up, the children help them create artwork that reflects their favorite things.

episodes.title: Flamenco
episodes.description: After checking her mail, Peppa finds a leaflet about Madame Gazelle's flamenco classes. Wanting to learn what flamenco is, she attends a lesson. Although she finds it very difficult, Señor Ram applauds her enthusiasm!

episodes.title: Evie in the Future
episodes.description: It's Christmas and Peppa receives a new puzzle. She wants to put it together with Evie, but she's still too little. Peppa imagines what it will be like when she grows up and gets even more excited about all they'll be able to do together.

episodes.title: Rollercoaster
episodes.description: While their mother is out shopping, the boys build a roller coaster. Dr. Doofenshmirtz and Perry battle due to the doctor's evil plan of throwing the earth off its rotation.

episodes.title: Lawn Gnome Beach Party of Terror
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb's newest backyard project is to create a tropical beach paradise. Meanwhile, Perry tries to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz's plan to steal all the garden lawn gnomes.

episodes.title: Flop Starz
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb decide to become a one hit wonder, Phineas and the Ferb-Tones and Candace wins the chance to sing with them. Meanwhile, Perry must stop Doofinshmirtz's giant robot - disguised as a temp.

episodes.title: The Fast and the Phineas
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb enter the family car in an auto race, while Candace has to bust them and impress Jeremy. Meanwhile, Perry must stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from deflating every inflatable object in the tri-state area.

episodes.title: Lights, Candace, Action!
episodes.description: Upon hearing that her favorite play is being made a movie, Candace rushes to try for the lead, only to see that Phineas and Ferb have become the directors and changed the script to include a little more insanity. Meanwhile, Perry goes to Doofinshmirtz Evil Inc. to find out why Heinz has been so quiet lately.

episodes.title: Raging Bully
episodes.description: Phineas enters a thumb-wrestling competition with a local bully, while Doofenshmirtz creates a hypnotic device to control people's minds so they will sing him Happy Birthday.

episodes.title: Candace Loses Her Head
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb decide to carve Candace's face into Mount Rushmore for her birthday present, while Perry attempts to stop Doofenshmirtz from making a tunnel to China.

episodes.title: I, Brobot
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb clone themselves so they can complete more projects while Doofenschmirtz hovers over his girlfriend's house with a huge magnet to erase crazy messages on her answering machine, for the sake of recording new ones.

episodes.title: Run Away Runway
episodes.description: Candace becomes a model, and is forced to wear outfits designed by Phineas and Ferb while Doofenshmirtz designs a machine to create clones of himself, to avoid having to wait in line.

episodes.title: The Magnificent Few
episodes.description: When Doofinshmirtz unleashes his army of termites to eat all the wood in the tri-state area, Phineas and Ferb use their newfounded love of a cowboy life to herd the stampeding cattle back to the carnival, but with Agent P stuck in a room filling with lava, how will he survive?

episodes.title: S'Winter
episodes.description: The boys use a sno-cone machine to create a Winter paradise during the middle of Summer in their backyard, Candace tries to pursue Jeremy (who thinks dropped her for a Swedish exchange student), and Doofenshmirtz tries to melt chocolate with a machine made from laser pointers.

episodes.title: Jerk De Soleil
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create a circus for the neighborhood and Candace becomes the surprise hit of the show while, Doofenshmirtz creates a device to make people's voices higher, making his deeper by comparison.

episodes.title: Are You My Mummy?
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb visit an Egyptian-themed movie theater and attempt to get a mummy of their own, but they end up capturing Candace, who is wrapped in toilet paper, while Doofenshmirtz tries to raise the city's water level so his real estate will become beachfront property.

episodes.title: Ready for the Bettys
episodes.description: Ferb and Phineas accidentally discover Perry's secret lair and are thrust into a spy mission of their own. Meanwhile, Candace travels on a tour bus with a girl band called "The Bettys"

episodes.title: I Scream, You Scream
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb make the biggest ice cream maker for Isabella after her tonsils are taken out. Doofenshmirtz's daughter, Vanessa, spends the day at his lair and tries to convince his ex-wife that he's evil.

episodes.title: Toy to the World
episodes.description: Based on the fact that a platypus doesn't do very much, Phineas and Ferb create a wooden toy version of Perry to sell to a toy company. Meanwhile, the real Perry heads off to stop Doofenshmirtz from building the Great Wall of the Tri-State Area and starting up toll booths at the only exits.

episodes.title: Get That Bigfoot Outta My Face!
episodes.description: Candace and the boys visit their grandparents at a lake house and the boys try to scare her with a fake Bigfoot while Doofenshmirtz goes out on a date and Perry gets ends up in the middle of it.

episodes.title: It's a Mud, Mud, Mud, Mud World
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create a monster truck for Candace to practice driving while Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to find investors for his line of monster trucks that are actual monsters, with a trump card to take down the competition.

episodes.title: Mom's Birthday
episodes.description: Candace plans a special birthday for Mom, and even a song, but Phineas and Ferb are always getting in her way of what she planned, unintentionally topping everything. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz creates a shrinking machine that will make whatever he hates implode.

episodes.title: Journey to the Center of Candace
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build a shrinking submarine so they can go inside Isabella's dog and retrieve a sash the pet ate, but they accidentally end up in Candace's stomach instead. Meanwhile, Perry must stop Doofenshmirtz from destroying people who can't make up their mind.

episodes.title: It's About Time!
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb find a time machine at a museum and travel back to the Jurassic Age. Meanwhile, Perry is sad when Doofenshmirtz replaces him with a new nemesis, Peter the Panda, so he confides in a relationship talk-show host.

episodes.title: Dude, We're Getting the Band Back Together
episodes.description: The boys locate their parents' favorite band, Love Handel, to perform a reunion concert in the backyard to make up Dad forgetting his wedding anniversary. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz plans a surprise birthday party for his daughter, Vanessa.

episodes.title: Tree to Get Ready
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build super tree houses for themselves and Candace, but things get a little out of hand when a treehouse fight instigates. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans to ruin a ceremony in his brother's honor.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Badbeard
episodes.description: The boys set out on a high-seas adventure after learning about a mysterious pirate from their grandpa. Meanwhile, Candace spies Perry and Dr. Doofenschmirtz up to their old tricks, but is it all in her head?

episodes.title: Greece Lightning
episodes.description: The boys stage a chariot race through the town's streets after learning about ancient Greece. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmritz creates a giant robot named Norm to destroy Perry, once and for all.

episodes.title: Leave the Busting to Us!
episodes.description: Candace uses a reality show to secretly film her brothers designing a white-water rafting ride. Meanwhile, Perry must crush Doofenshmirtz' dream of becoming a magician, as well as dominating the tri-state area.

episodes.title: Crack That Whip
episodes.description: The boys build a roller-derby rink for their grandma, who once was on a championship derby team, so she can skate against her onetime rival. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz believes a statue of a bearded man is mocking him because he can't grow facial hair, leading him to create a machine to solve his problem for him.

episodes.title: The Best Lazy Day Ever
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb decide to spend the day doing absolutely nothing, but Candace doesn't believe them and ends up constructing something of her own, in an attempt to get them to take over for her, letting her bust them. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz invents an ugly-inator so he will be more handsome than everyone else.

episodes.title: Boyfriend from 27,000 B.C.
episodes.description: The boys go on an archaeological dig and find a real caveman, who falls in love with Candace. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans to destroy all people dressed as sandwiches

episodes.title: Voyage to the Bottom of Buford
episodes.description: When Buford's goldfish goes missing, the boys help him find it out at sea. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to destroy a tape of him 'saving' a kitten from a tree.

episodes.title: A Hard Day's Knight
episodes.description: Phineas, Ferb, and Candace go to a Renaissance festival and Phineas and Ferb get Candace to go into a jousting tournament.

episodes.title: Traffic Cam Caper
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build the world's largest bowling ball and pins. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz wants to use his latest invention to freeze the Tri-State Area so the people will buy his hot chocolate.

episodes.title: Bowl-R-Ama Drama
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build the world's largest bowling ball and pins. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz wants to use his latest invention to freeze the Tri-State Area so the people will buy his hot chocolate.

episodes.title: Got Game?
episodes.description: The guys create a sports competition that pits boys against girls to see which are the better athletes. Meanwhile, Candace is having a bad hair day, and Doofenshmirtz trys to win a dog show.

episodes.title: Comet Kermillian
episodes.description: The boys build a telescope, while Doofenshmirtz tries to liquify steak. Meanwhile, Candace has another encounter with Jeremy's younger sister, Suzy.

episodes.title: Put That Putter Away
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create the world's largest golf course, and since Candace is sick, she asks her best friend Stacey to bust the boys for her.

episodes.title: Does This Duckbill Make Me Look Fat?
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create a teleporting machine, but it ends up switching Candace and Perry's brains.

episodes.title: The Flying Fishmonger
episodes.description: The boys are helping Ferb's grandfather live his life long dream - to jump a gorge in his motorcycle, the Holy Mackerel. Meanwhile, Perry sets out to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from exacting another petty revenge that dates all the way back to the sandbox.

episodes.title: One Good Scare Ought to Do It!
episodes.description: When Isabella falls prey to hiccups, Phineas and Ferb gather the kids together to help scare them out of her, using a remote controlled haunted house. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz sets out to destroy his mentor's hideout, so that no one could discover his secrets, but not if Perry has something to say about it!

episodes.title: The Monster of Phineas n Ferbenstein
episodes.description: The boys learn about one of Ferb's Victorian ancestors, who helped a scientist create a monster. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz recalls the story of his great-great-grandfather Dr. Jekyll Doofenshmirtz.

episodes.title: Oil on Candace
episodes.description: When Django feels down for not being able to draw art on the same scale as his father, Phineas and Ferb get some big ideas for his piece and the famous "unpainted desert". Meanwhile, Perry faces off against Doofenshmirtz, as he does his best to impress his visiting evil professor.

episodes.title: Out of Toon
episodes.description: The boys create a cartoon and cast themselves as superheroes and Candace as the villain, while Perry attempts to defeat Doofenshmirtz, who has taken control of the power of dance.

episodes.title: Hail Doofania!
episodes.description: When Doofenshmirtz's brother Roger is elected mayor, he decides to build his own country, where he can rule over everything, but how will he stop him when Perry is having trouble entering his hideout? Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb, in an attempt to help Isabella see her "first" rainbow, create the Rainbow-enator, which harnesses the power of their breakfast cereal to make the light show. The strangest anomaly of the episode, however, is when Candace and Vanessa manage to get their clothes mixed up at the dry-cleaners, resulting in a backwards day for everyone.

episodes.title: Out to Launch
episodes.description: The boys build a rocket ship to get a good look at a star named for them, and Candace accidentally takes a ride with them just as she is trying to find the courage to ask Jeremy to a dance, while Isabella tries her best to do the same with Phineas. Meanwhile, Perry must stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz, who, not only is conveniently in space too, but has created a massive spacestation in an attempt to get revenge on "Huge-Hands-Hans".

episodes.title: Phineas and Ferb Get Busted!
episodes.description: Candace has finally busted her brothers, and they are being sent away to a reformatory school to stamp out their imagination! But just how long can Candace enjoy her summer without her usual routine, her family? And speaking of usual routine, where is Perry?

episodes.title: Unfair Science Fair
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb help Baljeet build a portal to Mars for a special Summer science fair. Candace competes against another girl for getting a job at Mr. Slushy Burger. Meanwhile, Doofenshmitz builds a bicarbonate volcano for the science fair, in yet another attempt to redeem himself from his embarrassing childhood, where we discover where the -inator suffix originated from.

episodes.title: Unfair Science Fair Redux (Another Story)
episodes.description: When Candace believes that no one wants to be around her anymore, she quickly steps through Baljeet's portal to Mars, where she is quickly heralded among the martians. Meanwhile, Perry accompanies Dr. Doofenshmirtz to help build his evil contraption for him to stop faster, with slightly less than pleasing results.

episodes.title: The Lake Nose Monster
episodes.description: After taunting the boys for going to search for the "Lake Nose Monster", Candace begins freaking out on her lifeguard job, seeing the monster at every turn. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to remove all the zinc from the lake, though even he's not sure why.

episodes.title: Interview with a Platypus
episodes.description: Curious as to what Perry's chirping sound really means, Phineas and Ferb create a "Perry Translator". But they soon find it's not just bound to translating platypuses, platypi, platypeople? Meanwhile, Perry himself is caught in a plan involving a shark cage that is half off, a remote to open the dam, complicated acronyms and the high tech BO-AT.

episodes.title: Tip of the Day
episodes.description: When the daily crossword puzzle brings one of the worlds most useful, yet under-appreciated inventions to Phineas and Ferb's attention, the boys set out to bring the plight of the shoelace tip, the "aglet", to the worlds attention, with their only obstacle being Candace, who relentlessly wishes to convince everyone that it doesn't matter, even when she tries to use their campaign to become an insta-star. Meanwhile, Perry's new mission is to erase Doofenshmirtz' viral video, however this time, it seems both he and Heinz have the same goal, even if Doofenshmirtz wants to take it to a slight extreme.

episodes.title: Attack of the 50 Foot Sister
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create a slow reacting growth potion to help Baljeet with his "giant" watermelon, but Candace decides to use it for herself, when she finds that she's a little too short to be a flawless girl. Meanwhile, Perry must stop Doofenshmirtz from his most disgusting plan ever!

episodes.title: Backyard Aquarium
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb have a new pet, Goldy the goldfish, and to help make Goldy feel less lonely, Phineas and Ferb have built an aquarium with many other creatures. Meanwhile, Perry must stop Doofenshmirtz from a food related childhood revenge story.

episodes.title: Day of the Living Gelatin
episodes.description: When Phineas and Ferb get inspired by Candace's dessert club to create the biggest piece of gelatin ever, even Jenny and Stacy want to join in. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has a horrific plan, to turn Perry evil!

episodes.title: Elementary My Dear Stacy
episodes.description: While in London, Candace and Stacy decide to take a page out of Sherlock Holmes'…entire collection, to figure out what Phineas and Ferb have planned for the London Eye. Meanwhile, Perry must team up with British agent 00 Zero in order to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from moving Big Ben to the Tri-State Area.

episodes.title: Don't Even Blink
episodes.description: Fed up with her brother's inventions always disappearing, Candace enlists the help of everyone in the neighbourhood to build and watch a big and obvious invention, that they might finally see exactly what happens to everything. Meanwhile, is it mime? No, it's Doofenshmirtz' new Invisibility Ray.

episodes.title: Chez Platypus
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb open Chez Platypus, which becomes the trendiest restaurant in town. Jeremy asks Candace out on a date to the restaurant. Meanwhile Doofenshmirtz goes on another date from his online dating service, and vows to destroy all love in the tri-state area if the date doesn't go well.

episodes.title: Perry Lays an Egg
episodes.description: When an early end to their daily project causes Phineas and Ferb to mistake an egg for Perry's, the boys use all their technological knowhow to help hatch the new part of the family. However Candace has different plans for the egg, as a nature show brings her to be the one to convince Phineas and Ferb that the newborn will need a real mother. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz is doing all he can to convince Perry that his latest scheme really is evil.

episodes.title: Gaming the System
episodes.description: Buford has a new game, "Jump and Duck", which everyone is loving the look of. But Phineas is always one for a challenge, and Candace's comment about a game "sucking them in" is just the inspiration he needs to create a virtual reality machine of "Jump and Duck". The trouble begins when Candace, in her preparations for a Cotillion Jeremy has asked her to, gets pulled in before the boys. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has a slightly more disturbing childhood horror revenge story, but is the song and dance really necessary for this one?

episodes.title: The Chronicles of Meap
episodes.description: It's another average, logic defying day for Phineas and Ferb, until a crashed space pod, carrying an unbearably cute alien, Meap, thrusts the boys into another adventure in space! Everyone has a different role to play, while Candace holds on to Meap by accident, Ferb is fixing up the ship, as Phineas uses the new cute tracker to find where their new friend is, to the slight irritation of Isabella, as he can't get what *cough* is causing cute interference, but of course, it all has to lead up to the big explosive finale in SPACE -ace-ace. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has a new plan, simplistic in nature, but buried in an avalanche of backstory, oh dears.

episodes.title: Thaddeus and Thor
episodes.description: Visiting relatives of the Flynns' neighbors bear an uncanny resemblance to Candace, Phineas and Ferb. Meanwhile, Perry finds himself in the middle of Dr. Doofenshmirtz's family reunion.

episodes.title: De Plane! De Plane!
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb set out to build a bigger plane than Howard Hughes. Meanwhile, Candace attends a pool party at Jeremy's house where another girl is trying to impress him with her various adventure stories.

episodes.title: Let's Take a Quiz
episodes.description: After hearing that Jeremy was in a commercial, Candace wants to gain popularity as well, by going on Phineas and Ferb's TV game show.

episodes.title: At the Car Wash
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create an automatic carwash in order to raise money for Isabella and the Fireside girls.

episodes.title: Oh, There You Are, Perry
episodes.description: Perry the Platypus is reassigned and forced to move to the Quad State area with a new family and battle a new villain, the Regurgitator. During his new assignment, Phineas, Ferb, and Candace put in every effort to find him, hoping he'll return to them.

episodes.title: Swiss Family Phineas
episodes.description: The family takes a short sail trip out to sea, but a storm causes them to wind up stranded on a remote island. To pass the time, Phineas, Ferb, and Isabella, build a set of treehouses with the most modern conveniences, to Candace's dismay, as she wants to get back home in time to attend Jeremy's party. Meanwhile, Perry the Platypus, who was left behind, must get away from the watchful eye of Baljeet and Buford, so he can go on his mission to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz's latest plot.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.description: To play a game of indoor hide-and-seek Phineas and Ferb shrink down their friends including, their new extreme fan, Irving. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz attaches a nanobot to Perry in an attempt to discover where he lives.

episodes.title: That Sinking Feeling
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build a ocean liner so that Baljeet can go on a romantic cruise with his friend Mishti, whom he now notices is a very pretty girl. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz wants to move all the lighthouses to the other side of town so that he can get a good night's sleep instead of hearing the constant noise from the boats surrounding the bay by his headquarters.

episodes.title: The Baljeatles
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb learn that Baljeet has signed up for rock camp and worries he may get his first failing grade. So the boys help by forming a band to help him express his feelings, especially for math. Meanwhile, Candace wonders why Jeremy doesn't give her a cool nickname as Stacy gets close to Coltrane, the rock camp director. Doofenshmirtz's latest plan has him wanting his own army of babies by broadcasting his heartbeat all over the tristate area.

episodes.title: Vanessassary Roughness
episodes.description: Vanessa Doofenshirtmz tries to convince her dad that she's responsible enough to have her own car. For that, she has to get a special chemical for him in hopes she doesn't always have to ride with him on the family scooter. At the mega mall, a chase for the chemical ensues as it's tossed around between Candace and Stacy, Buford and Baljeet, and Ferb, who joins Vanessa's quest in hopes he'll be able to get her attention.

episodes.title: No More Bunny Business
episodes.description: When Candace finds a rabbit, she wants him as her pet, but in hindsight, he's actually a rogue agent trying to find Perry's secret lair for information. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb try to make x-ray glasses. And since Perry isn't around to stop his latest plot, Doofenshirtmz faces an unusual new foe.

episodes.title: Spa Day
episodes.description: Stacy has a spa day planned for herself and Candace, but they get side tracked when Jeremy is participating in a house-building program for the homeless and Candace joins as well in hopes of impressing him. Fortunately, the girls are able to get their spa day after all when Phineas and Ferb build their own spa with its own special features. Meanwhile, Doofenshmritz finds a cat which causes a lot of problems when he's trying to carry out his latest evil plot.

episodes.title: Phineas and Ferb's Quantum Boogaloo
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb travel to the future to find a tool that hasn't been invented yet, and run into future Candace. Seeing an opportunity to finally bust her brothers, she follows them back through time to catch them building their rollercoaster, and exposes their antics to her mom. In the process, she accidentally foils Agent P's defeat of Dr. Doofenshmirtz, starting a chain reaction that turns the future into a dystopian society.

episodes.title: Phineas and Ferb Musical Cliptastic Countdown
episodes.description: Major Monogram and Dr. Doofenshmirtz host this special episode counting down the top 10 most popular music videos from the show's first season as voted by the fans and viewers, but not without the evil doctor attempting to pull off another scheme to gain power. Fortunately, Perry the Platypus is there to save the day.

episodes.title: Bubble Boys
episodes.description: The boys are able to create a giant bubble which enables them and their friends to float and view all of Danville from above as Candace tries to bust them while on a practice drive with Mom for her learner's permit. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to gain popularity by singing country and western music and Perry must stop him before the concert crowd submits to his latest invention.

episodes.title: Isabella and the Temple of Sap
episodes.description: Isabella and the Fireside Girls set out to find the rare maraca nut tree so they can get its much needed sap for Phineas and Ferb's bubble invention. Their quest leads them to an old abandoned amusement park. Meanwhile, Pinky the Chihuahua must stop his archenemy, Professor Poofenplotz, from acquiring her favorite brand of hair spray, which she needs to look beautiful enough in order to plan taking over the world. The last of the discontinued product is located at the same amusement park.

episodes.title: Cheer Up Candace
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb give Candace the ultimate makeover.

episodes.title: Fireside Girl Jamboree
episodes.description: Candace hopes to join the Fireside Girls before the Paisley Sideburn Brothers perform.

episodes.title: The Bully Code
episodes.description: After Baljeet saves him, Buford vows to become Baljeet's slave.

episodes.title: Finding Mary McGuffin
episodes.description: Dad accidentally sells Candace's favorite doll at a yard sale. Phineas and Ferb become detectives and interview various people to find the doll. Meanwhile, Perry the Platypus tries to get the doll back from his nemesis.

episodes.title: Picture This
episodes.description: After Ferb accidentally leaves his skateboard at his grandparents' house, he and Phineas develop a teleportation device that can retrieve any object. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to rid the world of mimes.

episodes.title: Nerdy Dancin'
episodes.description: Unsure of his own dancing skills when he agrees to go on a TV show with Candace, Phineas and Ferb develop a device to help Jeremy imitate the dance moves of a professional. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz and several other villains try to broadcast an evil message during the taping of the show.

episodes.title: What Do It Do?
episodes.description: The boys reconstuct one of Doofenshmirtz's inventions to discover what it does after it lands in their front yard.

episodes.title: Atlantis
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb discover the lost city of Atlantis, Candace enters a sand castle building contest, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to use a growth formula to make plants evil.

episodes.title: Phineas and Ferb Christmas Vacation!
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb try to decorate the Tri-State Area as a thank you for Santa Claus, but when Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to spread naughtiness across the city with his "Naughty-inator," the boys must help restore holiday cheer to Danville. Meanwhile, Candace tries to find out the contents of Jeremy's wish list.

episodes.title: Just Passing Through
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create an orb that allows its user to pass through objects to help find Linda's guitar pick, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to destroy a statue honoring his brother Roger.

episodes.title: Candace's Big Day
episodes.description: When Aunt Tiana and Uncle Bob's wedding is moved to the Flynn-Fletcher's backyard, Candace hopes that her brothers do not upstage her role as maid of honor. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to transform food into junk food

episodes.title: I Was a Middle Aged Robot
episodes.description: Lawrence's memory is accidentally erased by a gadget in Perry's lair before participating in a father-daughter race with Candace, so Perry operates a robot version of Lawrence to fill in for him. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents an opposite of glue named "Eulg," which breaks stuff apart rather than join it together.

episodes.title: Suddenly Suzy
episodes.description: Candace and Suzy try to get Phineas and Ferb to bust themselves, the boys build a replica of Niagara Falls so they can ride a barrel over it, Doofenshmirtz builds a device to increase his carbon footprint.

episodes.title: Undercover Carl
episodes.description: When the boys build an Anti-Gravity Fun Launcher, Carl accidentally intercepts their plans and assumes they are working for Dr. Doofenshmirtz, so he is sent undercover to figure out what they are doing. Meanwhile, Perry tries to find a lost agent, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz also acquires the blueprints to help with a parking issue on his street.

episodes.title: Hip Hip Parade
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb decide to help build floats for all the neighborhood kids in the yearly "Tri-State Area Unification Day" parade, but a family grudge leads Buford and his family to try and wreak havoc on the parade.

episodes.title: Invasion of the Ferb Snatchers
episodes.description: After watching a sci-fi movie marathon, Candace becomes convinced that Ferb is an alien. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to market an evil invention by claiming it to be a cleaning device.

episodes.title: Ain't No Kiddie Ride
episodes.description: The boys trick out the kiddie rides at a store, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to burn his name into the atmosphere.

episodes.title: Not Phineas and Ferb
episodes.description: Irving's brother Albert doesn't believe that Phineas and Ferb are anything special, and since he claims to be the "Truth Detector," he can prove it. Desperate to prove Albert wrong, Irving convinces Baljeet and Buford to pose as Phineas and Ferb beside a giant hologram of the boys' Eiffel Tower construction. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz is fed up with the quality of accessories for his model train set, and decides to shrink down a variety of national monuments to add to his collection.

episodes.title: Phineas and Ferb-Busters!
episodes.description: Candace, Stacy, and Jenny team up to try and bust Phineas and Ferb together. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz enlists a new robot to replace Norm, but a power surge causes it to glitch and turn against him.

episodes.title: The Lizard Whisperer
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb find a chameleon in the backyard, who grows to the size of a dinosaur, thanks to Doofenshmirtz's Gigant-Inator, and takes a walk through downtown. Meanwhile, Jeremy teaches a song to Doofenshmirtz, who plans to use it to summon aliens to do his bidding.

episodes.title: Robot Rodeo
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build a robotic rodeo in the backyard. Candace tries to prove she can focus so she can go to a concert with Stacy. Doofenshmirtz stalls to finish his entry into the Inator Creator competition.

episodes.title: The Beak
episodes.description: Khaka Peü Peü arrives in Danville to challenge Phineas and Ferb after the boys are mistaken as a superhero (while wearing an indestructible suit they designed to safely conquer their newly built extreme skate-track) known as The Beak. With the super villain wreaking havoc, it's up to Phineas and Ferb to thwart him while Dr. Doofenshmirtz tells the people of the Tri-State area that he is in charge, in hopes that they will actually just go along with it. Meanwhile, his brother Roger is worried that everyone will blame him for the recent super villain catastrophe so he decides to make Doofenshmirtz Mayor.

episodes.title: She's the Mayor
episodes.description: Candace is awarded the opportunity to be mayor for the day, so she create laws that can bust her brothers. Back at home, Phineas and Ferb build an authentic log cabin and pioneer village. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz is scheduled to play golf with his brother Rodger but isn't happy about it.

episodes.title: The Lemonade Stand
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build the ultimate lemonade stand and begin to offer franchise opportunities. Meanwhile, Candace and Stacy's relationship is put to the test when Candace feels she must pick between their friendship and busting her brothers, while Dr. Doofenshmirtz creates a "Paper-Cut-Inator" so that he can make millions selling band-aids.

episodes.title: Phineas and Ferb Hawaiian Vacation
episodes.description: The Flynn-Fletcher Family go on a vacation to Hawaii. While they are there, Phineas and Ferb make living sea creatures and Candace find a lava necklace of bad luck. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz creates a De-Evolution-inator and Perry and him get stranded on a island.

episodes.title: Phineas and Ferb Summer Belongs to You!
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb and their friends travel around the world. However, for once, not everybody believes they can achieve what they set out to do. Also, Candace and Jeremy's relationship will be further explored.

episodes.title: Nerds of a Feather
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb head to the Tri-State area's annual sci-fi/comic book convention to meet their hero, special effects guru Clive Addison. Their plan gets sidetracked when they're swept into a duel between fantasy fans and sci-fi geeks. Meanwhile, Candace tries to keep secret that she's a fan of Ducky Mo-Mo, another convention staple. Across the convention hall, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has taken television executive Jeff McGarland hostage so he can pitch him a show he's developed, Doof ‘N' Puss.

episodes.title: Wizard of Odd
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb head to the Tri-State area’s annual sci-fi/comic book convention to meet their hero, special effects guru Clive Addison. Their plan gets sidetracked when they’re swept into a duel between fantasy fans and sci-fi geeks. Meanwhile, Candace tries to keep secret that she’s a fan of Ducky Mo-Mo, another convention staple. Across the convention hall, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has taken television executive Jeff McGarland hostage so he can pitch him a show he’s developed, Doof ‘N’ Puss.

episodes.title: We Call It Maze
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create a life sized maze filled with fun obstacles. Melissa, the leader of the Little Sparks, a younger branch of the Fireside Girls, is immediately captivated when she meets Candace and finds out that she was a Fireside Girl who earned 50 patches in one day. When the girls try out the maze, Candace takes charge, but things don't go as planned. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz reasons that if the Leaning Tower of Pisa can generate souvenir revenue, then surely he can use his latest invention, the "Tilt-inator," to tilt buildings so he can sell souvenir replicas.

episodes.title: Ladies and Gentlemen, Meet Max Modem!
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb create a life sized maze filled with fun obstacles. Melissa, the leader of the Little Sparks, a younger branch of the Fireside Girls, is immediately captivated when she meets Candace and finds out that she was a Fireside Girl who earned 50 patches in one day. When the girls try out the maze, Candace takes charge, but things don’t go as planned. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz reasons that if the Leaning Tower of Pisa can generate souvenir revenue, then surely he can use his latest invention, the "Tilt-inator," to tilt buildings so he can sell souvenir replicas.

episodes.title: The Secret of Success
episodes.description: When Linda is asked to do a Lindana reunion concert, Lawrence worries that she might be missing the excitement of her old life, so he asks the boys to help turn him into a pop star so that he can perform at the concert and show mom he too is an exciting guy. Across town, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans a faux alien invasion in order to take over the Tri-State area.

episodes.title: The Doof Side of the Moon
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb plan to put Danville on the map by building the world's tallest building. However, Candace teams up with Albert and utilizes his expertise to bust her brothers. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz wants to be responsible for all the evil in the Tri-state area, and since he believes that evil levels rise during a full moon, he plans to rotate it so that only the infamous "dark side of the moon" faces Earth.

episodes.title: Split Personality
episodes.description: Candace accidentally gets hit by a "splitter" ray which causes her to have two different personalities - Romantic Candace and Busting Candace, so the boys have to figure out a way to put her back together again. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to get over his irrational fear of high diving, but he figures that if he can't, he will just use his "Look-away-inator" to zap everyone so that they do not witness his shame.

episodes.title: Brain Drain
episodes.description: Phineas, Ferb and the gang are all sick with a cold, so they decide to make it the best "sick day" ever by creating a live television feed to their friends' homes so that they can all enjoy a day of fun together. Meanwhile, Vanessa learns from her mom, Charlene, that her dad is picking her up from a party she is going to with her punk rock boyfriend Johnny and is worried that he will embarrass her yet again. However, Dr. Doofenshmirtz is busy trying to use his "Deevolution-ator" to drain Agent P's will power so that he can control him, and things get out of hand when Dr. Doofenshmirtz picks up Vanessa at the party, and it's up to Agent P to save the day.

episodes.title: Rollercoaster: The Musical!
episodes.description: Phineas, Ferb and the gang are all sick with a cold, so they decide to make it the best "sick day" ever by creating a live television feed to their friends' homes so that they can all enjoy a day of fun together. Meanwhile, Vanessa learns from her mom, Charlene, that her dad is picking her up from a party she is going to with her punk rock boyfriend Johnny and is worried that he will embarrass her yet again. However, Dr. Doofenshmirtz is busy trying to use his "Deevolution-ator" to drain Agent P's will power so that he can control him, and things get out of hand when Dr. Doofenshmirtz picks up Vanessa at the party, and it's up to Agent P to save the day.

episodes.title: Make Play
episodes.description: A musical in which Phineas and Ferb revisit the day they built a gigantic roller coaster in their backyard.  Doofenshmirtz tries to pull the East Coast to the west using tinfoil and a huge magnet.

episodes.title: Candace Gets Busted
episodes.description: When Linda and Lawrence go on a trip, Candace decides to have an Intimate Get Together with Stacy and Jenny. But, then more people come and makes it into a party. Later, when her parents get home, Candace gets busted.

episodes.title: Candace Gets Busted
episodes.description: When Linda and Lawrence go on a trip, Candace decides to have an Intimate Get Together with Stacy and Jenny. But, then more people come and makes it into a party. Later, when her parents get home, Candace gets busted.

episodes.title: The Great Indoors
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb build a gigantic biome during a bit of bad weather to help Isabella earn a Fireside Girl patch. Meanwhile, Candace wants to know what Jeremy likes about her, and Doofenshmirtz wants to watch his favorite foreign soap opera.

episodes.title: Canderemy
episodes.description: Candace realizes that she needs to spend more time with Stacy, so she vows to spend the whole day with her only. But while visiting Jeremy and his mom, Mrs. Johnson, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's "combine-inator" zaps her and Jeremy, literally joining them at the hip. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb build a giant robot dog that causes a lot of mischief.

episodes.title: Run, Candace, Run
episodes.description: Phineas and Ferb's newest invention is a pair of boots that make the wearer extraordinarily fast. Candace decides to wear them so that she can be in two places at once; at Jeremy's family picnic, where she runs into Mrs. Johnson, and also at the library where she promised Mom she would read to the kids. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's building is put up for sale so he tries to convince a prospective buyer, Annabelle, who turns out to be a long lost relative of the Johnson family, that it is not worth buying.

episodes.title: Last Train to Bustville
episodes.description: While visiting their grandparents, the kids decide to create and race a giant hot air balloon. Meanwhile, Candace is inspired by train engineer Glenda's can-do attitude and decides to "give up" on busting her brothers. On the other side of town, Dr. Doofenshmirtz finds a Dodo bird egg and is convinced that it is a fierce bird-monster that can help him take over the Tri-state area, but discovers the exact opposite when the egg hatches.

episodes.title: Phineas' Birthday Clip-O-Rama!
episodes.description: It's Phineas' birthday and for the special occasion, Ferb puts together a clip show of the gang's favorite moments. Meanwhile, Agent P has to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from using his 'non-inator' to pre-empt his brother's biography from appearing on television.

episodes.title: The Belly of the Beast
episodes.description: For Harbor Days Festival, Phineas and Ferb celebrate by creating a mechanical version of the historical elusive shark of Danville Harbor. Seeing what the boys are up to, Candace enlists some help to capture the mysterious shark. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents the 'Salt Water Taffy-inator' to give cavities to every kid in the Tri-State Area.

episodes.title: Moon Farm
