episodes.description: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

episodes.title: Clan of the Cave Mom
episodes.description: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

episodes.title: Night of the Living Wage
episodes.description: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she collectively bargained for.

episodes.title: Cremains of the Day
episodes.description: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

episodes.title: The Tell-Tale Pants
episodes.description: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

episodes.title: The Tipping Point
episodes.description: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.

episodes.title: Bart's Brain
episodes.description: Bart makes a new friend.

episodes.title: Bart's Birthday
episodes.description: Bart celebrates a birthday that will change his life forever.

episodes.title: The Yellow Lotus
episodes.description: The Simpsons will encounter a death while on vacation at a high-end resort.

episodes.title: Desperately Seeking Lisa
episodes.description: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

episodes.title: Shoddy Heat
episodes.description: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s... as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXV
episodes.description: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be called.. Denim.

episodes.title: Women in Shorts
episodes.description: Girls just want to have funny.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
episodes.description: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

episodes.title: Convenience Airways
episodes.description: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

episodes.title: Homer and Her Sisters
episodes.description: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

episodes.title: The Man Who Flew Too Much
episodes.description: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

episodes.title: Bottle Episode
episodes.description: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

episodes.title: The Flandshees of Innersimpson
episodes.description: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far .

episodes.title: The Last Man Expanding
episodes.description: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug... all except Homer.

episodes.title: P.S. I Hate You
episodes.description: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

episodes.title: Abe League of Their Moe
episodes.description: After Grampa And Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

episodes.title: Stew Lies
episodes.description: When a world-famous celebrity chef loses his passion for cooking, Homer unexpectedly becomes his unlikely muse and revives his love for food with a little help from Springfield’s mob.

episodes.title: Full Heart, Empty Pool
episodes.description: Homer and Grampa team up to create a new sport that rivals pickleball, until jealousy drives the two apart.

episodes.title: Estranger Things
episodes.description: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart.. but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!.

episodes.title: Thrifty Ways to Thieve Your Mother
episodes.description: Lisa discovers Marge's vintage clothes from the 90’s and is welcomed into the school's elite fashion club. But to feed their hunger for retro looks, the thrifters break the law — becoming a fashionista bling ring. Meanwhile, Homer gets addicted to a Reacher-type Dad TV show with lots of punching.

episodes.title: Keep Chalm and Gary On
episodes.description: Homer gets Superintendent Chalmers a job at the power plant. There, Chalmers discovers huge mutated snails that produce valuable slime launching his new career as a man-o-sphere guru.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
episodes.description: In this year's installment of the annual fright-fest, the town is menaced by a mysterious murdering monster from out of the sewers, Krusty has a demonic special guest on his live Halloween special, and we go a thousand years into Springfield's poseable plastic post-apocalyptic future.

episodes.title: Men Behaving Manly
episodes.description: Marge turns to a Man Camp to save the men of Springfield from themselves.

episodes.title: Bad Boys... For Life?
episodes.description: Is Bart Simpson truly a bad seed? Homer and Marge must find out once and for good.

episodes.title: Bart 'N' Frink
episodes.description: When Bart becomes Professor Frink's lab assistant, the Simpsons are thrown into a world of tech billionaires determined to live forever, with the future of the internet at stake.

episodes.title: Sashes to Sashes
episodes.description: Bart runs against Mayor Quimby's son for student council president, while Lisa learns troubling secrets about the Quimby clan.. and about the Simpsons.

episodes.title: The Day of the Jack-up
episodes.description: After a mysterious buyer purchases every ticket for the KPOP concert Lisa wants to go to, the Simpsons have to figure out the identity of this evil ticket reseller. Or do they? (Yes, they do).

episodes.title: Aunt Misbehavin'
episodes.description: Patty and Bart team up for the ultimate prank: getting Homer declared legally dead. To their chagrin, Homer loves being officially dead - which leads to Patty and Selma having a huge fight and Patty moving away to "Palm Springfield".

episodes.title: Guess Who's Coming to Skinner
episodes.description: When Principal Skinner discovers that one of his students is a runaway who has been living in the school library, he has to take the snarky, difficult kid into his home and is forced into a role he never expected or wanted - being a parent.

episodes.title: Parahormonal Activity
episodes.description: Set in the near future, Marge is competently coping with the hormonal onslaught hitting her now teenage kids when she's suddenly struck by a big life change of her own, leaving Homer as the last sane person in the house... or is he?

episodes.title: ¡The Fall Guy-Yi-Yi!
episodes.description: Homer revitalizes Bumblebee Man's career when he becomes his secret stuntman. But how much punishment can a Stunt-Bee take before it starts to sting.

episodes.title: Seperance
episodes.description: Homer's enthusiasm skills land him a job at a secretive company with a mind-altering agenda.

episodes.title: Irrational Treasure
episodes.description: Marge's crusade to get the family dog in better shape leads to her entering Santa's Little Helper in canine agility competitions and a trip to the National Dog Show in Philadelphia. There, Marge and Homer suddenly find themselves - and the dog - mixed up in a historical conspiracy adventure worthy of a "National Treasure" movie.

episodes.title: Homer? A Cracker Bro?
episodes.description: Homer strikes up an unlikely friendship with Kirk Van Houten, which leads to them launching a hugely successful business venture together - a "crumbless" cracker that sweeps the nation. But when Kirk's darkest secrets are revealed, Homer has to choose between his family and his fortune... and may just end up going in jail.

episodes.title: The Children's Book Job
episodes.description: A British children's book author comes to Springfield to give a talk at Springfield Elementary School. Homer is tasked with picking her up from the airport, but things go bad from there.

episodes.title: Diary of a Chimpy Kid
episodes.description: Bart and Lisa adopt an abandoned baby chimp and clash over their surprisingly different parenting styles. When the chimp is abducted by a private wild animal zoo, the family goes on a mission to rescue him. Homer is conflicted about saving the ape, because he's convinced the chimp will tear off his face and groin.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening
episodes.description: All hell breaks loose on Halloween when a killer comes to Springfield and hacks their way through town. No Simpson is safe from... THE REVENGENING!

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXVII
episodes.description: In this year's extra-scary, ultra-spooky Treehouse of Horror, Marge gets a horrifying new perspective on marriage; Bart and Santa's Little Helper embark on a bone-chilling adventure; and Homer takes a driving lesson.

episodes.title: Testing 1-2-3
episodes.description: In what she argues is not an attempt to get extra time on tests, Lisa has herself evaluated for three types of neurodiversity... which remind her of behaviors she's witnessed in Principal Skinner, Comic Book Guy and Homer. Perhaps these atypical behaviors aren't as atypical as we think.

episodes.title: The Kosmic Kruiser
episodes.description: Bart and Lisa break into Krustyland's most notorious failed attraction, only to discover that it hasn't been completely abandoned.

episodes.title: Dream Scenari-Moe
episodes.description: When Moe has trouble sleeping, he enrolls in a brand-new sleep study that gives him the greatest romantic comedy dreams of his life. But unbeknownst to him, his beautiful fantasy comes at a nightmarish price.

episodes.title: Curb Your Expectations
episodes.description: After Krusty's latest marriage ends in spectacular fashion, he swears off love forever, only to discover his perfect match in a familiar face. Can a selfish, emotionally stunted TV clown forge a new family and finally win the love he doesn't deserve?

episodes.title: Jersey Score
episodes.description: When Chief Wiggum learns his son Ralph is a martial arts prodigy, he scrambles to find money to pay for lessons. Luckily Bart is there to help with a scheme to sell stolen sports merchandise.

episodes.title: Don't Marge with Texas
episodes.description: When Bart and Milhouse crash a bar mitzvah in tuxes and discover that no adult can resist a kid in formalwear, they have a wild party-crashing night. At home, after Marge makes finger puppet shows for Maggie, Homer thinks that Marge can become the next superstar performer for babies. He posts her shows online, which gets the Simpsons an invitation to a baby entertainment festival in Texas. There, in a Texas setting that reminds us of the show "Landman," Marge has a difficult moral decision to make.

episodes.title: Lock, Stock and One Stupid Narrator
Glorious Purpose
episodes.description: After picking up the Tesseract, Loki finds himself called before the Time Variance Authority (TVA), a Kafkaesque bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space.

episodes.title: The Variant
episodes.description: Mobius puts Loki to work investigating The Variant, but not everyone at the TVA is thrilled to be working alongside The God of Mischief.

episodes.title: Lamentis
episodes.description: Loki finds himself trapped in an apocalypse with a dead TemPad and the last person he wants by his side: the Loki Variant, Sylvie. Now the two must find their way off of the doomed moon before complete annihilation.

episodes.title: The Nexus Event
episodes.description: Loki and Sylvie find their way off the Lamentis-1 mere moments before complete annihilation. Now, the question on everyone's mind, especially those in charge of the TVA — how did these two variants create a Nexus Event in the face of an apocalypse?

episodes.title: Journey Into Mystery
episodes.description: Upon discovering the Time Keepers aren't real, Judge Renslayer prunes Loki with the Time Stick. Now in an unknown land surrounded by variant Lokis, they urge him to follow them. Meanwhile, turning on the judge, Sylvie demands to be told everything about the TVA.

episodes.title: For All Time. Always.
episodes.description: Loki and Sylvie arrive the Citadel at the End of Time. Will they finally discover who is behind the Time Variance Authority?

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.description: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

episodes.title: Breaking Brad
episodes.description: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone's favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

episodes.title: Heart of the TVA
episodes.description: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.

episodes.title: Science/Fiction
episodes.description: Loki traverses dying timelines in an attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.description: Loki learns the true nature of ‘glorious purpose’ as he rectifies the past to save the future.

episodes.title: Tourist Trapped
episodes.description: When Dipper and Mabel Pines arrive to spend their summer break in the remote town of Gravity Falls, Mabel's suspiciously weird new boyfriend causes the twins to come face to face with the town's strange and uncanny secrets.

episodes.title: The Legend of the Gobblewonker
episodes.description: When Dipper and Mabel hear rumors that a lake monster lives at the bottom of the local lake, they enlist Soos to take them on a boating expedition to prove that it really does exist, instead of going with Stan Pines to go fishing.

episodes.title: Headhunters
episodes.description: When someone tampers with Mabel's life-size wax statue of Grunkle Stan, she and Dipper set out to find the culprit. Meanwhile, Grunkle Stan mourns over the loss of his wax doppelganger.

episodes.title: The Hand That Rocks the Mabel
episodes.description: Dipper and Mabel discover their seemingly cherubic new neighbor, Lil' Gideon, happens to be the town's adored psychic. But when Dipper convinces Mabel to go on a date with Gideon to question his authenticity, she soon learns that his cuteness can fade all too quickly.

episodes.title: The Inconveniencing
episodes.description: When Dipper tries to impress Wendy by acting older than he really is, he's invited to join a group of teenagers that leads to an old abandoned convenience store that may be haunted. Mabel tags along for the ride but gets sidetracked when she sees a discontinued line of flavored candies that sends her on an unexpected adventure.

episodes.title: Dipper vs. Manliness
episodes.description: In a quest to attain manliness, Dipper ventures into the forest to battle the notorious Multi-Bear. Meanwhile, Mabel tries to teach Grunkle Stan how to be attractive to women, particularly the waitress in the local diner, Lazy Susan,.

episodes.title: Double Dipper
episodes.description: Stan throws a big weekend party to promote the Mystery Shack. Dipper makes clones of himself to impress Wendy. Mabel fights for the Party Queen title in honor of her two friends.

episodes.title: Irrational Treasure
episodes.description: When Dipper and Mabel discover evidence that the reported town founder is a hoax, they set out to expose the historical cover-up and prove that Mabel's silliness is not a bad thing.

episodes.title: The Time Traveler's Pig
episodes.description: When Dipper wishes he could go back in time and undo a mistake he made, he discovers there is a time machine that can help him do just that. Meanwhile, it's love at first sight for Mabel when she wins a pet pig at the fair.

episodes.title: Fight Fighters
episodes.description: After being challenged to a fight by Wendy's boyfriend Robbie, Dipper is shocked when his favorite Fight Fighters fighter, Rumble McSkirmish, comes to life to defend him, but Dipper soon loses control of Rumble and has to find a way to stop him from seriously injuring Robbie

episodes.title: Little Dipper
episodes.description: Dipper feels self-conscious that Mabel is taller than him and is becoming the alpha twin, so he seeks out a magic way to grow himself the same height. Meanwhile, Lil' Gideon takes advantage of Dipper's and Mabel's height discrepancies.

episodes.title: Summerween
episodes.description: It's Gravity Falls' version of Halloween in Summer with Jack-o-Melons and lots of trick-or-treating. Dipper and Mabel are excited to join in on the fun, but when Wendy casually mentions that trick-or-treating is for kids, Dipper's whole outlook on the evening changes. The night gets even more complicated when a monster that Dipper accidentally insulted makes them fulfill his candy quota by night's end or else he will eat them.

episodes.title: Boss Mabel
episodes.description: When Mabel questions the way Stan runs the Shack, he challenges her to a bet - whoever can make the most money in three days wins the chance to run the Shack however they wish for the rest of the summer. Mabel takes the bet and implements a new bossing method that coddles her employees and gives them the freedom to follow their hopes and dreams. Unfortunately, the results are not as expected and Mabel finds herself just trying to get back some normalcy. Meanwhile, Grunkle Stan sets off to win big money on a television game show.

episodes.title: Bottomless Pit!
episodes.description: When Stan, Dipper, Mabel and Soos find themselves falling into a bottomless pit, they each decide to tell a different story to pass the time.

episodes.title: The Deep End
episodes.description: When Mabel befriends a cute Merman trapped in the deep end of the public pool, she's determined to return him to his family in the ocean - even though that means her whirlwind.

episodes.title: Carpet Diem
episodes.description: When Dipper discovers a hidden room inside the Mystery Shack, he is happy to claim it as his own space, but there is one problem - Mabel wants the room too. The duo compete to win the room with a contest that gets even trickier when they learn the room's carpet has electric body swapping properties.

episodes.title: Boyz Crazy
episodes.description: When Mabel discovers that her favorite boy band is actually a bunch of imprisoned clones, she sets them free, only to decide on keeping them for herself. Meanwhile, Dipper is convinced that Robbie plans to brainwash Wendy with a secret message hidden inside one of his songs.

episodes.title: Land Before Swine
episodes.description: When Waddles is snatched by a prehistoric beast, Dipper, Mabel, Stan, Soos, and Old Man McGucket must journey to a mysterious land trapped in time to rescue him.

episodes.title: Dreamscaperers
episodes.description: Dipper, Mabel, and Soos must travel through Grunkle Stan's mind to defeat a tricky dream demon summoned by Lil Gideon.

episodes.title: Gideon Rises
episodes.description: After 'Lil Gideon swindles the Mystery Shack away from Stan, everything in Gravity Falls appears to be even more west of weird - Dipper, Mabel and Grunkle Stan are forced to move in with Soos and his grandmother, while the town remains enamored with Gideon's charm. Meanwhile, Grunkle Stan isn't certain he can take care of the twins and is considering sending them back home. With their summer in Gravity Falls threatening to come to an end, Mabel and Dipper decide to take on Gideon and win back their home.

episodes.title: Scary-Oke
episodes.description: The Pines family is starting to get everything back to normal after the Lil' Gideon incident. They throw a “Mystery Shack Is Back” party, but some unwelcome guests intend to crash it.

episodes.title: Into the Bunker
episodes.description: Dipper's secret journal pages lead him and the gang to the author's hidden bunker where they find themselves face-to-face with a mysterious figure from Gravity Falls' lore.

episodes.title: The Golf War
episodes.description: After being belittled by Pacifica one too many times, Mabel challenges her to a miniature golf-off which gets a tad out of control when some local residents offer their help.

episodes.title: Sock Opera
episodes.description: Mabel decides to put on a sock puppet rock opera to impress a local puppeteer, but her show goes awry when Dipper's drive to uncover more of the journal's secrets leads to a supernatural disaster.

episodes.title: Soos and the Real Girl
episodes.description: Soos needs a date for his cousin Reggie's engagement party and looks to a dating simulator game to help him talk to girls.

episodes.title: Little Gift Shop of Horrors
episodes.description: In three separate mysterious tales, Stan is cursed by a Witch, Waddles accidentally eats a bowl of brain-enhancing jelly and builds a machine that allows him to speak for the first time, and Mabel faces her fear of Claymotion.

episodes.title: Society of the Blind Eye
episodes.description: The kids, along with Old Man McGucket's help, discover there is a secret society in Gravity Falls.

episodes.title: Blendin's Game
episodes.description: Blendin Blandin returns to fight Dipper and Mabel in a futuristic battle that could trap the two of them forever in time jail.

episodes.title: The Love God
episodes.description: Mabel takes matchmaking too far when she steals a love potion from a real love god.

episodes.title: Northwest Mansion Noir
episodes.description: Pacifica enlists Dipper's help to rid the Northwest Mansion of a ghost before he wreaks havoc on her fancy party. Nathan Fillion reprises his role as Pacifica's father, Preston Northwest.

episodes.title: Not What He Seems
episodes.description: After government agents take Stan into custody, Dipper and Mabel question how much they really know about their Grunkle Stan. Nick Offerman guest stars as Agent Powers.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Stans
episodes.description: Cornered underneath the Mystery Shack, Stan must finally reveal the secrets of his past and his mysterious portal to Dipper and Mabel. Academy Award winner J.K. Simmons ("Whiplash") recurs as Stan's twin brother.

episodes.title: Dungeons, Dungeons, & More Dungeons
episodes.description: Dipper finds an unlikely friend to join him with his newest obsession, a board game called "Dungeons, Dungeons & More Dungeons.".

episodes.title: The Stanchurian Candidate
episodes.description: When Grunkle Stan decides to run for mayor, Dipper and Mabel have their work cut out for them trying to turn their gaffe-prone uncle into the perfect candidate.

episodes.title: The Last Mabelcorn
episodes.description: A new threat leads Mabel to venture into the enchanted realm of the unicorns. Meanwhile, Dipper learns an unexpected twist about the enigmatic Bill Cipher.

episodes.title: Roadside Attraction
episodes.description: Grunkle Stan takes the kids with him on a road-trip to sabotage all the other tourist traps in Oregon.

episodes.title: Dipper and Mabel vs. the Future
episodes.description: Mabel decides to plan for her and Dipper's 13th birthday party. Meanwhile, Dipper and Ford venture below the town to find its most shocking secret.

episodes.title: Weirdmageddon (1)
episodes.description: Bill has returned to take down the Pines family. But this time he has brought some of his friends with him.

episodes.title: Weirdmageddon (2): Escape from Reality
episodes.description: Dipper, Soos and Wendy must save Mabel from a strange new world, while Bill's forces plan their next move.

episodes.title: Weirdmageddon (3): Take Back the Falls
episodes.description: In the series finale, the Mystery Shack crew and townsfolk fight against Bill Cipher and his minions in a final stand to defeat them once and for all and save the town of Gravity Falls and the world.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: A single mom with an exceptional mind is recruited to the LAPD Major Crimes unit, where her unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

episodes.title: Dancers in the Dark
episodes.description: As Morgan and the detectives adjust to her new role as a consultant, they investigate the attempted murder of a tap dancer and discover things are not quite as they seem. Meanwhile, Ava learns more about her father, and Morgan surprises her kids.

episodes.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrel
episodes.description: Morgan's intellect and cleaning experience prove useful when the detectives are called to a hotel room murder scene, eventually uncovering the victim's many cons. Morgan navigates Ava's dating while Soto reveals details about Roman's disappearance.

episodes.title: Survival Mode
episodes.description: Morgan is excited to get her official LAPD badge despite Karadec's reluctance. The detectives work tirelessly on an emotional missing children case, which hits close to home for Morgan and sends her mind into overdrive.

episodes.title: Croaked
episodes.description: The team investigates the death of an exotic animal veterinarian, uncovering a complicated love triangle in the process. Work interferes with Karadec's dating life, while Morgan follows a parental hunch about her teenage daughter and snoops on Ava.

episodes.title: Hangover
episodes.description: A wild office party at a high-profile medical technology startup leads to the shocking murder of the founder and CEO, and Morgan and the team are on the case. Meanwhile, a new co-worker at the precinct catches Morgan's eye.

episodes.title: One of Us
episodes.description: Morgan agrees to show Ava around the LAPD, but things quickly take a dangerous turn when the precinct is held hostage by the friends of a recently convicted man. Can Morgan and the detectives outsmart their captors and lead everyone to safety?

episodes.title: Obsessed
episodes.description: The team investigates a mysterious young girl who was found attacked on a beach. Meanwhile, Morgan begins to let her guard down on her date with Tom, and Soto comes one step closer to finding out what happened to Roman.

episodes.title: The RAMs
episodes.description: A famous baseball newscaster is murdered, and the team is on the case. Meanwhile, Soto and Morgan meet with a potential lead to discuss Roman's disappearance, and Tom has some personal news to share with Morgan.

episodes.title: Chutes and Murders
episodes.description: A nanny is found bludgeoned to death in the park. Elsewhere, Morgan interferes when Elliot admits to not being invited to his classmate's party.

episodes.title: The Sauna at the End of the Stairs
episodes.description: Soto reopens an old murder case in the famous Donovan family, determined to uncover the true killer in a classic "whodunit" style.

episodes.title: Partners
episodes.description: The FBI joins the investigation into the murder of a controversial tech magnate, forcing Karadec to reunite with his former partner. Meanwhile, Ludo becomes overwhelmed with his increasing childcare duties.

episodes.title: Let's Play
episodes.description: An anonymous tip to the LAPD sparks an unusual multiple-victim kidnapping investigation, forcing the team to rely on board games and puzzles to track down their suspect; a shocking revelation changes everything for Morgan.

episodes.title: Pawns
episodes.description: While working tirelessly to shield her family from the Game Maker's threats, another crime drags Morgan back into his game and the LAPD must decide whether to trust her instincts before the next move turns fatal.

episodes.title: Checkmate
episodes.description: As the Major Crimes team desperately seek answers amidst a string of unresolved crimes, Morgan suspects the Game Maker is responsible. Meanwhile, Daphne and Oz set out to find Roman, and Elliot prepares a surprise act for his school’s talent show.

episodes.title: Eleven Minutes
episodes.description: When a man with a troubled past is killed under mysterious circumstances, Morgan and the LAPD uncover a tragic motive behind his death. Meanwhile, Morgan opens up to Ava about her father, forcing Ava to confront truths she isn’t ready to face.

episodes.title: Behind the Music
episodes.description: An investigation involving the murder of a local singer uncovers details that reopen a strikingly similar decades-old cold case; the team rallies around Soto after she is passed over for the captain's chair.

episodes.title: Content Warning
episodes.description: When a social media stunt turns deadly, Morgan and Karadec head to an influencer content house to track down answers. Meanwhile, the LAPD team adjusts to Captain Nick Wagner's new role, and Ava seeks out more information on Roman's disappearance.

episodes.title: Chasing Ghosts
episodes.description: It's almost Halloween, and the team investigates a spooky case where a wealthy lawyer is found dead in his haunted Victorian mansion, while Captain Wagner surprises everyone with his skills. At home, Eliott plays mediator between Morgan and Ava.

episodes.title: The One That Got Away
episodes.description: When a priceless painting is stolen in a museum heist, Morgan and Karadec team up with an art-recovery expert to unravel a tangled case and fierce ownership battle. Meanwhile, Soto is determined to uncover the secrets hidden inside Roman's backpack.

episodes.title: The One That Got Away: Part Two
episodes.description: Morgan's suspicions of Rhys grow deeper as the case of the missing Rembrandt artwork continues. Elsewhere, Roman's missing backpack causes problems for all involved.

episodes.title: Under the Rug
episodes.description: As Morgan and Karadec investigate the mysterious death of a hitman in a car crash, they uncover details that force the LAPD and FBI to partner on the case. Meanwhile, Elliott tries to rekindle romance for his parents.

episodes.title: Grounded
episodes.description: The team investigates the midair murder of an Air Force veteran, and Morgan works to crack the case despite being sidelined to mandatory detective training. Elsewhere, Wagner and Soto's leadership conflict comes to a head.

episodes.title: NPC
episodes.description: When a former esports champion is mysteriously murdered, both his gaming rival and a sushi chef are under suspicion. Time spent with Elliot unexpectedly provides Morgan with insight on the case. Meanwhile, Karadec reconnects with his ex-fiancée.

episodes.title: The Faust and the Furious
episodes.description: Oz faces a deeply personal struggle when he discovers his late father's headstone was never ordered. Elsewhere, the team investigates the murder of a tech founder obsessed with life extension.

episodes.title: In the Driver's Seat
episodes.description: The team investigates a late night luxury car heist turned deadly, uncovering a complex web of details and multiple perpetrators. Meanwhile, Morgan has mixed feelings when Ava begins focusing on her future.

episodes.title: If You Come for the Queen
episodes.description: Daphne leads an investigation into the attempted murder of a beloved colleague and mentor, which is further complicated when it intertwines with another case. Later on, Ava comes to Daphne for advice and support.

episodes.title: Pie in the Sky
episodes.description: When a renowned retired astronaut is murdered in plain sight, Morgan and the team uncover some of his mysterious entanglements. Soto travels to New York City to meet a high-profile political fixer connected to Roman's disappearance.

episodes.title: Turn, Up the Heat
episodes.description: Morgan relies on old friends to help with a case involving street artists, while Karadec leans on the women in his life during a time of need.

episodes.title: Second Sunday
episodes.description: Wagner joins Morgan and the team on a hunt for the crew behind a series of heists ripping through elite private vaults - only to uncover a far more dangerous endgame: a looming cyberattack that could cripple Los Angeles' core infrastructure.

episodes.title: Family Tree
episodes.description: A woman is found dead at the luxury hotel where Lucia works, posing a potential complication for Karadec and Morgan’s investigation. Elsewhere, Ava races to come up with the perfect idea for her art show, and a heated confrontation leads to tragedy.

episodes.title: Auditions (1)
episodes.description: Famed chef Gordon Ramsay conducted a nationwide search for the best home cooks in America, and through a series of exciting elimination rounds, will turn one of them into a culinary master. Joining Ramsay on the judging panel are restaurateur and wine maker Joe Bastianich, owner of some of the most-celebrated Italian restaurants across the country; and Graham Elliot, the youngest four-star chef in the U.S. and mastermind behind Chicago's first "bistronomic" restaurant. In the series premiere episode, home cooks from all over the country present their signature dishes to the three judges in the hopes of being awarded the coveted MASTERCHEF apron, which guarantees them a spot in the next round of competition.

episodes.title: Auditions (2)
episodes.description: In the search to find the best amateur home cook in America, only a few more hopefuls have the opportunity to present their signature dish to judges Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich and Graham Elliot. Some chefs wow the judging panel with their raw talent and many fall flat, but one thing is for certain: all of the home cooks endure an intense grilling. The remaining contestants pour their hearts into their creations in order to convince the judges they have the potential to take the culinary world by storm.

episodes.title: Top 14 Revealed
episodes.description: Thirty home cooks have made it this far in the competition, but only half of them will remain by the end of tonight's episode. After impressing the judges with their signature dishes, the hopefuls will have to prove that they have mastered basic kitchen techniques, including slicing onions and cooking an egg to perfection. Find out whose skills are sharp enough to advance to the next round and who cracks under pressure when the Top 14 are revealed.

episodes.title: 14 Chefs Compete (1)
episodes.description: The Top 14 contestants enter the MASTERCHEF kitchen for the very first time and begin on a journey that will change their lives. Judges Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich and Graham Elliot put the contestants through a series of challenges throughout each episode and at the end of them some contestants are sent home while the rest are left to move on in the competition. During the team challenge, the contestants spend the day feeding hundreds of Marines at Camp Pendleton. The team who wins the challenge is safe from elimination while the losers return to the MASTERCHEF kitchen to face a pressure test.

episodes.title: 14 Chefs Compete (2)
episodes.description: The cooks prepare their best dishes in hopes of impressing the judges.

episodes.title: 11 Chefs Compete (1)
episodes.description: The home cooks are challenged to make a single cupcake, and while that sounds like a simple task, they quickly learn that it's not that easy. Later, special guest Chef Cat Cora and the contestants step out of the kitchen for the team challenge: cooking for truckers at a truck stop. The losers return to face the pressure test, where they must name as many ingredients they can from a table of fresh farmers-market finds.

episodes.title: 11 Chefs Compete (2)
episodes.description: The remaining chefs need to feed 100 truckers at a remote California truck stop. The losing team returns to the kitchen to face a pressure test, which consists of naming as many foods as they can from a table of farmer's market ingredients.

episodes.title: 9 Chefs Compete (1)
episodes.description: For this week's team challenge, the contestants travel outside the MASTERCHEF kitchen to cater a high-end wedding. However, when the main course goes missing, the judges are less than pleased. The losers return to face the pressure test, where another home cook will be eliminated.

episodes.title: 9 Chefs Compete (2)
episodes.description: The contestants must cater a high-end wedding, and things go awry when the main course goes missing. The losing team goes back to the MasterChef kitchen to face a pressure test, and one more chef is eliminated.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete (1)
episodes.description: The judges force the home cooks work for their food as they all go fishing and are allowed to use only what they caught to make a delicious meal.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete (2)
episodes.description: The contestants  go fishing, and use their catches for their entrees. Another chef is eliminated.

episodes.title: Winner Revealed (1)
episodes.description: After enduring a series of intense pressure tests and grueling challenges, the moment has finally come for one MASTERCHEF contestant to claim the title of America's Best Home Cook. In the season finale, judges Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich and Graham Elliot determine which amateur cook truly has the potential to transform their culinary dreams into reality. The contestants who have made it this far in the competition have earned the judges' respect, but only one will walk away with $250,000 and a cookbook-publishing deal and embark on a life-changing journey.

episodes.title: Winner Revealed (2)
episodes.description: The winner is revealed.

episodes.title: Audition (1)
episodes.description: After conducting a nationwide search, 100 of the best amateur cooks in America - including a police officer, an oil rig engineer, an interior designer, a forklift operator, a professional poker player, a classical pianist and a tattoo shop owner - were flown to Los Angeles in the hopes of becoming the next MASTERCHEF and walking away with the life-changing grand prize. The hopefuls will prepare their signature dishes and present them to judges Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich and Graham Elliot. The amateur cooks will be put through the paces, and only the most deserving among them will win the coveted white apron and move on to the next round of the competition.

episodes.title: Audition (2)
episodes.description: Nerves are tested as the judges continue to winnow down the Top 100 in their search for the America's best amateur cook.

episodes.title: Audition (3) / Top 38 Revealed
episodes.description: Nerves are tested as the judges continue to winnow down the Top 100 in their search for the America's best amateur cook.

episodes.title: Top 18 Revealed
episodes.description: After impressing the judges with their signature dishes, the hopefuls will have to prove that they have mastered basic kitchen techniques, including chopping apples and cooking a chicken to perfection. Find out whose skills are sharp enough to advance to the next round and who cracks under pressure.

episodes.title: 2 Eliminated / Top 16 Revealed
episodes.description: The competition continues to sizzle as the Top 18 contestants vie for a coveted spot in the next round of competition. In the next intense culinary challenge, the judges raise the stakes to find out who can handle the heat and who will crack under pressure. Find out which contestants have skills sharp enough to advance to the next round.

episodes.title: Top 16 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 16 contestants battle it out in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill to be America's Best Amateur Cook. Find out which contestants wow the judges with their culinary chops and who may wind up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 15 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 15 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 14 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 14 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.description: The Top 13 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.description: The Top 12 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.description: The Top 11 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 10 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 10 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 9 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 9 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 8 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 8 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 8 Compete Again
episodes.description: After the judges spared the home cooks from elimination last night, the Top 8 flex their culinary muscles once again in another grueling challenge to prove they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out who wows the judges and which two contestants wind up on the chopping block.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete
episodes.description: The six chefs go to the Patina restaurant at the Walt Disney Concert Hall where team captains Suzy and Tracy select their teams to cook two of Patina's appetizers and two of their entrees for a fully booked diner service. The teams will be judged by their customers and by the restaurants owner and the head chef of Patina restaurant. The winning and losing team meet at the masterchef restaurant to hear the results and the losing team is left as usual in the kitchen downstairs to the take the pressure test. This time around the three chefs must skin, fillet, debone and, portion a salmon. There must be at least ten equal portions and the chefs must cook one portion. There is a clear winner and loser in this pressure test and one chef is asked to retire their apron. This episode though has an interesting result for the loser that is completly unexpected but deserved.

episodes.title: Top 5 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 5 home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to advance to the next round. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block in the next elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 4 Compete
episodes.description: The four remaining home cooks flex their culinary muscles in another grueling challenge to prove to the judges they have the passion and skill it takes to carry them through to the season finale. Find out which contestants wow the judges and who winds up on the chopping block.

episodes.title: Top 3 Compete
episodes.description: After enduring a season's worth of intense pressure tests and grueling challenges, the determining moment has finally arrived. In the season finale, judges Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich and Graham Elliot determine which amateur cook truly has the potential to transform his/her culinary dreams into reality. The contestants who have made it this far in the competition have earned the judges' respect, but only one will walk away with the grand prize of $250,000.

episodes.title: WINNER Announced
episodes.description: The Top 3 chefs face off in a grueling final challenge, and the judges determine the winner in the Season 2 finale. At stake is $250,000 and the coveted title of MasterChef.

episodes.title: Auditions (1)
episodes.description: Amateur cooks from across the country compete during the first day of auditions to win a place as a masterchef contestant.

episodes.title: Auditions (2)
episodes.description: Amateur cooks from across the country compete in a second day of auditions to be a Masterchef contestant.

episodes.title: Auditions (3) / Top 36 Bootcamp
episodes.description: The judges continue to winnow down the competition in the final round of auditions, but the stakes are raised as the 36 remaining hopefuls are put to the ultimate test in an intense ground beef challenge. Those who impress the judges will earn a spot in the Top 18 and join the nation's best crop of amateur cooks in the MASTERCHEF kitchen.

episodes.title: Top 18 Compete
episodes.description: The Top 18 contestants compete in their first mystery box challenge of the season and must create a unique and delicious dish using duck and bananas. Later, the remaining amateur cooks are forced out of their comfort zone when the judges challenge them to cook an outstanding dish using unusual and intimidating ingredients. Find out which contestants make the cut after the first emotional elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 16 Compete
episodes.description: The chefs are divided into two teams and told to cook a hearty meal for 201 hungry soldiers who will be their judges. The two teams get their meals out to the troops who vote for the winners and the losers. Back in the Masterchef kitchen the losers are given only 75 minutes to prepare an exquisite apple pie. A losing contestant is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 15 Compete
episodes.description: The fifteen chefs face their second mytery box challenge, and the selection of meats they see upon lifting the boxes was a shock to all. Despite the difficult challenge the amateur chefs were able to satisfy the judges, a winner was chosen, and given the usual advantage of selecting the meals the others will cook. This time the winner of the mystery box challenge took throwing his competition under the bus to a new level, at least he tried to.

episodes.title: Top 14 Compete
episodes.description: The fourteen remaining amateur chefs divide up into two teams to cook room service breakfast for 130 hungry hotel guests. The losing team returns to the Masterchef kitchen to face the always dreaded prssure test challenge. Tonight the three judges select the four worst performing team members from the losing team to participate in the pressure test where they must cook a Molten Lava cake in 45 minutes. A loser is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 13 Compete
episodes.description: In the Mystery Box challenge. The chefs are given food that can be purchased at Wal-Mart for fifteen dollars and asked to prepare a dish that would sell for forty dollars at a fine dinning restaurant. The winning dish is selected and the winner is taken to the pantry. The judges present the Mystery Box challenge winner with the nights elimination challenge. The amateur chefs must create the judges favorite desserts. Tiramisu, Strawberry Shortcake, and Trifle. The winner of the Mystery Box challenge is given the advantage of skipping the elimination challenge and also picking which of her competitors will have to create one of the three desserts. The three judges will then select the worst dessert from the four of each presented by the contestants and the worst of the three desserts will send a Masterchef hopeful home.

episodes.title: Top 12 Compete
episodes.description: The amateur chefs find themselves on Venice Beach where they are divided into three teams and asked to prepare a seven dollar meal for the crowds of Venice Beach. The teams each have their own food truck from which each team will sell a different cuisine, Indian, Mexican, or American. The teams are judged by the amount of money they generate from food sales. The four members of the losing team return to the Masterchef kitchen where they are given a demonstration on how to make a tortellini and then given sixty minutes to prepare ten tortellini in a simple broth. The contestant with the least favorite dish is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 11 Compete
episodes.description: The contestants begin the show with a mystery box competition, and a professional chef joins in on the competition to show the amateur chefs what is expected of a Masterchef. The winner of the mystery box is then taken to the pantry and shown the theme of this episodes elimination challenge. The contestants will be required to cook a meal using either a cooking stone, a wok, or a deep fat fryer. As usual the winner of the mystery box challenge is given an advantage over her competitors, the option of picking which cooking utensil she will use and which one her competitors will have to cook with.

episodes.title: Top 9 Compete
episodes.description: The remaining nine amateur cooks are faced with one of the most intimidating mystery box ingredients to date - "uni," otherwise known as sea urchin. In a surprising twist, the contestants must incorporate the spiky culinary delicacy into their creations, and the amateur cook who presents the most exceptional uni dish will earn a significant advantage in the next round. Later in the elimination challenge, the winner of the mystery box challenge will assign each of the remaining contestants one of eight different types of fish. Find who will impress the judges and whose culinary dreams will sink.

episodes.title: Top 8 Compete
episodes.description: The contestants travel East into the desert to a Cowboy Ranch where they are divided into two teams and tasked with cooking 101 steak dinners for a bunch of hungry cowwboys who are the judges in this team challenge. The losing team returns to the Masterchef kitchen where they are told to select one team member for amnesty. The three remaining chefs are then told to cook one soft boiled egg, one sunny side up, a poached egg, and a three egg omelette using only the six eggs given to them in twenty minutes. A contestant is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 7 Compete
episodes.description: Celebrity chef Paula Deen joins the MASTERCHEF judging panel and selects the mystery box ingredients, which include traditional Southern staples and a comforting surprise - a family photo and a letter from home. The amateur cook who prepares the most delicious Southern-inspired dish will earn a priceless reward. Later, the winner of the previous challenge will couple the remaining six contestants who will work in pairs to cook a Japanese dish. Find out which amateur cooks will be on the chopping block in another emotional elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete, Part 1
episodes.description: The Top Six finalists are in for a big surprise when the eight previously eliminated contestants return to the MASTERCHEF kitchen to compete for a chance to earn a spot back in the competition. The eager hopefuls will each select one ingredient to make up a mystery box, and they will be required to use all of the items to create a stunning dish that will prove that they deserve a second chance. After the contestants are whittled down, only two amateur cooks will compete head to head for a chance to win back their aprons and continue on the journey to become the next MASTERCHEF.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete, Part 2
episodes.description: The judges challenge the remaining seven amateur cooks to use their imagination in the next mystery box challenge, which features shrimp. The hopefuls will have a very limited pantry and little time to create a standout dish that will impress the judges. The winner of the mystery box challenge will determine which savory ingredient the remaining hopefuls must incorporate into a dessert dish in the elimination round. Find out whose savory treat will please the judges and who will be on the chopping block.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete, Part 3
episodes.description: The remaining six home cooks compete in a high-pressure team challenge at Hatfield's, one of the most talked about restaurants in Hollywood. The contestants will split into two teams and replicate the award-winning restaurant's signature dishes. The team that executes a fine dining experience which impresses the judges, restaurant owners and hungry diners will win the challenge, while the losing team will be sent into the dreaded pressure test. Later, the contestants facing elimination will have to prepare steak three different ways. Find out whose dishes will prove to be a job well done and who will be cut from the competition.

episodes.title: Top 5 Compete
episodes.description: The final five contestants open their mystery box to find it empty and then told to pick ingredients they would like to use to make an incredible entree of their choosing for the judges. After selecting their ingredients with glee the contestants are given the inevitable twist, it is just not that easy. After the mystery Box challenge the winning contest is taken to the pantry and given a huge advantage in the elimination test. The winner is allowed to pick from a selection of dishes created by Graham Elliot for all the contestants to prepare. A white tuna dish Graham Elliot had prepared for President Barrack Obama was selected and all contestants were given 30 minutes to recreate the dish. Winners and losers were selected and a losing contestant was sent home.

episodes.title: Top 4 Compete
episodes.description: The remaining four contestants split up into two teams. In this episode three world class chefs, Daniel Boulad, Alain Ducasse, and Guy Savoy, are invited to help judge the contestants as they prepare a three course gourmet dinner for the judges. A winning team is selected and the losing team then faces an extreme pressure test where they must prepare a cheese soufle, a dark chocolate soufle, and a raspberry soufle in sixty minutes. Both of the home chef's soufles were perfect, but only one chef was selected to join the other two chefs in the semi-final.

episodes.title: Top 3 Compete
episodes.description: The final three contestants face their last mystery box challenge where they are allowed to pick their own ingredients and make a dish they would include in their cookbook if they are selected the winner of Masterchef. The judges pick the winner and the loser and all three contestants go to the Masterchef pantry where they are shown the topic of this elimination test, Legs. The contestants are shown Leg of Lamb, Chicken legs, and Frog Legs. Each contestant must cook one of the three choices. The winner of the Mystery Box challenge is allowed to choose first and the loser had to accept what was left after the runner up chose their protein. Two contestants are chosen to go on to the finale.

episodes.title: The Winning Chef is Chosen
episodes.description: The Top Two finalists have one last chance to prove to the judges that they have the passion, skill and drive worthy of the MASTERCHEF title. In their final challenge in the MASTERCHEF kitchen, the two home cooks will conceptualize and prepare the most important three-course meal of their lives. Later, the judges will reveal America's next MASTERCHEF, and the deserving home cook will walk away with a book deal and the $250,000 grand prize.

episodes.title: Auditions (1)
episodes.description: Home cooks present dishes to the judges in the season premiere. 100 homecooks from around the country compete for a Masterchef apron and their chance of winning $250,000.00.

episodes.title: Auditions (2)
episodes.description: More home chefs cook for the judges hoping their dishes will allow them to become a contestant in the Masterchef competition.

episodes.title: Top 19 Revealed
episodes.description: The judges continue to winnow down the competition in the final round of auditions, but the stakes are raised as the remaining hopefuls are put to the ultimate test in an intense lamb challenge. Then, the Top 19 contestants compete in their first mystery box challenge of the season and must create an exceptional dish using the most basic mystery box ingredients. Later, the contestants participate in the season's first emotional elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 19 Compete
episodes.description: The top nineteen contestants face a mystery box of four of the most basic and simple of ingredients. A winner is chosen and taken to the Masterchef pantry and shown three of the finest ingredients of the culinary world, and given the advantage of choosing which ingredient would be cooked by all of the other contestants and given immunity from elimination. Winners and losers are chosen and a contestant is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 18 Compete
episodes.description: In their first team challenge, the Top 18 home cooks face their pickiest judges yet when they visit a local elementary school and are tasked to create a healthy, balanced meal for over 300 school children. Later the losing team assembles in the Masterchef kitchen where six members of the losing team are chosen by the team leader to participate in the dreaded pressure test. A contestant is sent home

episodes.title: Top 17 Compete
episodes.description: In this episode's mystery box challenge Gordon Ramsay cooks alongside the home cooks and prepares a dish using the mystery box ingredients. The winner of the mystery box challenge chooses the dish the rest of the contestants must prepare in the elimination round and is given immunity and also the opportunity to try and rectify a perceived wrong by someone from the previous episode's pressure test. A contestant is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 16 Compete, Part 1
episodes.description: The remaining 16 home cooks compete in a team challenge and cook a hearty and balanced steak meal for 101 firefighters. The losing team will face a pressure test and cook their best eggs benedict dish. Later, the bottom four contestants from the previous challenge will try their luck in Las Vegas for the first time in MASTERCHEF history. The four home cooks will split into two teams to prepare their most impressive burger dish at Gordon Ramsay BurGR at Planet Hollywood. The losing team will go head to head in a cook-off that will send one contestant home for good.

episodes.title: Top 16 Compete, Part 2
episodes.description: In order to choose a loser from the last episode's pressure test the cooks prepare burger dishes at Gordon Ramsay BurGR in Las Vegas.Two teams of two compete to make the best burgers that are voted on by the customers and their fellow competitors. A losing teaam is chosen who must now compete in a head to head competition to see who remains in Masterchef and who goes home. A losing contestant is chosen from this special elimination contest but is given an opportunity rarely given to a losing contestant.

episodes.title: Top 15 Compete
episodes.description: A mystery-box challenge involving exotic foreign ingredients from all over the world takes place. Later Joe Bastianich's mother, Chef Lidia Bastianich is invited into the Masterchef kitchen to help judge and to demonstrate the technique involved in cooking Agnolotti to some of the Masterchef contestants while two are excluded. Agnolotti is a stuffed pasta dish. Then all of the chef contestants except the winner of the Mystery Box challenge are judged on their Agnolotti. A contestant leaves the Masterchef kitchen.

episodes.title: Top 14 Compete
episodes.description: The contestants find themselves on the set of the hit show "Glee" where they are divided into two teams selected by none other than star Jane Lynch who plays Sue Sylvester on the show. The teams then cook over a hundred meals for the cast and crew of "Glee" who then vote for a winning team. The losing team then gathers in the Masterchef kitchen where they must face the dreaded pressure test. In this episode they must prepare a lemon meringue pie but without using any lemons. A contestant is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 13 Compete
episodes.description: The contestants deal with a mystery-box challenge that involves an unusual ingredient and a limited pantry; Season 3 winner Christine Ha introduces the the three proteins for tonight's elimination challenge, and the judges allow the winner of the mystery box challenge the chance to choose from chicken, catfish, or live dungeons crab for one cook to use, and then one of the other two proteins for the rest of the challengers to cook with. Christine Ha helps judge the elimination challenge and one contestant is sent home.

episodes.title: Top 12 Compete
episodes.description: Gordon Ramsay, Graham Elliot and Joe Bastianich - introduce the remaining 12 home cooks to flavor scientist Aaron and his fiancé Anna. The contestants will be preparing the meal for their wedding reception.

episodes.title: Top 11 Compete
episodes.description: The masterchefs begin this episode with a mystery box challenge that tasks the chefs with creating a dish for Eva Longoria who chose the ingredients and helps judge this mystery box. After a winner is selected as usual the winner is given immunity from the elimination challenge and also allowed to pick what her fellow contestants will have to cook and a chance to burn one of her competitors. A winning dish was selected and a losing dish sent its creator home.

episodes.title: Top 10 Compete
episodes.description: The chefs find themselves on the beach formerly known as Surf City USA where they are divided into two teams and asked to cook fish tacos for 101 hungry surfers. The winning team was selected as the first team to receive 51 votes for their fish taco dish. The masterchefs then meet in the Masterchef kitchen where the losing team selects who among them must face the pressure test. In this episode the unlucky few must prepare a chicken breast three different ways as preferred by each one of the three judges. A very hard pressure test ends with a contestant leaving the Masterchef kitchen.

episodes.title: Top 9 Compete
episodes.description: The masterschefs begin this episode with a mystery box challenge where they must create their own sausage from a wide assortment of meats and use it to create a dish for the judges. A winner is chosen and allowed to choose the protein for the rest of the chefs to use in the elimination challenge. The choices for this elimination was Ham, Mushrooms, or Shrimp. Mushrooms were selected by the mystery box winner. The judges then allowed the winner of the mystery box challenge to select four of the contestants who would cook with delicious wild mushrooms, and four who could only cook with canned mushrooms. Winners and losers were chosen by the judges and a contestant was sent home.

episodes.title: Top 8 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks compete in an overnight challenge; the losing team faces a spun sugar dessert pressure test.

episodes.title: Top 7 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks create dishes inspired by loved ones; tag-team sushi challenge.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete
episodes.description: Previously eliminated contestants get the chance to get back in the competition by perfectly frying an egg and preparing a salmon dish.

episodes.title: Top 7 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks must prepare a T-bone steak dish; the challenge winner assigns a type of poultry to the other contestants.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks must re-create popular dishes served at a fine-dining restaurant in downtown Los Angeles; the losing team must prepare a perfect plate of fried calamari with a side of marinara sauce.

episodes.title: Top 5 Compete (1)
episodes.description: The judges get some very special help from their sons, who stop by the MASTERCHEF kitchen to judge the next mystery box challenge. Then, the contestants face the daunting task of recreating one of the greatest dishes the judges ever tasted. Later, in a field challenge, the remaining five home cooks visit a ranch where they will each prepare one Southern-inspired dish as part of a special summer luncheon for local charity volunteers. After the first part of the competition, two home cooks will advance to the finals and the Top Four, while the bottom three contestants will face a pressure test that will end the competition for one home cook.

episodes.title: Top 5 Compete (2)
episodes.description: Two cooks advance to the finals while the remaining three face a pressure test.

episodes.title: Top 4 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks split into two teams for the mystery box challenge.

episodes.title: Top 3 Compete
episodes.description: The remaining three contestants cook more sophisticated versions of the dishes they made in their initial auditions.

episodes.title: Winner Chosen
episodes.description: The final two cooks prepare three-course meals; the judges choose the winner.

episodes.title: Top 30 Compete
episodes.description: MASTERCHEF returns for an exciting fifth season, giving talented home cooks from all walks of life the chance to showcase their skills, knowledge and passion in front of the show's esteemed judging panel: Gordon Ramsay, Joe Bastianich and Graham Elliot. After a nationwide search, 30 of the best home cooks in America present their signature dish to the judges, but only the Top Finalists will earn a coveted white apron and compete for a chance to win the MASTERCHEF title, a cookbook deal and the $250,000 grand prize.

episodes.title: Top 22 Compete
episodes.description: In the first mystery box challenge of the season, the Top Finalists will have 90 minutes to prep and cook a unique and impressive dish, using mainly dessert ingredients. The winner of the mystery box will have a significant advantage in the next round, deciding which classic American dish the remaining contestants will have to prepare in the elimination round. Find out who will rise to the occasion and whose dream of becoming America's next MASTERCHEF will come to an end.

episodes.title: Top 20 Compete
episodes.description: It's the ultimate culinary war when the remaining 20 home cooks compete in the biggest field challenge in MASTERCHEF history: feeding an army of 500 servicemen and women on a desert army base. In their first team challenge, the contestants will split into two teams - the red team and the blue team - to create a hearty meal including one protein and two side dishes. Tempers flare as both teams struggle with consistency, and every dish counts as the troops will vote for their favorite dish and determine the winning team. Later, the losing team will face an intense pressure test featuring the all-American classic, blueberry pie. Find out whose dessert will prove to be a victory and who will be sent home.

episodes.title: Top 18 Compete
episodes.description: The contestants tackle a seafood challenge, with the winner chooses what dessert the others prepare in the elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 17 Compete
episodes.description: In the next team challenge, contestants must prepare an upscale seafood menu for a beachfront wedding. After an emotional challenge, tensions are high, but both teams complete their dinner for the wedding guests. The team who most successfully finishes the dinner is safe from elimination, while the losing team faces the pressure test featuring a traditional American meal with steak and fries. Find out who will stay and who will be sent home.

episodes.title: Top 16 Compete
episodes.description: The contestants prepare a dish using canned foods; MasterChef winner Luca Manfe and MasterChef Junior winner Alexander Weiss help determine what dish the contestants cook in the elimination round.

episodes.title: Top 15 Compete
episodes.description: The contestants must put aside their difference as they pair up to create a surf-and-turf dish; the challenge losers face a pressure test featuring spring rolls.

episodes.title: Top 14 Compete
episodes.description: The remaining 14 cooks work in two sets of teams at a busy, iconic diner in Los Angeles; the members of the losing team must make a three-layer red velvet cake during a pressure test.

episodes.title: Top 13 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks must create a dish using Alaskan king salmon; during the elimination round, the cooks create a dish using one judge's favorite ingredients.

episodes.title: Top 12 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks prepare romantic dinners for couples celebrating anniversaries; Ramsay's wife joins him for dinner; the losing team create their own truffle recipes for a box of chocolates.

episodes.title: Top 11 Compete
episodes.description: For the first time, the contestants get to choose between two mystery boxes: one filled with high-end ingredients and one containing ordinary items; the winner of the challenge chooses which type of stuffed pasta the remaining cooks make.

episodes.title: Top 10 Compete
episodes.description: The home cooks split into two teams and create menus of healthy football game concessions for an entire stadium; the cooks on the losing team must create three unique prawn dishes in a pressure test.

episodes.title: Top 8 Compete
episodes.description: The cooks split into teams of two and prepare a poultry dish using different parts of the chicken; two pairs face a pressure test with eggs.

episodes.title: Top 7 Compete
episodes.description: The remaining contestants receive hometown encouragement as they prepare savory apple dishes; while the challenge winner is safe from elimination, the other contestants form teams of two and make a variety of dim sum.

episodes.title: Top 6 Compete
episodes.description: The remaining six cooks compete in teams and take over a high-end restaurant in Los Angeles. The losing team competes individually in a unique croquembouche pressure test.

episodes.title: Top 5 Compete
episodes.description: Each cook creates a dish inspired by one of their loved ones after they meet with some VIP kitchen guests and all but the winner prepre rare protein dishes to stay in the game.

episodes.title: Top 4 Compete
episodes.description: A final team challenge establishes who moves on to the top three.

episodes.title: Top 3 Compete
episodes.description: One chef moves on to the finals after impressing a panel of judges representing all 50 states and a second finalist is determined based on a challenge involving three classic American desserts.

episodes.title: Winner Chosen
episodes.description: The two top chefs compete in a final pressure test and the judges choose a winner.

episodes.title: Let the Battle Commence (Top 40)
episodes.description: Forty of the best home cooks in America travel to Los Angeles to present their signature dishes to the distinguished judging panel: Gordon Ramsay, Graham Elliot, and new judge Christina Tosi.

episodes.title: The Battle Continues (Top 22)
episodes.description: Some of America's best home cooks present their signature dishes to the judges: Gordon Ramsay, Graham Elliot and the newest addition to the panel, Christina Tosi.

episodes.title: 100th Episode: You're the Apple of My Pie (Top 22 Compete Again!)
episodes.description: The Top 22 home cooks in America face their first Mystery Box Challenge. Each contestant is given 20 staple ingredients that anyone could find in their home and tasked with preparing a dish for the judges — were the judges to show up at their homes for dinner. The winner of the Mystery Box Challenge receives a significant advantage in the season's first pressure test, during which contestants must make their versions of an apple pie.

episodes.title: Cinammon Roll-er Coaster (Top 20)
episodes.description: The remaining 20 home cooks face their first team challenge of the season at an amusement park. Once teams are decided, each team is tasked with creating its version of an amusement park burger and fish & chips dish for thousands of amusement park guests. The winning team is safe from elimination, while the losing team has to face the first pressure test of the season, during which the home cooks make 12 cinnamon rolls.

episodes.title: Clawing to Victory
episodes.description: The next mystery box challenge has the home cooks come out of their shells and prepare unique crab dishes for the judges. The home cook who prepares the best crab dish receives a significant advantage before the next elimination challenge. Then the remaining home cooks create their versions of sweet or savory dishes, using the same surprise ingredient of corn.

episodes.title: What Happens in Vegas Steaks in Vegas
episodes.description: In the second field challenge of the season, the home cooks take a surprise trip to Las Vegas, where they are split into two teams to take over Drai's Nightclub and feed 101 Las Vegas performers. The team who receives the most winning votes from the Las Vegas performer diners is safe from the next pressure test, while the losing team deals with a deuce steak contest at Gordon Ramsay's Steak. In the pressure test, the home cooks face two steak challenges testing temperature and taste, and one contestant is sent home.

episodes.title: Bring Home the Bacon
episodes.description: In the next challenge, it's proven that Breakfast is indeed the most important meal of the day when the home cooks are each tasked to create an elevated breakfast dish in 45 minutes. Not only does the winner have immunity in the next mystery box challenge, but they also receive two additional advantages. Later, in the mystery box challenge, contestants must create TV dinners.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday, MasterChef!
episodes.description: Each team prepares a two-course menu for the 100th episode celebration, during which VIP guests dine on oyster and caviar appetizers and a duck breast entrée, followed by a special surprise dish by judge Christina Tosi. The losing team faces the next pressure test, in which contestants must create a three-layer birthday cake.

episodes.title: Gordon's Greatest Hits
episodes.description: The remaining home cooks learn from the best as they enter a special taste-it-and-make-it challenge. Each contestant must recreate Gordon Ramsay's signature Beef Wellington. The home cooks with the worst dishes compete in the next pressure test, featuring another Gordon Ramsay dish — scallops with puree of English peas, bacon, and quail eggs, finished with shaved truffles. Find out who can keep up with the master and who is sent home for good.

episodes.title: Rice Rice Baby
episodes.description: In the next mystery box challenge, the remaining home cooks must create a rice dish in 60 minutes. The contestant with the winning dish will be featured in Family Circle Magazine and do not have to participate in the next elimination challenge. Then, in the elimination challenge, contestants are tasked with creating dishes based on dynamic duo ingredients. Find out who makes it into the Top 10 best home cooks in America.

episodes.title: Moo-vers and Bakers
episodes.description: The Top 10 home cooks enter the Wild West when they face their next team challenge and create steak meals for 101 cowboys and ranchers. The team that receives the most winning votes moo-ve on in the competition, while the remaining home cooks face the next pressure test. For the pressure test the losing team bakes tarts and see who can bake their way to victory.

episodes.title: Family Reunion
episodes.description: The Top 10 home cooks cook family style when they face their next team challenge and create family style meals for VIP diners. After each team prepares their family style meals, they are greeted by the dinner guests, their family members. Each diner votes for one team's meal and the team with the most votes is safe from the next pressure test. In the pressure test, the losing team home cooks must create a gnocchi-in-brown-sage-butter-sauce dish.

episodes.title: A Little Southern Flare
episodes.description: The cooks prepare a flambé in a mystery box challenge, and the winner is safe from elimination and also gets to choose which Southern dish the contestants must make. The winner also receives two other significant advantages.

episodes.title: Getting A-Head in the Competition
episodes.description: In the next team challenge, the remaining home cooks split into teams to prepare vegetarian meals for guests of the MasterChef restaurant. Teams have access to any ingredients that they choose in the MasterChef pantry, as long as the dishes are vegetarian. The winning team is safe from elimination, while the losing team must cook in the next pressure test and create delicious well-composed meals using various cuts from an animal head.

episodes.title: A Storm's a Brewing
episodes.description: In the next mystery box challenge, the remaining home cooks must create a dish using coffee as one of the main ingredients. The winner of the challenge receives a significant advantage in the next pressure test and is safe from elimination. Then, during the pressure test, contestants team up in pairs as they replicate an elaborate party platter.

episodes.title: The Restaurant Takeover
episodes.description: In the next team challenge, the Top 6 home cooks face the wildly popular restaurant takeover. Each team must complete two appetizer and two entree dishes for the dining guests in a downtown Los Angeles restaurant. The winning team is safe from elimination, while the losing team members face the next pressure test, in which they prep, cook, and plate three different pasta dishes. Find out who can't stand the heat of the restaurant kitchen and who moves on to the Top 5.

episodes.title: Return of the Champions
episodes.description: In the next mystery box challenge, the Top 5 home cooks must create a dish using pear, blue cheese, tomato, portabella mushroom, and chocolate. The winner receives both safety from elimination and the power to choose among 4 baskets of ingredients for the elimination challenge, baskets that were put together with the help of the 3 former MasterChef winners.

episodes.title: Think Inside the Box
episodes.description: The 4 remaining contestants use special ingredients from Gordon and Graham in the next team challenge. Each team must create a unique appetizer and entrée, and create them 3 times. The losing pair face a pressure test in which they must recreate judge Christina Tosi's world-famous Chocolate Malted Layer Cake to see who rounds out the Top 3.

episodes.title: Team Gordon Ramsay
