episodes.description: Athena and the 118 race to the rescue when a fading movie star is plagued by a series of near death experiences.

episodes.title: What's Your Fantasy?
episodes.description: The 118 race to the rescue to a renaissance faire; then an office building. when an overbearing boss is poisoned; Athena fears for May's life when she encounters a disturbed young man; Uncle Buck babysits young Jee-Yun as Maddie and Chimney begin house-hunting; Eddie and Carla prepare Christopher for his first school dance.

episodes.title: Red Flag
episodes.description: The Santa Ana winds bring in a variety of weirder-than-usual emergencies as the 118 respond to a family dog retrieving a severed hand and a young woman sleep-driving into the station. Bobby worries about his AA sponsor; Denny questions Hen and Karen about his biological parents; and Chimney thinks he's found the perfect house for him and Maddie.

episodes.title: In a Flash
episodes.description: A dry thunderstorm rolls over LA, bringing in a series of lightning strike emergencies for the 118 and leaves a first responder's life hanging in the balance. Athena and May go undercover at the rehab facility to help Bobby with his investigation into his sponsor's mysterious death. Maddie dreads her parents visit to her and Chimney's new and unfinished house, while Chimney gets a surprise of his own from a visiting Albert.

episodes.title: In Another Life
episodes.description: As Buck's life hangs in the balance, he dreams of a world where he never became a firefighter, for better and worse.

episodes.title: Recovery
episodes.description: Despite the case being closed, Bobby is determined to prove his AA sponsor was murdered and bring his killer to justice. Meanwhile Buck struggles with his post-traumatic stress.

episodes.title: Mixed Feelings
episodes.description: The 118 race to the rescues with emergencies at a spin class; in a hair salon and to a husband and wife in a compromising position; Buck discovers new cognitive abilities post lightning strike; Hen and Karen are concerned when they find out Denny has been seeing his biological father behind their backs; Maddie and Chimney enlist Athena and Bobby's help with a suspicious neighbor.

episodes.title: Performance Anxiety
episodes.description: The 118 race to the rescue at emergencies at a commercial bakery and a bodybuilding competition; Bobby's annual performance reviews sends Chimney to the firefighter academy where he runs into a familiar face; Eddie's aunt gets involved in his personal life; Maddie helps a nervous teen suffering a panic attack.

episodes.title: Death and Taxes
episodes.description: The 118 race to the rescue at emergencies when a fire breaks out in an accountant's office and a car crashes into a "living funeral." Athena is shocked when a suspect dies in her custody minutes after she arrests him; Buck is attracted to a death doula; Maddie and Chimney panic when they are audited by the IRS.

episodes.title: Lost & Found
episodes.description: The 118 race to rescue two roommates desperately trying to find a needle in a haystack at a landfill, and help a woman whose nightmare dream suddenly becomes a painful reality. Athena and Maddie team-up to find a missing boy in a crowded mall; Chimney debates if the time is right to propose to Maddie.

episodes.title: Love Is in the Air
episodes.description: Athena and the 118 race to rescue when a wedding proposal tragically intersects with a bank robbery, and then when a princess bride is literally stuck on her way to the altar. Athena talks a victim through her grief; Maddie takes matters into her own hands as Buck finds a surprise visitor on his doorstep.

episodes.title: Pay It Forward
episodes.description: A series of freeway car accidents leads to a catastrophic overpass collapse that endangers the lives of civilians and members of the 118.

episodes.title: Abandon Ships
episodes.description: Athena and Bobby set off on their honeymoon cruise, but when duty calls, their vacation is put on hold. Meanwhile, a fighter jet traps a civilian, and an unusual incident leaves a couple stuck together.

episodes.title: Rock the Boat
episodes.description: The disastrous cruise continues when Bobby and Athena respond to the ship’s explosion, racing to aid injured passengers. Meanwhile, Hen questions her instincts in a life-taking call and grows concerned about Athena and Bobby’s whereabouts.

episodes.title: Capsized
episodes.description: With each moment becoming critical as the ship is flipped upside down, Athena and Bobby take charge, seeking methods for rescue while navigating efforts to guide survivors to safety. Meanwhile, Hen defies protocols in her search for Bobby and Athena.

episodes.title: Buck, Bothered and Bewildered
episodes.description: Upon her return to shore, Athena's son, Harry, finds himself in trouble with the law. Meanwhile, Buck grows envious as Eddie forms a close bond with someone else, and the 118 rescue a woman who's stuck on receiving a rose at an iconic mansion.

episodes.title: You Don't Know Me
episodes.description: Hen and Karen welcome a new addition to their family, while a call unfolds involving a person's limb that's taken on a mind of its own. Meanwhile, Eddie and Marisol take a closer look at their relationship, and Buck navigates his new feelings.

episodes.title: There Goes the Groom
episodes.description: After years of anticipation, Maddie and Chimney's long-awaited wedding day arrives. However, when the groom mysteriously vanishes, the 118 races against time to ensure he doesn't miss the most crucial day of his life.

episodes.title: Ghost of a Second Chance
episodes.description: Maddie and Athena investigate a case surrounding an abducted mother and child as Hen and Karen learn more about Mara's family history. Meanwhile, Eddie grapples with unresolved feelings for someone from his past.

episodes.title: Step Nine
episodes.description: After a victim of the apartment fire that changed Bobby's life resurfaces, he searches to make amends. Driven by his need to right past wrongs, Bobby delves deep into memories of his childhood, unearthing moments from his fractured past.

episodes.title: Ashes, Ashes
episodes.description: The 118 and Tommy are presented with the Medal of Valor for their work on the cruise ship rescue. Meanwhile, Hen and Karen encounter an unforeseen hurdle in their foster care journey, while Eddie’s emotional affair develops further.

episodes.title: All Fall Down
episodes.description: Following the devastating fire at the Nash home, Bobby's fate remains uncertain, while Athena embarks on a mission to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, Hen and Karin engage in a heated custody battle, while Christopher grapples with forgiving Eddie.

episodes.title: Buzzkill
episodes.description: The 118 team battles an "un-bee-lievable" emergency when a trailer with millions of bees crashes on the streets of Los Angeles, unleashing a swarm.

episodes.title: When the Boeing Gets Tough...
episodes.description: Athena is tasked with safely delivering a prisoner to testify on a high-profile case. Meanwhile, a light plane is hit by a swarm of bees and sent careening into a passenger plane.

episodes.title: Final Approach
episodes.description: Athena's only chance of surviving and saving everyone on the flight is to attempt to land the plane before it crashes and call on the 118 for help.

episodes.title: No Place Like Home
episodes.description: When it finally looks like Hen and Karen may get their foster license back, they are hit with another obstacle. Meanwhile, the 118 races to the aid of a cheerleader involved in an infield collision.

episodes.title: Masks
episodes.description: The 118 is once again working on the spookiest night of the year and missing out on all the tricks and treats. Meanwhile, Buck's Halloween decorations become a little scarier than he had hoped.

episodes.title: Confessions
episodes.description: When a toddler falls down a pipe and becomes trapped, the 118 must rely on more than their skills to rescue him. Meanwhile, old wounds are opened when members of the 118 race to the aid of a man dealing with a divorce.

episodes.title: Hotshots
episodes.description: When Athena is assigned a rookie to mentor, she begins to question her own abilities. Meanwhile, Bobby and the 118 return to the set of "HOT SHOTS" following a 911 call.

episodes.title: Wannabes
episodes.description: Things get messy for the 118 following a massive pipe explosion. Meanwhile, Athena investigates the brutal beating of a man found behind a grocery store, and Bobby's working relationship with Brad from "HOT SHOTS" just got a little more intimate.

episodes.title: Sob Stories
episodes.description: The 118 responds to a fire at a local animal shelter and races to evacuate all the animals. Meanwhile, Maddie takes a 9-1-1 call that sets her on a quest for answers.

episodes.title: Voices
episodes.description: Following Maddie's mysterious 9-1-1 call, Chimney returns home to find his daughter alone and Maddie nowhere to be found; he then enlists Athena and Romero to help investigate.

episodes.title: Holy Mother of God
episodes.description: The 118 responds to a call at a mega-church, where Bobby runs into his estranged mother. Also, the 118 unexpectedly uncover hidden secrets at a garden rescue, Buck attempts to expand his social circle in the wake of losing Eddie, and Athena gets called away to assist on a high stakes case on a cruise ship called The Odyssey.

episodes.title: Disconnected
episodes.description: Maddie's return to work proves to be more triggering than expected, as she may have returned too soon. As Eddie struggles to adapt to his new surroundings, Christopher discovers him in an unfamiliar situation.

episodes.title: Invisible
episodes.description: After the 118 responds to several calls from the same person, Hen steps in to offer them advice. Meanwhile, Eddie confronts his parents and takes a big step in his relationship with his son.

episodes.title: Sick Day
episodes.description: In part one of a two-part episode, the 118 is called to a research lab that has been set on fire and becomes a biohazard.

episodes.title: Lab Rats
episodes.description: Athena and Buck are in a race against time to rescue the rest of the 118 following the fire in the bio lab.

episodes.title: The Last Alarm
episodes.description: Following the tragic events at the lab, the 118 must come together to lay their fallen hero to rest. Meanwhile, despite her own grief, Athena re-investigates the death of a child to help a grieving mother.

episodes.title: Don't Drink the Water
episodes.description: Following an earthquake, the 118 races to the scene of several unusual fires and must figure out their cause before anyone else is hurt. Meanwhile, as everyone settles into their new normal, they try to move forward and plan for the future.

episodes.title: Seismic Shifts
episodes.description: The 118, still reeling from their recent loss, is dispatched to a mass casualty event after a high-rise apartment building collapses. Then, Athena and Chimney have to work together to save a familiar face.

episodes.title: Eat the Rich
episodes.description: In honor of Bobby Nash's sacrifice, the 118 comes together to dedicate the firehouse in his memory. Meanwhile, when a billionaire tech giant is involved in a life-or-death emergency, the team must race to his aid.

episodes.title: Spiraling
episodes.description: As a geostorm ravages Earth, Athena and Hen's space mission teeters on the edge; on the ground, the 118 battles chaos when technology goes rogue.

episodes.title: The Sky Is Falling
episodes.description: Athena and Hen face increasing dangers in space as friends both near and far try to get them home safely. Meanwhile, the 118 continues to help victims of the geostorm and falling debris.

episodes.title: Reentry
episodes.description: As Athena and Hen navigate their way back home, Athena will be forced to confront what it means to live without Bobby.

episodes.title: Día de los Muertos
episodes.description: The 118's beliefs are put to the test as they respond to emergency calls involving a Jack-o'-lantern and a few more jump scares than they were expecting on Halloween.

episodes.title: Family History
episodes.description: Athena revisits a painful part of her past while responding to a call, and Buck coaches Harry as he prepares for the firefighter CPAT test.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.description: Hen's attempts at keeping her mysterious health issues private are starting to impact more than just her physical well-being. Meanwhile, Buck and Ravi decide Eddie needs a night out on the town.

episodes.title: War
episodes.description: Following Hen's firing, Chimney grapples with his decision and how it has affected the team. Meanwhile, a new AI call center assistant, meant to help, has begun to create more complications, and the 118 must intervene.

episodes.title: Fighting Back
episodes.description: As Hen continues to seek out a diagnosis for her mysterious symptoms, her friends and family rally behind her. Meanwhile, Harry hits a wall in his attempts to complete the academy firefighting exam and looks for some much-needed motivation.

episodes.title: Handle with Care
episodes.description: Harry's first day as a probie proves to be more challenging than Chimney expects. Meanwhile, Eddie and Hen are called into court over a former patient that brings back some old demons.

episodes.title: Going Once, Going Twice
episodes.description: Eddie faces an unthinkable personal crisis. Hen and Karen spring into action when thrown into a terrifying situation. The 118 hosts a LAFD charity bachelor auction that brings up a few concerns from Buck.

episodes.title: Dads and Cads
episodes.description: Maddie and Buck are blindsided by some unexpected news that turns their world upside down. Meanwhile, Buck and Eddie head to Nashville when they are selected to participate in the national firefighting games.

episodes.title: Mother's Boy
episodes.description: Eddie and Buck's flight back to Los Angeles is cancelled following the National Firefighter Games. Hoping to be home for Hen's birthday, they decide a cross-country road trip is the fastest way, until they get offtrack and Buck goes missing.

episodes.title: D.I.Y.
episodes.description: As Buck tries to manage the trauma following his kidnapping on his own, May tries to secure her first law internship without the help of her mother. Then, Maddie handles a personal crisis at the call center.

episodes.title: Pick Your Poison
episodes.description: Athena is pulled into a mysterious murder investigation when a man arrives at the station to report his own death. Meanwhile, the 118 races to the site of a car crash involving a mother and son.

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke
episodes.description: The 118 must account for every decision made during a recent fire call when the team's actions are investigated for possible mistakes. Meanwhile, Buck works behind the scenes to support his team as he waits to learn if he can return to the station.

episodes.title: I Got You Babe
episodes.description: Buck is faced with his past after an electrical emergency call. Meanwhile, Maddie learns to navigate her working relationships now that she has become a supervisor.

episodes.title: Hearts and Flowers
episodes.description: Following Athena's shooting, the 118 gathers at the hospital awaiting news. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind the trafficking ring is determined to silence Athena and anyone who gets in his way for good.

episodes.title: That Sinking Feeling
episodes.description: The 118 faces an earth-shattering emergency that shakes the city of Los Angeles to its core. Still finding her footing as a detective, Athena leans on instinct to crack a mysterious new case, while May finds her own confidence in a new job.

episodes.title: Fire in the Hole
episodes.description: As lava takes over Los Angeles, the 118 works to evacuate scared and trapped citizens. Meanwhile, Athena runs into a familiar face as she searches for a way out of a collapsed tunnel, and Maddie is forced to make an impossible decision.

episodes.title: Streets of Fire
episodes.description: In the wake of the volcanic eruption, Maddie and the 118 race to divert a river of lava before it consumes a packed hospital. Athena, still trapped underground, faces a massive obstacle that cuts her off from any chance of calling for help.

episodes.title: Imposter Syndrome
episodes.description: Buck and Eddie's friendship is at odds following their argument over Theo. Meanwhile, the 118 races to the scene of an accident that has been complicated by a good Samaritan.

episodes.title: Who's Your Daddy?
episodes.description: The 118 races to help a father and son after a harrowing tree-mulcher accident. Meanwhile, Athena and Newell work to crack a puzzling homicide case, Buck weighs how best to support Theo, and a life-or-death decision tests Chimney's family ties.

episodes.title: Et Tu?
episodes.description: The 118 races to diffuse a potentially catastrophic situation on the streets of Los Angeles as Athena is called in for questioning following the death of Detective Ben Hooks.

episodes.title: Curse of the Swamp Monster
episodes.description: What caused a Baltimore street to collapse onto a railroad? How did engineers fix London’s wobbly Millennium Footbridge? Experts and witnesses analyse what happened.

episodes.title: Nightmare in Florida
episodes.description: In San Francisco, California, residents in a luxury apartment block noticed their floor wasn't flat. Experts and witnesses analyse what happened to the building.

episodes.title: Curse of the Devil's Dam
episodes.description: Once considered the eighth Wonder of the World, the Kinzua Bridge was the longest railway bridge in the world. But, a freak tornado destroyed it - why did it fall?

episodes.title: Terror in Tacoma
episodes.description: What epic engineering error caused flooding in Chicago? Plus, on the east coast of the UK, residents seek a solution for their houses that are falling onto the beach.

episodes.title: Crash of the Titan
episodes.description: What architectural error ruined a Paris landmark? Plus, in Dallas, Texas, soaring temperatures and sunrays blaze and reflect into high-rise apartment building.

episodes.title: Houston's Hurricane Hell
episodes.description: What Scottish landmark has a limited timespan with risky consequences? Also, in Liverpool on New Year's Eve a huge fire broke out in a carpark - what happened?

episodes.title: Chicago's Tower of Terror
episodes.description: In Maryland, an aging and crumbling sewage system wreaks havoc in Baltimore. Experts and witnesses analyse what caused the major environmental and health problem.

episodes.title: Boston's Big Dig Disaster
episodes.description: The Big Dig in Boston was a massive infrastructure build that would take a freeway that was blight on the city and put it underground, but a tragic accident raises concerns about its safety. A new bridge in Wales collapses before it is even completed, is it an issue with design or construction? A dam in Spain collapses, devastating a region. A Milwaukee bridge begins to sag and debris is seen falling from it without any warning.

episodes.title: Olympic Stadium Fiasco
episodes.description: America's first space station threatens to fall to earth. And, a miscalculation means strong winds could cause a New York skyscraper to topple over. What happened?

episodes.title: Deepwater Disaster
episodes.description: Why did an apartment block in Liverpool resist demolition? And, how did an engineering mix-up in Bristol derail a new bus route? Experts examine what happened.

episodes.title: Mayhem in Minneapolis
episodes.description: In 1973, the Aon Center became the tallest marble-clad building in the world. Years later, Chicago's extreme weather would turn its beautiful exterior into a death-trap.

episodes.title: Sinkhole at the Museum
episodes.description: What caused the collapse of a Corvette museum in Kentucky, the catastrophic failure of a bridge under construction in Melbourne, Australia, earthquakes in a Oklahoma town and the sudden collapse of a longstanding bridge in Northern Ontario

episodes.title: Calamity Comes to Canada
episodes.description: In Florida, homes are swallowed whole as a giant sinkhole opens up. And in the Netherlands, why did a brand-new airport parking garage suddenly collapse?

episodes.title: Nightmare in New Orleans
episodes.description: Why do a hotel in New Orleans and two elevated pedestrian campus walkways in North Carolina tragically collapse during construction. What causes a wind turbine to self destruct in Denmark, a pioneer in the use of commercial wind power.

episodes.title: Oklahoma Freeway Free-fall
episodes.description: What mistakes caused a tragic bridge collapse in Oklahoma, a dam failure in England that threatened an entire town, a catastrophic grain elevator explosion near New Orleans and a fatal runaway train crash in Australia.

episodes.title: Kansas City Skywalk Disaster
episodes.description: The tragic collapse of a sky-walk in a Kansas City Hotel is one of America's greatest engineering disasters, a deadly sinkhole in the middle of a San Antonio street is a result of a deteriorating infrastructure, an innovative student centre in Sheffield is demolished before it is completed and a highway interchange in Iowa is seeing increased congestion and more accidents.

episodes.title: Suez Canal Catastrophe
episodes.description: A single massive cargo ship is grounded and blocking the Suez Canal causing a major impact to world trade. A Canberra highway overpass collapses during construction. A sinkhole in suburban Pennsylvania suddenly opens up swallowing a moving car on camera. A vital bridge on a key New Orleans evacuation route, is found to have a corrosion problem with its cables during an inspection following the collapse of another bridge.

episodes.title: Dallas Demolition Disaster
episodes.description: What went wrong with a deadly rush hour bridge collapse in Minneapolis, a controlled building demolition in Dallas, a fatal rail collision on a mixed use bridge in Denmark and a dam failure in Iowa which threatened a small town.
A revolutionary floating bridge in Washington sinks into the bottom of a lake. And, an engineering disaster in the Gulf of Mexico causes a global crisis.
In Montreal, a vital highway crossing collapses, with tragic consequences. And, an engineering catastrophe hits a legendary space mission more than 300,000km from earth.

episodes.title: San Francisco Freeway Fire
episodes.description: Catastrophe strikes in the heart of Minnesota. In Denmark, a railway tragedy exposes a security breach that affects the whole of Europe.

episodes.title: Arizona Railroad Inferno
episodes.description: A rail bridge and train in Arizona burst into flames, in Los Angeles the unique design of the Disney Concert Hall causes for its neighbours, a sinkhole in Ohio swallows a car and its driver, and in Sweden an innovative ship design sinks.

episodes.title: Cincinnati Demolition Disaster
episodes.description: The demolition of a highway overpass in Ohio collapses tragically, but could have been much worse. A massive reservoir dam failure near Los Angeles was one of the worst civil engineering disasters in American history. A bridge in Italy that stood for over a century collapses suddenly. Bricks begin to fall from the worlds tallest academic library at the University of Massachusetts Amherst.

episodes.title: Atlantic City Casino Collapse
episodes.description: A tragic bridge crash in Sweden, a rushed parking garage build for an Atlantic City casino costs lives, a reservoir in Los Angeles on unstable ground leads to disaster, a very tall building in Chicago is reconfigured to prevent turbulence.

episodes.title: Pennsylvania Ice Flood
episodes.description: A landmark bridge in Pennsylvania suddenly swept away by ice, a five story Brooklyn condo under construction tragically collapses, a chasm suddenly opens in a hospital parking lot in Naples, a vital elevated roadway in London is at risk.

episodes.title: Italian Railway Debacle
episodes.description: A deadly highway bridge collapse in Pennsylvania leads to changes to in the inspection process. A construction crane is captured collapsing during the construction of an elevated rail line in Italy. A Boston high-rise apartment building tragically collapses during construction. Another bridge collapse during construction over a rail line in Sweden narrowly avoids disaster.

episodes.title: Texas Fertilizer Catastrophe
episodes.description: Catastrophe strikes one of America's most important intersections.

episodes.title: Miami's Condo Catastrophe
episodes.description: A Florida beachfront condominium tragically collapses over night, the Golden Gate Bridge is making a loud howling noise after a safety upgrade, a large hole opens up in the centre of Canada's capital, an historic London bridge may collapse

episodes.title: Jacksonville's Parking Garage Disaster
episodes.description: In Sweden, a historic bridge is destroyed in seconds.

episodes.title: Memphis Bridge of Doom
episodes.description: In Italy, a vital bridge comes crashing dawn.

episodes.title: Texas Oil Port Inferno
episodes.description: A desert bridge is washed away stranding thousands, a massive refinery explosion costs many lives and brings change to an entire industry, a probe sent to Mars mysteriously loses contact, a tiny flaw in a bridges design leads to tragedy.

episodes.title: Manhattan Crane Chaos
episodes.description: In New York a crane constructing a replacement pair of bridges collapses on the current bridge narrowly avoiding serious injuries, a 2,000 ft TV tower in Texas tragically collapses during installation, a vital fresh water pipeline for Boston bursts effecting two million residents and a stadium in Sweden is in danger of collapse during a concert because of the concert goers.

episodes.title: Bay Area Bridge of Mayhem
episodes.description: An incredible highway interchange fire in the Bay area of California, a controlled Hospital demolition in Canberra that tragically wasn't, a multi-purpose arena near Chicago's O'Hare airport collapses, and a terrible freeway in Michigan.

episodes.title: Miami's Condo Catastrophe
episodes.description: A Florida beachfront condominium tragically collapses over night, the Golden Gate Bridge is making a loud howling noise after a safety upgrade, a large hole opens up in the centre of Canada's capital, an historic London bridge may collapse

episodes.title: Texas Oil Port Inferno
episodes.description: A desert bridge is washed away stranding thousands, a massive refinery explosion costs many lives and brings change to an entire industry, a probe sent to Mars mysteriously loses contact, a tiny flaw in a bridges design leads to tragedy.

episodes.title: Manhattan Crane Chaos
episodes.description: In New York a crane constructing a replacement pair of bridges collapses on the current bridge narrowly avoiding serious injuries, a 2,000 ft TV tower in Texas tragically collapses during installation, a vital fresh water pipeline for Boston bursts effecting two million residents and a stadium in Sweden is in danger of collapse during a concert because of the concert goers.

episodes.title: Bay Area Bridge Of Mayhem
episodes.description: An incredible highway interchange fire in the Bay area of California, a controlled Hospital demolition in Canberra that tragically wasn't, a multi-purpose arena near Chicago's O'Hare airport collapses, and a terrible freeway in Michigan.

episodes.title: Pacific Coast Bridge Collapse
episodes.description: Residents along the Pacific Coast Highway (California Highway 1) are cut off from the outside world after a 2017 storm caused the Pfeiffer Canyon Bridge near Big Sur to buckle. A German commuter train derails with many casualties. A tragic Las Vegas hotel fire results in improved safety standards. A hi-rise in Australia has to be evacuated due to structural cracks.

episodes.title: Island Observatory Failure
episodes.description: A high-rise construction project in Virginia collapses. In the UK, a rural roadway is destroyed, and a ship takes down a bridge in Georgia, USA.

episodes.title: Tower Crane Calamity
episodes.description: Why did a crane collapse in Manhattan and parking garage under construction in San Antonio. In San Francisco how do they prepare for the next earthquake after what happened in 1989. Finally why did Hitler's plan for rebuilding Berlin fail.

episodes.title: The Fern Hollow Fiasco
episodes.description: A bridge collapse in Pittsburgh, an explosion at a chemical plant in Nevada, a train derailment and bridge collapse in Australia and the collapse of a Nebraska animal feed plant- were they failures in design, construction or maintenance?

episodes.title: Nebraska Bomb Cyclone
episodes.description: In Germany, an alpine ice rink roof collapses in seconds. In Tennessee, a toxic wave washes through a community. In Nebraska, a dam loses to nature.

episodes.title: Art School Inferno
episodes.description: In New Zealand, flooding devastates a community. In Texas, there's a fatal leak at a chemical plant. In Nebraska, disaster strikes a titanic TV tower.

episodes.title: Gas Leak Catastrophe
episodes.description: In Nebraska, a massive explosion devastates a town. In Canada, catastrophe strikes a lakeside community. A bridge collapses in Tennessee.

episodes.title: The Bronx Sinkhole
episodes.description: In New York, a vast sinkhole swallows a van. In Puerto Rico, a massive blast rocks a community. In Glasgow, an explosion destroys a shopping arcade.

episodes.title: Shopping Center Tragedy
episodes.description: In Puerto Rico, an explosion rips through the capital city. In New Zealand, a bridge collapse sparks a desperate rescue mission.

episodes.title: Chemical Plant Calamity
episodes.description: In New Jersey, an inferno rages at the heart of a community. In New Zealand, a volcanic flood takes down a crucial rail bridge.

episodes.title: Neue Wege
episodes.description: U-boat Captain Ulrich Wrangel and his men are caught in battle with a US Frigate. Meanwhile, in occupied France, young Captain Klaus Hoffmann worries that he won't be able to live up to his famous father's reputation.

episodes.title: Geheime Missionen
episodes.description: Aboard U-612, the men are adjusting to their new lives. Meanwhile in La Rochelle, Simone struggles to piece together what happened the previous evening.

episodes.title: Verluste
episodes.description: As U-612 completes the first part of their mission, the crew is reeling from a tragic death. Meanwhile on land, Gluck organises a parade for the return of Captain Becker and his men.

episodes.title: Zweifel
episodes.description: Unity on U-612 has crumbled and Hoffman and Tennstedt's continued conflict could jeopardise the mission. On land, Simone wrestles with a difficult choice.

episodes.title: Loyalität
episodes.description: A surprise new arrival takes Greenwood's place, causing a divide. Plus, Carla and Simone grow closer and a resistance fighter arrives at the safe house.

episodes.title: Gegen die Zeit
episodes.description: Trapped below the angry, ominous rumble of a destroyer, the outlook is bleak for the crew of U-612. The inexperienced but eager young men wanted a battle, but they may have taken on more than they bargained for.

episodes.title: Verdammt
episodes.description: Forster reveals to Simone that U-612 has gone missing. Meanwhile, the resistance endanger the innocent to further their cause.

episodes.title: Abrechnung
episodes.description: The U-boat crew struggle with recent events and what lies ahead. A revelation in La Rochelle infuriates Forster spelling bad news for Simone.

episodes.title: Überlebensstrategien
episodes.description: December 1942: Submarine captain Johannes von Reinhartz receives an order for a secret mission. Simone is risking her life for a Jewish family. Hoffmann seeks justice and wants to leave New York.

episodes.title: Unbequeme Allianzen
episodes.description: Wrangel starts pursuing his rival Reinhartz with U-612. In New York, lawyer Berger receives information that could enable Hoffmann's return trip. Forster searches for the gold leaf.

episodes.title: Sabotage
episodes.description: While chasing U-822, Wrangel's frustration with his crew grows. Greenwood extorts more information from Hoffmann. Margot is stuck with the gold leaf in St. Rémy.

episodes.title: Die Würfel sind gefallen
episodes.description: In order to raise the mood on board, von Reinhartz invites his team to swim—with fatal consequences. Hoffmann trusts Cassandra. Margot finds an important ally in Duval.

episodes.title: Befehl zum Töten
episodes.description: Wrangel finally has U-822 in sight and now demands everything from his men. Von Reinhartz completely loses the backing of his team. Margot desperately tries to save Elias.

episodes.title: Letzte Entscheidungen
episodes.description: Wrangel and von Reinhartz struggle with their teams at sea. Hoffmann's situation in New York comes to a head. The Jewish families from La Rochelle are due to be transported to Poland.

episodes.title: Kopf an Kopf
episodes.description: Wrangel and von Reinhartz have a dramatic battle on the Atlantic. Margot is horrified by a betrayal. The seriously injured Hoffmann asks Cassandra to leave the city with him.

episodes.title: Auf der anderen Seite
episodes.description: Despite injury, Hoffmann made it to the agreed meeting point. In order to save the gold leaf from being transported, Margot implements her risky plan. U-822 approaches the US coast.

episodes.title: Eine zweite chance
episodes.description: Spring 1943: L.I. Ehrenberg prepares submarines for use in Kiel. Minors are recruited as crews. Wilhelm Hoffmann attends a reception at the request of his son-in-law.

episodes.title: Neue befehle
episodes.description: Forster is investigating the village man murder case in Lisbon. In Kiel, the new sailors of the U-949 get into battle. Royal Navy captain Swinburne is travelling to Liverpool for his son's funeral service.

episodes.title: Das Blatt wendet sich
episodes.description: The U-949 is in danger during a test drive due to Commander Buchner's orders. Forster comes across a trail in a casino and makes the acquaintance of the German Bettina Gruber.

episodes.title: Krieg mit anderen Mitteln
episodes.description: While Swinburne sets sail with a technologically upgraded ship, Ehrenberg makes a serious decision in Kiel. Forster has to create a traitor out of the country.

episodes.title: In die Tiefe
episodes.description: After Wilhelm Hoffmann learned the truth about his son Klaus, he gets into a fight with Hannie. Ehrenberg has to say goodbye to Greta. In Portugal, Forster's plan gets out of hand.

episodes.title: Eingekesselt
episodes.description: Swinburne's destroyer sinks two submarines on the Atlantic, then he hunts U-949. Forster observes a secret meeting between consul Gruber and the American Gardiner.

episodes.title: Der Feind meines Feindes
episodes.description: U-949 meets a Japanese boat to take over heavy cargo - gold. Wilhelm Hoffmann receives an invitation to Lisbon. Forster betrays Klaus Hoffmann under duress what he knows.

episodes.title: Narrengold
episodes.description: After a bomb explosion, Forster and Klaus Hoffmann hide with the Portuguese Ines, while Wilhelm Hoffmann arrives in Lisbon. U-949 is heading for their new destination.

episodes.title: Der Seemannspsalm
episodes.description: Klaus Hoffmann pursues the German agent Weiss and discovers valuable information. U-949 is under heavy fire from Swinburne's destroyer - until Commander Buchner dares a manoeuvre.

episodes.title: Ein richtiger U-Boot-Mann
episodes.description: The U-949 reaches Portugal and unloads the gold. When Ehrenberg returns to Kiel, he finds Greta with her husband again. Klaus Hoffmann and Forster reach their goal through blackmail.

episodes.title: Ein deutscher Held
episodes.description: August 1943: Franz Buchner is in action with the U-949. An informer on board divides his crew. The Hoffmann family gathers in Berlin to attend the premiere of a film about Klaus.

episodes.title: Ziel erfasst
episodes.description: Robert Ehrenberg supports the resistance within the Navy and gives Klaus Hoffmann a clue. Bobby Schulz is on his trail. U-949 comes under fire in the Strait of Gibraltar.

episodes.title: Hüter meines Bruders
episodes.description: Commander Buchner reaches the coast of Naples. Klaus Hoffmann is also on his way there. His sister Hannie meets twelve-year-old Hertha.

episodes.title: Frontlinien
episodes.description: Klaus Hoffmann commands the ailing U-330 on a secret dive, but not all the men trust him. Hannie wants to take Hertha in. Staff officer Heinrich Gluck has to make a decision.

episodes.title: Punkt ohne Wiederkehr
episodes.description: After a risky maneuver, the U-330 appears next to a US Navy ship. SS man Koch uncovers the identity of the spy "Fidelio". Hannie gets on the trail of the Lebensborn organization.

episodes.title: Nichts persönliches
episodes.description: Schulz kills with his own hand for the second time. Klaus Hoffmann has to realize that the Allied invasion is already underway. In Naples, a man with a murder mission is waiting.
On the way home from a party, the gang break into an abandoned house and find something that will change their lives forever. But is it so smart to flash the find to Noah's brother?
The guys start spending the money. But what is Zacke not told? And why does he have to stay home with Emma instead of going to a party?
Noah has arranged a surprise at the quarry and the guys plan for a black club. Emma and Zacke develop their relationship when Amir suddenly stops by.

It's time for the first big party in the desolate house. Amir wonders what it is Zacke does not want to talk about and who is coming to the party, the one Zacke hopes for or the one Noah least of all wants there?
Husband confronts Noah and Alva is suspicious at home. At school, Zacke escapes from Molly, but his problems do not disappear no matter how much he avoids them. What will his lies force him to do?

Zacke tries to get away from his problems and goes on an adventure with Sofia in Copenhagen. Amir and Alva both worry about Zacke and meet on a walk that never really wants to end. The guys are supposed to count the money but something is not right.
Noah confronts Manne. Amir gets more and more tired of Zacke's explanations and seeks him out but is instead invited by Alva.
There are an awful lot of people at the club and Amir feels that he is the only one who takes responsibility. Zacke super instead of keeping track of the Malmö gang when Manne also shows up.

When the police have left, the boys get an unpleasant surprise. Zacke has locked himself in his lies and goes to Malmö to try to put everything right. But back in Eslöv he gets to see something he could never have imagined.
Zacke is so angry with Amir that he misses his chance. The only one he wants to meet is Emma but what does she want? Will Zacke finally deal with his lies and can the boys ever forgive him?

episodes.title: Days Gone Bye
episodes.description: Rick searches for his family after emerging from a coma into a world terrorized by the walking dead. Morgan and Duane, whom he meets along the way, help teach Rick the new rules for survival.

episodes.title: Guts
episodes.description: Rick unknowingly causes a group of survivors to be trapped by walkers. The group dynamic devolves from accusations to violence, as Rick must confront an enemy far more dangerous than the undead.

episodes.title: Tell It to the Frogs
episodes.description: Rick makes a decision to go back to Atlanta to retrieve the bag of guns and save a man's life. Lori and Shane must deal with the surprising return of someone they thought was dead.

episodes.title: Vatos
episodes.description: Rick's mission to Atlanta is jeopardized when things go awry. Jim becomes unhinged in camp.

episodes.title: Wildfire
episodes.description: Rick leads the group to the CDC after the attack on the camp. Jim must make a terrible life and death decision.

episodes.title: TS-19
episodes.description: Rick and the group are allowed into the CDC by a strange doctor. But all is not what it seems in their newfound haven.

episodes.title: What Lies Ahead
episodes.description: After the CDC explosion, the survivors are still on the move when they encounter a herd of walkers that separates one of their own, leading them to a possible safe haven.

episodes.title: Bloodletting
episodes.description: Coming to the aid of another, Rick discovers a possible safe haven. Shane must go on a dangerous mission to get badly needed medical supplies.

episodes.title: Save the Last One
episodes.description: The group desperately awaits Shane's return. Shane finds himself trapped in a school, surrounded by the undead. Daryl and Andrea search for someone in the woods.

episodes.title: Cherokee Rose
episodes.description: Shane makes a deadly sacrifice which leads to unusual behavior and self-distancing. The rest of the group tries to hang on somewhere between living to die and dying to live.

episodes.title: Chupacabra
episodes.description: Glenn, the only one breaking barriers between both groups, knows far too much for his comfort level. Daryl finds a sign of life and, in his delirium, tries to make it back to the farm alive.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.description: Secrets are told and secrets are revealed. Hershel refuses to acknowledge the world’s new reality. Andrea comes out of her shell. Everyone is becoming more and more aware that “everything is food for something.”

episodes.title: Pretty Much Dead Already
episodes.description: Hershel sets a deadline. All secrets are out in the open. Glenn stands up for himself and Shane takes charge.

episodes.title: Nebraska
episodes.description: Rick and the others try to restore order in the aftermath of a terrible discovery. Hershel takes up an old habit and disappears, Rick and Glenn must follow him into town.

episodes.title: Triggerfinger
episodes.description: Trapped, Rick, Hershel and Glenn fight to survive against new foes, both dead and alive. Shane finds Lori in danger on the road and makes it his mission to bring her back to the farm.

episodes.title: 18 Miles Out
episodes.description: Rick and Shane come into conflict over the fate of an outsider. Andrea helps Hershel's youngest daughter face a crucial decision.

episodes.title: Judge, Jury, Executioner
episodes.description: Rick sides with Shane on an important decision, causing Dale to worry that the group is losing its humanity. Carl's actions have unintended consequences on the group.

episodes.title: Better Angels
episodes.description: The group learns that someone dangerous may be on the loose near the farm. As night falls, Rick, Shane, Daryl and Glenn comb the woods to handle the situation and keep the group safe.

episodes.title: Beside the Dying Fire
episodes.description: Rick and Carl return from the woods to find the farm in jeopardy. The group is split up in the ensuing chaos. With things looking grim, Rick’s leadership is questioned.

episodes.title: Seed
episodes.description: With the world growing increasingly more dangerous and Lori’s pregnancy advancing, Rick discovers a potentially safe haven. But first he must secure the premises, pushing his group to its limit.

episodes.title: Sick
episodes.description: After a traumatic event, a life hangs in the balance. Complicating matters, the group must also deal with a potential threat to their new surroundings.

episodes.title: Walk with Me
episodes.description: After witnessing an accident, Andrea and Michonne are introduced to a new community of survivors. As conflicts arise with their new acquaintances, a decision must be made.

episodes.title: Killer Within
episodes.description: The group is severed, placing lives in jeopardy. Merle has a request for the Governor. Meanwhile the prison doesn't seem to be a place as secure as they thought.

episodes.title: Say the Word
episodes.description: After another loss, Rick struggles. Michonne remains suspicious of the Governor as he throws a party with a unique twist for the people of Woodbury.

episodes.title: Hounded
episodes.description: As Andrea grows closer to the Governor, Michonne makes a decision about Woodbury. Glenn and Maggie go on a run. Rick struggles.

episodes.title: When the Dead Come Knocking
episodes.description: The Governor presses for information. A new guest arrives at the prison, forcing Rick's hand.

episodes.title: Made to Suffer
episodes.description: Andrea steps up when the people of Woodbury are thrown into uncharted territory. A new threat arises at the prison.

episodes.title: The Suicide King
episodes.description: After the invasion of Woodbury by Rick’s group, Daryl and Merle are captured by The Governor. Rick decides the fate of Tyreese’s group.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.description: As the group debates their next course of action, Rick wanders after a lost friend. After helping another group of survivors flee a group of walkers, Daryl and Merle begin to have second thoughts about leaving the prison. The Governor cedes leadership of Woodbury to Andrea and makes plans to punish those responsible for the chaos.

episodes.title: I Ain't a Judas
episodes.description: Rick and the group are forced to make a decision now that their safety is no longer guaranteed. Andrea feels uncomfortable now that Woodbury has become a police state.

episodes.title: Clear
episodes.description: Realizing they are heavily outgunned against the Governor's forces, Rick leads an expedition to get more weapons.

episodes.title: Arrow on the Doorpost
episodes.description: In an effort to prevent any more deaths, Rick and the Governor meet to come up with a peace treaty.

episodes.title: Prey
episodes.description: The Governor chases a dissenter who fled Woodbury. While the Governor is gone, a traitor tries to sabotage his upcoming plans.

episodes.title: This Sorrowful Life
episodes.description: Rick and the group are faced with a serious problem. If they want a truce with the Governor, they will have to make a huge sacrifice.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Tombs
episodes.description: Rick and the group have to seriously consider if the prison is worth defending as the Governor's impending attack looms over their heads.

episodes.title: 30 Days Without an Accident
episodes.description: Rick and the group are as close to an ideal life as possible at the prison. Will they be able to hold on to humanity in the face of a new evil?

episodes.title: Infected
episodes.description: As the group faces a brand new enemy, Rick and the others must fight to protect the livelihood they worked so hard to create at the prison.

episodes.title: Isolation
episodes.description: As one group leaves the prison in search for supplies at a local college, those who stay must deal with recent losses while preserving what remains.

episodes.title: Indifference
episodes.description: While on a supplies mission to a local college, members of the group run into multiple hurdles. Things at the prison are getting worse.

episodes.title: Internment
episodes.description: Multiple enemies put pressure on Rick and the group. Could this finally be the breaking point for the survivors and the prison?

episodes.title: Live Bait
episodes.description: A familiar face returns as each member of the group struggles to find his or her humanity in a world of constant threats.

episodes.title: Dead Weight
episodes.description: A new and scary chapter is unfolding at a camp outside the prison. Will peace be attainable with the addition of new members?

episodes.title: Too Far Gone
episodes.description: Just when everything started to calm down at the prison, Rick and his group now face imminent danger and destruction. This time, they might not win.

episodes.title: After
episodes.description: As Rick deals with old wounds, members of the prison have to come to terms with their new environment and ask themselves if survival alone is enough.

episodes.title: Inmates
episodes.description: The group encounters many obstacles in their quest to find stability and safety, but sometimes all they have to guide them is hope.

episodes.title: Claimed
episodes.description: Just when Rick thinks he's going to be able to relax, he's faced with multiple immediate threats. Other members of the group deal with their past.

episodes.title: Still
episodes.description: Faced with the day-to-day survival of life outside shelter, a simple request by someone in the group leads to a bizarre but enlightening mission.

episodes.title: Alone
episodes.description: As one group finds what may be an ideal shelter, another group comes to realize that the best protection comes from those around them.

episodes.title: The Grove
episodes.description: After finding an idyllic place to establish a new shelter, the group starts to question whether it is possible to go back to the way things were.

episodes.title: Us
episodes.description: However brutal some survivors believe they must be to stay alive, we get to see that faith can sometimes be the strongest survival tool.

episodes.title: A
episodes.description: As multiple paths collide, Rick comes face to face with sheer brutality. Will he and the group have what it takes to survive?

episodes.title: No Sanctuary
episodes.description: We learn the true motives of the Terminans as Rick and the group find themselves in a vulnerable situation.

episodes.title: Strangers
episodes.description: With supplies running low and not knowing whether to trust the people around them, Rick leads a mission where the risk might not be worth the reward.

episodes.title: Four Walls and a Roof
episodes.description: Rick and the group find themselves pitted against some very nasty people, but they might just have a plan to gain the upper hand.

episodes.title: Slabtown
episodes.description: Beth awakes in a hospital in the middle of Atlanta controlled by what's left of the police force. Now she must find a way out while being harassed by both the officer in charge, Dawn Lerner, and one of her deputies.

episodes.title: Self Help
episodes.description: A new set of issues confront our group while on a mission. Will they be able to push through and survive these challenges? Or better yet, each other?

episodes.title: Consumed
episodes.description: Cautiously, members of our group must venture into a familiar location on a heroic rescue mission. It's a huge stage, but so are the stakes.

episodes.title: Crossed
episodes.description: Between holding down the church and going on a rescue mission, our group is spread pretty thin. Is this going to be the breaking point?

episodes.title: Coda
episodes.description: Rick wants to find a peaceful agreement, but the enemies seem to prefer a more violent resolution.

episodes.title: What Happened and What's Going On
episodes.description: After all the recent trials the group has faced, a slight detour might prove to be the solution they've been looking for.

episodes.title: Them
episodes.description: Life on the road has left the group beaten and beleaguered. Will they be able to trudge along? Are they even the same people they once were?

episodes.title: The Distance
episodes.description: After withstanding a spectacular storm, Rick and the others meet what appears to be a friendly person, but find themselves mistrustful.

episodes.title: Remember
episodes.description: Molding into a new lifestyle is proving difficult for the group. Has life on the road proven too treacherous to go back to who they once were?

episodes.title: Forget
episodes.description: Rick and the group continue to acclimate to their new surroundings. Will they be able to go back to normalcy? Better yet, what is normal now?

episodes.title: Spend
episodes.description: While trying to secure their new home, Rick and his group face many challenges, some life threatening. Is this really the utopia it seems to be?

episodes.title: Try
episodes.description: The group realizes that sheltered life might not be possible as life within the walls starts to mimic life outside. Will these setbacks break Rick?

episodes.title: Conquer
episodes.description: Daryl experiences trouble on a run while Rick and his group continue to feel like outsiders in Alexandria, where trouble is creeping into the gates.

episodes.title: First Time Again
episodes.description: Rick and the group continue to have trouble assimilating into Alexandria. Multiple threats lead the community to adopt a mindset of hardness, while Rick's group must take a step back from the violence they've come to embrace.

episodes.title: JSS
episodes.description: When it appears that things are starting to normalize in the settlement, a new problem arises for the Alexandrians.

episodes.title: Thank You
episodes.description: Rick and his group get caught up in a dangerous little town on the road back to Alexandria. Meanwhile, Daryl, Sasha and Abraham continue to lead away the remaining walkers away from the safe-zone.

episodes.title: Here's Not Here
episodes.description: A new face appears; trust issues form.

episodes.title: Now
episodes.description: Following a number of setbacks, the mood in Alexandria grows grim for the sheltered citizens.

episodes.title: Always Accountable
episodes.description: Daryl, Abraham, and Sasha encounter many obstacles and a new threat while trying to return to Alexandria.

episodes.title: Heads Up
episodes.description: Alexandria is finally able to begin pulling itself back together; peace is embraced between the two groups.

episodes.title: Start to Finish
episodes.description: After having a few moments of peace, trouble finds its way to Alexandria yet again. Only this time, the threat might be too big to defeat.

episodes.title: No Way Out
episodes.description: While trying to escape Alexandria, Rick and his group meet trouble when sudden noise draws walkers towards them with what could be fatal consequences.

episodes.title: The Next World
episodes.description: A simple scavenging run proves to be more tricky, when the survivors are not the only ones after a goldmine of supplies.

episodes.title: Knots Untie
episodes.description: After Rick comes to the realization that Alexandria might not be as safe as he thought, decisions must be made about where to go from here.

episodes.title: Not Tomorrow Yet
episodes.description: Rick and the group realize the only way to maintain the peace of Alexandria is to fight a new enemy. However, this time, the group might be outmatched.

episodes.title: The Same Boat
episodes.description: With no hope of safety in Alexandria, Rick and his band of survivors soon discover a larger world with new dangers and new opportunities.

episodes.title: Twice as Far
episodes.description: Two separate groups leave Alexandria for supplies, and while both worry over the future of the community, they will face immediate danger.

episodes.title: East
episodes.description: Alexandria is alerted after realizing someone is missing. Several search parties will venture out, but what they find isn't what they're hoping for.

episodes.title: Last Day on Earth
episodes.description: In the aftermath of a tragic blow, Eugene falls captured by Dwight, a member of the Saviors, whom are hell bent on getting even with Alexandria, Negan teaches Rick and co a brutal lesson, which shows that Rick and co finally have something to fear.

episodes.title: The Day Will Come When You Won't Be
episodes.description: Having been brutally overpowered by Negan and his Saviors, Rick and the group kneel helplessly as they suffer heavy losses that will haunt them forever.

episodes.title: The Well
episodes.description: For a number of familiar faces, a new, well-established community seems too good to be true.

episodes.title: The Cell
episodes.description: A new group of survivors seem to have it all in their impressive community; however, there is a price.

episodes.title: Service
episodes.description: The remaining members of the group try to keep it together in Alexandria; they receive a sobering visit.

episodes.title: Go Getters
episodes.description: Saddled with grief and surrounded by enemies, members of the group try to find safety at the Hilltop before it's too late.

episodes.title: Swear
episodes.description: Someone stumbles upon a brand new society, and this society is unlike anything seen before.

episodes.title: Sing Me a Song
episodes.description: A deeper look at the Sanctuary and the world of the Saviors; members of Alexandria look for supplies.

episodes.title: Hearts Still Beating
episodes.description: Negan's unwelcome visit to Alexandria continues as other members scavenge for supplies; things quickly spin out of control.

episodes.title: Rock in the Road
episodes.description: Rick and the group are led to a new community where they are introduced to its inhabitants and ruler. A familiar face resurfaces.

episodes.title: New Best Friends
episodes.description: While searching for a missing Alexandrian, Rick and his group encounter a mysterious collective, its inhabitants unlike any they have come across.

episodes.title: Hostiles and Calamities
episodes.description: An Alexandrian discovers they must navigate the mysterious, confusing and terrifying world within the Saviors' compound.

episodes.title: Say Yes
episodes.description: The group scavenges for supplies; back in Alexandria, someone must make a morally challenging decision.

episodes.title: Bury Me Here
episodes.description: Things do not go as planned when a group of Kingdommers delivers goods to the Saviors during a routine supply drop-off.

episodes.title: The Other Side
episodes.description: The Saviors visit the Hilltop unexpectedly, surprising everyone, with plans of taking more than supplies.

episodes.title: Something They Need
episodes.description: A group of Alexandrians embarks on a journey to a distant community and one member of the group must make a heartbreaking decision.

episodes.title: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
episodes.description: In the season finale, the stakes keep mounting higher and higher as different stories from the season clash while the group enacts an intricate plan.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.description: Rick and his group, along with the Kingdom and Hilltop, have banded together to bring the fight to Negan and the Saviors.

episodes.title: The Damned
episodes.description: The plan involving Alexandrians, Kingdommers and Hilltoppers unfolds; as Rick continues to fight, he encounters a familiar face.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.description: Conflict with the Saviors leads to unintended consequences for the Hilltop, the Kingdom, and Alexandria; morality proves tricky in wartime.

episodes.title: Some Guy
episodes.description: A new weapon in the Savior arsenal proves to be a giant hurdle as fighting continues between Rick's forces and those of the Saviors.

episodes.title: The Big Scary U
episodes.description: With war raging all around him, we get a close look at Negan and the lives of the Saviors during the conflict through a familiar set of eyes.

episodes.title: The King, the Widow, and Rick
episodes.description: With things looking up for Rick and the group, an argument breaks out at the Hilltop, where the consequences of the decision are life versus death.

episodes.title: Time for After
episodes.description: Negan has to enlist the help of his lieutenants in solving a huge issue facing the Sanctuary; Rick and the group continue to enact the plan.

episodes.title: How It's Gotta Be
episodes.description: Every story and battle from the first half of the season comes crashing together in this action-packed, emotional mid-season finale.

episodes.title: Honor
episodes.description: Rick faces new difficulties after a battle. Meanwhile, the fight continues in other communities as core members face hard decisions.

episodes.title: The Lost and the Plunderers
episodes.description: Groups unite their forces and converge on the Hilltop; Aaron and Enid search for allies; Simon takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.title: Dead or Alive Or
episodes.description: Daryl finds himself in bad company as his group heads to the Hilltop; Maggie makes difficult decisions at the Hilltop; Gabriel's faith becomes tested.

episodes.title: The Key
episodes.description: Hilltop's leadership faces a difficult dilemma after the arrival of unexpected visitors; Rick comes face to face with an adversary.

episodes.title: Do Not Send Us Astray
episodes.description: Trouble arises when unexpected visitors arrive at the Hilltop and the community is thrust into action; heartbreaking discoveries are made.

episodes.title: Still Gotta Mean Something
episodes.description: A Heaps prisoner makes a discovery; Carol searches for someone in the nearby forest; Rick and Morgan find themselves in the company of strangers.

episodes.title: Worth
episodes.description: With the threat of the Saviors still looming, Aaron continues searching for allies; Daryl and Rosita take action and confront an old friend.

episodes.title: Wrath
episodes.description: The communities join forces in the last stand against the Saviors as all-out war unfolds.

episodes.title: A New Beginning
episodes.description: Rick and his group make a risky run into Washington, D.C. to search for artifacts they will need to build the civilization he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.description: The communities join forces to restore a bridge that will facilitate communication and trade; someone is gravely injured at the construction site.

episodes.title: Warning Signs
episodes.description: Rick's vision for the future is threatened by a mysterious disappearance that divides the work camp where the communities are building a bridge.

episodes.title: The Obliged
episodes.description: Rick's vision of a civilized future is threatened by a sudden reckoning with past sins that remain unavenged and unforgiven.

episodes.title: What Comes After
episodes.description: Rick is forced to face the past as he struggles to maintain the safety of the communities and protect the future he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.title: Who Are You Now?
episodes.description: The Survivors encounter unfamiliar faces outside the safety of their community's walls and must decide whether or not this new group can be trusted.

episodes.title: Stradivarius
episodes.description: Carol seeks out an old friend living alone in a wilderness teeming with walkers; survivors make the perilous trek to a new home.

episodes.title: Evolution
episodes.description: A small rescue mission braves a dangerous herd in their hunt for a missing comrade, only to discover a surprising threat that could doom them all.

episodes.title: Adaptation
episodes.description: The communities thought they could build a better future separately, but the recent loss of one of their own drives them to band together; new leaders rise when a disturbing and dangerous threat is unmasked; an escaped captive revisits his past.

episodes.title: Omega
episodes.description: A new arrival at the Hilltop opens up about the leader of a group of mask-wearing savages. A search party sets out on a daring mission to find two missing friends.

episodes.title: Bounty
episodes.description: The savage group led by Alpha confronts the Hilltop in a harrowing attempt to retrieve her daughter. A supply run for the Kingdom turns into a dangerous quest.

episodes.title: Guardians
episodes.description: While one community struggles to ease tensions that threaten to divide from within, the true nature of another group comes into focus; a mission to rescue a friend has deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Chokepoint
episodes.description: Daryl's daring rescue mission forces Alpha to unleash a group of her own to retrieve what belongs to her, even if the price is paid in blood; the Kingdom's plans to reunite the communities are put in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.description: An outsider's arrival forces Alexandria to rehash devastating old wounds; eye-opening secrets from the past are revealed.

episodes.title: The Calm Before
episodes.description: The fair at the Kingdom is underway, with all four communities coming together in celebration for the first time in years; while some pacts are renewed, other deals will come at a much steeper price.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.description: In the aftermath of an overwhelming loss, the communities must brave a ferocious blizzard; as one group deals with an enemy from within, another is forced to make a life or death decision.

episodes.title: Lines We Cross
episodes.description: The group in Oceanside continues to train in case the Whisperers return. Tensions are high as the heroes struggle to hold onto their concept of civilization.

episodes.title: We Are the End of the World
episodes.description: The origins of Alpha and Beta are revealed in a flashback; Alpha tries to help Lydia prepare for their journey with the dead; the Whisperers create herds.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.description: Alexandria is overcome with paranoia as the threat of the Whisperers looms; Carol struggles over her desperate urge for revenge.

episodes.title: Silence the Whisperers
episodes.description: Still paranoid Alexandrians get riled up over the Whisperers and take their fear out on Negan. The Hilltop group deals with an unexpected safety issue.

episodes.title: What It Always Is
episodes.description: Supplies go missing from Hilltop; Negan is idolized by an Alexandrian; Ezekiel holds a secret.

episodes.title: Bonds
episodes.description: Carol teams up with Daryl as they embark on a mission together; Siddiq finds it harder than expected to unravel a mystery.

episodes.title: Open Your Eyes
episodes.description: Daryl becomes uncomfortable when Carol starts going past his boundaries; Alpha and Beta share reservations about a certain individual.

episodes.title: The World Before
episodes.description: A fight causes tensions in Oceanside while the Alexandrians set out on a high-stakes mission.

episodes.title: Squeeze
episodes.description: The group must figure out how to get out of a precarious situation.

episodes.title: Stalker
episodes.description: The group must defend Alexandria from a threatening outside force.

episodes.title: Morning Star
episodes.description: The Whisperers are coming for Hilltop. After Daryl and Lydia's encounter with Alpha, the communities must decide whether to run or fight. Meanwhile, Eugene's communication with Stephanie gets complicated.

episodes.title: Walk with Us
episodes.description: Negan helps the Whisperers and Alpha launch an attack against the Hilltop.

episodes.title: What We Become
episodes.description: Michonne takes Virgil back to his island to find his family; in exchange, Virgil offers weapons.

episodes.title: Look at the Flowers
episodes.description: Heroes and villains reckon with the aftermath of the Hilltop fire. Eugene takes a group on a journey to meet Stephanie, with the hopes of befriending another civilization.

episodes.title: The Tower
episodes.description: The communities prepare to participate in the Whisperer War's last battle; Eugene's group comes face-to-face with Princess.

episodes.title: A Certain Doom
episodes.description: With the Whisperer War upon them, the collective communities must come together and possibly sacrifice all they have to find a way to silence the Whisperers once and for all.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Home
episodes.description: Maggie has returned with a story she is not ready to share, even when her past catches up to her. Negan's safety is at stake again. Daryl and Maggie fight an unseen and unknown threat.

episodes.title: Find Me
episodes.description: An adventure for Daryl and Carol turns sideways when they come across an old cabin. It takes Daryl back to the years when he left the group after Rick disappeared as he relives a time that only the apocalypse could manifest.

episodes.title: One More
episodes.description: Gabriel and Aaron search for food and supplies to bring back to Alexandria. Small tragedies lead to bigger tragedies as faith is broken and optimism is fragmented when they are put to the ultimate test.

episodes.title: Splinter
episodes.description: Eugene, Ezekiel, Yumiko, and Princess are captured and separated. Princess struggles with memories of her traumatic past and tries to escape one way or another with the help of Ezekiel.

episodes.title: Diverged
episodes.description: Daryl and Carol come to a fork in the road and head their separate ways. Each going into their own type of survival mode, the easiest of challenges become much harder. Will their individual journeys be the tipping point needed to mend their friendship or is the distance between them permanent?

episodes.title: Here's Negan
episodes.description: Carol takes Negan on a journey, hoping to minimize the increasing tension. Negan reflects on the events that led him to this point and comes to a conclusion about his future.

episodes.title: Acheron: Part 1
episodes.description: Returning to Alexandria from a critical food mission, the group realizes it isn't enough. Maggie proposes a new plan, potentially a suicide mission. What choice do they have? They must find more food for all their people in order to survive and efficiently rebuild Alexandria. If they don't, Alexandria falls, taking them down with it. Once on the road, a violent storm erupts forcing them underground into a subway tunnel. As nerves fray and suspicions increase, chaos ensues. The terror is relentless as our people get a glimpse of what Maggie and her group endured prior to returning to Alexandria. Meanwhile, those captured by the strange soldiers are relocated to another undisclosed location.

episodes.title: Acheron: Part 2
episodes.description: The group discovers a member did not make it to safety inside the subway car. Surrounded by walkers, going back out into the tunnel to search is a guaranteed death wish. All eyes are on Negan as the rule of survival shifts. It is no longer No Man Left Behind. The motto now is We Keep Going. With very little ammo and energy remaining, the group must ready themselves as the walkers have found a way inside the subway train. Meanwhile, Daryl is in his own intense hellish situation trying to find Dog and finding more than he expected; and Yumiko challenges the process at the Commonwealth outpost, which threatens her future and that of Eugene, Ezekiel, and Princess.

episodes.title: Hunted
episodes.description: Maggie's mission team gets separated and hunted by the Reapers; Carol, Rosita, Magna and Kelly attempt to catch horses for Alexandria; Judith, RJ, Hershel and Gracie cope with their parents going away.

episodes.title: Rendition
episodes.description: Daryl and Dog get captured by the Reapers; they are taken to the Meridian and reconnect with a familiar figure from their past.

episodes.title: Out of the Ashes
episodes.description: Alexandrians encounter Hilltop squatters; Eugene's group undergoes orientation at the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: On the Inside
episodes.description: Connie and Virgil hide in a house; Pope tests Daryl's loyalty; Kelly searches for Connie.

episodes.title: Promises Broken
episodes.description: Maggie learns a survival tactic from Negan; Eugene's group clears walkers; Daryl hunts with Leah.

episodes.title: For Blood
episodes.description: The Reapers defend Meridian from a herd; Alexandrians protect themselves from walkers in a storm.

episodes.title: No Other Way
episodes.description: Daryl, Maggie, Gabriel, Negan, and Elijah battle the Reapers for food. Meanwhile, Aaron and the Alexandrians must survive a storm.

episodes.title: New Haunts
episodes.description: Our heroes experience Halloween in the Commonwealth. Daryl and Rosita undergo military training, led by Mercer. Carol investigates Ezekiel's medical condition.

episodes.title: Rogue Element
episodes.description: Eugene looks for Stephanie after she mysteriously goes missing; Connie investigates a story on Trooper Davis; Carol helps Hornsby with a labor dispute at a drug farm.

episodes.title: The Lucky Ones
episodes.description: Aaron and Maggie meet Governor Pamela Milton as she tours Alexandria, Oceanside and Hilltop. Ezekiel finds himself lucky during a routine checkup. Eugene processes Max's story.

episodes.title: Warlords
episodes.description: Maggie, Lydia and Elijah help a stranger from another community called Riverbend; they run into Aaron, who tells them about a mission he embarked on with Gabriel as emissaries for the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: The Rotten Core
episodes.description: Maggie, Lydia and Elijah help Aaron and Gabriel on a mission; Daryl and Rosita pull a heist.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.description: Hornsby inspect the human carnage piled up at the Riverbend Apartment Complex. He knows it doesn't add up and he's determined to prove it one way or another. Taking things into their own hands, Daryl, Gabriel, Aaron, and Maggie try to stay one step ahead of him. As secret are revealed, boundaries are pushed and an unexpected new job is offered. Ezekiel, too, has a secret of his own; one he hopes to share with Carol

episodes.title: Acts of God
episodes.description: In the very last mid-season finale for The Walking Dead, our heroes are trapped in situations beyond their control. Everyone they've worked so hard to protect is at risk as danger baits them at every turn. All is at stake. Now, they must decide who and what are worth saving. Each decision comes with its own deadly ramifications. Meanwhile, Eugene and Max's relationship deepens, but so does the trouble that is brewing inside the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: Lockdown
episodes.description: Daryl and Negan rush to the Commonwealth to stop Hornsby from going after their families. Pamela deals with protestors demanding justice for Sebastian's crimes. Mercer needs Rosita's help to fight a swarm.

episodes.title: A New Deal
episodes.description: Carol makes a deal with Pamela to wipe the slate clean on behalf of her friends. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia and Elijah get on the road to Oceanside to fill them in on a plan. The Commonwealth celebrates Founders Day.

episodes.title: Variant
episodes.description: Eugene goes on the run, and Mercer is tasked to find him; Aaron's group faces a complication on the road.

episodes.title: What's Been Lost
episodes.description: Daryl and Carol investigate the whereabouts of their friends after Pamela disappeared them from the Commonwealth. Unfortunately, their only lead is Hornsby. Meanwhile, Pamela asks Yumiko to prosecute Eugene on behalf of the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: Outpost 22
episodes.description: Separated from their children, Maggie, Gabriel, and Rosita track a military convoy to a mysterious destination. Ezekiel, Kelly, Negan, and Annie find themselves at a work site. Daryl and Carol follow a train that has taken Connie aboard.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.description: Ezekiel and Negan team up to lead a clandestine labor revolt against the warden. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah catch up with Luke and Jules fleeing Oceanside. Eugene stands trial with Yumiko as his defense attorney.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.description: The Alexandrians and the prisoners head back to the Commonwealth to confront Pamela Milton. Meanwhile, a swarm approaches the city.

episodes.title: Rest in Peace
episodes.description: Daryl and Carol rush Judith to the hospital; Rosita, Eugene, and Gabriel search for Coco; Maggie and Negan take arms against Pamela; the heroes assemble for one last stand.
